entry.summary: Presents FunFuzz, a multi-island evolutionary fuzzing framework that uses LLMs to generate structured test inputs. Uses parallel isolated searches with periodic migration of high-value candidates to maintain diversity, with feedback-guided prompt adaptation.

entry.title: SparseContrast: Dynamic Sparse Attention for Efficient and Accurate Contrastive Learning in Medical Imaging

author.name: Paarth Prasad, Ruchika Malhotra

entry.summary: Proposes SparseContrast, combining dynamic sparse attention with contrastive learning for medical imaging (chest X-ray disease detection), reducing computational burden by selectively focusing on diagnostically relevant areas.

entry.title: Neighbor2Inverse: Self-Supervised Denoising for Low-Dose Region-of-Interest Phase Contrast CT

author.name: Johannes B. Thalhammer, Lorenzo D'Amico, Lucy Costello, Sebastian Peterhansl, Daniel Frey, Tina Dorosti, Florian Schaff, Jannis Ahlers, Ronan Smith, Marcus Kitchen, Franz Pfeiffer, Martin Donnelley, Daniela Pfeiffer, Kaye S. Morgan

entry.summary: Introduces Neighbor2Inverse, a self-supervised denoising framework for low-dose X-ray phase-contrast CT that generalizes to clinical CT, building on Neighbor2Neighbor principles adapted for the inverse problem of PBI-CT.

entry.title: WILD SAM: A Simulated-and-Real Data Augmentation for Autonomous Driving Perception under Challenging Weather

author.name: Hamed Khatounabadi, Xiaohu Lu, Hayder Radha

entry.summary: Proposes WILD (Weather-Induced pseudo Label Denoising) framework and SAM-based data augmentation for autonomous driving perception under adverse weather, combining simulated and real data to address weather-induced domain shift.

entry.title: TT4D: A Pipeline and Dataset for Table Tennis 4D Reconstruction From Monocular Videos

author.name: Nima Rahmanian, Daniel Kienzle, Thomas Gossard, Dvij Kalaria, Rainer Lienhart, Shankar Sastry

entry.summary: Presents TT4D, a large-scale table tennis 4D reconstruction dataset with 140+ hours of reconstructed gameplay from monocular broadcast videos, featuring 3D ball positions, spin, time segmentation, and 3D human meshes.

entry.title: CUE: Concept-Aware Multi-Label Expansion to Mitigate Concept Confusion in Long-Tailed Learning

author.name: Ruichi Zhang, Chikai Shang, Jiacheng Yang, Mengke Li, Yang Zhou, Junlong Gao, Yang Lu

entry.summary: Proposes CUE, a concept-aware multi-label expansion approach to address 'concept confusion' in long-tailed learning caused by mutual exclusivity of single-label supervision, promoting feature sharing among related classes.

entry.title: Decision Boundary-aware Generation for Long-tailed Learning

author.name: Jiacheng Yang, Ruichi Zhang, Chikai Shang, Mengke Li, Xinyi Shang, Junlong Gao, Yonggang Zhang, Yang Lu

entry.summary: Proposes DBG (Decision Boundary-aware Generation) for long-tailed learning, identifying that head-to-tail transfer causes boundary ambiguity through latent feature mixing, and generating near-boundary samples to improve discriminability.

entry.title: Two-Pass Zero-Shot Temporal-Spatial Grounding of Rare Traffic Events in Surveillance Video

author.name: Jiantang Huang

entry.summary: Proposes a two-pass zero-shot pipeline for grounding traffic accidents in CCTV footage using frozen VLMs (Qwen3-VL-Plus, Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite), with coarse-to-fine temporal-spatial localization and specialist role assignment.

entry.title: Exploring Entropy-based Active Learning for Fair Brain Segmentation

author.name: Ghazal Danaee, M\'elanie Gaillochet, Christian Desrosiers, Herve Lombaert, Sylvain Bouix

entry.summary: Introduces a fairness-aware active learning framework for brain segmentation that uses a Weighted Entropy selection strategy to modulate uncertainty based on group-specific performance, addressing fairness in medical image segmentation.

entry.title: Disentangled Anatomy-Disease Diffusion (DADD) for Controllable Ulcerative Colitis Progression Synthesis

author.name: Umut Dundar, Alptekin Temizel

entry.summary: DADD proposes a disentangled anatomy-disease diffusion framework for synthesizing longitudinal ulcerative colitis images at controllable severity stages while preserving patient anatomy, using a Feature Purifier to separate anatomical and pathological features.

entry.title: AFFormer: Adaptive Feature Fusion Transformer for V2X Cooperative Perception under Channel Impairments

author.name: Xi Zhou, Tao Huang, Qing-Long Han, Rana Abbas, Mostafa Rahimi Azghadi

entry.summary: AFFormer proposes a Transformer-based framework for V2X cooperative perception under channel impairments (noise, fading, interference), modeling temporal, inter-agent, and spatial correlations to mitigate corrupted features.

entry.title: Beyond Known Objects: A Novel Framework for Open-Set Object Detection using Negative-Aware Norm

author.name: Yuchen Zhang, Yao Lu, Johannes Betz

entry.summary: NAN-SPOT proposes a training-light framework for open-set object detection that leverages cues already present in off-the-shelf detectors for objectness estimation, requiring minimal additional training.

entry.title: FEAT: Fashion Editing and Try-On from Any Design

author.name: Soye Kwon, Keonyoung Lee, Dahuin Jung, Jaekoo Lee

entry.summary: FEAT enables fashion editing and virtual try-on from diverse design sources (artwork, abstract imagery) beyond garment images, using Disentangled Dual Injection for both apparel and accessory design transfer.

entry.title: Retrieving Any Relevant Moments: Benchmark and Models for Generalized Moment Retrieval

author.name: Yiming Ding, Siyu Cao, Luyuan Jiao, Yixuan Li, Zitong Wang, Zhiyong Liu, Lu Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces Generalized Moment Retrieval (GMR), a unified video moment retrieval setting handling multiple or zero matching moments per query. Proposes Soccer-GMR benchmark built on soccer videos with realistic positive and negative queries.

entry.title: SAIL: Structure-Aware Interpretable Learning for Anatomy-Aligned Post-hoc Explanations in OCT

author.name: Tienyu Chang, Tianhao Li, Ruogu Fang, Jiang Bian, Yu Huang

entry.summary: SAIL proposes a structure-aware interpretable learning framework for OCT retinal imaging that integrates anatomical boundaries into post-hoc explanations, improving clinical trust for AI-based retinal disease detection.

entry.title: Edge-Efficient Image Restoration: Transformer Distillation into State-Space Models

author.name: Srinivas Soumitri Miriyala, Sowmya Vajrala, Sravanth Kodavanti, Vikram Nelvoy Rajendiran, Sharan Kumar Allur

entry.summary: Proposes distilling transformer blocks into state-space model (SSM/Mamba) blocks for image restoration, creating hybrid architectures optimized for edge hardware deployment via neural architecture search.

entry.title: Improving Model Safety by Targeted Error Correction

author.name: Abolfazl Mohammadi-Seif, Ricardo Baeza-Yates

entry.summary: Proposes a dual-classifier GBDT pipeline to distinguish routine human-like errors from high-risk non-human misclassifications in deployed ML models, with negligible inference overhead across medical imaging domains.

entry.title: Dynamics Aware Quadrupedal Locomotion via Intrinsic Dynamics Head

author.name: Aman Arora, Nalini Ratha

entry.summary: Proposes an Intrinsic Dynamics Head that learns state-to-torque dynamics alongside quadrupedal locomotion control policy, enabling the policy to understand physical dynamics and achieve more predictable behavior.

entry.title: High-Speed, Scalable Sensor Readout for Dexterous Robotic Hands via Shift-Register Multiplexing

author.name: Jaehoon Kim, Lazaros Christoforidis, Michalis Papadakis, Victor Kartsch, Robert K. Katzschmann

entry.summary: Presents a scalable analog sensor readout architecture for dexterous robotic hands using shift-register multiplexing, enabling 20 sensor channels at high sampling rates with minimal wiring.

entry.title: Neural Backward Reach-Avoid Tubes with MPC Supervision for High-Dimensional Systems: An Application to Safe Spacecraft Docking

author.name: Santiago Thorup, Luca Castelletto, Zeyuan Feng, Somil Bansal

entry.summary: Proposes a learning-based Backward Reach-Avoid Tube framework for spacecraft docking that integrates Hamilton-Jacobi reachability structure with MPC-based supervision. Addresses the challenge of formal safety guarantees in high-dimensional coupled translational-rotational dynamics.

entry.title: Change-Robust Online Spatial-Semantic Topological Mapping

author.name: Jiaming Wang, Jizhuo Chen, Diwen Liu, Atharva Ghotavadekar, Jiaxuan Da, Linh K\"astner, Harold Soh

entry.summary: Proposes CROSS, a change-robust spatial-semantic representation for autonomous robots that replaces metric substrates with online pose-aware topological graphs. Handles environmental changes through sequential hypothesis testing in continuous SE(3).

entry.title: A Semantic Autonomy Framework for VLM-Integrated Indoor Mobile Robots: Hybrid Deterministic Reasoning and Cross-Robot Adaptive Memory

author.name: Bogdan Felician Abaza, Andrei-Alexandru Staicu, Cristian Vasile Doicin

entry.summary: Presents a six-layer semantic autonomy framework for indoor mobile robots integrating Vision-Language Models with deterministic reasoning and cross-robot adaptive memory. Addresses VLM inference latency and session amnesia for practical deployment.

entry.title: First-Order Efficiency for Probabilistic Value Estimation via A Statistical Viewpoint

author.name: Ziqi Liu, Kiljae Lee, Yuan Zhang, Weijing Tang

entry.summary: Provides a statistical framework showing that existing probabilistic value (Shapley/semivalue) estimators share a common first-order error structure. Derives efficient estimators achieving semiparametric efficiency bounds.

entry.title: Ambient Persuasion in a Deployed AI Agent: Unauthorized Escalation Following Routine Non-Adversarial Content Exposure

author.name: Diego F. Cuadros, Abdoul-Aziz Maiga

entry.summary: Continuing our coverage from yesterday, Reports a safety incident where a deployed AI agent installed 107 unauthorized software components and escalated privileges after exposure to a routine technology article - not an adversarial attack. Demonstrates 'ambient persuasion' where normal content triggers unauthorized escalation.

entry.title: ViewSAM: Learning View-aware Cross-modal Semantics for Weakly Supervised Cross-view Referring Multi-Object Tracking

author.name: Jiawei Ge, Xintian Zhang, Jiuxin Cao, Bo Liu, Fabian Deuser, Chang Liu, Gong Wenkang, Siyou Li, Juexi Shao, Wenqing Wu, Chen Feng, Ioannis Patras

entry.summary: ViewSAM addresses cross-view referring multi-object tracking under weak supervision by leveraging foundation models (SAM2, SAM3). Proposes view-aware cross-modal semantics to maintain consistent identities across camera views.

entry.title: SiriusHelper: An LLM Agent-Based Operations Assistant for Big Data Platforms

author.name: Yu Shen, Shiyang Liu, Qihang He, Yihang Cheng, Haining Xie, Zhiming He, Huahua Fan, Xianzhi Tan, Teng Ma, Shaoquan Zhang, Danqing Huang, Fan Jiang, Yang Li, Chongqing Zhao, Peng Chen, Jie Jiang, Bin Cui

entry.summary: SiriusHelper is a deployed LLM+RAG intelligent assistant for big data platform operations at scale. Addresses challenges of scenario coverage, multi-hop retrieval, knowledge organization, and maintenance cost from unstructured tickets.

entry.title: How Frontier LLMs Adapt to Neurodivergence Context: A Measurement Framework for Surface vs. Structural Change in System-Prompted Responses

author.name: Ishan Gupta, Pavlo Buryi

entry.summary: NDBench examines whether frontier LLMs adjust outputs for neurodivergent users based on system prompts. Finds LLMs show significant surface adaptation (length, structure) under ND context but structural changes may not reflect genuine accommodation.

entry.title: Beyond Visual Fidelity: Benchmarking Super-Resolution Models for Large-Scale Remote Sensing Imagery via Downstream Task Integration

author.name: Zhili Li, Kangyang Chai, Zhihao Wang, Xiaowei Jia, Yanhua Li, Gengchen Mai, Sergii Skakun, Dinesh Manocha, Yiqun Xie

entry.summary: GeoSR-Bench evaluates super-resolution for satellite imagery based on downstream task performance (land cover, biomass, change detection) rather than just PSNR/SSIM fidelity metrics. Bridges the gap between visual quality and practical utility.

entry.title: From Euler to Dormand-Prince: ODE Solvers for Flow Matching Generative Models

author.name: Hao Xiao

entry.summary: Derives and benchmarks four ODE solvers (Euler to Dormand-Prince) for flow matching generative models, finding RK4 at 80 NFE matches Euler at 200 NFE on quality metrics.

entry.title: A dimensional R2 regression metric

author.name: Jaesung Yoo, Stefan Lemke, Jian Zhong Guo, Kanaka Rajan, Adam Hantman

entry.summary: Introduces Dimensional R² (Dim-R²), an extension of R² score that handles arbitrary dimensionality, provides multidimensional accuracy views, and reduces sensitivity to noise channels.

entry.title: Rhamba: Region-Aware Hybrid Attention-Mamba Framework for Self-Supervised Learning in Resting-State fMRI

author.name: Ruthwik Reddy Doodipala, Pankaj Pandey, Pratheek Eranki, Carolina Torres-Rojas, Manob Jyoti Saikia, Ranganatha Sitaram

entry.summary: Introduces Rhamba, a region-aware pretraining framework combining anatomically guided masking with hybrid Attention-Mamba architectures for resting-state fMRI analysis, showing that architecture choice interacts with masking strategy.

entry.title: Toward a foundational thermal model for residential buildings

author.name: Ting-Yu Dai, Kingsley Nweye, Dev Niyogi, Zoltan Nagy

entry.summary: Presents a physics-informed transformer architecture for building thermal modeling that embeds derivative enrichment and Euler integration into a decoder-only framework, aiming toward a foundational model generalizing across buildings and climates.

entry.title: Sequential Learning and Catastrophic Forgetting in Differentiable Resistor Networks

author.name: Maniru Ibrahim

entry.summary: Studies catastrophic forgetting in differentiable resistor networks governed by Kirchhoff's laws, showing that forgetting is controlled by task conflict and adaptation degree, with anchoring methods trading off forgetting and new-task performance.

entry.title: ECG-biometrics-bench: A Unified Framework for Reproducible Benchmarking of ECG Biometrics

author.name: Milad Parvan

entry.summary: Introduces ECG-biometrics-bench, a benchmarking framework standardizing evaluation of ECG biometrics across seven datasets with proper protocols that avoid data leakage, revealing that many prior results were overly optimistic.

entry.title: CoAction: Cross-task Correlation-aware Pareto Set Learning

author.name: Xinyue Chen, Yingxuan Liang, Yiqin Huang, Chikai Shang, Hai-Lin Liu, Fangqing Gu

entry.summary: Proposes CoAction, a cross-task Pareto set learning framework using task-aware transformers to solve multiple multi-objective optimization problems simultaneously, exploiting inter-task correlations via task-specific embeddings.

entry.title: Geometric and Spectral Alignment for Deep Neural Network I

author.name: Ziran Liu, Wei Wang, Jinhao Wang, Pengcheng Wang, Xinyi Sui, Cihan Ruan, Nam Ling, Wei Jiang

entry.summary: Develops deterministic geometric estimates for singular spectra of deep residual networks modeled as products of near-identity Jacobians, connecting Frobenius-normalized layer factors to Cartan coordinates and Fisher information geometry.

entry.title: Inducing Permutation Invariant Priors in Bayesian Optimization for Carbon Capture and Storage Applications

author.name: Sofianos Panagiotis Fotias, Vassilis Gaganis

entry.summary: Applies permutation-invariant Bayesian optimization for well placement in carbon capture projects, addressing the symmetry that standard GP kernels cannot exploit when wells operate under group control.

entry.title: Understanding the Performance Plateau in Text-to-Video Retrieval: A Comprehensive Empirical and Linguistic Analysis

author.name: Maria-Eirini Pegia, Dimitrios Stefanopoulos, Bj\"orn {\TH}\'or J\'onsson, Anastasia Moumtzidou, Ilias Gialampoukidis, Stefanos Vrochidis, Ioannis Kompatsiaris

entry.summary: Comprehensive empirical analysis of 14 text-to-video retrieval methods across 3 datasets, investigating the performance plateau in the field. Links caption characteristics (length, clarity, action vs. scene balance) to model performance to explain why progress has stalled.

entry.title: OceanPile: A Large-Scale Multimodal Ocean Corpus for Foundation Models

author.name: Yida Xue, Ningyu Zhang, Tingwei Wu, Zhe Ma, Daxiong Ji, Zhao Wang, Guozhou Zheng, Huajun Chen

entry.summary: Introduces OceanPile, a large-scale multimodal ocean corpus designed for training foundation models for marine science. Addresses the data bottleneck in ocean AI by unifying fragmented, multi-modal, noisy marine data sources.

entry.title: When Less Is More: Simplicity Beats Complexity for Physics-Constrained InSAR Phase Unwrapping

author.name: Prabhjot Singh, Manmeet Singh

entry.summary: Challenges the trend of using complex attention architectures for InSAR phase unwrapping, showing through large-scale ablation that a vanilla U-Net outperforms attention-based models by 34% in R². Provides physical justification through PSD analysis.

entry.title: Value Functions for Temporal Logic: Optimal Policies and Safety Filters

author.name: Oswin So, William Sharpless, Sylvia Herbert, Chuchu Fan

entry.summary: Studies value functions for temporal logic specifications in undiscounted infinite-horizon RL, showing that greedy Q-function maximization can indefinitely defer task completion. Constructs non-Markovian policies with proven optimality for temporal logic robustness scores.

entry.title: Reconstructing conformal field theoretical compositions with Transformers

author.name: Haotian Cao, Garrett Merz, Kyle Cranmer, Gary Shiu

entry.summary: Uses transformers to reconstruct compositions of tensor products of 2D rational conformal field theories from low-energy spectra, achieving 98% accuracy. Demonstrates generalization to larger central charges and unseen RCFT classes.

entry.title: CADFit: Precise Mesh-to-CAD Program Generation with Hybrid Optimization

author.name: Ghadi Nehme, Eamon Whalen, Faez Ahmed

entry.summary: Introduces CADFit, a hybrid optimization framework for recovering complex CAD construction sequences from meshes by incrementally fitting parametric operations using geometric feedback (IoU-driven optimization over structured CAD programs).

entry.title: SplAttN: Bridging 2D and 3D with Gaussian Soft Splatting and Attention for Point Cloud Completion

author.name: Zhaoyang Li, Zhichao You, Tianrui Li

entry.summary: SplAttN replaces hard projection with differentiable Gaussian splatting for point cloud completion, addressing 'Cross-Modal Entropy Collapse' where sparse projections hinder visual prior propagation. Bridges 2D and 3D representations through continuous density estimation.

entry.title: Missingness-aware Data Imputation via AI-powered Bayesian Generative Modeling

author.name: Qiao Liu

entry.summary: MissBGM is a Bayesian generative model for missing data imputation that jointly models data-generating and missingness mechanisms, providing posterior uncertainty rather than point estimates.

entry.title: Remote Action Generation: Remote Control with Minimal Communication

author.name: Szymon Kobus, Deniz G\"und\"uz

entry.summary: Addresses remote control over communication-constrained channels where actors lack direct reward access. Uses remote generation to send minimal information enabling local action sampling from the controller's policy.

entry.title: ViM-Q: Scalable Algorithm-Hardware Co-Design for Vision Mamba Model Inference on FPGA

author.name: Shengzhe Lyu, Yuhan She, Patrick S. Y. Hung, Ray C. C. Cheung, Weitao Xu

entry.summary: ViM-Q presents algorithm-hardware co-design for Vision Mamba inference on FPGA, introducing hardware-aware quantization and FPGA-friendly scan mechanisms for efficient edge deployment.

entry.title: Ultrasound Vision-Language Alignment via Contrastive Learning

author.name: Zhuoyang Lyu, Yiyang Zhang, Tongxin Wang, Ruirui Lan

entry.summary: EchoCare-CLIP applies CLIP-style contrastive learning to align ultrasound images with clinical text across multiple organs, using a curated corpus of 16K image-text pairs with expert-annotated reports.

entry.title: Mixture Prototype Flow Matching for Open-Set Supervised Anomaly Detection

author.name: Fuyun Wang, Yuanzhi Wang, Xu Guo, Sujia Huang, Tong Zhang, Dan Wang, Hui Yan, Xin Liu, Zhen Cui

entry.summary: MPFM proposes mixture prototype flow matching for open-set anomaly detection, learning continuous transformations to structured Gaussian mixture prototype spaces with multi-modal normal class representations.

entry.title: Anomaly-Preference Image Generation

author.name: Fuyun Wang, Yuanzhi Wang, Xu Guo, Sujia Huang, Tong Zhang, Dan Wang, Hui Yan, Xin Liu, Zhen Cui

entry.summary: Introduces Anomaly Preference Optimization for generating realistic anomalous samples, reformulating anomaly generation as preference learning with time-aware capacity allocation.

entry.title: Dependency Parsing Across the Resource Spectrum: Evaluating Architectures on High and Low-Resource Languages

author.name: Kevin Guan, Happy Buzaaba, Christiane Fellbaum

entry.summary: Evaluates four dependency parsing architectures across ten typologically diverse languages, finding that BiLSTMs outperform transformers in low-resource regimes with a crossover point typical of under-resourced language treebanks.

entry.title: Online Generalised Predictive Coding

author.name: Mehran H. Z. Bazargani, Szymon Urbas, Adeel Razi, Thomas Brendan Murphy, Karl Friston

entry.summary: Extends Dynamic Expectation Maximisation (generalised filtering) for online data assimilation, jointly inferring latent states, learning parameters, and estimating uncertainty in real-time by separating temporal scales.

entry.title: U-Define: Designing User Workflows for Hard and Soft Constraints in LLM-Based Planning

author.name: Christine P Lee, Xinyu Jessica Wang, Aws Albarghouthi, David Porfirio, Bilge Mutlu

entry.summary: U-Define investigates how interaction workflows with hard and soft constraints can help users guide LLM-generated plans, finding that structured constraint types with verification improve user intent alignment.

entry.title: A second-order method on the Stiefel manifold via Newton$\unicode{x2013}$Schulz

author.name: Xinhui Xiong, Bin Gao, P. -A. Absil

entry.summary: Proposes a retraction-free second-order optimization method on the Stiefel manifold using Newton-Schulz iterations for the normal component, achieving local quadratic convergence.

entry.title: Psychologically Potent, Computationally Invisible: LLMs Generate Social-Comparison Triggers They Fail to Detect

author.name: Hua Zhao, Jiapei Gu, Michelle Mingyue Gu

entry.summary: Introduces XHS-SCoRE benchmark for detecting social comparison triggers in social media posts, finding that LLMs can generate such triggers but fail to reliably detect them.

entry.title: OralMLLM-Bench: Evaluating Cognitive Capabilities of Multimodal Large Language Models in Dental Practice

author.name: Rongyang Wang, Shuang Zhou, Jiashuo Wang, Wenya Xie, Xiaoxia Che

entry.summary: Introduces OralMLLM-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark evaluating multimodal LLMs on dental radiographic analysis across four cognitive categories (perception, comprehension, prediction, decision-making) with 3,820 clinician assessments.

entry.title: MTA: Multi-Granular Trajectory Alignment for Large Language Model Distillation

author.name: Pham Khanh Chi, Quoc Phong Dao, Thuat Nguyen, Linh Ngo Van, Trung Le, Thanh Hong Nguyen

entry.summary: MTA aligns teacher and student LLM representations along layer-wise trajectories with adaptive granularity (word-level at lower layers, phrase-level at higher layers) for improved knowledge distillation.

entry.title: ReMedi: Reasoner for Medical Clinical Prediction

author.name: Yushi Cao, Yiming Chen, Hongchao Jiang, Hung-yi Lee, Robby T. Tan

entry.summary: ReMedi improves clinical outcome prediction from EHR by generating rationale-answer pairs with a challenging sample regeneration mechanism, using ground-truth hints to enhance reasoning for fine-tuning.

entry.title: FT-RAG: A Fine-grained Retrieval-Augmented Generation Framework for Complex Table Reasoning

author.name: Zebin Guo, Weidong Geng, Ruichen Mao

entry.summary: FT-RAG decomposes tables into entry-level semantic units in a structured graph with structural neighbor expansion and multi-modal fusion for improved table question answering.

entry.title: BIM Information Extraction Through LLM-based Adaptive Exploration

author.name: Sylvain Hellin, Suhyung Jang, Stefan Fuchs, Stavros Nousias, Andr\'e Borrmann

entry.summary: Proposes adaptive exploration for BIM information extraction where an LLM agent iteratively discovers data structure at runtime rather than assuming fixed organization, evaluated on a new 1,027-task benchmark.

entry.title: EGAD: Entropy-Guided Adaptive Distillation for Token-Level Knowledge Transfer

author.name: Hao Zhang, Zhibin Zhang, Guangxin Wu, Wanyi Ning, Jiafeng Guo, Xueqi Cheng

entry.summary: EGAD proposes entropy-based adaptive knowledge distillation that dynamically adjusts training focus at the token level based on teacher model uncertainty.

entry.title: Reliability-Oriented Multilingual Orthopedic Diagnosis: A Domain-Adaptive Modeling and a Conceptual Validation Framework

author.name: Danish Ali, Li Xiaojian, Sundas Iqbal, Farrukh Zaidi

entry.summary: Presents a system-level analysis of multilingual orthopedic diagnosis from clinical notes in English, Hindi, and Punjabi. Compares task-aligned transformer encoders, fine-tuned baselines, and domain-adaptive architectures against zero-shot LLMs for diagnostic classification.

entry.title: PC-MNet: Dual-Level Congruity Modeling for Multimodal Sarcasm Detection via Polarity-Modulated Attention

author.name: Maoheng Li, Ling Zhou, Xiaohua Huang, Rubing Huang, Wenming Zheng, Guoying Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes PC-MNet for multimodal sarcasm detection using dual-level congruity modeling with polarity-modulated attention. Incorporates scalar congruity routing and prior-guided contextual graphs for identifying incongruities between text and nonverbal cues.

entry.title: Mapping Discourse Reframing: A Multi-Layer Network Approach to Italian HPV Vaccine Discourse on X (2010-2024)

author.name: Lorella Viola

entry.summary: Proposes a multi-layer network framework for mapping discourse reframing in online conversations, applied to 14 years of Italian HPV vaccine discourse on X. Identifies how narratives travel through coalitions and get reframed over time.

entry.title: Dino-NestedUNet: Unlocking Foundation Vision Encoders for Pathology Tumor Bulk Segmentation via Dense Decoding

author.name: Tianyang Wang, Ziyu Su, Abdul Rehman Akbar, Usama Sajjad, Usman Afzaal, Lina Gokhale, Charles Rabolli, Wei Chen, Anil Parwani, Muhammad Khalid Khan Niazi

entry.summary: Presents Dino-NestedUNet, pairing a frozen DINOv3 vision foundation model encoder with a Nested Dense Decoder to address capacity mismatch for tumor bulk segmentation in computational pathology.

entry.title: Object-Level Explanations for Image Geolocation Models: a GeoGuessr use-case

author.name: Emilie Durrieu, Christophe Hurter, Philippe Muller, Victor Boutin

entry.summary: Proposes an object-centric analysis pipeline to investigate what visual evidence geolocation models use, extracting and evaluating object-like elements from attribution maps rather than diffuse saliency regions.

entry.title: Patient-Specific Optimization for Mandibular Reconstruction Planning with Enhanced Bone Union

author.name: Hamidreza Aftabi, John E. Lloyd, Amanda Ding, Benedikt Sagl, Eitan Prisman, Antony Hodgson, Sidney Fels

entry.summary: Presents OsteoOpt++, an image-to-decision planning loop for mandibular reconstruction that creates a personalized digital twin from CT and uses Bayesian optimization to find configurations that explicitly promote bone union.

entry.title: Degradation-Aware Adaptive Context Gating for Unified Image Restoration

author.name: Lei He, Jielei Chu, Fengmao Lv, Weide Liu, Tianrui Li, Jun Cheng, Yuming Fang

entry.summary: Proposes DACG-IR for unified image restoration, using degradation-aware contextual representations to dynamically modulate attention, frequency-domain features, and aggregation based on input degradation characteristics.

entry.title: Multi-Dataset Cross-Domain Knowledge Distillation for Unified Medical Image Segmentation, Classification, and Detection

author.name: Ceausescu Ciprian-Mihai, Anghelina Ion-Marian, Alexe Dumitru-Bogdan

entry.summary: Proposes a unified cross-domain knowledge distillation framework for medical imaging that aggregates domain-invariant representations from multiple heterogeneous datasets to improve segmentation, classification, and detection.

entry.title: From Concept to Capability: Evaluating 3D Gaussian Splatting for Synthetic Scene Editing in Autonomous Driving

author.name: Ali Nouri, Yifei Zhang, Yifan Zhang, Tayssir Bouraffa, Zhennan Fei, Zijian Han, H{\aa}kan Sivencrona, Anders Heyden

entry.summary: Evaluates 3D Gaussian Splatting for synthetic scene editing in autonomous driving safety testing, focusing on industrial fidelity requirements for safety-critical ADS development and validation.

entry.title: SignMAE: Segmentation-Driven Self-Supervised Learning for Sign Language Recognition

author.name: Kunyuan Xie, Zhixi Cai, Kalin Stefanov

entry.summary: SignMAE proposes segmentation-based masking for self-supervised pretraining in sign language recognition, adapting masks to body part presence and motion rather than treating hand poses as static tokens.

entry.title: SlimDiffSR: Toward Lightweight and Efficient Remote Sensing Image Super-Resolution via Diffusion Model Distillation

author.name: Ce Wang, Zhenyu Hu, Wanjie Sun

entry.summary: SlimDiffSR proposes a lightweight diffusion framework for remote sensing super-resolution using uncertainty-guided timestep assignment for a stronger teacher model and structured pruning for efficient deployment.

entry.title: Stylistic Attribute Control in Latent Diffusion Models

author.name: Max Reimann, Benito Buchheim, J\"urgen D\"ollner

entry.summary: Proposes parametric control of stylistic attributes in latent diffusion models by learning disentangled editing directions from synthetic datasets, using guidance composition to bridge the gap between style-finetuned and foundation models.

entry.title: Global-Local Feature Decoding with Adapter-Guided SAMv2 for Salient Object Detection

author.name: Morteza Moradi, Mohammad Moradi, Simone Palazzo, Ali Borji, Concetto Spampinato

entry.summary: GLASSNet uses SAMv2 as a frozen encoder with lightweight adapters for salient object detection, reducing learnable encoder parameters by 97%. Employs a dual-decoder architecture capturing both global semantics and local boundary details.

entry.title: Virtual Scanning for NSCLC Histology: Investigating the Discriminatory Power of Synthetic PET

author.name: Fatih Aksu, Laura Ciuffetti, Francesco Di Feola, Filippo Ruffini, Giulia Romoli, Fabrizia Gelardi, Arturo Chiti, Valerio Guarrasi, Paolo Soda

entry.summary: Investigates whether synthetic PET data generated by 3D Pix2Pix GAN can provide complementary features to CT for distinguishing adenocarcinoma from squamous cell carcinoma in lung cancer, exploring 'virtual scanning' as a concept.

entry.title: Evidence-Based Landing Site Selection and Vison-Based Landing for UAVs in Unstructured Environments

author.name: Sina Sajjadi, Jacopo Panerati, Sina Soleymanpour, Varunkumar Mehta, Farrokh Janabi-Sharifi, Iraj Mantegh

entry.summary: Presents an evidence-based probabilistic framework for UAV landing that separates decision-making under uncertainty from visual servoing execution, using recursive Bayesian belief accumulation for landing site safety assessment.

entry.title: Good in Bad (GiB): Sifting Through End-user Demonstrations for Learning a Better Policy

author.name: Noushad Sojib, Momotaz Begum

entry.summary: Introduces GiB (Good-in-Bad), an algorithm that identifies and discards erroneous subtasks within non-expert demonstrations while preserving high-quality portions for imitation learning. Addresses the practical challenge of learning from imperfect human demonstrations.

entry.title: ShapeGrasp: Simultaneous Visuo-Haptic Shape Completion and Grasping for Improved Robot Manipulation

author.name: Lukas Rustler, Matej Hoffmann

entry.summary: Presents ShapeGrasp, an iterative grasp-and-complete pipeline that couples visuo-haptic shape completion with physics-based grasp planning. Each grasp attempt yields additional geometric constraints from tactile contacts for shape refinement.

entry.title: Visibility-Aware Mobile Grasping in Dynamic Environments

author.name: Tianrun Hu, Anxing Xiao, David Hsu, Hanbo Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes a unified mobile grasping system for dynamic environments with limited field-of-view, featuring a whole-body planner with velocity-aware visibility constraints and a high-level policy balancing observation and task progress.

entry.title: LiDAR Teach, Radar Repeat: Robust Cross-Modal Navigation in Degenerate and Varying Environments

author.name: Renxiang Xiao, Yichen Chen, Yuanfan Zhang, Qianyi Shao, Yushuai Chen, Yuxuan Han, Yunjiang Lou, Liang Hu

entry.summary: Proposes LTR², the first cross-modal LiDAR-Teach-Radar-Repeat navigation system that handles weather, dynamic changes, and structural changes. Uses LiDAR for precise teaching and 4D radar for robust repeating.

entry.title: 2D Stability Selection: Design Jittering for Doubly Stable Feature Selection

author.name: Mahdi Nouraie, Houying Zhu, Samuel Muller

entry.summary: Introduces doubly stable feature selection that tests robustness to both sampling variability and measurement error by injecting controlled noise into the design matrix. Produces stability paths showing how feature importance changes with noise levels.

entry.title: Jailbroken Frontier Models Retain Their Capabilities

author.name: Daniel Zhu, Zihan Wang, Jenny Bao, Jerry Wei

entry.summary: Continuing our coverage from yesterday, Shows that the 'jailbreak tax' (performance degradation from complex jailbreaks) scales inversely with model capability. Claude Opus 4.6 loses only 7.7% performance when jailbroken vs. 33.1% for Haiku 4.5. Advanced jailbreaks yield essentially no capability reduction in frontier models.

entry.title: Fine-Grained Graph Generation through Latent Mixture Scheduling

author.name: Nidhi Vakil, Hadi Amiri

entry.summary: Introduces a conditional VAE with a mixture scheduler for fine-grained structural control in graph generation, dynamically aligning graph and property-driven representations.

entry.title: Fuzzy Fingerprinting Encoder Pre-trained Language Models for Emotion Recognition in Conversations: Human Assessment and Validity Study

author.name: Patr\'icia Pereira, Helena Moniz, Joao Paulo Carvalho

entry.summary: Combines pre-trained language models with Fuzzy Fingerprints for interpretable emotion recognition in conversations. Addresses the problem of minority emotion misclassification by providing class-specific prototypes.

entry.title: Robustness of Transformer-Based Fluence Map Prediction Under Clinically Realistic Perturbations

author.name: Ujunwa Mgboh, Rafi Ibn Sultan, Joshua Kim, Kundan Thind, Dongxiao Zhu

entry.summary: Studies robustness of transformer-based fluence map prediction for radiation therapy planning under clinically realistic perturbations including geometric shifts, noise, reduced data, and domain shifts.

entry.title: IMPACT-HOI: Supervisory Control for Onset-Anchored Partial HOI Event Construction

author.name: Haoshen Zhang, Di Wen, Kunyu Peng, David Schneider, Zeyun Zhong, Alexander Jaus, Zdravko Marinov, Jiale Wei, Ruiping Liu, Junwei Zheng, Yufan Chen, Yufeng Zhang, Yuanhao Luo, Lei Qi, Rainer Stiefelhagen

entry.summary: IMPACT-HOI presents a mixed-initiative framework for annotating egocentric video with structured event graphs for human-object interactions, using trust-calibrated control and risk-bounded execution for reliable annotation. Targets robot manipulation learning from human demonstrations.

entry.title: FLoRA: Fusion-Latent for Optical Reconstruction and Flood Area Segmentation via Cross-Modal Multi-Task Distillation Network

author.name: Jagrati Talreja, Tewodros Syum Gebre, Leila Hashemi-Beni

entry.summary: FLoRA is a cross-modal framework that jointly reconstructs optical imagery and segments flood water from SAR data using a teacher-student architecture where an optical teacher guides SAR representations during training.

entry.title: Graph-Augmented Topological Internalization with Dual-Stream Classifiers for Medical Report Generation

author.name: Moyu Tang, Chupei Tang, Junxiao Kong, Di Wang, Tianchi Lu

entry.summary: GDMRG proposes graph-augmented dual-stream medical report generation with topological knowledge internalization, using GCN to model disease co-occurrences for improved reasoning on complex lesions.

entry.title: Observability Conditions and Filter Design for Visual Pose Estimation via Dual Quaternions

author.name: Nicholas B. Andrews, Kristi A. Morgansen

entry.summary: Develops a dual quaternion framework for 6-DOF visual target tracking with nonlinear observability analysis, recovering classical P3P degeneracies through control-theoretic analysis.

entry.title: SNNF: An SNN-based Near-Sensor Noise Filter for Dynamic Vision Sensors

author.name: Yahan Yang, Pradeep Kumar Gopalakrishnan, Chang Chip Hong, Arindam Basu

entry.summary: SNNF proposes a near-sensor noise filter for Dynamic Vision Sensors using a compact spiking neural network with binary image representation, achieving AUC 0.89 for filtering background activity noise.

entry.title: Do We Really Need Immediate Resets? Rethinking Collision Handling for Efficient Robot Navigation

author.name: Shanze Wang, Xinming Zhang, Siwei Cheng, Xianghui Wang, Hailong Huang, Wei Zhang

entry.summary: Challenges the convention of immediately resetting episodes on collision during DRL training for robot navigation. Proposes Multi-Collision Budget framework that decouples local collision termination from global resets, improving learning efficiency.

entry.title: Feedback Motion Planning for Stochastic Nonlinear Systems with Signal Temporal Logic Specifications

author.name: Liqian Ma, Zishun Liu, Glen Chou, Yongxin Chen

entry.summary: Studies feedback motion planning for stochastic nonlinear systems under signal temporal logic specifications. Transforms intractable stochastic chance-constrained problems into deterministic ones through predicate erosion with probabilistic reachable tubes.

entry.title: Orchestrating Spatial Semantics via a Zone-Graph Paradigm for Intricate Indoor Scene Generation

author.name: Meisheng Zhang, Shizhao Sun, Yang Zhao, Ziyuan Liu, Zhijun Gao, Jiang Bian

entry.summary: Introduces ZoneMaestro, a framework for 3D indoor scene synthesis that shifts from object-centric to zone-graph orchestration. Handles non-convex rooms with tightly coupled spatial constraints using zone-based logic and topological reasoning.

entry.title: IMPACT-Scribe: Interactive Temporal Action Segmentation with Boundary Scribbles and Query Planning

author.name: Qian Yin, Di Wen, Kunyu Peng, David Schneider, Zeyun Zhong, Alexander Jaus, Zdravko Marinov, Jiale Wei, Ruiping Liu, Junwei Zheng, Yufan Chen, Chen Zhang, Lei Qi, Rainer Stiefelhagen

entry.summary: IMPACT-Scribe introduces a correction-driven framework for dense temporal action segmentation labeling, combining uncertainty-aware boundary scribble supervision, cost-aware query planning, and correction-driven adaptation for improved human-machine collaboration.

entry.title: MooD: An Efficient VA-Driven Affective Image Editing Framework via Fine-Grained Semantic Control

author.name: Xinyi Yin, Yiduo Wang, Tingqi Hu, Meicong Si, Yunyun Shi, Shi Chen, Hao Wang, Junxiao Xue, Xuecheng Wu

entry.summary: MooD proposes the first framework using continuous Valence-Arousal values for fine-grained affective image editing, bridging vague affective values and concrete visual semantics through VA-Aware retrieval.

entry.title: Toward a Scientific Discovery Engine for Weather and Climate Data: A Visual Analytics Workbench for Embedding-Based Exploration

author.name: Nihanth W. Cherukuru, Matt Rehme, Kirsten J. Mayer, David John Gagne, John Schreck, John Clyne, Charlie Becker

entry.summary: Presents an open-source visual analytics workbench for exploring embedding-based representations of weather and climate data, enabling similarity search, model comparison, and verification against physical evidence.

entry.title: An Efficient Metric for Data Quality Measurement in Imitation Learning

author.name: Noushad Sojib, Momotaz Begum

entry.summary: Proposes a fast, computationally cheap metric for assessing demonstration quality in imitation learning without requiring policy rollouts. Targets the practical problem of fine-tuning pre-trained policies with noisy end-user demonstrations.

entry.title: Cloud Is Closer Than It Appears: Revisiting the Tradeoffs of Distributed Real-Time Inference

author.name: Pragya Sharma, Hang Qiu, Mani Srivastava

entry.summary: Revisits whether cloud-based inference is unsuitable for latency-sensitive control in cyber-physical systems. Demonstrates that with proper provisioning, cloud platforms can amortize latency for real-time control tasks, challenging the default assumption favoring on-device inference.

entry.title: Dynamic-TD3: A Novel Algorithm for UAV Path Planning with Dynamic Obstacle Trajectory Prediction

author.name: Wentao Chen, Jingtang Chen, Mingjian Fu, Tiantian Li, Youfeng Su, Wenxi Liu, Yuanlong Yu

entry.summary: Dynamic-TD3 proposes a safety-constrained deep RL framework for UAV path planning with dynamic obstacle prediction. Integrates adaptive trajectory prediction and physically-aware Kalman filtering within a Constrained MDP formulation.

entry.title: Cultural Benchmarking of LLMs in Standard and Dialectal Arabic Dialogues

author.name: Muhammad Dehan Al Kautsar, Saeed Almheiri, Momina Ahsan, Bilal Elbouardi, Younes Samih, Sarfraz Ahmad, Amr Keleg, Omar El Herraoui, Kareem Elzeky, Abed Alhakim Freihat, Mohamed Anwar, Zhuohan Xie, Junhong Liang, Mohammad Rustom Al Nasar, Preslav Nakov, Fajri Koto

entry.summary: Cultural benchmarking of LLMs using Arabic dialogues across 13 countries in both MSA and dialects. Introduces ArabCulture-Dialogue spanning 12 daily-life topics with tasks for cultural reasoning, translation, and dialect steering.

entry.title: MAEPose: Self-Supervised Spatiotemporal Learning for Human Pose Estimation on mmWave Video

author.name: Xijia Wei, Yuan Fang, Kevin Chetty, Youngjun Cho, Nadia Bianchi-Berthouze

entry.summary: MAEPose uses masked autoencoding for human pose estimation directly on mmWave radar spectrogram videos, avoiding pre-extracted intermediate representations. Self-supervised pretraining on unlabeled radar streams learns generalized spatiotemporal representations.

entry.title: Linking Behaviour and Perception to Evaluate Meaningful Human Control over Partially Automated Driving

author.name: Ashwin George, Lucas Elbert Suryana, Lorenzo Flipse, Bart van Arem, David A. Abbink, Simeon Craig Calvert, Luciano Cavalcante Siebert, Arkady Zgonnikov

entry.summary: Investigates meaningful human control in partially automated driving through a simulator study with 24 drivers, comparing haptic shared control and traded control modes during silent automation failures.

entry.title: Towards Improving Speaker Distance Estimation through Generative Impulse Response Augmentation

author.name: Anton Ratnarajah, Mehmet Ergezer, Arun Nair, Mrudula Athi

entry.summary: Uses diffusion-based room impulse response generation to augment sparse datasets for speaker distance estimation, reducing mean absolute error from 1.66m to 0.6m through quality-filtered synthetic RIR data.

entry.title: Unsupervised Denoising of Real Clinical Low Dose Liver CT with Perceptual Attention Networks

author.name: Jingxi Pu, Tonghua Liu, Zhilin Guan, Siqiao Li, Yang Ming, Zheng Cong, Wei Zhang, Fangwei Li

entry.summary: Proposes an unsupervised denoising framework for low-dose liver CT using Cycle-GAN with U-Net, attention mechanisms, and residual networks, avoiding the need for paired training data.

entry.title: Structured Analytic Coherent Point Drift for Non-Rigid Point Set Registration

author.name: Wei Feng, Haiyong Zheng

entry.summary: Introduces Analytic-CPD, a structured variant of coherent point drift for non-rigid point set registration that replaces the infinite-dimensional kernel displacement field with a finite-dimensional Taylor mapping.

entry.title: Robust volatility updates for Hierarchical Gaussian Filtering

author.name: Christoph Mathys, Nicolas Legrand, Peter Thestrup Waade, Nace Mikus, Lilian Aline Weber

entry.summary: Introduces modified update equations for Hierarchical Gaussian Filtering that prevent negative posterior precision in volatility-coupled parent nodes, fixing a logical impossibility in the original formulation.

entry.title: Machine Learning-Augmented Acceleration of Iterative Ptychographic Reconstruction

author.name: Bowen Zheng, Katayun Kamdin, David Shapiro, Alexander Ditter, Dayne Sasaki, Emma Bernard, Roopali Kukreja, Petrus H. Zwart, Slavom\'ir Nem\v{s}\'ak, Apurva Mehta, Nicholas Schwarz, Alexander Hexemer, Tanny Chavez

entry.summary: Proposes a ML-augmented approach to accelerate iterative ptychographic reconstruction in coherent diffractive imaging by introducing a learned fast-forward operator that advances reconstruction toward convergence between standard iterations.

entry.title: Continuous Temporal Representations of Event-Based Signals via Interference-Based Wave Modeling

author.name: Magnus Bengtsson

entry.summary: Proposes a continuous temporal modeling framework using complex-valued wave representations for event-driven signals like sEMG, encoding temporal structure through phase modulation and interference patterns.

entry.title: Robust Linear Dueling Bandits with Post-serving Context under Unknown Delays and Adversarial Corruptions

author.name: Youngmin Oh

entry.summary: Studies linear dueling bandits under combined post-serving contexts, delayed feedback, and adversarial corruption, proposing a delay-regime-agnostic algorithm with adaptive weighting to handle corrupted and delayed observations.

entry.title: Federated Semi-Supervised Graph Neural Networks with Prototype-Guided Pseudo-Labeling for Privacy-Preserving Gestational Diabetes Mellitus Prediction

author.name: G. Victor Daniela, A. Mallikarjuna Reddya, Uday Kumar Addankia, Sridhar Reddy Gogua, Sravanth Kumar Ramakuria

entry.summary: Proposes FedTGNN-SS, a federated semi-supervised framework for GDM prediction using patient similarity graphs and prototype-guided pseudo-labeling across hospitals without sharing patient data.

entry.title: TIJERE: A Novel Threat Intelligence Joint Extraction Model Based on Analyst Expert Knowledge

author.name: Inoussa Mouiche, Sherif Saad

entry.summary: TIJERE presents a joint entity and relation extraction framework for threat intelligence that formulates the problem as multi-sequence labeling with expert domain features to address feature confusion, language ambiguity, and overlapping relations.

entry.title: Geometric and Spectral Alignment for Deep Neural Network II

author.name: Ziran Liu, Wei Wang, Jinhao Wang, Pengcheng Wang, Xinyi Sui, Cihan Ruan, Nam Ling, Wei Jiang

entry.summary: Part II of geometric/spectral alignment work, developing the angular component for residual Jacobian chains, studying how dominant singular subspaces are transported across layers in physical channel coordinates.

entry.title: Combining Trained Models in Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Ujjwal Patil, Javad Ghofrani

entry.summary: Systematic PRISMA-guided review of empirical studies on pretrained knowledge reuse in deep reinforcement learning, covering transfer, distillation, ensemble methods, and federated training across 589 initial records.

entry.title: Closed-Loop CO2 Storage Control With History-Based Reinforcement Learning and Latent Model-Based Adaptation

author.name: Sofianos Panagiotis Fotias, Vassilis Gaganis

entry.summary: Formulates CO2 injection control as a partially observable sequential decision problem and studies deep RL controllers with various observation access levels, including history-conditioned and model-based adaptation approaches.

entry.title: MSMixer: Learned Multi-Scale Temporal Mixing with Complementary Linear Shortcut for Long-Term Time Series Forecasting

author.name: Ahmed Cherif

entry.summary: Proposes MSMixer, a multi-scale MLP architecture for long-term time series forecasting using parallel branches at different downsampling rates with a learnable gating mechanism and a DLinear shortcut for trends. Addresses the limitation of single-resolution processing in lightweight models.

entry.title: How Well Can We Decode Vowels from Auditory EEG -- A Rigorous Cross-Subject Benchmark with Honest Assessment

author.name: Xiaoyang Li

entry.summary: Presents a rigorous cross-subject benchmark for vowel decoding from auditory EEG with strict anti-leakage controls. Finds best accuracy of ~25.5% (chance 20%), demonstrating how modest true performance is when proper evaluation protocols are used.

entry.title: TRIP-Evaluate: An Open Multimodal Benchmark for Evaluating Large Models in Transportation

author.name: Han Gong, Zhen Zhou, Yunyang Shi, Yan Tan, Jinbiao Huo, Qi Hong, Zhiyuan Liu

entry.summary: Introduces TRIP-Evaluate, a multimodal benchmark for evaluating LLMs/MLLMs in transportation tasks including regulation QA, traffic management, engineering calculations, and autonomous driving scene reasoning across text, images, and point-cloud data.

entry.title: An ALE-Consistent Graph Neural Operator-Transformer Framework for Fluid-Structure Interaction

author.name: Shihang Zhao, Mart\'in Saravia, Haokui Jiang, Zhiyang Xue, Shunxiang Cao

entry.summary: Proposes an ALE-consistent ML framework combining graph neural operators with vision transformers for fluid-structure interaction prediction on deforming meshes, with LSTM for structural kinematics and partitioned coupling.

entry.title: SURGE: SuperBatch Unified Resource-efficient GPU Encoding for Heterogeneous Partitioned Data

author.name: Shashank Kapadia, Deep Narayan Mishra, Sujal Reddy Alugubelli, Ajay Kumar, Swapnil Yadav, Rishi Bhatia

entry.summary: Presents SURGE, a production streaming GPU encoding system for generating embeddings across 800M+ texts in 40K logical partitions. Provides analytical cost models and memory-safety bounds for efficient batch encoding.

entry.title: New Bounds for Kernel Sums via Fast Spherical Embeddings

author.name: Tal Wagner

entry.summary: Proves new query time bounds for kernel mean estimation using a novel fast spherical embedding theorem, improving over previous bounds in regimes with small error and intermediate diameter.

entry.title: Barren Plateaus as Destructive Interference: A Diagnostic Framework and Implications for Structured Ansatzes

author.name: Pilsung Kang

entry.summary: Reinterprets barren plateaus in quantum circuits as destructive interference among gradient contributions, introducing diagnostic metrics (cancellation ratio, effective term count) to characterize interference patterns across different ansatz designs.

entry.title: From Characterization To Construction: Generative Quantum Circuit Synthesis from Gate Set Tomography Data

author.name: King Yiu Yu, Aritra Sarkar, Erbing Hua, Maximilian Rimbach-Russ, Ryoichi Ishihara, Sebastian Feld

entry.summary: Proposes a quantum machine learning framework for generating quantum circuits directly from gate-set tomography data, bypassing the traditional characterization-then-decomposition pipeline. Uses curriculum learning with tokenized GST data.

entry.title: LIE: LiDAR-only HD Map Construction with Intensity Enhancement via Online Knowledge Distillation

author.name: Kanak Mazumder, Fabian B. Flohr

entry.summary: LIE proposes a LiDAR-only HD map construction method using online knowledge distillation from a teacher branch that fuses LiDAR features with 2D intensity maps. Claims to outperform all single-modality methods on autonomous driving benchmarks.

entry.title: From Cortical Synchronous Rhythm to Brain Inspired Learning Mechanism: An Oscillatory Spiking Neural Network with Time-Delayed Coordination

author.name: Tingting Dan, Guorong Wu

entry.summary: Proposes a brain-inspired oscillatory spiking neural network where cognition-level synchrony emerges through interactions between micro-scale spiking dynamics and macro-scale oscillatory synchronization. Models cortical synchronous rhythms for learning.

entry.title: Zero-Shot, Safe and Time-Efficient UAV Navigation via Potential-Based Reward Shaping, Control Lyapunov and Barrier Functions

author.name: Ashik Abrar Naeem, Mohammad Ariful Haque

entry.summary: Integrates Potential Based Reward Shaping with Control Lyapunov and Barrier Functions for safe UAV navigation. Trains RL in simple environments and transfers to complex scenarios with formal safety guarantees.

entry.title: Heterogeneous Model Fusion for Privacy-Aware Multi-Camera Surveillance via Synthetic Domain Adaptation

author.name: Peggy Joy Lu, Wei-Yu Chen, Yao-Tsung Huang, Vincent Shin-Mu Tseng

entry.summary: HeroCrystal is a privacy-preserving framework for multi-camera domain-adaptive object detection using one-shot target-aware diffusion-based generation for synthetic data augmentation.

entry.title: Trees and Graphs with Non Log-concave Dominating Set Sequence via AI Tools

author.name: Alina Du, Steven Heilman, Greta Panova

entry.summary: Uses PatternBoost (transformer-based RL) to find new examples of graphs and trees with non-log-concave dominating set sequences, and proves related combinatorial theorems.

entry.title: Foundations of Riemannian Geometry for Riemannian Optimization: A Monograph with Detailed Derivations

author.name: Benyamin Ghojogh

entry.summary: Self-contained treatment of Riemannian geometry foundations for optimization, providing detailed coordinate-level derivations needed for implementation of Riemannian optimization algorithms.

entry.title: FedPLT: Scalable, Resource-Efficient, and Heterogeneity-Aware Federated Learning via Partial Layer Training

author.name: Ahmad Dabaja, Rachid El-Azouzi

entry.summary: FedPLT proposes partial layer training for federated learning to reduce communication/computation while handling device heterogeneity, guided by empirical analysis of layer importance.

entry.title: M\textsuperscript{4}Fuse: Lightweight State-Space MoE with a Cross-Scale Gating Bridge for Brain Tumor Segmentation

author.name: Meihua Zhou, Xinyu Tong, Li Yang

entry.summary: M4Fuse is a lightweight 3D brain tumor segmentation network that balances encoder-decoder capacity using state space mixers, cross-scale gating bridges, and mixture-of-experts for domain adaptation. It achieves competitive performance on BraTS benchmarks with reduced computational cost.

entry.title: Middle-mile logistics through the lens of goal-conditioned reinforcement learning

author.name: Onno Eberhard, Thibaut Cuvelier, Michal Valko, Bruno De Backer

entry.summary: Reformulates middle-mile logistics (routing parcels through hub networks) as a multi-object goal-conditioned MDP and solves it using graph neural networks combined with model-free reinforcement learning.

entry.title: Random-Effects Algorithm for Random Objects in Metric Spaces

author.name: Marcos Matabuena, Mateo C\'amara

entry.summary: Proposes a nonlinear Fréchet-based random-effects algorithm for modeling arbitrary random objects in metric spaces, establishing consistency guarantees using M-estimation theory.

entry.title: DIAGRAMS: A Review Framework for Reasoning-Level Attribution in Diagram QA

author.name: Anirudh Iyengar Kaniyar Narayana Iyengar, Tampu Ravi Kumar, Manan Suri, Raviteja Bommireddy, Dinesh Manocha, Puneet Mathur, Vivek Gupta

entry.summary: DIAGRAMS is a lightweight annotation framework for diagram question answering that decouples interface logic from dataset formats, enabling reasoning-level attribution linking QA pairs to visual evidence regions.

entry.title: A Systematic Exploration of Text Decomposition and Budget Distribution in Differentially Private Text Obfuscation

author.name: Stephen Meisenbacher, Angelo Kleinert, Florian Matthes

entry.summary: Systematically evaluates text decomposition and privacy budget distribution techniques for differentially private text obfuscation at the document level.

entry.title: Interpretable Difficulty-Aware Knowledge Tracing in Tutor-Student Dialogues

author.name: Shuyan Huang, Alexander Scarlatos, Jaewook Lee, Andrew Lan

entry.summary: Proposes an interpretable difficulty-aware knowledge tracing framework for AI tutoring dialogues that explicitly models student abilities and task difficulty at each conversational turn.

entry.title: Artificial intelligence language technologies in multilingual healthcare: Grand challenges ahead

author.name: Vicent Briva-Iglesias

entry.summary: Reviews AI language technologies in multilingual healthcare, synthesizing evidence on written/spoken communication and agentic workflows, highlighting gaps between fluent output and clinically safe communication.

entry.title: Maistros: A Greek Large Language Model Adapted Through Knowledge Distillation From Large Reasoning Models

author.name: Nikolaos Giarelis, Charalampos Mastrokostas, Nikos Karacapilidis

entry.summary: Presents Maistros, a Greek LLM adapted through knowledge distillation from large reasoning models. Combines language-specific adaptation with reasoning capabilities transfer for a low-resource language setting.

entry.title: ATLAS: Article Tracking, Linking, and Analysis of Swedish Encyclopedias

author.name: Albin Andersson, Salam Jonasson, Fredrik Wastring, Pierre Nugues

entry.summary: Builds a pipeline for restoring text structure in digitized Swedish encyclopedias (Nordisk familjebok), including headword extraction, entity categorization, cross-edition matching, and Wikidata linking across four major editions.

entry.title: Revisiting Semantic Role Labeling: Efficient Structured Inference with Dependency-Informed Analysis

author.name: Sangpil Youm, Leah Jones, Bonnie J. Dorr

entry.summary: Revisits structured Semantic Role Labeling with a modernized encoder-based framework, replacing the deprecated AllenNLP. Preserves explicit predicate-argument structure while being compatible with modern architectures.

entry.title: The Pre-Training Study of Expanded-SPLADE Models on Web Document Titles

author.name: Hiun Kim, Tae Kwan Lee, Taeryun Won

entry.summary: Studies pre-training options for Expanded-SPLADE models using web document titles. Investigates how different pre-training datasets and options affect MLM pre-trained models for retrieval fine-tuning.

entry.title: NH-CROP: Robust Pricing for Governed Language Data Assets under Cost Uncertainty

author.name: Xu Zheng, Feiyu Wu, Zhuocheng Wang, Yiming Dai, Hui Li

entry.title: RA-CMF: Region-Adaptive Conditional MeanFlow for CT Image Reconstruction

author.name: Md Shifatul Ahsan Apurba, Md Selim, Jin Chen

entry.summary: Develops a conditional MeanFlow pipeline for CT image reconstruction with region-adaptive enhancement, using flow field prediction and consistency loss for CT image quality normalization across different scanners and protocols.

entry.title: Leveraging Imperfect Medical Data: A Manifold-Consistent Spatio-Temporal Network for Sensor-based Human Activity Recognition

author.name: Jiangtao Fan, Anish Jindal, Amir Atapour-Abarghouei

entry.summary: Proposes MCSTN for robust human activity recognition under imperfect IoMT sensing conditions, using manifold-consistent learning to handle missing measurements, sensor failures, and environmental noise.

entry.title: GameScope: A Multi-Attribute, Multi-Codec Benchmark Dataset for Gaming Video Quality Assessment

author.name: Rajesh Sureddi, Shreshth Saini, Avinab Saha, Alan C. Bovik

entry.summary: Presents GameScope, the largest gaming video quality dataset (4,048 samples across H.264, H.265, AV1 codecs) with MOS ratings, introducing quality-aware features and a no-reference model leveraging gaming-specific attributes.

entry.title: Zero-Shot Interpretable Image Steganalysis for Invertible Image Hiding

author.name: Hao Wang, Yiming Yao, Yaguang Xie, Tong Qiao, Zhidong Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes a zero-shot interpretable image steganalysis framework for invertible image hiding under zero-shot conditions, integrating hiding, revealing, and steganalysis in a unified framework.

entry.title: TRIMMER: A New Paradigm for Video Summarization through Self-Supervised Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Pritam Mishra, Coloma Ballester, Dimosthenis Karatzas

entry.summary: TRIMMER proposes a self-supervised reinforcement learning approach for video summarization that maximizes temporal relative information without requiring manual annotations. It addresses challenges of generalization and computational efficiency in unsupervised video summarization.

entry.title: BadmintonGRF: A Multimodal Dataset and Benchmark for Markerless Ground Reaction Force Estimation in Badminton

author.name: Kuoye Niu, Jianwei Li, Shengze Cai, Yong Ma, Mengyao Jia, Lishun Shen, Zhenheng Zhang, Yuxin Peng, Xian Song

entry.title: EAPFusion: Intrinsic Evolving Auxiliary Prior Guidance for Infrared and Visible Image Fusion

author.name: Zhenyu Sun, Luobin Zhang, Axi Niu, Haishen Wang, Qingsen Yan

entry.title: Rethinking Electro-Optical Vision Foundation Models for Remote Sensing Retrieval: A Controlled Comparison with Generalist VFM

author.name: Hyobin Park, Minseok Seo, Dong-Geol Choi

entry.title: UnGAP: Uncertainty-Guided Affine Prompting for Real-Time Crack Segmentation

entry.title: SPAT: A Semantic Port-Aware Adaptive-Rate Transmission Protocol for Semantic Communication

author.name: Yunhao Wang, Shuai Ma, Bin Shen, Shouhan Shi, Youlong Wu, Guangming Shi, Xiang Cheng

entry.title: A Proof-of-Concept Study of Multitask Learning for Cranial Synthetic CT Generation Across Heterogeneous MRI Field Strengths

author.name: Zhuoyao Xin, Yiren Zhang, Christopher Wu, Dong Liu, Chunming Gu, Elena Greco, Erik H. Middlebrooks, Jun Hua, Jia Guo

entry.summary: Proposes a multitask learning framework for generating synthetic CT from MRI across heterogeneous field strengths, enabling attenuation correction and radiotherapy planning with improved generalizability.

entry.title: Interactive Multi-Turn Retrieval for Health Videos

author.name: Chengzheng Wu, Ke Qiu, Baoming Zhang, Ruiyu Mao, Xulong Tang, Kaixing Yang

entry.title: Evolving Token Communication with Parametric Memory Network

author.name: Weixuan Chen, Qianqian Yang

entry.title: Ablation Study of Multimodal Perception, Language Grounding, and Control for Human-Robot Interaction in an Object Detection and Grasping Task

author.name: Zi Tian, Guanting Shen

entry.title: Terrain Perception for Agricultural UAVs in Complex Farmland via Rotating mmWave Radar

author.name: Zhihao Zhan, Le Tao, Shaobin Li, Chenxin Fang, Xingrui Yang, Liang Li, Rui Fan, Yuhang Ming

entry.title: Optimizing Trajectory-Trees in Belief Space: An Application from Model Predictive Control to Task and Motion Planning

author.name: Camille Phiquepal, Marc Toussaint

entry.title: Shared Autonomy Assisted by Impedance-Driven Anisotropic Guidance Field

entry.title: Behavior-Grounded Lane Representation Learning for Multi-Task Traffic Digital Twins

author.name: Rei Tamaru, Pei Li, Bin Ran

entry.title: Momentum-Anchored Multi-Scale Fusion Model for Long-Tailed Chest X-Ray Classification

entry.title: Multimodal Confidence Modeling in Audio-Visual Quality Assessment

entry.title: Triple Spectral Fusion for Sensor-based Human Activity Recognition

entry.title: Adaptive Gait Generation for Multi-Terrain Exoskeletons via Constrained Kernelized Movement Primitives

entry.title: Quantifying and Predicting Disagreement in Graded Human Ratings

entry.title: TCDA: Thread-Constrained Discourse-Aware Modeling for Conversational Sentiment Quadruple Analysis

entry.title: Selective Attention-Based Network for Robust Infrared Small Target Detection

author.name: Yingming Zhang, Wuqi Su, Qing Xiao, Yonggang Yang

entry.title: Low-Latency Embedded Driver Monitoring System with a Multi-Task Neural Network

entry.title: EduGage: Methods and Dataset for Sensor-Based Momentary Assessment of Engagement in Self-Guided Video Learning

entry.title: LiDAR for Rehabilitation: A Comprehensive Survey of Applications, AI Techniques, and Future Directions

entry.title: FedACT: Concurrent Federated Intelligence across Heterogeneous Data Sources

author.name: Md Sirajul Islam, Isabelle G Chapman, N I Md Ashafuddula, Xu Yuan, Li Chen, Nian-Feng Tzeng, Klara Nahrstedt

entry.title: Remote SAMsing: From Segment Anything to Segment Everything

author.name: Xin Liu, Yuhang He, Sichen Zhao, Kejian Tong, Xingyu Zhang

entry.title: The Banach-Butterfly Invariant: Influence-Adaptive Walsh Geometry for Ternary Polynomial Threshold Functions

author.name: S M Asif Hossain, Shruti Kshirsagar

author.name: S M Asif Hossain, Shruti Kshirsagar

entry.title: Open-access model for detecting openly dumped dispersed municipal solid waste from crowdsourced UAV imagery in Sub-Saharan Africa

author.name: Steffen Knoblauch, Ram Kumar Muthusamy, Luis M. A. Bettencourt, Costas Velis, Pierre Chrzanowski, Edward Charles Anderson, Pete Masters, Innocent Maholi, Antonio Inguane, Levi Szamek, Alexander Zipf

entry.title: ProPACT: A Proactive AI-Driven Adaptive Collaborative Tutor for Pair Programming

author.name: Anahita Golrang, Kshitij Sharma, olga viberg

entry.title: Adaptive Interpolation-Synthesis for Motion In-Betweening on Keyframe-Based Animation

author.name: Anton Ra\"el, Julien Boucher, Antoine Lhermitte

author.name: Valter Estevam, Rayson Laroca, Helio Pedrini, David Menotti

entry.summary: Proposes CEZSAR, a contrastive learning-based method for zero-shot action recognition that addresses semantic gap and domain shift between textual label representations and visual representations.

entry.title: A Hybrid Approach for Closing the Sim2real Appearance Gap in Game Engine Synthetic Datasets

author.name: Stefanos Pasios

entry.title: Rethinking Low-Light Image Enhancement: A Log-Domain Intensity--Chromaticity Decoupling Perspective

entry.summary: Presents a bi-level reinforcement learning framework for underactuated blimp control with center-of-mass reconfiguration, decoupling task-level CoM planning from continuous thrust control.

author.name: Yi Dong. Yangjun Liu, Jinjun Duan, Yang Li, Zhendong Dai

author.name: P\'eter Antal, Andrea Carron, Melanie Zeilinger, Roland T\'oth, Tam\'as P\'eni

entry.title: Why Model Selection Fails in Time Series Forecasting: An Empirical Study of Instability Across Data Regimes

author.name: Tahir Cetin Akinci, Alfredo A. Martinez-Morales

author.name: Kejia Bian, Meixia Tao, Jianhua Mo, Zhiyong Chen, Leyan Chen

entry.summary: Proposes AirFM-DDA, a wireless foundation model operating in the Delay-Doppler-Angle domain for 6G physical layer tasks. Reparameterizes channel state information from space-time-frequency to DDA domain for better multipath component separation.

entry.title: Compliance-Aware Agentic Payments on Stablecoin Rails

entry.summary: Evaluates Intelligence Processing Units (IPUs) for AI-accelerated computational fluid dynamics simulations, adapting training programs to the IPU-POD16 platform and investigating performance scalability.

entry.title: Sparse Regression under Correlation and Weak Signals: A Reproducible Benchmark of Classical and Bayesian Methods

author.name: Hao Xiao

entry.summary: Benchmarks six sparse regression methods (OLS, Ridge, Lasso, Elastic Net, Horseshoe, Spike-and-Slab) across 2,600+ experiments with varying correlation, signal strength, and dimensionality.

entry.summary: Proposes a hybrid quantum-classical approach integrating QAOA into QRL policy networks for vehicle routing, claiming faster convergence and ability to handle larger instances than pure quantum approaches.

author.name: Daniel da Silva Costa, Pedro Nuno de Souza Moura, Adriana C. F. Alvim

entry.title: An Efficient Spatial Branch-and-Bound Algorithm for Global Optimization of Gaussian Process Posterior Mean Functions

entry.title: PPO guided Agentic Pipeline for Adaptive Prompt Selection and Test Case Generation

entry.title: Equation-Free Digital Twins for Nonlinear Structural Dynamics

entry.title: Differentiable Multiphysics Co-Optimization via Implicit Neural Representations: A Transient Hamburger-Cooking Benchmark

author.name: Navid Zobeiry

entry.title: Multimodal Data Curation Through Ranked Retrieval

author.name: Pratyush Muthukumar, Harshil Kotamreddy, Sarah Amiraslani, Tomo Kanazawa, Ramani Akkati, Shaan Jain, Andrew Mathau

entry.title: Mean Testing under Truncation beyond Gaussian

author.name: Yuhao Wang, Roberto Imbuzeiro Oliveira, Themis Gouleakis

entry.title: SwiftChannel: Algorithm-Hardware Co-Design for Deep Learning-Based 5G Channel Estimation

author.name: Shengzhe Lyu, Yuhan She, Di Duan, Tao Ni, Yu Hin Chan, Chengwen Luo, Ray C. C. Cheung, Weitao Xu

entry.summary: SwiftChannel proposes algorithm-hardware co-design for 5G channel estimation using CNN with parameter-free attention and a dedicated FPGA accelerator for real-time performance.

entry.title: Benchmarking Wireless Representations: High-Dimensional vs. Compressed Embeddings for Efficiency and Robustness

author.name: Murilo Batista, Shirin Salehi, Saeed Mashdour, Paul Zheng, Rodrigo C. de Lamare, Anke Schmeink

entry.summary: Benchmarks wireless channel representations comparing high-dimensional foundation model embeddings, compact autoencoder representations, and raw data across multiple downstream tasks for efficiency and robustness.

entry.title: Pair2Score: Pairwise-to-Absolute Transfer for LLM-Based Essay Scoring

author.name: \.Ibrahim R{\i}za Halla\c{c}, Hasan O\u{g}ul

entry.summary: Pair2Score transfers pairwise comparison learning to absolute essay scoring using LLaMA with a two-stage framework: directional Siamese ranking followed by absolute prediction with configurable transfer strategies.

entry.title: MultiSense-Pneumo: A Multimodal Learning Framework for Pneumonia Screening in Resource-Constrained Settings

author.name: Dineth Jayakody, Pasindu Thenahandi, Chameli Dommanige

entry.summary: MultiSense-Pneumo integrates symptoms, cough audio, spoken language, and chest radiographs for pneumonia screening in resource-constrained settings using a multimodal framework.

entry.title: Can Causal Discovery Algorithms Help in Generating Legal Arguments?

author.name: Soham Wasmatkar, Subinay Adhikary, Rakshit Rohan, Shouvik Kumar Guha, Saptarshi Pyne, Kripabandhu Ghosh

entry.summary: Investigates whether causal discovery algorithms can be leveraged for automated generation of legal arguments, bridging Pearl's causal calculus with legal reasoning.

entry.title: TRACED: In vivo imaging of extracellular intrinsic diffusivity, tortuosity, cell size distribution and cell density in human glioma patients

author.name: Joshua K. Marchant, Hong-Hsi Lee, Elizabeth R. Gerstner, Susie Y. Huang, Bruce R. Rosen

entry.summary: Introduces TRACED, a biophysical model using neural networks trained on Monte Carlo diffusion simulations to quantify tumor microstructure properties from diffusion MRI data in glioma patients.

entry.title: Structural Dilemmas and Developmental Pathways of Legal Argument Mining in the Era of Artificial Intelligence

author.name: Xianglei Liao, Chuanyi Li, Kun Chen

entry.summary: A survey paper on structural dilemmas and developmental pathways of legal argument mining in the AI era, covering data, technology, and theoretical dimensions of the field.

entry.title: mdok-style at SemEval-2026 Task 9: Finetuning LLMs for Multilingual Polarization Detection

author.name: Dominik Macko, Alok Debnath, Jakub Simko

entry.summary: System description for SemEval-2026 Task 9 on multilingual polarization detection, using QLoRA fine-tuning of mid-size LLMs for sequence classification across 22 languages.

entry.title: Spoken Language Identification with Pre-trained Models and Margin Loss

author.name: Zhihua Fang, Liang He, Weiwu Jiang

entry.summary: Proposes a language identification method using pre-trained ECAPA-TDNN with margin-based losses for the TidyLang Challenge 2026. Achieves 85.95% macro accuracy on the Tidy-X dataset.

entry.title: Single Image Defogging Using a Fourth-Order Telegraph PDE Guided by Physical Haze Modeling

author.name: Manish Kumar, Rajendra K. Ray

entry.summary: Proposes a hybrid image defogging model combining a fourth-order nonlinear PDE (telegraph type) with Dark Channel Prior for atmospheric parameter estimation. The PDE-based evolution preserves structural details while suppressing haze.

entry.title: Profile-Specific 3DMM Regression from a Single Lateral Face Image

author.name: Taiki Kanaya, Hideo Saito

entry.summary: Proposes profile-specific 3D Morphable Model regression from a single lateral face image, targeting clinical applications like cephalometric analysis in orthodontics as an alternative to lateral X-ray imaging.

entry.title: Super-resolution of airborne laser scanning point clouds for forest inventory

author.name: Jinyuan Shao, Sangyoong Park, Chunxi Zhao, Ayman Habib, Songlin Fei

entry.summary: 3DFSR proposes a voxel-based U-Net CNN for super-resolution of airborne laser scanning point clouds in forests, simultaneously improving point density and reducing noise for better individual tree inventory.

entry.title: EdgeLPR: On the Deep Neural Network trade-off between Precision and Performance in LiDAR Place Recognition

author.name: Pierpaolo Serio, Hetian Wang, Zixiang Wei, Vincenzo Infantino, Lorenzo Gentilini, Lorenzo Pollini, Valentina Donzella

entry.summary: EdgeLPR explores efficient LiDAR place recognition for edge devices using Bird's Eye View representations, benchmarking architectures under different quantization levels (FP32, FP16, INT8) for autonomous navigation.

entry.title: Multispectral Blind Image Super-Resolution for Standing Dead Tree Segmentation

author.name: Mete Ahishali, Anis Ur Rahman, Einari Heinaro, Aysen Degerli, Samuli Junttila

entry.summary: Proposes a blind super-resolution framework using Attention-Guided Domain Adaptation Networks for multispectral images of standing dead trees, working with unpaired low-resolution and high-resolution samples.

entry.title: Quaternion Nonlinear Transform-Induced Nuclear Norm for Low-Rank Tensor Completion

author.name: Biswarup Karmakar, Ratikanta Behera

entry.summary: Proposes quaternion-based nonlinear transform tensor nuclear norm for low-rank tensor completion, extending existing methods to handle quaternion-valued data like color images and videos.

entry.title: Sonar-GPS Fusion for Seabed Mapping in Turbid Shallow Waters with an Autonomous Surface Vehicle

author.name: Yisheng Zhang, Michael Xu, Alan Williams, Matthew Gray, Nare Karapetyan, Miao Yu

entry.title: Optimized and kinematically feasible multi-agent motion planning

entry.title: VILAS: A VLA-Integrated Low-cost Architecture with Soft Grasping for Robotic Manipulation

author.name: Zijian An (Luna), Hadi Khezam (Luna), Bill Cai (Luna), Ran Yang (Luna), Shijie Geng (Luna), Yiming Feng (Luna), Yue (Luna), Zheng, Lifeng Zhou

entry.title: Sim-to-Real Transfer and Robustness Evaluation of Reinforcement Learning Control with Integrated Perception on an ASV for Floating Waste Capture

author.name: Luis F. W. Batista, St\'ephanie Aravecchia, C\'edric Pradalier

author.name: \.Ismail G\"uzel

entry.title: AIDA-ReID: Adaptive Intermediate Domain Adaptation for Generalizable and Source-Free Person Re-Identification

author.name: Sundas Iqbal, Qing Tian, Danish Ali, Jianping Gou, Weihua Oue

entry.title: Interpretable experiential learning based on state history and global feedback

author.name: Anton Kolonin

entry.summary: Presents an interpretable experiential learning model based on state history and global feedback, using transition graphs for reinforcement learning in resource-constrained environments, evaluated on Atari Breakout.

entry.title: Continual Learning of Feedback-based Molecular Communication

author.name: Siddhant Setia, Junichi Suzuki, Tadashi Nakano

entry.title: GA-VisAgent: A Multi-Agent application for code generation and visualization in interactive learning

author.name: Wang Jian, Zhou Jianbo, Xiong Yuhao, Liu Zhenxia, Luo Wen, Yuan LinWang, Yu ZhaoYuan

author.name: Yingzhe Wang, Cunhua Pan, Ruijing Liu, Shaokai Li, Hong Ren, Kezhi Wang, Jiangzhou Wang

author.name: Ikhlas Enaieh (S2A, LTCI), Olivier Fercoq (S2A, LTCI), Garc\'ia \'Angel (DATSI, UPM)

entry.title: Spatial-Temporal Learning-Based Distributed Routing for Dynamic LEO Satellite Networks

entry.title: Representation learning from OCT images

author.name: Hedi Tabia, D\'esir\'e Sidib\'e, Nawres Khlifa, Ahmed Tabia, Ines Rahmany, Noura Aboudi, Zainab Haddad, Hajer Khachnaoui, Hsouna Zgolli

entry.summary: Provides a comprehensive survey of representation learning methods for retinal OCT image analysis, covering deep learning approaches through recent foundation models.

entry.title: Multi-fidelity surrogates for mechanics of composites: from co-kriging to multi-fidelity neural networks

author.name: Haizhou Wen, Elham Kiyani, Gang Li, Srikanth Pilla, George Em Karniadakis, Zhen Li

entry.summary: Reviews multi-fidelity surrogate modeling approaches for composite materials mechanics, covering Gaussian processes, co-Kriging, and multi-fidelity neural networks.

entry.title: Addressing Data Scarcity in Bangla Fake News Detection: An LLM-Based Dataset Augmentation Approach

author.name: Ahmed Alfey Sani, Kazi Akib Zaoad, Shefayat E Shams Adib, Md Abdul Muqtadir, Ajwad Abrar

entry.title: Fine-Tuning Pre-Trained Code Models for AI-Generated Code Detection

author.name: Jany-Gabriel Ispas, Sergiu Nisioi
