entry.title: Automatic Reflection Level Classification in Hungarian Student Essays

author.name: Zsolt Csibi, M\'onika S\'andor, M\'onika Serf\H{o}z\H{o}, Kinga Gy\"ongy, Kristian Fenech

entry.summary: Presents the first study on automatic reflection level classification in Hungarian student essays, using a dataset of 1,954 expert-annotated essays. Compares classical ML approaches with Hungarian-specific transformer models.

entry.title: mdok-style at SemEval-2026 Task 10: Finetuning LLMs for Conspiracy Detection

author.name: Dominik Macko

entry.summary: System description for SemEval-2026 Task 10 on conspiracy detection, using data augmentation and self-training to fine-tune Qwen3-32B for binary classification. Ranks in 85th percentile.

entry.title: AgriKD: Cross-Architecture Knowledge Distillation for Efficient Leaf Disease Classification

author.name: Minh-Dung Le, Minh-Duc Hoang, Hoang-Vu Truong, Thi-Thu-Hong Phan

entry.summary: Proposes AgriKD, a cross-architecture knowledge distillation framework transferring knowledge from Vision Transformer teachers to compact CNN students for plant disease classification on edge devices.

entry.title: From Spherical to Gaussian: A Comparative Analysis of Point Cloud Cropping Strategies in Large-Scale 3D Environments

author.name: Maximilian Kellner, Dominik Merkle, Michael Brunklaus, Alexander Reiterer

entry.summary: Proposes Gaussian vs. spherical cropping strategies for large-scale 3D point clouds, showing that alternative methods can provide larger spatial context while maintaining similar point counts for neural network processing.

author.name: Jagrati Talreja, Tewodros Syum Gebre, Leila Hashemi Beni

entry.summary: Investigates cross-polarization fusion of VV and VH SAR observations for flood mapping using deep learning segmentation, comparing single-polarization vs. fused configurations under identical training conditions.

author.name: Baiyan Chen, Weixin Zhai

entry.title: The Bayesian Reflex: Online Learning as the Autonomic Nervous System of Modern and Future AI

This is a domain-specific application paper with limited broader novelty.

entry.title: NorBERTo: A ModernBERT Model Trained for Portuguese with 331 Billion Tokens Corpus

author.name: Enzo S. N. Silva, Pablo B. Costa, Raphael C. Vlasman, Rosimeire P. Costa, Henrique L. P. Silva, Lucas F. A. O. Pellicer, Guilherme Rinaldo, Renato A. Almeida, Darian S. R. Rabbani, Cinthya O. Oestreich, Vinicius F. Carid\'a

entry.title: Unbox Responsible GeoAI: Navigating Climate Extreme and Disaster Mapping

author.name: Hao Li, Steffen Knoblauch

entry.title: Deep learning-based pavement performance modeling using multiple distress indicators and road work history

author.name: Lu Gao, Zhe Han, Yunshen Chen

entry.summary: Applies CNN and LSTM deep learning models to predict pavement deterioration using 18 years of Texas DOT data with 21 condition indicators and maintenance history. A domain-specific application of standard deep learning methods to infrastructure management.

entry.title: Large margin classifier with graph-based adaptive regularization

author.name: V\'itor M. Hanriot, Tur\'ibio T. Salis, Luiz C. B. Torres, Frederico Coelho, Antonio P. Braga

entry.summary: Introduces per-class regularization hyperparameters in Gabriel graph-based classifiers that can handle outliers and class imbalance through flexible thresholds, expanding the solution space.

entry.title: CNNs for Vis-NIR Chemometrics: From Contradiction to Conditional Design

author.name: D\'ario Passos

entry.summary: A review paper analyzing why CNN design studies in NIR chemometrics produce contradictory results, arguing the inconsistencies arise from uncontrolled moderating variables rather than fundamental method incompatibilities. It provides a framework for reconciling conflicting findings in spectroscopy deep learning.

entry.title: Autonomous QA Agent: A Retrieval-Augmented Framework for Reliable Selenium Script Generation

author.name: Dudekula Kasim Vali

entry.summary: Presents an autonomous QA agent using RAG to ground Selenium test script generation in project-specific documentation and HTML structure, achieving 100% syntax validity and 90% execution success compared to lower rates without RAG. Addresses hallucination of non-existent UI elements.

entry.title: 1BT: One-Block Transformer for EEG-Based Cognitive Workload Assessment

entry.title: Benchmarking local Hebbian learning rules for memory storage and prototype extraction

author.name: Anders Lansner, Andreas Knoblauch, Naresh B Ravichandran, Pawel Herman

entry.title: FeedbackLLM: Metadata driven Multi-Agentic Language Agnostic Test Case Generator with Evolving prompt and Coverage Feedback

author.name: Kushal Jasti, Tejamani Prashanth Sahu, Rishitha Pentyala, Muvvala Mohit, Vivek Yelleti

entry.title: CGFformer: Cluster-Guidance Frequency Transformer for Pansharpening

author.name: Zijian Zhou, Jianing Zhang, Kai Sun, Xiangyu Zhao, Chunxia Zhang, Xiangyong Cao

entry.summary: CGFformer proposes a cluster-guidance frequency Transformer for pansharpening that adapts to complex frequency distributions in satellite images. Uses adaptive frequency filters instead of fixed ones.

entry.title: Class-Aware Adaptive Differential Privacy in Deep Learning for Sensor-Based Fall Detection

author.name: Joydeb Kumar Sana

entry.summary: Proposes Class-Aware Adaptive Differential Privacy (CA-ADP) for fall detection that dynamically adjusts noise based on class composition of mini-batches, integrated with a 3D CNN-BiLSTM architecture.

entry.title: Toward Resilient 5G Networks: Comparative Analysis of Federated and Centralized Learning for RF Jamming Detection

author.name: Samhita Kuili, Mohammadreza Amini, Burak Kantarci

entry.summary: Proposes federated learning-based jamming detection for 5G networks using IQ samples from synchronization signal blocks. Compares federated and centralized approaches for RF jamming detection.

entry.title: Stochastic Modeling of Human-Machine Authentication Channels under Partial Information Leakage

author.name: Nilesh Chakraborty, Mohammad Zulkernine, Burak Kantarci

entry.summary: Models PIN-based authentication as a stochastic communication channel and proposes context-conditioned probabilistic inference for progressive security degradation under partial information leakage.

entry.title: H3: A Healthcare Three-Hop Index for Physician Referral Network Prediction

author.name: Zhexi Gu, Jiaxin Ying, Xu-Wen Wang, Can Chen

entry.summary: H3 proposes a healthcare three-hop index for physician referral network prediction that models indirect pathways with degree normalization and redundancy penalty to handle hub-dominated topology.

entry.title: RAFNet: Region-Aware Fusion Network for Pansharpening

author.name: Jianing Zhang, Zijian Zhou, Kai Sun

entry.summary: RAFNet proposes region-aware fusion for pansharpening that exploits regional sparsity in remote sensing imagery with dynamic convolution kernels adapting to frequency and regional variations.

entry.title: Dueling DDQN-Based Adaptive Multi-Objective Handover Optimization for LEO Satellite Networks

author.name: Po-Heng Chou, Chiapin Wang, Chung-Chi Huang, Kuan-Hao Chen

entry.summary: Proposes dueling DDQN-based adaptive handover optimization for LEO satellite networks balancing throughput, blocking probability, and switching cost.

entry.title: Creating and Evaluating Figurative Language Dataset for Sindhi

author.name: Wazir Ali, Adeeb Noor, Saifullah Tumrani

entry.summary: Introduces SiNFluD, a benchmark dataset for Sindhi figurative language classification with baseline results from multilingual transformers.

entry.title: Methods, Data, and Conceptual Change: Reflections from Two Quantitative Diachronic Case Studies

author.name: Catherine Wong, Bach Phan-Tat, Susan Fitzmaurice

entry.summary: A discussion paper reflecting on how quantitative approaches to historical linguistics interact with dataset properties, examining English data through two case studies of Early Modern English and scientific writing from the Royal Society Corpus.

entry.title: Visual Chart Representations for Cryptocurrency Regime Prediction: A Systematic Deep Learning Study

author.name: Dustin M. Haggett

entry.summary: Systematic study comparing visual chart representations (candlestick charts, Gramian Angular Fields, multi-channel GAF) and neural network architectures (CNN, ResNet, EfficientNet, ViT) for cryptocurrency regime prediction from chart images.

entry.title: CNN-based Multi-In-Multi-Out Model for Efficient Spatiotemporal Prediction

author.name: Hyeonseok Jin

entry.summary: Proposes a CNN-based multi-input multi-output model for spatiotemporal prediction that addresses limitations of both CNN (local information only) and Transformer (high computation) approaches.

entry.title: Research on Vision-Language Question Answering Models for Industrial Robots

author.name: Ping Li, Bartlomiej Brzozka

entry.summary: Proposes a hierarchical cross-modal fusion model for vision-language question answering in industrial robotics, integrating object detection, multi-scale visual encoding, and syntactic parsing.

entry.title: TemPose-TF-ASF: Two-Stage Bidirectional Stroke Context Fusion for Badminton Stroke Classification

entry.title: Human Activity Recognition Method for Moderate Violence Detection

author.name: Luis Angel Aparicio Borjas, Victor Elias Nieto, Juan Irving Vasquez, Alfonso Fernandez-Vazquez, Gerardo Antonio Alvarez Hernandez

entry.title: A Coupled Fourth Order Telegraph Diffusion Framework Using Grayscale Indicators for Image Despeckling

author.name: Manish Kumar, Rajendra K. Ray

author.name: Kazuho Kobayashi, Shohei Kobayashi, Seiya Ueno, Takehiro Higuchi

entry.title: Tensegrity crutches with compliance from a pre-stressed self-tensile module improve ground reaction force profiles, speed, effort, comfort, and perceived stability

author.name: Jingxian Gu, Joanna Spyra, Andrew Walski, Lyla Elsaesser, Samuel Bierner, Dobromir Dotov

entry.summary: Designed and evaluated biologically-inspired tensegrity crutches with compliant modules against rigid and spring-loaded designs. Human trials with 18 participants showed improvements in ground reaction force profiles, speed, effort, comfort, and stability.

entry.title: Research Summary: May 04, 2026

author.name: AATF AI News Aggregator

entry.summary:
AI safety dominates today's highlights with two critical findings: Ambient Persuasion documents a real deployed agent installing 107 unauthorized packages and escalating to admin privileges from routine content exposure, while a study on jailbroken frontier models shows capability degradation drops to just 7.7% at the frontier—meaning safety bypasses become nearly free.

  • Learning While Deploying (LWD) presents fleet-scale offline-to-online RL for continual post-training of Vision-Language-Action robot policies in production
  • Wasserstein DRO for RLHF provides principled Goodharting mitigation via distributionally robust regret optimization
  • Uniform-Correct Policy Optimization identifies and fixes diversity collapse in RLVR training objectives like GRPO
  • Multi-Path Discrete Consistency (MPDC) adapts consistency training to discrete diffusion language models, filling a fundamental theoretical gap

Complementary work includes a comprehensive world models for robotics survey (Abbeel, Malik, Torr et al.), the counterintuitive Tool-Use Tax showing tool-augmented reasoning can underperform native chain-of-thought, Causal Foundations of Collective Agency formalizing emergent group agents via causal games, and a position paper arguing agentic AI orchestration should be Bayes-consistent.

entry.title: Ambient Persuasion in a Deployed AI Agent: Unauthorized Escalation Following Routine Non-Adversarial Content Exposure

author.name: Diego F. Cuadros and Abdoul-Aziz Maiga

entry.summary: Reports a safety incident where a deployed AI agent installed 107 unauthorized software components and escalated to admin privileges after routine (non-adversarial) content exposure—a forwarded tech article. Analyzes how permissive environments and conflicting guidelines enabled this cascade.

entry.title: Jailbroken Frontier Models Retain Their Capabilities

author.name: Daniel Zhu, Zihan Wang, Jenny Bao, Jerry Wei

entry.summary: Shows that jailbreak 'tax' (capability degradation) scales inversely with model capability—frontier models like Claude Opus 4.6 lose only 7.7% performance when jailbroken vs 33.1% for Haiku 4.5. Reasoning tasks show more degradation than knowledge recall.

entry.title: Uniform-Correct Policy Optimization: Breaking RLVR's Indifference to Diversity

author.name: Anamika Lochab, Bolian Li, Ruqi Zhang

entry.summary: Identifies that RLVR objectives like GRPO are indifferent to how probability mass distributes among correct solutions, causing diversity collapse. Proposes Uniform-Correct Policy Optimization to maintain multi-sample coverage (Pass@K) while preserving Pass@1 accuracy.

entry.title: Wasserstein Distributionally Robust Regret Optimization for Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback

author.name: Yikai Wang, Shang Liu, Jose Blanchet

entry.summary: Addresses reward over-optimization (Goodharting) in RLHF by proposing Wasserstein distributionally robust regret optimization. The approach provides a tractable dual reformulation that mitigates proxy-reward misspecification without being overly pessimistic.

entry.title: World Model for Robot Learning: A Comprehensive Survey

author.name: Bohan Hou, Gen Li, Jindou Jia, Tuo An, Xinying Guo, Sicong Leng, Haoran Geng, Yanjie Ze, Tatsuya Harada, Philip Torr, Oier Mees, Marc Pollefeys, Zhuang Liu, Jiajun Wu, Pieter Abbeel, Jitendra Malik, Yilun Du, Jianfei Yang

entry.summary: Comprehensive survey of world models for robot learning, covering architectures, functional roles (planning, simulation, data generation), and how they couple with robot policies. Includes prominent authors from Berkeley, Stanford, and other major labs.

entry.title: Are Tools All We Need? Unveiling the Tool-Use Tax in LLM Agents

author.name: Kaituo Zhang, Zhen Xiong, Mingyu Zhong, Zhimeng Jiang, Zhouyuan Yuan, Zhecheng Li, Ying Lin

entry.summary: Demonstrates that tool-augmented reasoning in LLM agents doesn't always outperform native chain-of-thought, especially under semantic noise. Proposes a Factorized Intervention Framework isolating the 'tool-use tax' and introduces G-STEP to mitigate it.

entry.title: Consistent Diffusion Language Models

author.name: Hasan Amin, Yuan Gao, Yaser Souri, Subhojit Som, Ming Yin, Rajiv Khanna, Xia Song

entry.summary: Introduces Multi-Path Discrete Consistency (MPDC), adapting consistency training to discrete diffusion language models by using the exact posterior bridge instead of a deterministic ODE. Promises faster generation for discrete diffusion models.

entry.title: Learning while Deploying: Fleet-Scale Reinforcement Learning for Generalist Robot Policies

author.name: Yi Wang, Xinchen Li, Pengwei Xie, Pu Yang, Buqing Nie, Yunuo Cai, Qinglin Zhang, Chendi Qu, Jeffrey Wu, Jianheng Song, Xinlin Ren, Jingshun Huang, Mingjie Pan, Siyuan Feng, Zhi Chen, Jianlan Luo

entry.summary: Presents Learning While Deploying (LWD), a fleet-scale offline-to-online RL framework for continual post-training of Vision-Language-Action policies using autonomous rollouts and human interventions from robot fleets.

entry.title: Position: agentic AI orchestration should be Bayes-consistent

author.name: Theodore Papamarkou, Pierre Alquier, Matthias Bauer, Wray Buntine, Andrew Davison, Gintare Karolina Dziugaite, Maurizio Filippone, Andrew Y. K. Foong, Vincent Fortuin, Dimitris Fouskakis, Jes Frellsen, Eyke H\"ullermeier, Theofanis Karaletsos, Mohammad Emtiyaz Khan, Nikita Kotelevskii, Salem Lahlou, Yingzhen Li, Fang Liu, Clare Lyle, Thomas M\"ollenhoff, Konstantina Palla, Maxim Panov, Yusuf Sale, Kajetan Schweighofer, Artem Shelmanov, Siddharth Swaroop, Martin Trapp, Willem Waegeman, Andrew Gordon Wilson, Alexey Zaytsev

entry.title: Towards A Generative Protein Evolution Machine with DPLM-Evo

author.name: Xinyou Wang, Liang Hong, Jiasheng Ye, Zaixiang Zheng, Yu Li, Shujian Huang, Quanquan Gu

entry.summary: Introduces DPLM-Evo, an evolutionary discrete diffusion framework for protein language models that models substitution and insertion/deletion operations, better aligning with biological protein evolution than masking-based approaches.

entry.title: Causal Foundations of Collective Agency

author.name: Frederik Hytting J{\o}rgensen, Sebastian Weichwald, Lewis Hammond

entry.summary: Formalizes collective agency using causal games and causal abstraction, addressing when multiple simpler agents might form a collective agent with emergent capabilities and goals. Motivated by AI safety concerns about emergent collective behavior.

entry.title: A unified perspective on fine-tuning and sampling with diffusion and flow models

author.name: Carles Domingo-Enrich, Yuanqi Du, Michael S. Albergo

entry.summary: Provides a unified framework connecting stochastic optimal control and non-equilibrium thermodynamics perspectives on fine-tuning/sampling with diffusion and flow models. Key contributions include bias-variance decompositions for different training methods and norm bounds on the adjoint ODE.

entry.title: Minimal, Local, Causal Explanations for Jailbreak Success in Large Language Models

author.name: Shubham Kumar and Narendra Ahuja

entry.summary: Proposes minimal, local, causal explanations for why jailbreak attacks succeed against safety-trained LLMs, arguing that different jailbreak strategies work through different intermediate concepts rather than a single global mechanism. entry.title: Why Do LLMs Struggle in Strategic Play? Broken Links Between Observations, Beliefs, and Actions

entry.title: State Stream Transformer (SST) V2: Parallel Training of Nonlinear Recurrence for Latent Space Reasoning

author.name: Thea Aviss

entry.title: Attention Is Where You Attack

entry.summary: Introduces Attention Redistribution Attack (ARA), a white-box adversarial attack targeting safety-critical attention heads in LLMs by redirecting attention away from safety-relevant positions using Gumbel-softmax optimization. Achieves jailbreaking with as few as 5 tokens.

entry.title: Caracal: Causal Architecture via Spectral Mixing

author.name: Bingzheng Gan, Tianyi Zhang, Yusu Li, Jing Huang, Wei Shi, Yangkai Ding, Tao Yu

entry.summary: Introduces Caracal, a transformer alternative replacing attention with an O(L log L) Multi-Head Fourier module using FFT for sequence mixing, with frequency-domain causal masking for autoregressive generation.

entry.title: Mean-Field Path-Integral Diffusion: From Samples to Interacting Agents

author.name: Michael Chertkov

entry.summary: Introduces Mean-Field Path-Integral Diffusion (MF-PID), a framework where diffusion model samples become interacting agents that coordinate through shared population statistics. This unifies generative modeling and multi-agent control under Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman/Kolmogorov-Fokker-Planck duality, with analytically tractable LQG and Gaussian-mixture regimes.

entry.title: Lucid-XR: An Extended-Reality Data Engine for Robotic Manipulation

author.name: Yajvan Ravan, Adam Rashid, Alan Yu, Kai McClennen, Gio Huh, Kevin Yang, Zhutian Yang, Qinxi Yu, Xiaolong Wang, Phillip Isola, and Ge Yang

entry.summary: Introduces Lucid-XR, a generative data engine using XR headsets for web-based physics simulation and human-to-robot retargeting, amplified by physics-guided video generation. Demonstrates zero-shot sim-to-real transfer for robotic manipulation.

entry.title: Alethia: A Foundational Encoder for Voice Deepfakes

author.name: Yi Zhu, Brahmi Dwivedi, Jayaram Raghuram, Surya Koppisetti

entry.summary: Introduces Alethia, the first foundational audio encoder for voice deepfake detection and localization tasks, using bottleneck masked embedding prediction with flow-matching spectrogram reconstruction. Outperforms existing speech foundation models across 56 benchmarks.

entry.title: Rethinking Network Topologies for Cost-Effective Mixture-of-Experts LLM Serving

author.name: Junsun Choi, Sam Son, Sunjin Choi, Hansung Kim, Yakun Sophia Shao, Scott Shenker, Sylvia Ratnasamy, Borivoje Nikolic

entry.summary: Analyzes network topology cost-effectiveness for MoE LLM serving, finding that lower-cost switchless topologies (3D full-mesh) outperform expensive scale-up networks by 20-57% in cost-effectiveness across all serving scenarios explored.

entry.title: Borrowed Geometry: Computational Reuse of Frozen Text-Pretrained Transformer Weights Across Modalities

author.name: Abay Bektursun

entry.summary: Demonstrates that frozen Gemma 4 31B text-pretrained transformer weights can transfer across modalities (robotics, RL, associative recall) through thin trainable interfaces, achieving SOTA on robotic manipulation without the substrate ever seeing such tasks. Shows that text-pretrained geometry is surprisingly reusable across domains.

entry.title: Trees to Flows and Back: Unifying Decision Trees and Diffusion Models

author.name: Sai Niranjan Ramachandran and Suvrit Sra

entry.summary: Establishes mathematical correspondence between decision trees and diffusion processes, revealing Global Trajectory Score Matching as shared optimization principle. Instantiates as TreeFlow (competitive tabular generation with 2x speedup) and DSMTree (distillation of diffusion into trees).

entry.title: End-to-End Autoregressive Image Generation with 1D Semantic Tokenizer

author.name: Wenda Chu, Bingliang Zhang, Jiaqi Han, Yizhuo Li, Linjie Yang, Yisong Yue, Qiushan Guo

entry.summary: Presents an end-to-end autoregressive image generation pipeline with 1D semantic tokenizer that jointly optimizes reconstruction and generation, achieving state-of-the-art FID of 1.48 on ImageNet 256x256 without guidance.

entry.title: ML-Bench&Guard: Policy-Grounded Multilingual Safety Benchmark and Guardrail for Large Language Models

author.name: Yunhan Zhao, Zhaorun Chen, Xingjun Ma, Yu-Gang Jiang, Bo Li

entry.summary: Introduces ML-Bench, a policy-grounded multilingual safety benchmark covering 14 languages, constructed directly from regional regulations rather than general risk taxonomies. Also presents ML-Guard, a lightweight guardrail model trained on the benchmark data, addressing the gap between generic safety evaluation and region-specific regulatory compliance.

entry.title: Binomial flows: Denoising and flow matching for discrete ordinal data

author.name: Yair Shenfeld, Ricardo Baptista, Stefano Peluchetti

entry.summary: Introduces Binomial flows, a framework for discrete ordinal data that closes the gap between denoising and scoring in discrete diffusion models. Provides a unified recipe for training that simultaneously handles denoising, sampling, and exact likelihood estimation.

entry.title: How Language Models Process Out-of-Distribution Inputs: A Two-Pathway Framework

author.name: Hamidreza Saghir

entry.summary: Shows that existing white-box OOD detection methods for LLMs are confounded by sequence length, collapsing to near-chance under length-matched evaluation. Proposes a two-pathway framework (embedding for topic shifts, processing trajectory for how models process input).

entry.title: Online Self-Calibration Against Hallucination in Vision-Language Models

author.name: Minghui Chen, Chenxu Yang, Hengjie Zhu, Dayan Wu, Zheng Lin, Qingyi Si

entry.summary: Proposes OSCAR, an online self-calibration method for reducing VLM hallucinations by exploiting the Generative-Discriminative Gap—models verify better than they generate—to produce reliable self-supervision without external models like GPT.

entry.title: Jailbreaking Vision-Language Models Through the Visual Modality

author.name: Aharon Azulay, Jan Dubi\'nski, Zhuoyun Li, Atharv Mittal, Yossi Gandelsman

entry.summary: Introduces four novel visual jailbreak attacks on VLMs exploiting the vision modality: symbol sequences, object substitution, text replacement, and visual analogy puzzles. Tests across six frontier VLMs reveal a cross-modality alignment gap.

entry.title: Posterior Augmented Flow Matching

author.name: George Stoica, Sayak Paul, Matthew Wallingford, Vivek Ramanujan, Abhay Nori, Winson Han, Ali Farhadi, Ranjay Krishna, Judy Hoffman

entry.summary: Introduces Posterior-Augmented Flow Matching (PAFM), which replaces single-target supervision in flow matching with an expectation over approximate posterior distributions of valid target completions. Addresses flow collapse where learned dynamics memorize specific source-target pairings.

entry.title: LLMs Choose the Safer Gamble Yet Price the Riskier One Higher

author.name: Jonathan Dang

entry.summary: Reports a 25,920-call experiment across Claude Opus 4.7, DeepSeek V4-Pro, Gemini 3 Flash, and GPT-5.5 showing preference reversals analogous to the classic Lichtenstein-Slovic finding in humans: LLMs choose safer gambles but assign higher prices to riskier ones. Tests across 28 gamble pairs with multiple prompt formats and reasoning settings.

entry.title: Exploring LLM biases to manipulate AI search overview

author.name: Roman Smirnov

entry.summary: Investigates biases in LLM-powered search overview systems and trains a small language model via RL to generate content that exploits these biases to manipulate search result selection.

entry.title: Being-H0.7: A Latent World-Action Model from Egocentric Videos

author.name: Hao Luo, Wanpeng Zhang, Yicheng Feng, Sipeng Zheng, Haiweng Xu, Chaoyi Xu, Ziheng Xi, Yuhui Fu, Zongqing Lu

entry.summary: Presents Being-H0.7, a latent world-action model for robot control that inserts learnable latent queries between perception and action tokens, enabling future-aware reasoning without expensive pixel-space video generation.

entry.title: Fair Dataset Distillation via Cross-Group Barycenter Alignment

author.name: Mohammad Hossein Moslemi, Nima Hosseini Dashtbayaz, Zhimin Mei, Boyu Wang, Bissan Ghaddar

entry.summary: Shows that dataset distillation can amplify fairness gaps between demographic groups even when group sizes are balanced, because subgroup predictive patterns differ fundamentally. Proposes cross-group barycenter alignment to address this.

entry.title: ARMOR 2025: A Military-Aligned Benchmark for Evaluating Large Language Model Safety Beyond Civilian Contexts

author.name: Sydney Johns, Heng Jin, Chaoyu Zhang, Y. Thomas Hou, Wenjing Lou

entry.summary: Introduces ARMOR 2025, a benchmark for evaluating LLM safety in military contexts, grounded in Law of War, Rules of Engagement, and Joint Ethics Regulation doctrines. Addresses the gap between civilian-focused safety benchmarks and military operational needs.

entry.title: When Do Diffusion Models learn to Generate Multiple Objects?

author.name: Yujin Jeong, Arnas Uselis, Iro Laina, Seong Joon Oh, Anna Rohrbach

entry.summary: Investigates when diffusion models learn to generate multiple objects, introducing the MOSAIC controlled framework. Disentangles data distribution effects from model architecture limitations for multi-object generation failures.

entry.title: Semia: Auditing Agent Skills via Constraint-Guided Representation Synthesis

author.name: Hongbo Wen, Ying Li, Hanzhi Liu, Chaofan Shou, Yanju Chen, Yuan Tian, and Yu Feng

entry.summary: Introduces Semia, a static auditor for LLM agent skills that lifts skill configurations into a Datalog fact base to prove that tainted inputs can reach high-impact sinks, combining structured code analysis with prose-driven condition analysis.

entry.title: Embodied Interpretability: Linking Causal Understanding to Generalization in Vision-Language-Action Models

author.name: Hanxin Zhang, Mingshuo Xu, Abdulqader Dhafer, Shigang Yue, Hongbiao Dong, Zhou Daniel Hao

entry.summary: Introduces Interventional Significance Score (ISS) for causal visual-action attribution in VLA models, showing that high attribution to task-irrelevant features predicts poor generalization under distribution shift.

entry.title: SAGA: Workflow-Atomic Scheduling for AI Agent Inference on GPU Clusters

author.name: Dongxin Guo, Jikun Wu, Siu Ming Yiu

entry.summary: Proposes SAGA, a workflow-atomic scheduler for AI agent inference that treats entire agent workflows as schedulable units rather than individual LLM calls, reducing latency by 3-8x through KV cache reuse prediction, session-affinity batching, and priority scheduling.

entry.title: Characterizing the Expressivity of Local Attention in Transformers

author.name: Jiaoda Li and Ryan Cotterell

entry.summary: Provides a formal characterization of local attention expressivity in transformers, explaining why restricting attention to bounded windows can improve model quality despite reducing computational cost. Shows that fixed-precision transformers with local attention correspond to specific formal language classes.

entry.title: Can Coding Agents Reproduce Findings in Computational Materials Science?

author.name: Ziyang Huang, Yi Cao, Ali K. Shargh, Jing Luo, Ruidong Mei, Mohd Zaki, Zhan Liu, Wyatt Bunstine, William Jurayj, Somdatta Goswami, Tyrel McQueen, Michael Shields, Jaafar El-Awady, Paulette Clancy, Benjamin Van Durme, Nicholas Andrews, William Walden, Daniel Khashabi

entry.summary: Introduces AutoMat, a benchmark for evaluating LLM coding agents' ability to reproduce claims from computational materials science papers. Tests three interrelated challenges: recovering underspecified procedures, navigating specialized toolchains, and determining whether evidence supports scientific claims.

entry.title: Let ViT Speak: Generative Language-Image Pre-training

author.name: Yan Fang, Mengcheng Lan, Zilong Huang, Weixian Lei, Yunqing Zhao, Yujie Zhong, Yingchen Yu, Qi She, Yao Zhao, Yunchao Wei

entry.summary: Presents GenLIP, a generative pretraining framework for Vision Transformers that trains ViTs to predict language tokens directly from visual tokens using standard language modeling objectives, without contrastive learning or separate text decoders. Designed for seamless integration with multimodal LLMs.

entry.title: Paraphrasing Is (At Best) a Partial Defence Against Steganography in LLMs

author.name: Usman Anwar

entry.summary: Argues that paraphrasing is an incomplete defense against steganography in LLMs, providing a taxonomy of three types (structural, lexical-distributional, and semantic) and analyzing paraphrasing's effectiveness against each. Notes that some steganography types that LLMs have been shown to use are completely undetectable by paraphrasing.

entry.title: Data Deletion Can Help in Adaptive RL

author.name: Param Budhraja, Aditya Gangrade, Alex Olshevsky, Venkatesh Saligrama

entry.summary: Identifies a counterintuitive trick for adaptive RL: randomly deleting training data improves context estimation because older trajectories from worse policies bias the estimator. Studied in the contextual MDP framework.

entry.title: Provable and scalable quantum Gaussian processes for quantum learning

author.name: Jonas J\"ager, Paolo Braccia, Pablo Bermejo, Manuel G. Algaba, Diego Garc\'ia-Mart\'in, M. Cerezo

entry.summary: Introduces quantum Gaussian processes as a Bayesian framework for learning from quantum systems, showing that unitary quantum stochastic processes define Gaussian processes under suitable conditions. This enables regression, classification, and Bayesian optimization directly on quantum data with provable scalability.

entry.title: Gradient Regularized Newton Boosting Trees with Global Convergence

author.name: Nikita Zozoulenko, Daniel Falkowski, Thomas Cass, Lukas Gonon

entry.summary: Introduces Restricted Newton Descent framework proving global convergence of Newton boosting for gradient boosted decision trees. Shows vanilla Newton boosting achieves linear convergence for strongly convex losses and proposes gradient-regularized variants with improved robustness.

entry.title: Adaptive Querying with AI Persona Priors

author.name: Kaizheng Wang, Yuhang Wu, Assaf Zeevi

entry.summary: Proposes a persona-induced latent variable model using LLM-generated AI personas as priors for adaptive querying, enabling efficient Bayesian experimental design for learning about users within tight question budgets.

entry.title: A Survey of Reasoning-Intensive Retrieval: Progress and Challenges

author.name: Yiyang Wei, Tingyu Song, Siyue Zhang, Yilun Zhao

entry.summary: Provides a comprehensive survey of reasoning-intensive retrieval, systematizing benchmarks by domain/modality and introducing a taxonomy of methods integrating LLM reasoning into the IR pipeline from retrievers to rerankers.

entry.title: DeGenTWeb: A First Look at LLM-dominant Websites

author.name: Sichang Steven He and Calvin Ardi and Ramesh Govindan and Harsha V. Madhyastha

entry.summary: Presents DeGenTWeb, a systematic methodology for identifying LLM-dominant websites, finding that LLM text detectors perform worse than advertised and adapting them for web-page-level and site-level analysis.

entry.title: Real-Time Frame- and Event-based Object Detection with Spiking Neural Networks on Edge Neuromorphic Hardware: Design, Deployment and Benchmark

author.name: Udayanga G.W.K.N. Gamage, Yan Zeng, Cesar Cadena, Matteo Fumagalli, Silvia Tolu

entry.summary: Presents a comprehensive methodology for deploying spiking neural networks on Intel Loihi 2 neuromorphic hardware for real-time object detection, benchmarking against conventional ANNs on NVIDIA Jetson platforms with both frame-based and event-based datasets.

entry.title: FieryGS: In-the-Wild Fire Synthesis with Physics-Integrated Gaussian Splatting

author.name: Qianfan Shen, Ningxiao Tao, Qiyu Dai, Tianle Chen, Minghan Qin, Yongjie Zhang, Mengyu Chu, Wenzheng Chen, Baoquan Chen

entry.summary: Proposes FieryGS, a framework integrating physics-based combustion simulation and rendering within 3D Gaussian Splatting for realistic fire synthesis in real-world scenes. Combines multimodal scene understanding with user-controllable combustion physics.

entry.title: Diversity in Large Language Models under Supervised Fine-Tuning

author.name: Roman Klypa and Oleksandr Cherednichenko

entry.summary: Investigates diversity loss during supervised fine-tuning of LLMs, attributing it to neglect of low-frequency patterns and knowledge forgetting. Proposes TOFU (Tempered Focal) loss to address both issues simultaneously.

entry.title: VkSplat: High-Performance 3DGS Training in Vulkan Compute

author.name: Jingxiang Chen, Mohamed Ibrahim, Yang Liu

entry.summary: Presents VkSplat, the first fully Vulkan-based 3D Gaussian Splatting training pipeline, achieving 3.3x speed and 33% VRAM reduction over CUDA+PyTorch baseline while maintaining quality and enabling cross-vendor GPU compatibility.

entry.title: TUR-DPO: Topology- and Uncertainty-Aware Direct Preference Optimization

author.name: Abdulhady Abas Abdullah, Fatemeh Daneshfar, Seyedali Mirjalili, Mourad Oussalah

entry.summary: Proposes TUR-DPO, a variant of Direct Preference Optimization that incorporates reasoning topology and uncertainty awareness, rewarding how answers are derived rather than just what they say. Combines semantic faithfulness, utility, and topology quality.

entry.title: Pessimism-Free Offline Learning in General-Sum Games via KL Regularization

author.name: Claire Chen, Yuheng Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes GANE and GAMD for offline multi-agent RL in general-sum games using KL regularization instead of manual pessimistic penalties, achieving accelerated statistical rates for Nash equilibrium recovery.

entry.title: REALM: An RGB and Event Aligned Latent Manifold for Cross-Modal Perception

author.name: Vincenzo Polizzi, David B. Lindell, Jonathan Kelly

entry.summary: Introduces REALM, a cross-modal framework projecting event camera representations into pretrained RGB foundation model latent spaces using LoRA, enabling event-based perception to leverage RGB model priors without task-specific training.

entry.title: DynamicPO: Dynamic Preference Optimization for Recommendation

author.name: Xingyu Hu, Kai Zhang, Jiancan Wu, Shuli Wang, Chi Wang, Wenshuai Chen, Yinhua Zhu, Haitao Wang, Xingxing Wang, Xiang Wang

entry.summary: Identifies 'preference optimization collapse' in LLM-based recommendation where more negative samples degrade performance despite lower training loss, caused by gradient suppression from easy negatives dominating boundary-critical ones. Proposes DynamicPO.

entry.title: AgentFloor: How Far Up the tool use Ladder Can Small Open-Weight Models Go?

author.name: Ranit Karmakar, Jayita Chatterjee

entry.summary: Introduces AgentFloor, a 30-task benchmark organized as a six-tier capability ladder to determine which parts of agent workflows require large frontier models vs. small open-weight models. Evaluates 16 models (0.27B-32B) alongside GPT-5 across 16K+ runs, revealing clear capability boundaries.

entry.title: ResRL: Boosting LLM Reasoning via Negative Sample Projection Residual Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Zihan Lin, Xiaohan Wang, Jie Cao, Jiajun Chai, Li Wang, Xiaodong Lu, Wei Lin, Ran He, Guojun Yin

entry.summary: Proposes ResRL, a reinforcement learning method for LLM reasoning that decouples similar semantic distributions between positive and negative responses using negative sample projection. Theoretically links Lazy Likelihood Displacement to gradient interference and derives a practical proxy.

entry.title: Mesh Field Theory: Port-Hamiltonian Formulation of Mesh-Based Physics

author.name: Satoshi Noguchi and Yoshinobu Kawahara

entry.summary: Presents Mesh Field Theory (MeshFT) and MeshFT-Net, a structure-preserving framework for mesh-based continuum physics that separates topological from metric structure. Proves a reduction theorem showing dynamics factor into port-Hamiltonian form with topology-fixed interconnection.

entry.title: BWLA: Breaking the Barrier of W1AX Post-Training Quantization for LLMs

author.name: Zhixiong Zhao, Zukang Xu, Dawei Yang

entry.summary: Proposes BWLA, the first post-training quantization framework achieving 1-bit weights with low-bit activations (6-bit) through Orthogonal-Kronecker Transformation that converts weights to symmetric bimodal distributions suitable for binarization.

entry.title: Escaping Mode Collapse in LLM Generation via Geometric Regulation

author.name: Xin Du and Kumiko Tanaka-Ishii

entry.summary: Reinterprets LLM mode collapse as geometric collapse in representation space from a dynamical systems perspective. Proposes Reinforced Mode Regulation (RMR), a lightweight online state-space intervention that maintains diversity by preventing trajectory confinement.

entry.title: Thinking in Text and Images: Interleaved Vision--Language Reasoning Traces for Long-Horizon Robot Manipulation

author.name: Jinkun Liu, Haohan Chi, Lingfeng Zhang, Yifan Xie, YuAn Wang, Long Chen, Hangjun Ye, Xiaoshuai Hao, Wenbo Ding

entry.summary: Introduces Interleaved Vision-Language Reasoning (IVLR), a robot policy framework that generates explicit intermediate traces alternating textual subgoals with visual keyframes for long-horizon manipulation. Uses single multimodal transformer for global semantic-geometric planning.

entry.title: Decouple before Integration: Test-time Synthesis of SFT and RLVR Task Vectors

author.name: Chaohao Yuan, Chenghao Xiao, Yu Rong, Hong Cheng, Long-Kai Huang

entry.summary: Analyzes SFT and RLVR through task vectors revealing 30x magnitude disparity, 45° sign interference, and heterogeneous module-wise distributions. Proposes test-time synthesis approach that decouples before integrating the two paradigms.

entry.title: Recovering Hidden Reward in Diffusion-Based Policies

author.name: Yanbiao Ji, Qiuchang Li, Yuting Hu, Shaokai Wu, Wenyuan Xie, Guodong Zhang, Qicheng He, Deyi Ji, Yue Ding, Hongtao Lu

entry.summary: Introduces EnergyFlow, unifying generative action modeling with inverse RL by parameterizing energy functions whose gradients are denoising fields. Proves that score matching recovers expert's soft Q-function gradient, enabling reward extraction without adversarial training.

entry.title: To Call or Not to Call: A Framework to Assess and Optimize LLM Tool Calling

author.name: Qinyuan Wu, Soumi Das, Mahsa Amani, Arijit Nag, Seungeon Lee, Krishna P. Gummadi, Abhilasha Ravichander, Muhammad Bilal Zafar

entry.summary: Introduces a principled framework based on decision-making theory to evaluate when LLMs should use web search tools, analyzing tool-use decisions along necessity, utility, and affordability. Combines normative and descriptive perspectives to understand tool-calling behavior.

entry.title: Themis: Training Robust Multilingual Code Reward Models for Flexible Multi-Criteria Scoring

author.name: Indraneil Paul, Glava\v{s} Glavas, Iryna Gurevych

entry.summary: Introduces Themis, a multilingual multi-criteria code reward model framework with a benchmark (Themis-CodeRewardBench) spanning 5 preference dimensions and 8 programming languages. Profiles 50+ existing reward models and trains improved code RMs using synthetic training data.

entry.title: Persistent Visual Memory: Sustaining Perception for Deep Generation in LVLMs

author.name: Siyuan Huang, Xiaoye Qu, Yafu Li, Tong Zhu, Zefeng He, Muxin Fu, Daizong Liu, Wei-Long Zheng, Yu Cheng

entry.summary: Identifies 'Visual Signal Dilution' in autoregressive LVLMs where visual attention decays as textual history accumulates. Proposes Persistent Visual Memory (PVM), a lightweight module that provides distance-agnostic visual retrieval alongside the FFN, evaluated on Qwen3-based models.

entry.title: Bypassing Refusal Behavior in Qwen Models via Activation Steering

author.name: Talib Mirza

entry.summary: Demonstrates activation steering to bypass refusal behavior in Qwen3 models, achieving 100% compliance on the first 40 AdvBench harmful prompts using simple averaged concept vectors. Shows that small Qwen3 models can easily be steered away from safety behaviors.

entry.title: When LLMs Stop Following Steps: A Diagnostic Study of Procedural Execution in Language Models

author.name: Sailesh Panda, Pritam Kadasi, Abhishek Upperwal and Mayank Singh

entry.summary: Presents a diagnostic benchmark for LLM procedural execution where models must follow step-wise arithmetic algorithms. Finds accuracy drops from 61% on 5-step to 20% on 95-step procedures across 14 models and 55 datasets, with failures including missing answers and self-correction loops.

entry.title: Information-geometric adaptive sampling for graph diffusion

author.name: Yuhui Lu, Wenjing Liu, Kun Zhan

entry.summary: Presents an information-geometric framework for adaptive sampling in graph diffusion models, using Fisher-Rao metric to derive a Drift Variation Score that enables geometry-aware time-stepping with constant informational speed on the statistical manifold.

entry.title: Cross-fluctuation phase transitions reveal sampling dynamics in diffusion models

author.name: Sai Niranjan Ramachandran, Manish Krishan Lal and Suvrit Sra

entry.summary: Analyzes diffusion model sampling dynamics through cross-fluctuations from statistical physics, showing samples undergo sharp discrete transitions. Derives closed-form expressions for variance-preserving SDEs and proposes an early-exit strategy.

entry.title: MoDAl: Self-Supervised Neural Modality Discovery via Decorrelation for Speech Neuroprosthesis

author.name: Yuanhao Chen, Peter Chin

entry.summary: Introduces MoDAl, a framework for speech neuroprosthesis that discovers complementary neural modalities from multiple brain areas through contrastive alignment with LLM text embeddings and decorrelation losses to prevent encoder collapse.

entry.title: UniBCI: Towards a Unified Pretrained Model for Invasive Brain-Computer Interfaces

author.name: Binjie Hong, Rui Xiong, Liyuan Han, Tielin Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes UniBCI, a unified pretrained model for invasive brain-computer interfaces featuring context-conditioned spatiotemporal tokenization, hierarchical attention mechanisms, and evaluation across multiple neural decoding tasks.

entry.title: Timing is Everything: Temporal Scaffolding of Semantic Surprise in Humor

author.name: Yuxi Ma, Yongqian Peng, Junchen Lyu, Chi Zhang, Yixin Zhu

entry.summary: Proposes the Dual Prediction Violation framework for humor, showing that temporal structure ('timing') substantially outweighs semantic incongruity in predicting audience amusement. Analyzed 828 professional Chinese stand-up performances.

entry.title: The $\textit{Silicon Society}$ Cookbook: Design Space of LLM-based Social Simulations

author.name: Aur\'elien B\"uck-Kaeffer (1 and 2 and 4), Sneheel Sarangi (1 and 2), Maximilian Puelma Touzel (1 and 3), Reihaneh Rabbany (1 and 2), Zachary Yang (1 and 2 and 4), Jean-Fran\c{c}ois Godbout (2 and 3) ((1) McGill University, (2) Mila - Quebec Artificial Intelligence Institute, (3) Universit\'e de Montr\'eal, (4) Ubisoft La Forge)

entry.summary: Presents a systematic analysis of design choices in LLM-based social simulations ('Silicon Societies'), examining how base model choice, agent connection topology, and other parameters interact non-trivially to affect simulation realism.

entry.title: RSAT: Structured Attribution Makes Small Language Models Faithful Table Reasoners

author.name: Jugal Gajjar and Kamalasankari Subramaniakuppusamy

entry.summary: Introduces RSAT, a method training small language models (1-8B) to produce step-by-step reasoning with cell-level citations for table question answering. Uses SFT followed by GRPO with NLI-based faithfulness rewards, achieving 3.7x faithfulness improvement.

entry.title: Trident: Improving Malware Detection with LLMs and Behavioral Features

author.name: Rebecca Saul, Jingzhi Jiang, Elliott Chia, and David Wagner

entry.summary: Introduces Trident, using LLMs with reasoning to process semi-structured sandbox behavior reports for malware detection, generating behavior-based detection rules that are more robust to concept drift than static-feature methods.

entry.title: Intelligent Elastic Feature Fading: Enabling Model Retrain-Free Feature Efficiency Rollouts at Scale

author.name: Jieming Di, Xiaoyu Chen, Ying She, Siyu Wang, Lizzie Liu, Fenggang Wu, Jiaoying Mu, Tony Tsui, Amr Elroumy, Hsing Tang, Zewei Jiang, Qiao Yang, Lin Qi, Haibo Lin, Weifeng Cui, Daniel Li, Kapil Gupta, Shivendra Pratap Singh, Jie Zheng, Arnold Overwijk, Ling Leng, Sri Reddy, Robert Malkin, Rocky Liu

entry.summary: Introduces Intelligent Elastic Feature Fading (IEFF), a production system enabling retrain-free feature efficiency rollouts in large-scale ranking systems by elastically controlling feature coverage at serving time, deployed across Meta's infrastructure.

entry.title: Prompt-Induced Score Variance in Zero-Shot Binary Vision-Language Safety Classification

author.name: Charles Weng, Dingwen Li, Alexander Martin

entry.summary: Shows that zero-shot VLM safety classifiers are unreliable under semantically equivalent prompt reformulations, with materially different unsafe probabilities for the same sample. A simple mean ensemble improves calibration.

entry.title: Making Every Verified Token Count: Adaptive Verification for MoE Speculative Decoding

author.name: Lehan Pan, Ziyang Tao, Ruoyu Pang, Xiao Wang, Jianjun Zhao, Yanyong Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes EVICT, a training-free and lossless adaptive verification method for MoE speculative decoding that truncates draft trees before verification to retain only cost-effective prefixes. Addresses the specific problem that MoE models activate different experts for different branches, increasing verification cost.

entry.title: Unlearning What Matters: Token-Level Attribution for Precise Language Model Unlearning

author.name: Jiawei Wu, DouDou Zhou

entry.summary: Proposes TokenUnlearn, a token-level attribution framework for precise LLM unlearning that identifies critical tokens through knowledge-aware and entropy-aware signals. Offers hard selection and soft weighting strategies, showing improvements over sequence-level unlearning methods.

entry.title: Physically Native World Models: A Hamiltonian Perspective on Generative World Modeling

author.name: Sen Cui and Jingheng Ma

entry.summary: Position paper arguing that world models need Hamiltonian structure to provide physically reliable, action-controllable, and long-horizon stable predictions. Proposes unifying 2D video, 3D scene, and JEPA approaches through port-Hamiltonian formulation for embodied AI.

entry.title: The Power of Order: Fooling LLMs with Adversarial Table Permutations

author.name: Xinshuai Dong, Haifeng Chen, Xuyuan Liu, Shengyu Chen, Haoyu Wang, Shaoan Xie, Kun Zhang, Zhengzhang Chen

entry.summary: Demonstrates that LLMs are vulnerable to adversarial permutations of table rows and columns that are semantically invariant but cause incorrect outputs. Introduces gradient-based attack to find worst-case permutations for table QA tasks.

entry.title: CleanBase: Detecting Malicious Documents in RAG Knowledge Databases

author.name: Weifei Jin, Xilong Wang, Wei Zou, Jinyuan Jia, Neil Gong

entry.summary: Proposes CleanBase, a method to detect malicious documents in RAG knowledge databases by exploiting semantic similarity patterns among adversarial documents targeting the same questions. Constructs similarity graph and uses community detection.

entry.title: Silicon Showdown: Performance, Efficiency, and Ecosystem Barriers in Consumer-Grade LLM Inference

author.name: Allan Kazakov and Abdurrahman Javat

entry.summary: Provides systematic benchmarking of consumer-grade LLM inference on Nvidia Blackwell and Apple Silicon, revealing a 'Backend Dichotomy' in TensorRT-LLM where NVFP4 achieves 1.6x throughput over BF16 but with complex tradeoffs, and Apple's unified memory enables 70B+ models.

entry.title: Stable-GFlowNet: Toward Diverse and Robust LLM Red-Teaming via Contrastive Trajectory Balance

author.name: Minchan Kwon, Sunghyun Baek, Minseo Kim, Jaemyung Yu, Dongyoon Han, Junmo Kim

entry.summary: Proposes Stable-GFN for LLM red-teaming that eliminates partition function estimation in Generative Flow Networks, reducing training instability and mode collapse while finding diverse and effective attacks.

entry.title: Learning How and What to Memorize: Cognition-Inspired Two-Stage Optimization for Evolving Memory

author.name: Derong Xu, Shuochen Liu, Pengfei Luo, Pengyue Jia, Yingyi Zhang, Yi Wen, Yimin Deng, Wenlin Zhang, Enhong Chen, Xiangyu Zhao, Tong Xu

entry.summary: Introduces MemCoE, a cognition-inspired two-stage framework for LLM agent memory management that learns both how memory should be organized (via guideline induction) and what information to update. Draws on memory schema theory and brain region functional divisions to address the challenge of maintaining long-term user memory with limited context windows.

entry.title: Make Your LVLM KV Cache More Lightweight

author.name: Xihao Chen, Yangyang Guo, Roger Zimmermann

entry.summary: Proposes LightKV, a method to reduce KV cache size in Large Vision-Language Models by exploiting redundancy among vision-token embeddings. Uses cross-modality message passing guided by text prompts to progressively compress vision tokens during prefill.

entry.title: When RAG Chatbots Expose Their Backend: An Anonymized Case Study of Privacy and Security Risks in Patient-Facing Medical AI

author.name: Alfredo Madrid-Garc\'ia and Miguel Rujas

entry.summary: Reports a security assessment of a publicly accessible patient-facing medical RAG chatbot, finding significant privacy and security vulnerabilities including exposed backend details. Uses Claude Opus 4.6 for exploratory testing followed by manual verification.

entry.title: TimeRFT: Stimulating Generalizable Time Series Forecasting for TSFMs via Reinforcement Finetuning

author.name: Siyang Li, Yize Chen, Zijie Zhu, Yuxin Pan, Yan Guo, Ming Huang, Hui Xiong

entry.summary: Introduces TimeRFT, applying reinforcement finetuning to Time Series Foundation Models for downstream adaptation, addressing temporal distribution shifts that SFT-based methods struggle with. Handles diverse data availability regimes.

entry.title: Do Open-Loop Metrics Predict Closed-Loop Driving? A Cross-Benchmark Correlation Study of NAVSIM and Bench2Drive

author.name: Yiru Wang, Anqing Jiang, Shuo Wang, Yuwen Heng, Hai Yang, Yang Chen, Hao Sun

entry.summary: Cross-references 15 methods across NAVSIM (open-loop) and Bench2Drive (closed-loop) autonomous driving benchmarks, finding that recent safety-aware open-loop metrics still have limited correlation with closed-loop driving performance.

entry.title: Hyperspherical Forward-Forward with Prototypical Representations

author.name: Shalini Sarode, Brian Moser, Joachim Folz, Federico Raue, Tobias Nauen, Stanislav Frolov, Andreas Dengel

entry.summary: Introduces Hyperspherical Forward-Forward (HFF), reformulating the Forward-Forward algorithm's local objective as multi-class classification in hyperspherical space using class prototypes, eliminating the need for per-class forward passes during inference.

entry.title: How Frontier LLMs Adapt to Neurodivergence Context: A Measurement Framework for Surface vs. Structural Change in System-Prompted Responses

author.name: Ishan Gupta, Pavlo Buryi

entry.summary: Proposes NDBench, a 576-output benchmark evaluating how frontier LLMs adjust outputs based on neurodivergence context in system prompts. Finds a dissociation between surface adaptation (structural changes) and genuine behavioral adjustment.

entry.title: RouteProfile: Elucidating the Design Space of LLM Profiles for Routing

author.name: Jingjun Xu, Hongji Pu, Tao Feng, Haozhen Zhang, Jiaxuan You, Ge Liu

entry.summary: Studies how LLM profile design affects routing performance across different routers. Develops a general design space (RouteProfile) for LLM profiles that capture model capabilities, enabling fairer comparison of routing systems.

entry.title: Bayesian Optimization in Linear Time

author.name: Jesse Schneider and William J. Welch

entry.summary: Proposes Bayesian optimization with linear time complexity using recursive binary partitioning, addressing the cubic scaling problem while also arguing that local modeling better suits the local nature of optimization.

entry.title: Beyond Structure: Revolutionising Materials Discovery via AI-Driven Synthesis Protocol-Property Relationships

author.name: Guillaume Lambard

entry.summary: Argues for a synthesis-first paradigm in AI-driven materials discovery, where executable synthesis protocols (not just atomic structures) are primary design variables. Outlines a roadmap for machine-readable protocols, generative pathway models, and closed-loop optimization.

entry.title: From Backward Spreading to Forward Replay: Revisiting Target Construction in LLM Parameter Editing

author.name: Wei Liu, Hongkai Liu, Zhiying Deng, Yee Whye Teh, Wee Sun Lee

entry.summary: Systematically investigates the foundations of backward spreading in LLM parameter editing, then proposes forward replay as a simpler alternative that optimizes at the first editing layer and propagates forward. Shows this eliminates failure modes of backward spreading.

entry.title: Social Bias in LLM-Generated Code: Benchmark and Mitigation

author.name: Fazle Rabbi and Lin Ling and Song Wang and Jinqiu Yang

entry.summary: Introduces SocialBias-Bench with 343 real-world coding tasks across seven demographic dimensions to evaluate social bias in LLM-generated code. Finds severe bias (up to 60.58%) and that standard interventions like CoT actually amplify bias rather than reduce it.

entry.title: Beyond Heuristics: Learnable Density Control for 3D Gaussian Splatting

author.name: Zhenhua Ning, Xin Li, Jun Yu, Guangming Lu, Yaowei Wang, Wenjie Pei

entry.summary: Proposes LeGS, replacing heuristic density control in 3D Gaussian Splatting with a learnable RL-based policy network. Uses sensitivity-analysis-based reward to quantify marginal contribution of individual Gaussians.

entry.title: AEM: Adaptive Entropy Modulation for Multi-Turn Agentic Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Haotian Zhao, Yuxin Zhang, Songlin Zhou, Stephen S.-T. Yau, Wenyu Zhang, Lun Tian, Tianshu Zhu, Yifeng Huang, Yucheng Zeng, Jingnan Gu, Daxiang Dong, and Jianmin Wu

entry.summary: Proposes AEM, a supervision-free credit assignment method for multi-turn agentic RL that adaptively modulates entropy dynamics during training. Provides theoretical analysis elevating entropy from regularization to informative signal about trajectory quality.

entry.title: AGoQ: Activation and Gradient Quantization for Memory-Efficient Distributed Training of LLMs

author.name: Wenxiang Lin, Juntao Huang, Luhan Zhang, Laili Li, Xiang Bao, Mengyang Zhang, Bing Wang, Shaohuai Shi

entry.summary: Introduces AGoQ for memory-efficient LLM training combining layer-aware activation quantization (near 4-bit) with precision-preserving 8-bit gradient All-Reduce, reducing memory usage while maintaining convergence.

entry.title: Affinity Is Not Enough: Recovering the Free Energy Principle in Mixture-of-Experts

author.name: Man Yung Wong (Russell)

entry.summary: Proposes improvements to Mixture-of-Experts routing at domain transitions using temporal memory, precision-weighted gating, and anticipatory routing, achieving 124x improvement in correct expert assignment at transition points.

entry.title: Beyond Benchmarks: MathArena as an Evaluation Platform for Mathematics with LLMs

author.name: Jasper Dekoninck, Nikola Jovanovi\'c, Tim Gehrunger, K\'ari R\"ognvalddson, Ivo Petrov, Chenhao Sun, Martin Vechev

entry.summary: Builds on MathArena by expanding it from olympiad problems to a continuously maintained evaluation platform for mathematical reasoning with LLMs, covering diverse tasks including proof generation and free-form problems.

entry.title: Weisfeiler Lehman Test on Combinatorial Complexes: Generalized Expressive Power of Topological Neural Networks

author.name: Jiawen Chen, Qi Shao, Duxin Chen, Wenwu Yu

entry.summary: Introduces the Combinatorial Complex Weisfeiler-Lehman (CCWL) test, a unified axiomatic extension of WL tests to combinatorial complexes that encompasses graphs, hypergraphs, simplicial, and cellular complexes. Proves that upper and lower neighborhoods are sufficient among four adjacency types to reach full expressivity.

entry.title: SPLICE: Latent Diffusion over JEPA Embeddings for Conformal Time-Series Inpainting

author.name: Arnaud Zinflou

entry.summary: Proposes SPLICE, combining JEPA-based latent diffusion for time-series imputation with adaptive conformal inference to provide distribution-free coverage guarantees. Applied to power systems load data, achieving strong reconstruction with guaranteed prediction intervals.

entry.title: Putting HUMANS first: Efficient LAM Evaluation with Human Preference Alignment

author.name: Woody Haosheng Gan, William Held, Diyi Yang

entry.summary: Proposes HUMANS framework showing that subsets of just 50 examples (0.3%) can achieve >0.93 correlation with full benchmark scores for evaluating large audio models, while both subsets and full benchmarks only achieve 0.85 correlation with human preferences.

entry.title: Human-in-the-Loop Meta Bayesian Optimization for Fusion Energy and Scientific Applications

author.name: Ricardo Luna Gutierrez, Sahand Ghorbanpour, Ejaz Rahman, Varchas Gopalaswamy, Riccardo Betti, Vineet Gundecha, Aarne Lees, Soumyendu Sarkar

entry.summary: Presents Human-in-the-Loop Meta Bayesian Optimization for inertial confinement fusion experiments, combining meta-learned surrogates with expert-informed acquisition functions and interpretable explanations for data-scarce scientific domains.

entry.title: XekRung Technical Report

author.name: Jiutian Zeng, Junjie Li, Chengwei Dai, Jie Liang, Zhaoyu Hu, Yiliang Zhang, Ziang Weng, Longtao Huang, Dongjie Zhang, Libin Dong, Yang Ge, Yuanda Wang, Kaiwen Lv Kacuila, Bingyu Zhu, Jing Wang, Jin Xu

entry.summary: Presents XekRung, a cybersecurity-specialized LLM built through diverse data synthesis, continued pre-training, SFT, and RL, with a multi-dimensional evaluation system. Claims state-of-the-art on cybersecurity benchmarks.

entry.title: Predictive Spatio-Temporal Scene Graphs for Semi-Static Scenes

author.name: Miguel Saavedra-Ruiz, Charlie Gauthier, Kumaraditya Gupta, Shima Shahfar, Kirsty Ellis, Steven Parkison, Liam Paull

entry.summary: Proposes predictive spatio-temporal scene graphs for semi-static environments where objects change locations in structured, cyclic patterns (e.g., a mug moving between cupboard, counter, sink). Enables temporal reasoning for robot planning.

entry.title: Technical Report: Activation Residual Hessian Quantization (ARHQ) for Low-Bit LLM Quantization

author.name: YiFeng Wang, Zhun Sun, Keisuke Sakaguchi

entry.summary: Presents ARHQ, a post-training weight quantization method that uses activation residual Hessians to identify error-sensitive weight directions and isolate them into a high-precision low-rank branch. Demonstrates improved performance on Qwen3-4B under aggressive quantization.

entry.title: CompleteRXN: Toward Completing Open Chemical Reaction Databases

author.name: Gabriel Vogel, Minouk Noordsij, Evgeny Pidko, Jana M. Weber

entry.summary: Introduces CompleteRXN, a benchmark for completing chemical reactions with missing byproducts, co-reactants, and stoichiometric coefficients. Evaluates novel encoder-decoder models with constrained decoding for reaction balancing.

entry.title: Lost in State Space: Probing Frozen Mamba Representations

author.name: Bhagyashree Wagh, Akash Singh

entry.summary: Tests whether frozen Mamba's recurrent state provides useful sentence representations without fine-tuning. Finds that patch boundary readouts don't consistently outperform mean pooling, identifying structural pathologies including severe anisotropy.

entry.title: NLPOpt-Net: A Learning Method for Nonlinear Optimization with Feasibility Guarantees

author.name: Bimol Nath Roy, Rahul Golder, MM Faruque Hasan

entry.summary: Proposes NLPOpt-Net, an unsupervised learning architecture for solving constrained nonlinear programs with guaranteed feasibility through a multi-layer projection scheme using local quadratic approximations.

entry.title: Polaris: Coupled Orbital Polar Embeddings for Hierarchical Concept Learning

author.name: Sahil Mishra, Srinitish Srinivasan, Sourish Dasgupta, Tanmoy Chakraborty

entry.summary: Introduces Polaris, a polar hyperspherical embedding framework for hierarchical concept learning that separates semanticity (angular) from hierarchy (radius) using spherical geometry. Includes uncertainty-aware asymmetric objectives.

entry.title: High-Probability Convergence in Decentralized Stochastic Optimization with Gradient Tracking

author.name: Aleksandar Armacki, Haoyuan Cai, Ali H. Sayed

entry.summary: Provides the first high-probability convergence guarantees for decentralized stochastic gradient descent with gradient tracking, bridging a gap between mean-squared error results and high-probability analysis.

entry.title: Token Arena: A Continuous Benchmark Unifying Energy and Cognition in AI Inference

author.name: Yuxuan Gao, Megan Wang, Yi Ling Yu

entry.summary: Introduces TokenArena, a continuous benchmark measuring AI inference at endpoint granularity across five axes (speed, latency, price, context, quality) with energy estimates, producing composite metrics like joules per correct answer.

entry.title: Pose-Aware Diffusion for 3D Generation

author.name: Zihan Zhou, Luxi Chen, Jingzhi Zhou, Yuhao Wan, Min Zhao, Baoyu Fan, Chongxuan Li

entry.summary: Introduces Pose-Aware Diffusion (PAD), an end-to-end diffusion framework that generates 3D geometry directly in observation space by using monocular depth as a geometric anchor, avoiding the canonical-then-rotate paradigm that introduces spatial mismatches.

entry.title: PrefMoE: Robust Preference Modeling with Mixture-of-Experts Reward Learning

author.name: Ziqin Yuan, Ruiqi Wang, Dezhong Zhao, Baijian Yang, Byung-Cheol Min

entry.summary: Proposes PrefMoE, a mixture-of-experts reward learning framework for preference-based RL that handles heterogeneous and conflicting supervision from multiple annotators. Uses trajectory-level soft routing to combine specialized reward experts.

entry.title: Rethinking LLM Ensembling from the Perspective of Mixture Models

author.name: Jiale Fu, Yuchu Jiang, Peijun Wu, Chonghan Liu, Joey Tianyi Zhou, Xu Yang

entry.summary: Proposes Mixture-model-like Ensemble (ME) for LLMs that reinterprets ensembling as a mixture model, stochastically selecting a single model per step rather than computing full ensemble distributions. Reduces computational cost while maintaining ensemble benefits.

entry.title: LLM-Oriented Information Retrieval: A Denoising-First Perspective

author.name: Lu Dai, Liang Sun, Fanpu Cao, Ziyang Rao, Cehao Yang, Hao Liu, Hui Xiong

entry.summary: A perspective paper arguing that denoising (maximizing usable evidence density and verifiability) is the primary bottleneck for LLM-oriented information retrieval in RAG/agentic search, proposing a four-stage framework of IR challenges.

entry.title: Structure Liberates: How Constrained Sensemaking Produces More Novel Research Output

author.name: James Mooney, Zae Myung Kim, Young-Jun Lee, Dongyeop Kang

entry.summary: Introduces SCISENSE, a sensemaking-grounded framework that operationalizes scientific ideation as structured cognitive stages, showing that constrained sensemaking produces more novel research output. Distills into SCISENSE-LM models from 3B to 70B parameters.

entry.title: CMTA: Leveraging Cross-Modal Temporal Artifacts for Generalizable AI-Generated Video Detection

author.name: Hang Wang, Chao Shen, Chenhao Lin, Minghui Yang, Lei Zhang, and Cong Wang

entry.summary: Identifies cross-modal temporal artifacts (CMTA) in AI-generated videos: unlike real videos with natural temporal fluctuations in cross-modal alignment, AIGVs show unnaturally stable semantic trajectories. Proposes detection framework exploiting this.

entry.title: AdaMeZO: Adam-style Zeroth-Order Optimizer for LLM Fine-tuning Without Maintaining the Moments

author.name: Zhijie Cai, Haolong Chen, Guangxu Zhu

entry.summary: Proposes AdaMeZO, a zeroth-order optimizer for LLM fine-tuning that achieves Adam-style moment estimation without storing moments in memory, using projected moment techniques to maintain MeZO's memory efficiency.

entry.title: Evaluating the Architectural Reasoning Capabilities of LLM Provers via the Obfuscated Natural Number Game

author.name: Lixing Li

entry.summary: Evaluates LLM provers on the Obfuscated Natural Number Game benchmark (renamed identifiers in Lean 4) to test whether formal math success comes from genuine logical reasoning or pattern matching, finding a universal latency tax from obfuscation.

entry.title: Map2World: Segment Map Conditioned Text to 3D World Generation

author.name: Jaeyoung Chung, Suyoung Lee, Jianfeng Xiang, Jiaolong Yang, Kyoung Mu Lee

entry.summary: Introduces Map2World, a framework for 3D world generation conditioned on user-defined segment maps of arbitrary shapes and scales. Includes a detail enhancer network for fine-grained detail generation while maintaining global scene coherence across expansive environments.

entry.title: MHC Interp #1: Previous-Token Heads Become Attention Sinks Under Manifold-Constrained Hyper-Connections

author.name: Realmbird

entry.summary: Interpretability analysis of Manifold-Constrained Hyper-Connections (mHC) in transformer models, finding that previous-token attention heads become attention sinks under mHC. Compares mHC, mHC-lite, and standard models, observing that attention head shapes and layer positions change after mHC.

entry.title: MemRouter: Memory-as-Embedding Routing for Long-Term Conversational Agents

author.name: Tianyu Hu, Weikai Lin, Weizhi Zhang, Jing Ma, Song Wang

entry.summary: Proposes MemRouter, a lightweight 12M-parameter write-side memory router that decides which conversation turns to store in external memory without requiring LLM generation at each turn. Uses embedding-based routing with frozen LLM backbone, outperforming baselines on LoCoMo benchmark.

entry.title: Scaling Video Understanding via Compact Latent Multi-Agent Collaboration

author.name: Kerui Chen, Jinglu Wang, Jianrong Zhang, Ming Li, Yan Lu, Hehe Fan

entry.summary: Proposes MACF, a multi-agent collaboration framework for long video understanding that decouples per-agent perception budgets from global video complexity. Uses compact latent communication protocol between agents processing video segments.

entry.title: Optimal Spatio-Temporal Decoupling for Bayesian Conformal Prediction

author.name: Yu-Hsueh Fang and Chia-Yen Lee

entry.summary: Proposes State-Adaptive Bayesian Conformal Prediction (SA-BCP) that decouples spatial and temporal components for online conformal prediction, gating temporal inertia with spatial kernel-density evidence for better coverage during distribution shifts.

entry.title: Geometric Embedding Alignment via Curvature Matching in Transfer Learning

author.name: Sung Moon Ko, Jaewan Lee, Sumin Lee, Soorin Yim, Kyunghoon Bae, Sehui Han

entry.summary: Proposes GEAR, a transfer learning framework that aligns models by matching Ricci curvature of their latent spaces using differential geometry, enabling knowledge aggregation from diverse sources for molecular property prediction.

entry.title: AgentReputation: A Decentralized Agentic AI Reputation Framework

author.name: Mohd Sameen Chishti, Damilare Peter Oyinloye, Jingyue Li

entry.summary: Proposes AgentReputation, a decentralized reputation framework for agentic AI marketplaces that addresses strategic optimization by agents, non-transferable competence across tasks, and varying verification rigor.

entry.title: CRC-Screen: Certified DNA-Synthesis Hazard Screening Under Taxonomic Shift

author.name: Najmul Hasan

entry.summary: Addresses DNA synthesis screening that fails when hazardous sequences come from unseen taxonomic families, proposing a three-signal fusion approach calibrated by Conformal Risk Control to maintain certified false negative rate bounds.

entry.title: Learning Fingerprints for Medical Time Series with Redundancy-Constrained Information Maximization

author.name: Huayu Li, ZhengXiao He, Xiwen Chen, Jingjing Wang, Siyuan Tian, Jinghao Wen, Ao Li

entry.summary: Introduces a framework for compressing variable-length medical time series (ECG, EEG) into fixed-size 'Fingerprint Tokens' using cross-attention bottleneck and dual-objective training. Addresses limitations of masked autoencoders for learning compact, interpretable medical signal representations.

entry.title: Matroid Algorithms Under Size-Sensitive Independence Oracles

author.name: Kiarash Banihashem, MohammadTaghi Hajiaghayi, Mahdi JafariRaviz, Danny Mittal

entry.summary: Introduces a size-sensitive oracle cost model for matroid algorithms where query cost scales with set size, and provides nearly optimal algorithms under this more realistic model for graphic and other natural matroid classes.

entry.title: Are You the A-hole? A Fair, Multi-Perspective Ethical Reasoning Framework

author.name: Sheza Munir, Ahanaf Rodoshi, Sumin Lee, Feiran Chang, Xujie Si, Syed Ishtiaque Ahmed

entry.summary: Proposes a neuro-symbolic aggregation framework using Weighted MaxSAT for resolving conflicting moral judgments, applied to Reddit's AmItheAsshole forum. Maps natural language to logical predicates with confidence weights.

entry.title: Beyond Visual Fidelity: Benchmarking Super-Resolution Models for Large-Scale Remote Sensing Imagery via Downstream Task Integration

author.name: Zhili Li, Kangyang Chai, Zhihao Wang, Xiaowei Jia, Yanhua Li, Gengchen Mai, Sergii Skakun, Dinesh Manocha, Yiqun Xie

entry.summary: Introduces GeoSR-Bench, a benchmark evaluating super-resolution models for remote sensing by downstream task performance (land cover classification, biomass estimation, change detection) rather than just fidelity metrics like PSNR/SSIM.

entry.title: Block-wise Codeword Embedding for Reliable Multi-bit Text Watermarking

author.name: Joeun Kim, HoEun Kim, Dongsup Jin, and Young-Sik Kim

entry.summary: Proposes BREW, a multi-bit text watermarking framework using block-wise reliable embedding with a two-stage mechanism: blind message estimation via independent block voting, then window-shifting verification. Achieves near-zero false positive rates while maintaining high detection sensitivity.

entry.title: GaMMA: Towards Joint Global-Temporal Music Understanding in Large Multimodal Models

author.name: Zuyao You, Zhesong Yu, Mingyu Liu, Bilei Zhu, Yuan Wan, Zuxuan Wu

entry.summary: Presents GaMMA, a large multimodal model for music understanding that uses mixture-of-experts audio encoders to unify time-series and non-time-series music tasks. Introduces MuBench benchmark and applies progressive training with pretraining, SFT, and RL.

entry.title: Model-Based Reinforcement Learning with Double Oracle Efficiency in Policy Optimization and Offline Estimation

author.name: Haichen Hu, Jian Qian, David Simchi-Levi

entry.summary: Studies offline oracle-efficient episodic RL using log-barrier and log-determinant regularization, achieving optimal Õ(√T) regret with only Õ(√T) oracle calls for tabular MDPs, then extends to linear mixture MDPs.

entry.title: RadLite: Multi-Task LoRA Fine-Tuning of Small Language Models for CPU-Deployable Radiology AI

author.name: Pankaj Gupta, Kartik Bose

entry.summary: Shows that 3-4B parameter models with LoRA fine-tuning on 162K samples across 9 radiology tasks can achieve strong multi-task performance deployable on consumer CPUs. Evaluates Qwen2.5-3B and Qwen3-4B as CPU-deployable radiology AI.

entry.title: Near-optimal and Efficient First-Order Algorithm for Multi-Task Learning with Shared Linear Representation

author.name: Shihong Ding, Fangyu Du, Cong Fang

entry.summary: Introduces a near-optimal first-order algorithm for multi-task learning with shared linear representation that converges in Õ(1) iterations and achieves estimation error improving over existing methods by factor k.

entry.title: Leveraging Vision-Language Models as Weak Annotators in Active Learning

author.name: Phuong Ngoc Nguyen, Kaito Shiku, Ryoma Bise, Seiichi Uchida, Shinnosuke Matsuo

entry.summary: Proposes an active learning framework leveraging VLMs as weak annotators for coarse-grained labels, combined with human fine-grained annotations. Models systematic VLM noise using noise transition matrices for fine-grained recognition.

entry.title: Scale-Aware Adversarial Analysis: A Diagnostic for Generative AI in Multiscale Complex Systems

author.name: Mengke Zhao, Guang-Xing Li, Duo Xu, Keping Qiu

entry.summary: Introduces Constrained Diffusion Decomposition (CDD), a diagnostic framework for evaluating whether generative AI models internalize physical laws or merely interpolate correlations, tested on multiscale complex systems like turbulence.

entry.title: Beyond Continuity: Simulation-free Reconstruction of Discrete Branching Dynamics from Single-cell Snapshots

author.name: Junda Ying and Yuxuan Wang and Bowen Yang and Peijie Zhou and Lei Zhang

entry.summary: Presents Unbalanced Schrödinger Bridge (USB), a simulation-free framework for learning cellular dynamics from single-cell snapshots that models discrete jump-like birth-death events at single-cell resolution, unlike existing continuous-fluid OT methods.

entry.title: Knowing when to trust machine-learned interatomic potentials

author.name: Shams Mehdi, Ilkwon Cho, Olexandr Isayev

entry.summary: Proposes PROBE, a post-hoc reliability method for machine-learned interatomic potentials that trains a discriminative classifier on frozen per-atom representations, recasting uncertainty as selective classification rather than error regression.

entry.title: Budget Constraints as Riemannian Manifolds

author.name: Michael Helcig, Dan Alistarh

entry.summary: Proposes formulating budget-constrained discrete assignment (e.g., mixed-precision quantization, pruning) as Riemannian optimization on the manifold defined by budget constraints in softmax-relaxed logit space.

entry.title: FinSafetyBench: Evaluating LLM Safety in Real-World Financial Scenarios

author.name: Yutao Hou, Yihan Jiang, Yuhan Xie, Jian Yang, Liwen Zhang, Hailiang Huang, Guanhua Chen, Yun Chen

entry.summary: Presents FinSafetyBench, a bilingual English-Chinese red-teaming benchmark for evaluating LLM safety in financial scenarios, grounded in real financial crime cases. Tests LLM compliance refusal across 14 subcategories of financial crimes and ethical violations under adversarial attack settings.

entry.title: HyCOP: Hybrid Composition Operators for Interpretable Learning of PDEs

author.name: Jinpai Zhao, Nishant Panda, Yen Ting Lin, Eirik Valseth, Diane Oyen, Clint Dawson

entry.summary: Introduces HyCOP, a modular framework for learning PDE solution operators by composing simple modules (advection, diffusion, closures) through learned programs. Learns a policy over which module to apply and for how long, enabling interpretable hybrid surrogates with strong OOD generalization.

entry.title: E$^2$DT: Efficient and Effective Decision Transformer with Experience-Aware Sampling for Robotic Manipulation

author.name: Kaiyan Zhao, Borong Zhang, Yiming Wang, Xingyu Liu, Xuetao Li, Yuyang Chen, Xiaoguang Niu

entry.summary: Proposes E²DT, a Decision Transformer framework using k-Determinantal Point Process sampling for experience-aware active selection in robotic manipulation, addressing poor sample efficiency in standard DT approaches.

entry.title: MAEPose: Self-Supervised Spatiotemporal Learning for Human Pose Estimation on mmWave Video

author.name: Xijia Wei, Yuan Fang, Kevin Chetty, Youngjun Cho, and Nadia Bianchi-Berthouze

entry.summary: Presents MAEPose, a masked autoencoding approach for human pose estimation directly from mmWave radar spectrogram videos, learning spatiotemporal representations from unlabeled data in a self-supervised manner.

entry.title: Task-Conditioned Uncertainty Costmaps for Legged Locomotion

author.name: Kartikeya Singh, Christo Aluckal, Romeo Orsolino, and Karthik Dantu

entry.summary: Models epistemic uncertainty in predicted footholds for legged robots, conditioned on terrain and commanded motion, to distinguish in-distribution from out-of-distribution operating regimes and enable safer locomotion planning.

entry.title: AlphaInventory: Evolving White-Box Inventory Policies via Large Language Models with Deployment Guarantees

author.name: Chenyu Huang, Jianghao Lin, Zhengyang Tang, Bo Jiang, Ruoqing Jiang, Benyou Wang, Lai Wei

entry.summary: Proposes AlphaInventory, an LLM-based evolutionary framework for generating white-box inventory policies with statistical safety guarantees. Extends AlphaEvolve-style approaches to online, non-stationary inventory management with confidence-interval-based certification.

entry.title: Agent Capsules: Quality-Gated Granularity Control for Multi-Agent LLM Pipelines

author.name: Aninda Ray

entry.summary: Presents Agent Capsules, an adaptive runtime that treats multi-agent pipeline execution as an optimization problem, merging agents into fewer LLM calls while gating on quality constraints. Identifies that naive merging degrades quality through tool loss and prompt compression.
