entry.title: A11y-Compressor: A Framework for Enhancing the Efficiency of GUI Agent Observations through Visual Context Reconstruction and Redundancy Reduction

author.name: Michito Takeshita, Takuro Kawada, Takumi Ohashi, Shunsuke Kitada, Hitoshi Iyatomi

entry.summary: Proposes A11y-Compressor that transforms accessibility trees into compact structured representations for GUI agents, reducing tokens to 22% of original while improving task success rates by 5.1 percentage points on OSWorld benchmark.

entry.title: Empowering Heterogeneous Graph Foundation Models via Decoupled Relation Alignment

author.name: Ziyu Zheng, Yaming Yang, Zhe Wang, Ziyu Guan, Wei Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes DRSA (Decoupled Relation Subspace Alignment), a plug-and-play framework for extending graph foundation models to multi-domain heterogeneous graphs. Addresses 'Type Collapse' and 'Relation Confusion' problems in existing alignment methods by decoupling feature semantics from relation structures.

entry.title: FollowTable: A Benchmark for Instruction-Following Table Retrieval

author.name: Rihui Jin, Yuchen Lu, Ting Zhang, Jun Wang, Kuicai Dong, Zhaocheng Du, Dongping Liu, Gang Wang, Yong Liu, Guilin Qi

entry.summary: Formalizes Instruction-Following Table Retrieval (IFTR), where relevance depends on explicit content and schema constraints rather than topical similarity alone. Introduces FollowTable benchmark to evaluate sensitivity to content scope and schema-grounded requirements.

entry.title: Skills as Verifiable Artifacts: A Trust Schema and a Biconditional Correctness Criterion for Human-in-the-Loop Agent Runtimes

author.name: Alfredo Metere

entry.summary: Argues that agent skills should be treated as untrusted code requiring verification before runtime loading, proposing a trust schema and biconditional correctness criterion for human-in-the-loop agent runtimes. Draws parallels to package manager security.

entry.title: PAMod: Modeling Cyclical Shifts via Phase-Amplitude Modulation for Non-stationary Time Series Forecasting

author.name: Yingbo Zhou, Yutong Ye, Shuhao Li, Rui Qian, Qiang Huang, Lemao Liu, Li Sun, Dejing Dou

entry.summary: Proposes PAMod, a framework modeling cyclical distribution shifts in time series via phase-amplitude modulation in normalized feature space. Learns periodic embeddings to modulate representations for handling non-stationary forecasting.

entry.title: From Local to Global to Mechanistic: An iERF-Centered Unified Framework for Interpreting Vision Models

author.name: Yearim Kim, Sangyu Han, and Nojun Kwak

entry.summary: Introduces an iERF-centric framework unifying local, global, and mechanistic interpretability of vision models around pointwise feature vectors and instance-specific effective receptive fields. Proposes Sharing Ratio Decomposition for attribution.

entry.title: Concentration and Calibration in Predictive Bayesian Inference

author.name: David T. Frazier, and Hui Wang

entry.summary: Studies predictive Bayesian inference (PBI) concentration and calibration properties, showing the posterior concentrates onto a quantity dependent on the forward predictive model, with implications for when PBI gives reliable frequentist-valid inferences.

entry.title: Two-View Accumulation as the Primary Training Lever for Hybrid-Capture Gaussian Splatting: A Variance-Decomposition View of When Gradient Surgery Helps

author.name: Sungjun Cho

entry.summary: Finds that for hybrid-capture 3D Gaussian Splatting (combining aerial and ground views), the simplest intervention—rendering two views per optimizer step—outperforms more complex gradient surgery and preconditioning approaches.

entry.title: Autoformalizing Memory Specifications with Agents

author.name: Jan Ole Ernst, Dmitri Michelangelo Saberi, Derek Christ, Thomas Zimmermann, Rajath Salegame, Suhaas M. Bhat, Stanislav Levental, Thomas Dybdahl Ahle, Matthias Jung

entry.summary: Proposes an agent-based system that automatically formalizes natural language DRAM memory specifications into formal representations for design verification, handling industry-relevant standards end-to-end.

entry.title: Information-Theoretic Generalization Bounds for Stochastic Gradient Descent with Predictable Virtual Noise

author.name: Mohammad Partohaghighi

entry.summary: Introduces predictable history-adaptive virtual perturbations for information-theoretic generalization bounds of SGD, allowing perturbation covariances to depend on optimization history including gradient statistics and preconditioners.

entry.title: Soft-MSM: Differentiable Context-Aware Elastic Alignment for Time Series

author.name: Christopher Holder and Anthony Bagnall

entry.summary: Introduces Soft-MSM, a differentiable relaxation of the Move-Split-Merge elastic distance for time series, enabling gradient-based optimization with context-aware transition costs. Proves convergence and demonstrates improved clustering.

entry.title: From Birdsong to Rumbles: Classifying Elephant Calls with Out-of-Species Embeddings

author.name: Christiaan M. Geldenhuys, Thomas R. Niesler

entry.summary: Demonstrates that pretrained acoustic embeddings from non-elephant domains can classify elephant vocalizations at near-supervised levels without fine-tuning, showing strong cross-species transfer in bioacoustics.

entry.title: Adaptive Geodesic Conformal Prediction for Egocentric Camera Pose Estimation

author.name: Aishani Pathak, Hasti Seifi

entry.summary: Proposes adaptive geodesic conformal prediction for egocentric pose estimation, showing standard conformal prediction has ~30% conditional coverage gap on hard frames. Uses DINOv2-bridged features and geodesic SE(3) scoring to close this gap.

entry.title: Estimating LLM Grading Ability and Response Difficulty in Automatic Short Answer Grading via Item Response Theory

author.name: Longwei Cong, Sonja Hahn, Sebastian Gombert, Leon Camus, Hendrik Drachsler and Ulf Kroehne

entry.summary: Applies item response theory (IRT) to evaluate LLM-based automatic short answer grading, modeling grading correctness as a function of latent grader ability and response difficulty. Reveals robustness differences invisible to aggregate metrics across 17 LLMs.

entry.title: Remote SAMsing: From Segment Anything to Segment Everything

author.name: Osmar Luiz Ferreira de Carvalho, Osmar Ab\'ilio de Carvalho J\'unior, Anesmar Olino de Albuquerque, Daniel Guerreiro e Silva

entry.summary: Proposes Remote SAMsing, a training-free pipeline adapting SAM2 for large remote sensing images by solving coverage-quality tradeoffs through multi-pass iterative masking and tile boundary stitching.

entry.title: Structure-Aware Chunking for Tabular Data in Retrieval-Augmented Generation

author.name: Pooja Guttal, Varun Magotra, Vasudeva Mahavishnu, Natasha Chanto, Sidharth Sivaprasad, Manas Gaur

entry.summary: Proposes structure-aware tabular chunking for RAG, using hierarchical Row Tree representation with token-constrained splitting and overlap-free merging to preserve semantic relationships within tabular data rows.

entry.title: Budget-Aware Routing for Long Clinical Text

author.name: Khizar Qureshi, Geoffrey Martin, Yifan Peng

entry.summary: Proposes RCD (Relevance, Coverage, Diversity), a submodular objective for budgeted context selection in clinical NLP, casting long document processing as a knapsack-constrained subset selection problem. Compares multiple unitization strategies and introduces adaptive routing heuristics for clinical text.

entry.title: Time-series Meets Complex Motion Modeling: Robust and Computational-effective Motion Predictor for Multi-object Tracking

author.name: Nhat-Tan Do, Le-Huy Tu, Nhi Ngoc-Yen Nguyen, Dieu-Phuong Nguyen, Trong-Hop Do

entry.summary: Introduces TCMP (Temporal Convolutional Motion Predictor) for multi-object tracking that uses modified temporal convolutional networks instead of complex generative models. Challenges the paradigm that complex models are needed, showing efficient TCN-based approach outperforms expensive alternatives.

entry.title: BOLT: Online Lightweight Adaptation for Preparation-Free Heterogeneous Cooperative Perception

author.name: Kang Yang, Tianci Bu, Peng Wang, Deying Li, Yongcai Wang

entry.summary: Introduces BOLT, a lightweight plug-and-play module for preparation-free heterogeneous cooperative perception in autonomous driving. Adapts neighboring agent features online via ego-as-teacher distillation without requiring joint pre-training.

entry.title: Improving LLM Code Generation via Requirement-Aware Curriculum Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Shouyu Yin, Zhao Tian, Junjie Chen, Shikai Guo

entry.summary: Proposes requirement-aware curriculum reinforcement learning for LLM code generation, addressing misaligned difficulty perception and absence of requirement difficulty awareness in existing CRL approaches.

entry.title: MMAudio-LABEL: Audio Event Labeling via Audio Generation for Silent Video

author.name: Kazuya Tateishi, Akira Takahashi, Atsuo Hiroe, Hirofumi Takeda, Shusuke Takahashi, Yuki Mitsufuji

entry.summary: Proposes MMAudio-LABEL, a framework that jointly generates audio and frame-aligned sound event labels from silent videos, addressing error accumulation in post-hoc pipelines that apply sound event detection to generated audio separately.

entry.title: Space Network of Experts: Architecture and Expert Placement

author.name: Zhanwei Wang, Huiling Yang, Min Sheng, Khaled B. Letaief, Kaibin Huang

entry.summary: Proposes Space-XNe, a framework for deploying Mixture-of-Experts LLMs on satellite networks by optimizing expert placement across satellites to minimize token generation latency under compute and communication constraints.

entry.title: Possibilistic Predictive Uncertainty for Deep Learning

author.name: Yao Ni, Jeremie Houssineau, Yew Soon Ong, Piotr Koniusz

entry.summary: Introduces DAPPr, a framework using possibility theory for epistemic uncertainty quantification in deep learning that defines a possibilistic posterior over parameters and projects it to prediction space via supremum operators.

entry.title: Learn where to Click from Yourself: On-Policy Self-Distillation for GUI Grounding

author.name: Yan Zhang, Daiqing Wu, Huawen Shen, Yu Zhou, Can Ma

entry.summary: Proposes GUI-SD, the first on-policy self-distillation framework for GUI grounding, using visually enriched privileged context with Gaussian soft masks as teacher supervision, avoiding expensive multiple rollouts of RL methods.

entry.title: UniVidX: A Unified Multimodal Framework for Versatile Video Generation via Diffusion Priors

author.name: Houyuan Chen, Hong Li, Xianghao Kong, Tianrui Zhu, Shaocong Xu, Weiqing Xiao, Yuwei Guo, Chongjie Ye, Lvmin Zhang, Hao Zhao, Anyi Rao

entry.summary: Presents UniVidX, a unified multimodal video generation framework using Stochastic Condition Masking to handle multiple modalities (depth, normals, etc.) as both inputs and outputs, with cross-modal consistency during synthesis.

entry.title: Spiking Sequence Machines and Transformers

author.name: Joy Bose

entry.summary: Shows formal equivalence between spiking Sparse Distributed Memory sequence machines (2007) and transformers (2017), proving they share five functional operations with cosine similarity as retrieval primitive, connected by a Phase-Latency Isomorphism.

entry.title: Augmented Lagrangian Multiplier Network for State-wise Safety in Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Jiaming Zhang, Yujie Yang, Yao Lyu, Shengbo Eben Li, Liping Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes an augmented Lagrangian approach for state-wise safety constraints in RL using multiplier networks, addressing training oscillations caused by network generalization amplifying local overshoots in dual ascent.

entry.title: Aitchison Embeddings for Learning Compositional Graph Representations

author.name: Nikolaos Nakis, Chrysoula Kosma, Panagiotis Promponas, Michail Chatzianastasis, Giannis Nikolentzos

entry.summary: Proposes compositional graph embeddings grounded in Aitchison geometry, where nodes are represented as simplex-valued compositions. Uses isometric log-ratio coordinates to preserve distances while enabling unconstrained Euclidean optimization, yielding intrinsically interpretable embeddings.

entry.title: NonZero: Interaction-Guided Exploration for Multi-Agent Monte Carlo Tree Search

author.name: Sizhe Tang, Zuyuan Zhang, Mahdi Imani, Tian Lan

entry.summary: Proposes NonZero, a method to make multi-agent MCTS tractable by using interaction-guided exploration over low-dimensional representations instead of the full joint-action space. Uses an interaction score that detects coordination benefits even when no single agent can improve alone.

entry.title: A Dirac-Frenkel-Onsager principle: Instantaneous residual minimization with gauge momentum for nonlinear parametrizations of PDE solutions

author.name: Matteo Raviola and Benjamin Peherstorfer

entry.summary: Addresses ill-conditioning in Dirac-Frenkel variational methods for nonlinear PDE parametrizations by interpreting non-uniqueness as gauge freedom and injecting momentum along nullspace directions using Onsager's minimum-dissipation principle.

entry.title: Randomized Subspace Nesterov Accelerated Gradient

author.name: Gaku Omiya, Pierre-Louis Poirion, Akiko Takeda

entry.summary: Develops randomized-subspace Nesterov accelerated gradient methods for convex optimization under matrix smoothness assumptions, achieving accelerated convergence rates with only projected-gradient information.

entry.title: A Benchmark Dataset for Graph Regression with Homogeneous and Multi-Relational Variants

author.name: Peter Samoaa, Marcus Vukojevic, Morteza Haghir Chehreghani and Antonio Longa

entry.summary: Introduces RelSC, a graph-regression benchmark dataset built from program graphs with execution-time cost labels, available in homogeneous and multi-relational variants to address limited diversity in existing graph benchmarks.

entry.title: AirFM-DDA: Air-Interface Foundation Model in the Delay-Doppler-Angle Domain for AI-Native 6G

author.name: Kejia Bian, Meixia Tao, Jianhua Mo, Zhiyong Chen, Leyan Chen

entry.summary: Proposes AirFM-DDA, a wireless foundation model operating in the Delay-Doppler-Angle domain for 6G physical layer tasks, reparameterizing channel state information to resolve multipath components and reduce computational overhead.

entry.title: Learning physically grounded traffic accident reconstruction from public accident reports

author.name: Yanchen Guan, Haicheng Liao, Chengyue Wang, Zhenning Li

entry.summary: Formulates traffic accident reconstruction from public reports as a multimodal learning problem, constructing the CISS-REC dataset of 6,217 real-world cases and developing a framework grounding report semantics to road topology and motion.

entry.title: Cultural Benchmarking of LLMs in Standard and Dialectal Arabic Dialogues

author.name: Muhammad Dehan Al Kautsar, Saeed Almheiri, Momina Ahsan, Bilal Elbouardi, Younes Samih, Sarfraz Ahmad, Amr Keleg, Omar El Herraoui, Kareem Elzeky, Abed Alhakim Freihat, Mohamed Anwar, Zhuohan Xie, Junhong Liang, Mohammad Rustom Al Nasar, Preslav Nakov, Fajri Koto

entry.summary: Introduces ArabCulture-Dialogue, a culturally grounded conversational dataset for 13 Arabic-speaking countries in MSA and dialects, benchmarking LLMs on cultural reasoning, translation, and dialect generation across 12 topics.

entry.title: From Images2Mesh: A 3D Surface Reconstruction Pipeline for Non-Cooperative Space Objects

author.name: Bala Prenith Reddy Gopu, Patrick Quinn, George M. Nehma, Madhur Tiwari, Matt Ueckermann, David Hinckley, Christopher McKenna

entry.summary: Presents a pipeline for neural implicit surface reconstruction of non-cooperative space objects from monocular inspection imagery, demonstrated on real ISS and rocket body footage. Shows that segmentation-based background removal is essential for real orbital imagery.

entry.title: Selfie-Capture Dynamics as an Auxiliary Signal Against Deepfakes and Injection Attacks for Mobile Identity Verification

author.name: Erkka Rantahalvari, Olli Silv\'en, Zinelabidine Boulkenafet, Constantino \'Alvarez Casado

entry.summary: Investigates whether passive motion traces from mobile selfie capture can detect deepfakes and injection attacks for identity verification. Introduces CanSelfie dataset with 375 multi-sensor sequences from 30 participants.

entry.title: CURE-OOD: Benchmarking Out-of-Distribution Detection for Survival Prediction

author.name: Wenjie Zhao, Jia Li, Mingrui Liu, Jing Wang, Yunhui Guo

entry.summary: Introduces CURE-OOD, the first benchmark for systematically studying out-of-distribution detection in cancer survival prediction from CT images, addressing covariate shifts from imaging acquisition variations.

entry.title: VQ-SAD: Vector Quantized Structure Aware Diffusion For Molecule Generation

author.name: Farshad Noravesh, Reza Haffari, Layki Soon, Arghya Pal

entry.summary: Proposes VQ-SAD, a molecule generation method using VQ-VAE codebooks as tokenizers for atom and bond types in a downstream diffusion process. This neuro-symbolic approach avoids hash collisions from Morgan fingerprints and information loss from one-hot representations.

entry.title: RTPrune: Reading-Twice Inspired Token Pruning for Efficient DeepSeek-OCR Inference

author.name: Ben Wan, Yan Feng, Zihan Tang, Weizhe Huang, Yuting Zeng, Jia Wang and Tongxuan Liu

entry.summary: Proposes RTPrune, a two-stage token pruning method for DeepSeek-OCR that observes a two-stage reading trajectory (high-norm tokens first, then redistribution) and prunes accordingly. Tailored specifically for visual-text compression in OCR.

entry.title: Foresight Arena: An On-Chain Benchmark for Evaluating AI Forecasting Agents

author.name: Maksym Nechepurenko, Pavel Shuvalov

entry.summary: Introduces Foresight Arena, a permissionless on-chain benchmark for evaluating AI forecasting agents on real Polymarket prediction markets using commit-reveal protocol on Polygon PoS. Measures Brier Score in incentive-compatible, contamination-resistant setting.

entry.title: MMAudioReverbs: Video-Guided Acoustic Modeling for Dereverberation and Room Impulse Response Estimation

author.name: Akira Takahashi, Ryosuke Sawata, Shusuke Takahashi, Yuki Mitsufuji

entry.summary: Proposes MMAudioReverbs, extending the MMAudio video-to-audio model for dereverberation and room impulse response estimation. Hypothesizes and validates that V2A models implicitly learn spatial audio-visual relationships.

entry.title: GOR-IS: 3D Gaussian Object Removal in the Intrinsic Space

author.name: Yonghao Zhao, Yupeng Gao, Jian Yang, Jin Xie, Beibei Wang

entry.summary: Presents GOR-IS, a framework for physically-based object removal in 3D Gaussian Splatting scenes that operates in intrinsic space to handle global lighting effects and non-Lambertian surfaces.

entry.title: Scaling Federated Linear Contextual Bandits via Sketching

author.name: Hantao Yang, Hong Xie, Xutong Liu, Defu Lian

entry.summary: Proposes FSCLB for federated contextual linear bandits that uses SVD-based sketching to reduce computation from O(d³) to O(l²d) and communication from O(d²) to O(ld), making high-dimensional federated bandits practical.

entry.title: Hierarchical Abstract Tree for Cross-Document Retrieval-Augmented Generation

author.name: Ziwen Zhao, Menglin Yang

entry.summary: Proposes Ψ-RAG, a tree-based RAG framework for cross-document multi-hop questions that addresses poor distribution adaptability, structural isolation, and coarse abstraction through hierarchical merging and cross-document connections.

entry.title: Colorful-Noise: Training-Free Low-Frequency Noise Manipulation for Color-Based Conditional Image Generation

author.name: Nadav Z. Cohen, Ofir Abramovich, Ariel Shamir

entry.summary: Presents Colorful-Noise, a training-free method for controlling color composition in diffusion model outputs by manipulating low-frequency noise components, showing that low frequencies determine global structure while high frequencies control details.

entry.title: AI Washing Inflates Expected Performance but Not Interaction Outcomes: An AI Placebo Study Using Fitts' Law

author.name: Nick von Felten, Luisa Ella M\"uller, Johannes Sch\"oning

entry.summary: Shows that AI washing (overstating AI capabilities) inflates performance expectations but does not actually improve interaction outcomes, demonstrated through a Fitts' Law study where 'AI-assisted' mouse labels didn't improve actual performance.

entry.title: Beyond Decodability: Reconstructing Language Model Representations with an Encoding Probe

author.name: Gaofei Shen, Martijn Bentum, Tom Lentz, Afra Alishahi, Grzegorz Chrupa{\l}a

entry.summary: Introduces an encoding probe that reconstructs internal model representations from interpretable features, solving limitations of standard decoding probes around feature comparison and correlation effects. Evaluates on text and speech transformers.

entry.title: Unlearning Offline Stochastic Multi-Armed Bandits

author.name: Zichun Ye, Runqi Wang, Xuchuang Wang, Xutong Liu, Shuai Li, Mohammad Hajiesmaili

entry.summary: Initiates the first study of machine unlearning for offline stochastic multi-armed bandits, formalizing privacy constraints and providing algorithms with utility guarantees for both single- and multi-source unlearning scenarios.

entry.title: Prediction of Alzheimer's Disease Risk Factors from Retinal Images via Deep Learning: Development and Validation of Biologically Relevant Morphological Associations in the UK Biobank

author.name: Seowung Leem, Yunchao Yang, Adam J. Woods, Ruogu Fang

entry.summary: Trains deep learning models on 62,876 UK Biobank fundus photographs to predict 12 Alzheimer's-related risk factors, characterizing retinal structural signatures corresponding to AD vulnerability pathways.

entry.title: PhysEdit: Physically-Consistent Region-Aware Image Editing via Adaptive Spatio-Temporal Reasoning

author.name: Guandong Li, Mengxia Ye

entry.summary: Presents PhysEdit, an image editing framework that adapts inference depth and spatial focus based on edit complexity. Introduces two inference-time modules—Complexity-Adaptive Reasoning Depth (CARD) and a spatial attention mechanism—that work without retraining the backbone model.

entry.title: EASE: Federated Multimodal Unlearning via Entanglement-Aware Anchor Closure

author.name: Zihao Ding, Beining Wu, Jun Huang

entry.summary: Presents EASE, a federated multimodal unlearning method that addresses the entanglement of forgotten knowledge across modalities and client gradient subspaces. Identifies an 'Anchor Principle' with three residual anchors that preserve forgotten alignments in federated contrastive learning.

entry.title: RunAgent: Interpreting Natural-Language Plans with Constraint-Guided Execution

author.name: Arunabh Srivastava, Mohammad A. (Amir) Khojastepour, Srimat Chakradhar, Sennur Ulukus

entry.summary: Proposes RunAgent, a multi-agent plan execution platform that interprets natural-language plans with constraint-guided execution. Bridges natural language expressiveness with programming determinism through an agentic language with explicit control constructs.

entry.title: SHIFT: Robust Double Machine Learning for Average Dose-Response Functions under Heavy-Tailed Contamination

author.name: Eichi Uehara

entry.summary: Introduces SHIFT, a robust double machine learning estimator for average dose-response functions that handles heavy-tailed contamination through a self-calibrated approach using Welsch-loss and graduated non-convexity optimization.

entry.title: M-CaStLe: Uncovering Local Causal Structures in Multivariate Space-Time Gridded Data

author.name: J. Jake Nichol, Michael Weylandt, G. Matthew Fricke, Jhayron Perez-Carrasquilla, Melanie E. Moses

entry.summary: Extends CaStLe to multivariate settings (M-CaStLe) for discovering local causal structures in high-dimensional space-time gridded data, jointly modeling within-variable and cross-variable causal relationships.

entry.title: Recursive Maximum Likelihood Estimation for Interacting Particle Systems using Virtual Particles

author.name: Louis Sharrock and Nikolas Kantas and Grigorios A. Pavliotis

entry.summary: Studies recursive maximum likelihood estimation for interacting particle systems from single-particle observations, using virtual particle systems to compute stochastic gradient estimates for the mean-field log-likelihood.

entry.title: FedACT: Concurrent Federated Intelligence across Heterogeneous Data Sources

author.name: Md Sirajul Islam, Isabelle G Chapman, N I Md Ashafuddula, Xu Yuan, Li Chen, Nian-Feng Tzeng, and Klara Nahrstedt

entry.summary: Proposes FedACT, a resource-heterogeneity-aware device scheduling approach for multiple concurrent federated learning jobs sharing a pool of heterogeneous devices, optimizing system performance across simultaneous FL tasks.

entry.title: SiriusHelper: An LLM Agent-Based Operations Assistant for Big Data Platforms

author.name: Yu Shen, Shiyang Liu, Qihang He, Yihang Cheng, Haining Xie, Zhiming He, Huahua Fan, Xianzhi Tan, Teng Ma, Shaoquan Zhang, Danqing Huang, Fan Jiang, Yang Li, Chongqing Zhao, Peng Chen, Jie Jiang, Bin Cui

entry.summary: Presents SiriusHelper, a deployed LLM+RAG assistant for big data platforms that handles consultation and troubleshooting through multi-hop retrieval, structured knowledge organization, and automated SOP generation from escalated tickets.

entry.title: Learning from the Unseen: Generative Data Augmentation for Geometric-Semantic Accident Anticipation

author.name: Yanchen Guan, Haicheng Liao, Chengyue Wang, Xingcheng Liu, Jiaxun Zhang, Keqiang Li, Zhenning Li

entry.summary: Proposes a dual-path framework for traffic accident anticipation combining generative data augmentation (video synthesis) with a graph neural network enriched with semantic cues for dynamic reasoning over spatial and semantic relations.

entry.title: RETO: A Rotary-Enhanced Transformer Operator for High-Fidelity Prediction of Automotive Aerodynamics

author.name: Bojun Zhang, Huiyu Yang, Yunpeng Wang, Yuntian Chen, Yuanwei Bin, Rikui Zhang, Jianchun Wang

entry.summary: Proposes RETO, a neural operator for aerodynamic prediction using rotary positional encodings (RoPE) adapted from NLP for spatial awareness in 3D, achieving improved accuracy on automotive aerodynamics benchmarks.

entry.title: Network Digital Untwinning: Towards Backward Optimization of Digital Twins

author.name: Zifan Zhang, Dianwei Chen, Anjun Gao, Manhua Wang, Mingzhe Chen, Minghong Fang, Xianfeng Yang, Yuchen Liu

entry.summary: Introduces network digital 'untwinning'—targeted removal of deprecated data contributions from network digital twins while maintaining model integrity. Addresses data privacy and regulatory compliance in network management.

entry.title: An End-to-End Decision-Aware Multi-Scale Attention-Based Model for Explainable Autonomous Driving

author.name: Maryam Sadat Hosseini Azad, Shahriar Baradaran Shokouhi, Amir Abbas Hamidi Imani, Shahin Atakishiyev, and Randy Goebel

entry.summary: Proposes a multi-scale attention-based model for explainable autonomous driving that integrates decision-awareness throughout the architecture, addressing limitations of post-hoc explanation methods.

entry.title: A Model-based Visual Contact Localization and Force Sensing System for Compliant Robotic Grippers

author.name: Kaiwen Zuo, Shuyuan Yang and Zonghe Chua

entry.summary: Develops a model-based visual force sensing approach for compliant robotic grippers using RGB-D cameras, combining iterative contact localization with analytical force estimation without end-to-end deep learning.

entry.title: Free Energy Surface Sampling via Reduced Flow Matching

author.name: Zichen Liu, Tiejun Li

entry.summary: Proposes FES-FM, a flow matching method for directly sampling free energy surfaces in collective variable space, avoiding expensive high-dimensional configuration space simulations. Uses Hessian-based prior distributions for many-particle systems to ensure rotational and translational invariance.

entry.title: Flow matching for Sentinel-2 super-resolution: implementation, application, and implications

author.name: Dakota Hester, Vitor S. Martins, Lucas B. Ferreira, Thainara M. A. Lima, Juliana A. Ara\'ujo

entry.summary: Applies flow matching models for 4x super-resolution of Sentinel-2 satellite imagery using 120K paired Sentinel-2/NAIP image pairs. Shows flow matching outperforms diffusion and Real-ESRGAN in pixel-wise accuracy with single-step inference, and achieves perceptual quality in 20 steps.

entry.title: Scalable Learning in Structured Recurrent Spiking Neural Networks without Backpropagation

author.name: Bo Tang and Weiwei Xie

entry.summary: Proposes structured multi-layer recurrent SNN with small-world long-range projections and strictly local plasticity mechanisms for supervised learning without backpropagation. Combines winner-take-all, population-based learning for biologically plausible computation.

entry.title: LIMSSR: LLM-Driven Sequence-to-Score Reasoning under Training-Time Incomplete Multimodal Observations

author.name: Huangbiao Xu, Huanqi Wu, Xiao Ke, Yuxin Peng

entry.summary: Proposes LIMSSR, a framework using LLMs for incomplete multimodal learning under training-time missing modalities. Reformulates the challenge as conditional sequence reasoning with prompt-guided imputation and multidimensional representation scoring.

entry.title: Adaptive Equilibrium: Dynamic Weighting Framework for Generalized Interruption of DeepFake Models

author.name: Hongrui Zheng, Liejun Wang, Zhiqing Guo

entry.summary: Proposes Adaptive Equilibrium Framework (AEF) for generalized deepfake disruption that uses dynamic weighting based on real-time loss feedback to balance perturbation effectiveness across multiple target models, shifting from average-case to worst-case optimization.

entry.title: ReLay: Personalized LLM-Generated Plain-Language Summaries for Better Understanding, but at What Cost?

author.name: Joey Chan, Yikun Han, Jingyuan Chen, Samuel Fang, Lauren D. Gryboski, Alexandra Lee, Sheel Tanna, Qingqing Zhu, Zhiyong Lu, Lucy Lu Wang, Yue Guo

entry.summary: Introduces ReLay, a dataset of 300 participant-PLS pairs evaluating personalized plain language summaries of health research using LLMs. Studies whether personalization helps comprehension and how to balance it with safety.

entry.title: Stereo Multistage Spatial Attention for Real-Time Mobile Manipulation Under Visual Scale Variation and Disturbances

author.name: Xianbo Cai, Hideyuki Ichiwara, Hyogo Hiruma, Masaki Yoshikawa, Hiroshi Ito and Tetsuya Ogata

entry.summary: Presents a stereo multistage spatial attention method for real-time mobile manipulation that extracts task-relevant attention points from stereo images and integrates with robot states through hierarchical recurrent architecture.

entry.title: "What Are You Really Trying to Do?": Co-Creating Life Goals from Everyday Computer Use

author.name: Shardul Sapkota, Matthew J\"orke, Zane Sabbagh, Omar Shaikh, Grace Wang, James A. Landay

entry.summary: Introduces 'striving co-creation,' a system that infers broader life goals from observations of everyday computer use, grounded in Activity Theory and personal strivings framework. Uses hierarchical representation of activities.

entry.title: PhysiGen: Integrating Collision-Aware Physical Constraints for High-Fidelity Human-Human Interaction Generation

author.name: Nan Lei, Yuan-Ming Li, Ling-An Zeng, Liang Xu, Zhi-Wei Xia, Hui-Wen Huang, Fa-Ting Hong, Wei-Shi Zheng

entry.summary: Proposes PhysiGen, an efficient optimization strategy for human-human interaction generation that uses geometric primitives instead of full body meshes for collision detection, significantly reducing computational cost while improving physical plausibility.

entry.title: 2D-SuGaR: Surface-Aware Gaussian Splatting for Geometrically Accurate Mesh Reconstruction

author.name: Prajwal Gupta C. R., Divyam Sheth, Jinjoo Ha, Mirela Ostrek, Justus Thies

entry.summary: Enhances 2D Gaussian Splatting with monocular depth and normal priors for more robust and geometrically accurate mesh reconstruction, proposing depth-guided initialization and surface-aware regularization.

entry.title: Federated Distillation for Whole Slide Image via Gaussian-Mixture Feature Alignment and Curriculum Integration

author.name: Luru Jing, Cong Cong, Yanyuan Chen, Yongzhi Cao

entry.summary: Proposes FedHD for federated learning in digital pathology that performs local Gaussian-mixture feature alignment for whole slide images, using one-to-one distillation and curriculum-based federation to handle heterogeneous architectures.

entry.title: Intrinsic Gradient Suppression for Label-Noise Prompt Tuning in Vision-Language Models

author.name: Jiayu Li, Jiaxin Qi, Sheng Zhou, Jiaqiang Huang, Xiansheng Hua

entry.summary: Proposes Double-Softmax Prompt Tuning (DSPT) for label-noise robust prompt tuning of CLIP, using sequential probabilistic normalization to suppress gradients from noisy samples while maintaining informative updates, without hyperparameters.

entry.title: Born-Qualified: An Autonomous Framework for Deploying Advanced Energy and Electronic Materials

author.name: Steven R. Spurgeon, Milad Abolhasani, Frederick Baddour, Ryan B. Comes, Vinayak P. Dravid, Hilary Egan, Patrick Emami, Robert W. Epps, Davi M. F\'ebba, Renae Gannon, E. Ashley Gaulding, Ayana Ghosh, Kenny Gruchalla, Grace Guinan, Taro Hitosugi, Michael Holden, Sergei V. Kalinin, Yangang Liang, John S. Mangum, Matthew J. Olszta, Nathaniel H. Park, Axel Palmstrom, Michelle A. Smeaton, Brooks Tellekamp, Nicholas E. Thornburg, Raymond R. Unocic, Daniela Ushizima, Rama K. Vasudevan, Robert White, Andrew Young, Andriy Zakutayev

entry.summary: Proposes 'born-qualified' autonomous materials discovery that embeds manufacturability, cost, and durability constraints from the outset rather than optimizing only laboratory metrics, addressing the 'valley of death' in materials deployment.

entry.title: From Prediction to Practice: A Task-Aware Evaluation Framework for Blood Glucose Forecasting

author.name: Alireza Namazi, Heman Shakeri

entry.summary: Presents a task-aware evaluation framework for blood glucose forecasting focusing on hypoglycemia early warning and insulin dosing, showing that models with low average error can have dangerous failures in high-risk regimes.

entry.title: Deep Kernel Learning for Stratifying Glaucoma Trajectories

author.name: Bruce Rushing, Angela Danquah, Alireza Namazi, Arjun Dirghangi, Heman Shakeri

entry.summary: Proposes a deep kernel learning architecture combining Gaussian Processes with transformer-based feature extraction on clinical-BERT embeddings for stratifying glaucoma patient trajectories. Successfully identifies three clinically distinct patient subgroups and importantly decouples disease progression from current severity.

entry.title: Meritocratic Fairness in Budgeted Combinatorial Multi-armed Bandits via Shapley Values

author.name: Shradha Sharma, Swapnil Dhamal, Shweta Jain

entry.summary: Proposes a framework for meritocratic fairness in budgeted combinatorial multi-armed bandits with full-bandit feedback, extending Shapley values to K-Shapley values that capture marginal contributions under size constraints. Proves uniqueness of K-Shapley values and develops a fairness-aware bandit algorithm.

entry.title: GeoContra: From Fluent GIS Code to Verifiable Spatial Analysis with Geography-Grounded Repair

author.name: Yinhao Xiao, Rongbo Xiao, Yihan Zhang

entry.summary: Presents GeoContra, a verification and repair framework for LLM-generated GIS Python workflows that enforces geographic rules including CRS semantics, topology, and spatial predicates. Evaluated on 7,079 real geospatial tasks across 15 Boston-area zones.

entry.title: Advancing Edge Classification through High-Dimensional Causal Modeling of Node-Edge Interplay

author.name: Duanyu Feng, Li Ding, Hongru Liang, Wenqiang Lei

entry.summary: Proposes CECF (Causal Edge Classification Framework), the first to apply causal inference to edge classification by modeling edge features as high-dimensional treatment within a causal framework, learning balanced representations by mitigating node feature influence.

entry.title: PILIR: Physics-Informed Local Implicit Representation

author.name: Jianfeng Li and Feng Wang and Ke Tang

entry.summary: Introduces PILIR, a physics-informed local implicit representation that separates global physical domains into discrete latent features and continuous decoders to overcome spectral bias in PINNs. Uses learnable grids for spatial locality to capture high-frequency details.

entry.title: MSACT: Multistage Spatial Alignment for Stable Low-Latency Fine Manipulation

author.name: Xianbo Cai, Hideyuki Ichiwara, Masaki Yoshikawa and Tetsuya Ogata

entry.summary: Introduces MSACT, a multistage spatial attention module for stable low-latency fine bimanual manipulation that extracts stable 2D attention points with explicit spatial consistency, addressing localization drift from limited demonstrations.

entry.title: Surprisal Minimisation over Goal-directed Alternatives Predicts Production Choice in Dialogue

author.name: Tom Utting, Mario Giulianelli, Arabella Sinclair

entry.summary: Models utterance production as probabilistic cost-sensitive choice over contextual alternatives using information-theoretic costs. Finds that surprisal minimization relative to goal-directed alternatives best predicts production choices in dialogue.

entry.title: SAVGO: Learning State-Action Value Geometry with Cosine Similarity for Continuous Control

author.name: Stavros Orfanoudakis, Pedro P. Vergara

entry.summary: Proposes SAVGO, a geometry-aware RL algorithm that learns a joint state-action embedding space where value-similar pairs have high cosine similarity. Uses this learned geometry to generate similarity kernels over candidate actions, guiding policy improvement toward higher-value regions.

entry.title: InpaintSLat: Inpainting Structured 3D Latents via Initial Noise Optimization

author.name: Jaeyoung Chung, Suyoung Lee, Kyoung Mu Lee

entry.summary: Presents InpaintSLat, a training-free approach for controllable 3D inpainting via initial noise optimization in structured 3D latent diffusion, using backpropagation approximation for the rectified flow model.

entry.title: Batch Normalization for Neural Networks on Complex Domains

author.name: Xuan Son Nguyen, Nistor Grozavu

entry.summary: Proposes batch normalization layers for neural networks on complex domains (e.g., Siegel disk domain), extending Riemannian BN to less-studied complex manifolds. Demonstrated on radar classification, node classification, and action recognition.

entry.title: Reinforcement Learning with Markov Risk Measures and Multipattern Risk Approximation

author.name: Andrzej Ruszczynski and Tiangang Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces mini-batch Markov coherent risk measures and multipattern Q-factor approximation for risk-averse reinforcement learning, proving regret bounds for the proposed Q-learning method.

entry.title: Decentralized Proximal Stochastic Gradient Langevin Dynamics

author.name: Mohammad Rafiqul Islam, Lingjiong Zhu

entry.summary: Proposes DE-PSGLD, a decentralized MCMC algorithm for constrained sampling using proximal regularization via Moreau-Yosida envelopes. Provides non-asymptotic convergence guarantees in 2-Wasserstein distance.

entry.title: Revisiting CroPA: A Reproducibility Study and Enhancements for Cross-Prompt Adversarial Transferability in Vision-Language Models

author.name: Atharv Mittal, Agam Pandey, Amritanshu Tiwari, Sukrit Jindal, Swadesh Swain

entry.summary: Reproduces and extends CroPA cross-prompt adversarial attacks on Vision-Language Models, proposing improved initialization strategies, cross-image transferability investigation, and structured prompt-based defenses.

entry.title: Cloud Is Closer Than It Appears: Revisiting the Tradeoffs of Distributed Real-Time Inference

author.name: Pragya Sharma, Hang Qiu, Mani Srivastava

entry.summary: Revisits the assumption that cloud inference is unsuitable for latency-sensitive CPS tasks, demonstrating that properly provisioned cloud platforms can match or beat on-device inference for real-time control by amortizing network and queuing delays.

entry.title: Broadband Wide Field of View Imaging with Computational Mirrors

author.name: Vishwanath Saragadam, Niki Nezakati, Amit Roy-Chowdhury, Vivek Boominathan

entry.summary: Introduces Computational Mirrors for broadband VIS-SWIR imaging using a single sensor, capturing minimal focal stacks and computationally reconstructing high-resolution wide-field images across the complete spectrum.

entry.title: ROSA: Robust and Energy-Efficient Microring-Based Optical Neural Networks via Optical Shift-and-Add and Layer-Wise Hybrid Mapping

author.name: Huifan Zhang, Yun Hu, Caizhi Sheng, Yurui Qu, Pingqiang Zhou

entry.summary: Presents ROSA, a microring-based optical neural network architecture with optical shift-and-add modules and hybrid mapping strategy, reducing energy-delay product by 64% and improving accuracy by 8.3% on CIFAR-10.

entry.title: NorBERTo: A ModernBERT Model Trained for Portuguese with 331 Billion Tokens Corpus

author.name: Enzo S. N. Silva, Pablo B. Costa, Raphael C. Vlasman, Rosimeire P. Costa, Henrique L. P. Silva, Lucas F. A. O. Pellicer, Guilherme Rinaldo, Renato A. Almeida, Darian S. R. Rabbani, Cinthya O. Oestreich, Vinicius F. Carid\'a

entry.summary: Proposes NorBERTo, a ModernBERT-based encoder model for Brazilian Portuguese trained on a new 331B token corpus. Achieves best results among encoder models on PLUE benchmark.

entry.title: Confidence Estimation in Automatic Short Answer Grading with LLMs

author.name: Longwei Cong, Sonja Hahn, Sebastian Gombert, Leon Camus, Hendrik Drachsler, Ulf Kroehne

entry.summary: Investigates confidence estimation for LLM-based automatic short answer grading, comparing model-based confidence (verbalizing, latent, consistency) with dataset-derived uncertainty, finding that model confidence alone is insufficient.

entry.title: Agentic AI for Trip Planning Optimization Application

author.name: Tiejin Chen, Ahmadreza Moradipari, Kyungtae Han, Hua Wei, and Nejib Ammar

entry.summary: Proposes an agentic AI framework for trip planning optimization with an orchestration agent coordinating specialized sub-agents, along with a benchmark dataset providing ground-truth optimal solutions for objective evaluation.

entry.title: Conformalized Quantum DeepONet Ensembles for Scalable Operator Learning with Distribution-Free Uncertainty

author.name: Purav Matlia, Christian Moya, Guang Lin

entry.summary: Proposes Conformalized Quantum DeepONet Ensembles that reduce operator learning inference complexity from O(n²) to O(n) using Quantum Orthogonal Neural Networks, while providing distribution-free uncertainty quantification through conformal prediction. Addresses both scalability and safety-critical reliability in surrogate modeling of dynamical systems.

entry.title: Group Cognition Learning: Making Everything Better Through Governed Two-Stage Agents Collaboration

author.name: Chunlei Meng, Pengbin Feng, Rong Fu, Hoi Leong Lee, Xiaojing Du, Zhaolu Kang, Zeyu Zhang, Weilin Zhou, Chun Ouyang, Zhongxue Gan

entry.summary: Proposes Group Cognition Learning (GCL), a two-stage multimodal learning framework with Routing and Auditing Agents that address modality dominance and spurious coupling. Uses governed collaboration to selectively gate cross-modal interactions.

entry.title: SIMON: Saliency-aware Integrative Multi-view Object-centric Neural Decoding

author.name: YuSheng Lin, Ji-Hwa Tsai, Chun-Shu Wei

entry.summary: Proposes SIMON, a saliency-aware multi-view framework for zero-shot EEG-to-image retrieval that uses saliency prediction to select fixation centers and generates foveated views. Achieves 69.7% top-1 accuracy on THINGS-EEG intra-subject setting.

entry.title: GD4: Graph-based Discrete Denoising Diffusion for MIMO Detection

author.name: Qincheng Lu, Sitao Luan, Xiao-Wen Chang

entry.summary: Proposes GD4, a graph-based discrete denoising diffusion method for MIMO detection that operates directly in discrete symbol space with fast inference. Particularly effective in under-determined systems where existing methods struggle.

entry.title: Learning from Compressed CT: Feature Attention Style Transfer and Structured Factorized Projections for Resource-Efficient Medical Image Analysis

author.name: Shadid Yousuf, S.M. Mahbubur Rahman, Mohammed Imamul Hassan Bhuiyan

entry.summary: Proposes FAST (Feature Attention Style Transfer), a knowledge distillation framework for learning from JPEG-compressed CT volumes, transferring activation patterns and structural relationships from models trained on uncompressed data.

entry.title: Federated Learning with Hypergradient-based Online Update of Aggregation Weights

author.name: Ayano Nakai-Kasai, Tadashi Wadayama

entry.summary: Proposes FedHAW, a federated learning method using hypergradient-based online updates of aggregation weights to handle data heterogeneity and varying communication environments for IoT devices.

entry.title: Scalable Context-Aware Graph Attention for Unsupervised Anomaly Detection in Large-Scale Mobile Networks

author.name: Sara Malacarne, Eirik Hoel-H{\o}iseth, Erlend Aune, David Zsolt Bir\'o, Massimiliano Ruocco

entry.summary: Proposes C-MTAD-GAT, a context-aware graph attention network for unsupervised anomaly detection in mobile networks that combines temporal and feature-wise graph attention with context conditioning. It operates as a single shared model across large populations of network elements, addressing the impracticality of supervised approaches at scale.

entry.title: LambdaRankIC: Directly Optimizing Rank IC for Financial Prediction

author.name: Yan Lin, Yihong Su, Yi Yang

entry.summary: Proposes LambdaRankIC, a learning-to-rank approach that directly optimizes Rank IC (Spearman correlation) for financial prediction by deriving closed-form lambda gradients for pairwise rank swaps within XGBoost.

entry.title: ControBench: An Interaction-Aware Benchmark for Controversial Discourse Analysis on Social Networks

author.name: Ta Thanh Thuy, Jiaqi Zhu, Xuan Liu, Lin Shang, Reihaneh Rabbany, Guillaume Rabusseau, Lihui Chen, Zheng Yilun, Sitao Luan

entry.summary: Introduces ControBench, a benchmark for controversial discourse analysis combining heterogeneous social interaction graphs with textual semantics, built from Reddit discussions on polarizing topics with 7,370 users and 26,525 interactions.

entry.title: Tempus: A Temporally Scalable Resource-Invariant GEMM Streaming Framework for Versal AI Edge

author.name: M. Grailoo and J. N\'u\~nez-Y\'a\~nez

entry.summary: Proposes Tempus, a resource-invariant temporal GEMM framework for AMD Versal AI Edge SoCs that uses temporal scaling instead of spatial scaling, enabling LLM inference on resource-constrained edge devices.

entry.title: Depth-Guided Privacy-Preserving Visual Localization Using 3D Sphere Clouds

author.name: Heejoon Moon, Jongwoo Lee, Jeonggon Kim, Je Hyeong Hong

entry.summary: Presents a privacy-preserving visual localization method using 3D sphere clouds, which lifts map points to lines crossing the map centroid, defeating density-based attacks while maintaining localization accuracy.

entry.title: Fairness of Classifiers in the Presence of Constraints between Features

author.name: Martin C. Cooper, Imane Bousdira

entry.summary: Proposes that classifier fairness should be defined through the existence of fair explanations (prime-implicant reasons without protected features), showing that ignoring feature constraints can completely change fairness assessments.

entry.title: Faithful Extreme Image Rescaling with Learnable Reversible Transformation and Semantic Priors

author.name: Hao Wei and Yanhui Zhou and Chenyang Ge and Saeed Anwar and Ajmal Mian

entry.summary: Proposes FaithEIR for extreme image rescaling (16x+) using diffusion with learnable reversible transformation inspired by SVD, adaptive detail priors, and pixel semantic embedders for preserving semantic consistency.

entry.title: EGREFINE: An Execution-Grounded Optimization Framework for Text-to-SQL Schema Refinement

author.name: Jiaqian Wang, Yutao Qi, Wenjin Hou, Yu Pang, Rui Yang

entry.summary: Proposes EGREFINE, framing database schema refinement as constrained optimization to improve Text-to-SQL accuracy by renaming ambiguous columns while preserving query equivalence through views.

entry.title: BlenderRAG: High-Fidelity 3D Object Generation via Retrieval-Augmented Code Synthesis

author.name: Massimo Rondelli, Francesco Pivi, Maurizio Gabbrielli

entry.summary: Presents BlenderRAG, a RAG system for generating executable Blender code from natural language using 500 expert-validated examples, improving compilation success from 40.8% to 70.0% and CLIP similarity from 0.41 to 0.77.

entry.title: Affordance Agent Harness: Verification-Gated Skill Orchestration

author.name: Haojian Huang, Jiahao Shi, Yinchuan Li, Yingcong Chen

entry.summary: Proposes Affordance Agent Harness, a closed-loop runtime for affordance grounding that orchestrates detection, segmentation, and interaction-imagination skills with verification-gated execution and difficulty-adaptive processing.

entry.title: FedKPer: Tackling Generalization and Personalization in Medical Federated Learning via Knowledge Personalization

author.name: Zoe Fowler and Ghassan AlRegib

entry.summary: Proposes FedKPer for medical federated learning that balances generalization and personalization through selective alignment with the global model and modified aggregation. Addresses the challenge of statistical heterogeneity across healthcare institutions and mitigates forgetting at both global and local levels.

entry.title: Modeling Subjective Urban Perception with Human Gaze

author.name: Lin Che, Xi Wang, Marc Pollefeys, Konrad Schindler, Martin Raubal, Peter Kiefer

entry.summary: Introduces Place Pulse-Gaze, an urban perception dataset augmenting street view images with synchronized eye-tracking recordings and perception labels. Proposes a Gaze-Guided Urban Perception Framework that studies how gaze behavior contributes to modeling subjective urban perception.

entry.title: Directed Social Regard: Surfacing Targeted Advocacy, Opposition, Aid, Harms, and Victimization in Online Media

author.name: Scott Friedman, Ruta Wheelock, Sonja Schmer-Galunder, Drisana Iverson, Jake Vasilakes, Joan Zheng, Jeffrey Rye, Vasanth Sarathy, Christopher Miller

entry.summary: Presents Directed Social Regard (DSR), a multi-dimensional sentiment analysis approach that detects span-level targets of sentiment and scores them across multiple social regard dimensions simultaneously. Addresses the limitation of existing NLP tools that cannot report co-existing positive and negative sentiments toward different targets.

entry.title: What Physics do Data-Driven MoCap-to-Radar Models Learn?

author.name: Kevin Chen, Kenneth W. Parker, and Anish Arora

entry.summary: Introduces a physics-based interpretability framework for evaluating whether data-driven MoCap-to-radar models learn actual physics, using two complementary metrics measuring Doppler frequency alignment and velocity-frequency relationship preservation.

entry.title: Dynamic-TD3: A Novel Algorithm for UAV Path Planning with Dynamic Obstacle Trajectory Prediction

author.name: Wentao Chen, Jingtang Chen, Mingjian Fu, Tiantian Li, Youfeng Su, Wenxi Liu, Yuanlong Yu

entry.summary: Proposes Dynamic-TD3 for UAV path planning with dynamic obstacle avoidance, combining constrained MDP formulation with adaptive trajectory prediction and a physically-aware Kalman filter for robust navigation.

entry.title: AIDA-ReID: Adaptive Intermediate Domain Adaptation for Generalizable and Source-Free Person Re-Identification

author.name: Sundas Iqbal, Qing Tian, Danish Ali, Jianping Gou, Weihua Oue

entry.summary: Proposes AIDA-ReID for source-free person re-identification using adaptive intermediate domain generation with dynamic mixing strategies, extending beyond fixed mixing and joint source-target requirements.

entry.title: Towards Robust and Scalable Density-based Clustering via Graph Propagation

author.name: Yingtao Zheng, Hugo Phibbs, Ninh Pham

entry.summary: Presents CluProp, a density-based clustering framework that reformulates varied-density clustering as label propagation over neighborhood graphs. Claims to process millions of points in minutes while outperforming existing baselines.

entry.title: Soft Graph Diffusion Transformer for MIMO Detection

author.name: Nan Jiang, Jiadong Hong, Lei Liu, Xinyu Bian, Wenjie Wang, Zhaoyang Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes Soft Graph Diffusion Transformer (SGDiT) for MIMO detection, reformulating it as a flow-matching denoising process with adaptive layer normalization and soft graph transformer for stage-aware information integration.

entry.title: Vesselpose: Vessel Graph Reconstruction from Learned Voxel-wise Direction Vectors in 3D Vascular Images

author.name: Rajalakshmi Palaniappan, Christoph Karg, Nemesio Navarro-Arambula, Peter Hirsch, Kristin Kraeker, Lisa Mais and Dagmar Kainmueller

entry.summary: Proposes Vesselpose, an approach for extracting topologically accurate vascular graphs from 3D images by predicting voxel-wise vessel direction vectors and using direction-vector-guided TEASAR algorithm for graph extraction.

entry.title: SC-Taxo: Hierarchical Taxonomy Generation under Semantic Consistency Constraints using Large Language Models

author.name: Shiqiang Cai, Nianhong Niu, Shizhu He, Kang Liu, Jun Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes SC-Taxo for hierarchical taxonomy generation with semantic consistency constraints using LLMs, addressing structural inconsistencies and semantic misalignment in existing taxonomy generation approaches.

entry.title: Paired-CSLiDAR: Height-Stratified Registration for Cross-Source Aerial-Ground LiDAR Pose Refinement

author.name: Montana Hoover, Jing Liang, Tianrui Guan, Dinesh Manocha

entry.summary: Introduces Paired-CSLiDAR benchmark for cross-source aerial-ground LiDAR registration with 12,683 pairs and proposes RGSR, a training-free registration pipeline exploiting height stratification for the shared terrain surface.

entry.title: Class Angular Distortion Index for Dimensionality Reduction

author.name: Kaviru Gunaratne, Stephen Kobourov, Jacob Miller

entry.summary: Introduces CADI, a metric for evaluating dimensionality reduction quality that uses internal angles among point triples to assess faithfulness of cluster organization in projections, addressing limitations of t-SNE/UMAP evaluations.

entry.title: PEACE: Cross-modal Enhanced Pediatric-Adult ECG Alignment for Robust Pediatric Diagnosis

author.name: Xinran Liu, Yuwen Li, Hongxiang Gao, Heyang Xu, Jianqing Li, Zongmin Wang, and Chengyu Liu

entry.summary: Proposes PEACE for automated pediatric ECG diagnosis, using cross-modal alignment from adult to pediatric data with tri-axial clinical semantic decomposition, label-query feature extraction, and curriculum-gated optimization.

entry.title: ASI motives and the ontonormative goods (re IABIED’s core argument)

author.name: Zsolt Tanko

entry.summary: Philosophical argument that ASI would necessarily share certain values with humanity due to 'ontonormative goods'—values that emerge from the structure of intelligence itself. Challenges the premise from IABIED (presumably Bostrom-adjacent work) that ASI motives would be completely alien and inscrutable.

entry.title: Image-Guided Shape-from-Template Using Mesh Inextensibility Constraints

author.name: Thuy Tran, Ruochen Chen, Shaifali Parashar

entry.summary: Proposes an image-guided Shape-from-Template method using mesh inextensibility constraints with differentiable physics and graphics, achieving real-time 3D reconstruction of deforming objects without requiring extensive training data.

entry.title: ViLegalNLI: Natural Language Inference for Vietnamese Legal Texts

author.name: Nhung Thi-Hong Duong, Mai Ngoc Ho, Tin Van Huynh, and Kiet Van Nguyen

entry.summary: Introduces ViLegalNLI, the first large-scale Vietnamese legal NLI dataset with 42,012 pairs, using a semi-automatic generation framework with LLMs and systematic quality validation.

entry.title: DPU or GPU for Accelerating Neural Networks Inference -- Why not both? Split CNN Inference

author.name: Ali Emre Oztas, Mahir Demir, James Garside, and Mikel Luj'an

entry.summary: Proposes splitting CNN inference across DPU (AI engines on Versal VCK190) and GPU (NVIDIA RTX 2080) to reduce latency, with asynchronous pipelining between the two hardware units.

entry.title: Hypergraph and Latent ODE Learning for Multimodal Root Cause Localization in Microservices

author.name: Xin Liu, Yuhang He, Sichen Zhao, Kejian Tong, Xingyu Zhang

entry.summary: Presents HyperODE RCA, a framework combining hypergraph attention learning, latent ODEs, and multimodal cross-attention fusion for root cause localization in microservice systems. Handles complex service dependencies, irregular temporal dynamics, and heterogeneous observability data.

entry.title: Combined Dictionary Unfolding Network with Gradient-Adaptive Fidelity for Transferable Multi-Source Fusion

author.name: Ge Luo, Jun-Jie Huang, Qi Yu, Tianrui Liu, Ke Liang, Yuming Xiang, Wentao Zhao, Xinwang Liu, Meng Wang

entry.summary: Proposes CDNet, a lightweight combined dictionary unfolding network for multi-source image fusion that translates coupled dictionary learning priors into efficient network architecture, avoiding separate modality updates.

entry.title: Multi-frame Restoration for High-rate Lissajous Confocal Laser Endomicroscopy

author.name: Minhee Lee, Sangyoon Lee, Jiwook Lee, Minki Hong, Kyuyoung Kim, Wonhwa Kim, Jaeho Lee

entry.summary: Introduces the first benchmark for high-rate Lissajous confocal laser endomicroscopy restoration and proposes MIRA, a lightweight recurrent framework for restoring structured missing pixel patterns through temporal aggregation.

entry.title: Robust Fusion of Object-Level V2X for Learned 3D Object Detection

author.name: Lukas Ostendorf, Lennart Reiher, Onn Haran, Lutz Eckstein

entry.summary: Studies integrating V2X cooperative awareness messages into learned 3D object detection for automated driving, evaluating robustness to realistic V2X imperfections including latency, positioning errors, and packet loss.

entry.title: Learning Multimodal Energy-Based Model with Multimodal Variational Auto-Encoder via MCMC Revision

author.name: Jiali Cui, Zhiqiang Lao, Heather Yu

entry.summary: Studies learning multimodal EBMs by combining them with multimodal VAEs via MCMC revision, addressing the poor mixing of Langevin dynamics in joint multimodal spaces and the limited expressiveness of Gaussian VAE generators.

entry.title: Foundation AI Models for Aerosol Optical Depth Estimation from PACE Satellite Data

author.name: Zahid Hassan Tushar, Sanjay Purushotham

entry.summary: Presents ViTCG, the first study exploring Foundation AI models (Vision Transformers with Channel-wise Grouping) for Aerosol Optical Depth retrieval from hyperspectral satellite data, reducing retrieval bias and error.

entry.title: Quantum Interval Bound Propagation for Certified Training of Quantum Neural Networks

author.name: Emma Andrews, Nahyeon Kim and Prabhat Mishra

entry.summary: Proposes quantum interval bound propagation (QIBP) for certified training of quantum neural networks, extending the classical IBP method to provide robustness guarantees under adversarial perturbations in the quantum domain.

entry.title: Generating Statistical Charts with Validation-Driven LLM Workflows

author.name: Pavlin G. Poli\v{c}ar and Andra\v{z} Pevcin and Bla\v{z} Zupan

entry.summary: Presents an LLM-based workflow for generating statistical charts from tabular data that decomposes the process into screening, proposal, synthesis, rendering, validation, and QA generation stages. Addresses visualization-specific failure modes through rendered-output validation.

entry.title: OTSS: Output-Targeted Soft Segmentation for Contextual Decision-Weight Learning

author.name: Renjun Hu and Hyun-Soo Ahn

entry.summary: Proposes OTSS for contextual decision-weight learning, using output-targeted soft segmentation to learn personalized weight vectors over interpretable decision factors from logged decisions.

entry.title: TADI: Tool-Augmented Drilling Intelligence via Agentic LLM Orchestration over Heterogeneous Wellsite Data

author.name: Rong Lu

entry.summary: Presents TADI, an agentic AI system for drilling operations that integrates structured databases and semantic search over drilling reports, using 12 domain-specialized tools orchestrated by an LLM for multi-step evidence gathering.

entry.title: Compliance-Aware Agentic Payments on Stablecoin Rails

author.name: Kenneth See, Xue Wen Tan

entry.summary: Proposes a compliance-aware architecture for agentic AI payment systems on stablecoin rails, embedding programmable compliance checks on-chain via policy wrappers rather than separate off-chain workflows.

entry.title: GAFSV-Net: A Vision Framework for Online Signature Verification

author.name: Himanshu Singhal, Suresh Sundaram

entry.summary: Proposes GAFSV-Net for online signature verification, converting temporal signature data into six-channel Gramian Angular Field images to leverage pretrained 2D vision backbones (ConvNeXt-Tiny) with cross-attention.

entry.title: Introducing WARM-VR: Benchmark Dataset for Multimodal Wearable Affect Recognition in Virtual Reality

author.name: Karim Alghoul, Faisal Mohd, Fedwa Laamarti, Hussein Al Osman, Abdulmotaleb El Saddik

entry.summary: Introduces WARM-VR, a publicly available multimodal dataset for affect recognition in VR environments using wearable sensors (BVP, EDA, skin temperature, ECG) from 31 participants experiencing immersive scenarios.

entry.title: Efficient Spatio-Temporal Vegetation Pixel Classification with Vision Transformers

author.name: Alan Gomes, Anderson Gon\c{c}alves, Samuel Felipe dos Santos, Nathan Felipe Alves, Magna Soelma Beserra de Moura, Bruna de Costa Alberton, Leonor Patricia C. Morellato, Ricardo da Silva Torres, Jurandy Almeida

entry.summary: Extensive study on optimizing Vision Transformers for spatio-temporal vegetation pixel classification, conducting comprehensive ablation across seven design dimensions for plant phenology monitoring.

entry.title: Geometric analysis of attractor boundaries and storage capacity limits in kernel Hopfield networks

author.name: Akira Tamamori

entry.summary: Investigates storage capacity and attractor basin geometry in kernel Hopfield networks trained with Kernel Logistic Regression, finding storage capacity up to P/N≈16 for random sequences and P/N≈20 for structured data. Uses morphing analysis and SNR analysis to characterize basin boundaries.

entry.title: Impact of Task Phrasing on Presumptions in Large Language Models

author.name: Kenneth J.K. Ong

entry.summary: Studies how task phrasing affects presumptions in LLMs using the iterated prisoner's dilemma. Finds LLMs are susceptible to presumptions even with reasoning steps, but neutral phrasing enables logical reasoning.

entry.title: Trading off rewards and errors in multi-armed bandits

author.name: Akram Erraqabi, Alessandro Lazaric, Michal Valko, Emma Brunskill, Yun-En Liu

entry.summary: Studies the tradeoff between identifying arm means accurately and accumulating reward in multi-armed bandits, presenting an algorithm with regret guarantees that interpolates between exploration and exploitation objectives. Provides both upper and lower bounds.

entry.title: High-Speed Vision Improves Zero-Shot Semantic Understanding of Human Actions

author.name: Yongpeng Cao and Yuji Yamakawa

entry.summary: Investigates how temporal resolution (high-speed vision) affects zero-shot semantic understanding of rapid human actions using pretrained models. Uses kendo as a case study for rapid fine-grained motions.

entry.title: IdentiFace: Multi-Modal Iterative Diffusion Framework for Identifiable Suspect Face Generation in Crime Investigations

author.name: Weichen Liu, Yixin Yang, Changsheng Chen and Alex Kot

entry.summary: Proposes IdentiFace, a diffusion-based framework for generating identifiable suspect faces in crime investigations using multi-modal inputs and iterative generation with facial identity loss.

entry.title: Linking Behaviour and Perception to Evaluate Meaningful Human Control over Partially Automated Driving

author.name: Ashwin George, Lucas Elbert Suryana, Lorenzo Flipse, Bart van Arem, David A. Abbink, Simeon Craig Calvert, Luciano Cavalcante Siebert and Arkady Zgonnikov

entry.summary: Investigates meaningful human control in partially automated driving through a simulator study comparing haptic shared control and traded control modes, linking behavioral metrics with subjective perception of control.

entry.title: Is Textual Similarity Invariant under Machine Translation? Evidence Based on the Political Manifesto Corpus

author.name: Daria Boratyn, Damian Brzyski, Albert Le\'sniak, Wojciech {\L}ukasik, Maciej Rapacz, Jan Rybicki, Wojciech S{\l}omczy\'nski, Dariusz Stolicki

entry.summary: Investigates whether cosine similarity between paragraph embeddings is invariant under machine translation using 2,800+ political manifestos in 28 languages, developing per-language non-inferiority tests.

entry.title: DMDSC: A Dynamic-Margin Deep Simplex Classifier for Open-Set Recognition on Medical Image Datasets

author.name: Vishal, Arnav Aditya, Nitin Kumar, Saurabh J. Shigwan

entry.summary: Proposes DMDSC, a dynamic-margin deep simplex classifier for open-set recognition on medical image datasets that accounts for varying class densities in imbalanced settings, unlike uniform-margin approaches.

entry.title: Static and Dynamic Graph Alignment Network for Temporal Video Grounding

author.name: Zhanjie Hu, Bolin Zhang, Jianhua Wang, Jianbo Zheng, Chenchen Yan, Takahiro Komamizu, Ichiro Ide, Jiangbo Qian

entry.summary: Proposes a Static and Dynamic Graph Alignment Network for temporal video grounding that addresses limitations of existing GCN-based methods by combining static and dynamic features, query-aware graph construction, and improved cross-modal interaction. The approach targets three specific bottlenecks in current temporal video grounding systems.

entry.title: Temporal Data Requirement for Predicting Unplanned Hospital Readmissions

author.name: Ramin Mohammadi, Vahab vahdat, Sarthak Jain, Amir T. Namin, Ramya Palacholla, Sagar Kamarthi

entry.summary: Investigates the optimal historical data time window for predicting 30-day hospital readmission after hip and knee arthroplasties, using 7,174 patients with both structured EHR data and clinical notes. Compares multiple text encoding methods and finds that combined structured+unstructured data with specific time windows optimizes prediction.

entry.title: LASE: Language-Adversarial Speaker Encoding for Indic Cross-Script Identity Preservation

author.name: Venkata Pushpak Teja Menta

entry.summary: Presents LASE, a language-adversarial speaker encoder that improves cross-script speaker identity preservation for Indic multilingual voice cloning. Addresses the problem that existing speaker encoders lose cosine similarity when the same speaker changes scripts, particularly for non-Indic-accented voices projected into Indic scripts.

entry.title: Machine Learning Toric Duality in Brane Tilings

author.name: Pietro Capuozzo, Tancredi Schettini Gherardini and Benjamin Suzzoni

entry.summary: Applies machine learning to classify Seiberg duality classes in 4d N=1 quantum field theories described by brane tilings, using neural networks and other methods to identify universality classes.

entry.title: CRADIPOR: Crash Dispersion Predictor

author.name: Edgar Chaillou, Sebastian Rodriguez, Yves Tourbier and Francisco Chinesta

entry.summary: Presents CRADIPOR, a tool for predicting numerical dispersion in automotive crash simulations using a Rank Reduction Autoencoder, enabling engineers to assess prediction reliability without repeating costly FE simulations.

entry.title: Efficient Mutation Testing of Quantum Machine Learning Models

author.name: Emma Andrews and Prabhat Mishra

entry.summary: Proposes efficient mutation testing methods for quantum machine learning circuits, defining mutation operations for fault injection and reducing redundant mutants to make testing practical.

entry.title: Unbox Responsible GeoAI: Navigating Climate Extreme and Disaster Mapping

author.name: Hao Li, Steffen Knoblauch

entry.summary: Position paper on responsible GeoAI for climate disaster mapping, proposing four dimensions (Representativeness, Explainability, Sustainability, Ethics) from a critical GIS perspective.

entry.title: Revealing graph bandits for maximizing local influence

author.name: Alexandra Carpentier, Michal Valko

entry.summary: Studies a graph bandit setting for detecting the most influential node without prior knowledge of the graph structure, applicable to viral marketing in social networks. The graph is discovered sequentially and actively.

entry.title: A Comparative Study of QSPR Methods on a Unique Multitask PAMPA dataset

author.name: Andrs Formanek, Anna Vincze, Richrd Bicsak, Yves Moreau, Gyorgy T. Balogh, Adam Arany

entry.summary: Presents a multitask PAMPA dataset of 143 drug molecules evaluated on six model membranes, comparing molecular descriptors and regression models from linear regression to transformers for permeability prediction.

entry.title: Bridging Graph Drawing and Dimensionality Reduction with Stochastic Stress Optimization

author.name: Daniel Hangan, Stephen Kobourov, Jacob Miller

entry.summary: Bridges dimensionality reduction and graph drawing by adapting stochastic gradient descent techniques from graph drawing to vector data embedding, providing a scikit-learn compatible implementation that converges faster than SMACOF.

entry.title: Learning to Act and Cooperate for Distributed Black-Box Consensus Optimization

author.name: Zi-Bo Qin, Feng-Feng Wei, Tai-You Chen and Wei-Neng Chen

entry.summary: Proposes a learning-based approach to distributed black-box consensus optimization in multi-agent systems, replacing handcrafted update rules with adaptive mechanisms that learn cooperation patterns from trajectory data. Introduces a meta-learning framework for discovering effective agent-level dynamics.

entry.title: Unpaired Image Deraining Using Reward-Guided Self-Reinforcement Strategy

author.name: Yinghao Chen, Yeying Jin, Xiang Chen, Yanyan Wei, Ziyang Yan, Yaowen Fu

entry.summary: Introduces RGSUD, an unsupervised image deraining method using reward-guided self-reinforcement. Uses IQA-based dynamic reward recycling to select optimal derained outputs during training and constructs pseudo-pairs for self-reinforcement training.

entry.title: GMGaze: MoE-Based Context-Aware Gaze Estimation with CLIP and Multiscale Transformer

author.name: Xinyuan Zhao, Yihang Wu, Ahmad Chaddad, Sarah A. Alkhodair, Reem Kateb

entry.summary: Proposes GMGaze, a gaze estimation method using Mixture of Experts with CLIP-based semantic prototype conditioning and multiscale transformers. Addresses challenges of late fusion, lack of factor-aware conditioning, and impractical capacity scaling in existing methods.

entry.title: Exploring the Limits of End-to-End Feature-Affinity Propagation for Single-Point Supervised Infrared Small Target Detection

author.name: Qiancheng Zhou, and Wenhua Zhang

entry.summary: Studies a minimalist approach to single-point supervised infrared small target detection using online point-to-mask supervision through feature-affinity propagation, eliminating external label-evolution loops. Identifies optimization bottlenecks in this compact design paradigm.

entry.title: Adaptive Norm-Based Regularization for Neural Networks

author.name: Muhammad Qasim and Farrukh Javed

entry.summary: Proposes two regularization strategies for neural networks: a covariance-aware ridge penalty and a combined L1/covariance-aware L2 penalty. Evaluated through Monte Carlo simulations and real-data applications.

entry.title: A Comparative Analysis of Machine Learning Models for Intrusion Detection in Intelligent Transport Systems

author.name: Zawad Yalmie Sazid, Robert Abbas, Sasa Maric

entry.summary: Comparative analysis of ML models for intrusion detection in intelligent transport systems, focusing on edge computing deployment with AI-powered security for V2X connectivity.

entry.title: What Don't You Understand? Using Large Language Models to Identify and Characterize Student Misconceptions About Challenging Topics

author.name: Michael J. Parker and Maria G. Zavala-Cerna

entry.summary: Uses LLMs to identify and characterize student misconceptions in online biomedical courses by combining quantitative quiz performance analysis with LLM assessment across 3,802 enrollments.

entry.title: Language-free Experience at Expo 2025 Osaka

author.name: Michael Paul, Kenji Imamura, Xiaolin Wang, Shohei Higashiyama, Masao Utiyama

entry.summary: Reports on multilingual simultaneous interpretation technologies deployed at Expo 2025 Osaka, including chunk-based input segmentation, context-aware translation, and multi-engine MT. Real-world deployment collaboration with private companies.

entry.title: MiniVLA-Nav v1: A Multi-Scene Simulation Dataset for Language-Conditioned Robot Navigation

entry.title: A Policy-Driven DRL Framework for System-Level Tradeoff Control in NR-U/Wi-Fi Coexistence

author.name: Po-Heng Chou, Yi-Fang Yu, Shou-Yu Chen, and Chiapin Wang

entry.title: H-RAG at SemEval-2026 Task 8: Hierarchical Parent-Child Retrieval for Multi-Turn RAG Conversations

author.name: Passant Elchafei, Hossam Emam, Mohamed Alansary, Monorama Swain, Markus Schedl

entry.summary: Presents H-RAG for SemEval-2026 Task 8 using hierarchical parent-child RAG pipeline separating fine-grained retrieval from context reconstruction in multi-turn conversations.

entry.title: Learning Coarse-to-Fine Osteoarthritis Representations under Noisy Hierarchical Labels

author.name: Tongxu Zhang

entry.summary: Investigates whether the clinical hierarchy of knee osteoarthritis assessment (coarse binary OA vs. fine-grained KL grading) can serve as a representation-level supervisory prior. Uses a simple dual-head model to probe hierarchical supervision across multiple 3D backbones.

entry.title: Learning the Helmholtz equation operator with DeepONet for non-parametric 2D geometries

author.name: Rodolphe Barlogis, Ferhat Tamssaouet, Quentin Falcoz and St\'ephane Grieu

entry.summary: Applies physics-informed DeepONet to solve the 2D Helmholtz equation on non-parametric domains with arbitrary scatterer geometries. Uses signed distance functions to encode arbitrary geometries as input to the branch network.

entry.title: Smart Ensemble Learning Framework for Predicting Groundwater Heavy Metal Pollution

author.name: T. Ansah-Narh, G. Y. Afrifa, J. B. Tandoh, K. Asare, M. Addi, K. E. Yorke, D. M. A. Akpoley, K. Aidoo, S. K. Fosuhene

entry.summary: Develops an ensemble ML framework for predicting groundwater heavy metal pollution in Ghana's Densu Basin, using response transformations and nested cross-validated ensemble methods. The Gaussian copula transformation with stacked Lasso ensemble achieved the best results.

entry.title: Sure About That Line? Approaching Confidence-Based, Real-Time Line Assignment in Reading Gaze Data

author.name: Franziska Kaltenberger, Wei-Ling Chen, Enkeleda Thaqi, and Enkelejda Kasneci

entry.summary: Proposes CONF-LA, a confidence-based online fixation-to-line assignment approach for eye tracking in multi-line reading, integrating reading behavior knowledge with Gaussian likelihoods and deferring uncertain assignments.

entry.title: Comparative Analysis of Polygon-Based and Global Machine Learning Models for Bus Occupancy Prediction

author.name: Daniel Azenkot, Michael Fire, Eran Ben Elia

entry.summary: Introduces a spatial clustering framework for bus occupancy prediction that divides cities into polygon regions with localized ML models, using multi-dimensional features including spatial, meteorological, and temporal data.

entry.title: Retrieval-Augmented Reasoning for Chartered Accountancy

author.name: Jatin Gupta, Akhil Sharma, Saransh Singhania, Ali Imam Abidi

entry.summary: Presents CA-ThinkFlow, a RAG framework for Indian Chartered Accountancy tasks using a 14B quantized reasoning model with layout-aware document extraction. Addresses domain-specific limitations of LLMs in jurisdiction-specific financial tasks.

entry.title: Elimination Templates in Macaulay2

author.name: Manav Batavia, Cheng Chen, Anna Natalie Chlopecki, Timothy Duff, William Huang, Aolong Li, Wanchun Shen

entry.summary: Introduces an elimination templates package for the Macaulay2 computer algebra system, providing automatic solvers for parameterized zero-dimensional radical ideals with applications in computer vision.

entry.title: Adaptation of AI-accelerated CFD Simulations to the IPU platform

author.name: P. Rosciszewski, A. Krzywaniak, S. Iserte, K. Rojek, and P. Gepner
