entry.summary: Presents an active-inference-inspired framework for UAV swarm trajectory planning that converts the problem from combinatorial optimization into hierarchical probabilistic inference. Uses expert demonstrations from a genetic algorithm planner to learn probabilistic world models at mission, route, and motion levels.

entry.title: SFF's HSEE grant round; human intelligence amplification projects I'd like to see

author.name: TsviBT

entry.summary: Announces the Survival and Flourishing Fund's themed grant round on Human Self-Enhancement and Empowerment, listing research areas including reprogenetics, brain interfaces, gene editing, and intelligence amplification. Calls for researchers and projects seeking funding.

entry.title: Maybe I was too harsh on deep learning theory (three days ago)

author.name: LawrenceC

entry.summary: Author reconsiders previous skepticism about deep learning theory, finding that infinite-width/depth limit work (NTK, neural network Gaussian processes) turned out more interesting than initially assessed. Discusses how theory illuminates deep learning phenomena.

entry.title: RIHA: Report-Image Hierarchical Alignment for Radiology Report Generation

author.name: Yucheng Chen, Yang Yu, Yufei Shi, Conghao Xiong, Xulei Yang, Si Yong Yeo

entry.summary: Proposes RIHA, a framework for radiology report generation that achieves hierarchical alignment between images and the structured sections of reports using a transformer architecture that respects report semantic hierarchies.

entry.title: Design Structure Matrix Modularization with Large Language Models

author.name: Shuo Jiang, Jianxi Luo

entry.summary: Applies LLMs to Design Structure Matrix modularization (system decomposition), finding near-reference quality within 30 iterations but counterintuitively showing that domain knowledge impairs performance on complex DSMs.

entry.title: Stable but Wrong: An Inference Limit in Galactic Archaeology

author.name: Zhipeng Zhang

entry.summary: Demonstrates a fundamental inference limit in galactic archaeology: as observational quality improves, inferred stellar ages converge to a stable but systematically biased result rather than the true value, challenging the assumption that more data yields better science.

entry.title: FiLMMeD: Feature-wise Linear Modulation for Cross-Problem Multi-Depot Vehicle Routing

author.name: Arthur Corr\^ea, Paulo Nascimento, Samuel Moniz

entry.summary: Proposes FiLMMeD, using Feature-wise Linear Modulation to create a unified neural solver for multiple multi-depot vehicle routing problem variants, enabling cross-problem generalization.

entry.title: VTBench: A Multimodal Framework for Time-Series Classification with Chart-Based Representations

author.name: Madhumitha Venkatesan, Xuyang Chen, Dongyu Liu

entry.summary: Introduces VTBench, a framework for evaluating time series classification using chart-based visual representations with multimodal models, systematically comparing chart types and visual encodings.

entry.title: World2Minecraft: Occupancy-Driven Simulated Scenes Construction

author.name: Lechao Zhang, Haoran Xu, Jingyu Gong, Xuhong Wang, Yuan Xie, Xin Tan

entry.summary: World2Minecraft converts real-world scenes into structured Minecraft environments using 3D semantic occupancy prediction, enabling embodied AI tasks like vision-language navigation. Includes a scalable data acquisition pipeline for occupancy prediction.

entry.title: MSR:Hybrid Field Modeling for CT-MRI Rigid-Deformable Registration of the Cervical Spine with an Annotated Dataset

author.name: Bohai Zhang, Wenjie Chen, Mu Li, Kaixing Long, Xing Shen, Xinqiang Yao, Jincheng Yang, Jianting Chen, Wei Yang, Qianjin Feng, Lei Cao

entry.summary: Proposes MSR, a rigid-deformable hybrid registration framework for cervical spine CT-MRI alignment, along with R-D-Reg, a comprehensively annotated CT-MRI dataset for this underexplored but clinically important task.

entry.title: Frequency-Aware Semantic Fusion with Gated Injection for AI-generated Image Detection

author.name: Shuchang Zhou, Shangkun Wu, Jiwei Wei, Ke Liu, Ran Ran, Caiyan Qin, Yang Yang

entry.summary: Proposes a Frequency-aware Gated Injection Network for AI-generated image detection that addresses frequency shortcut bias and cross-domain representation conflict between semantic and frequency features.

entry.title: Are DeepFakes Realistic Enough? Exploring Semantic Mismatch as a Novel Challenge

author.name: Sharayu Nilesh Deshmukh, Kailash A. Hambarde, Joana C. Costa, Hugo Proen\c{c}a, Tiago Roxo

entry.summary: Proposes a new evaluation setup for deepfake detection that models semantic-level inconsistency between authentic modalities, introducing a 'Real Audio-Real Video with Semantic Mismatch' class beyond binary or four-class formulations.

entry.title: Dreaming Across Towns: Semantic Rollout and Town-Adversarial Regularization for Zero-Shot Held-Out-Town Fixed-Route Driving in CARLA

author.name: Feeza Khan Khanzada, Jaerock Kwon

entry.summary: Studies zero-shot transfer of autonomous driving agents across unseen towns in CARLA simulator using a Dreamer-style world model augmented with semantic rollout prediction and town-adversarial regularization. Isolates the structural town shift problem by fixing weather and removing traffic.

entry.title: ZAYAN: Disentangled Contrastive Transformer for Tabular Remote Sensing Data

author.name: Al Zadid Sultan Bin Habib, Tanpia Tasnim, Md. Ekramul Islam, Muntasir Tabasum

entry.summary: Presents ZAYAN, a self-supervised contrastive learning framework for tabular remote sensing data that performs feature-level (not sample-level) contrastive learning without anchor selection or class labels, using dynamic perturbations and masking.

entry.title: FedHarmony: Harmonizing Heterogeneous Label Correlations in Federated Multi-Label Learning

author.name: Zhiqiang Kou, Junxiang Wu, Wenke Huang, Wenwen He, Ming-Kun Xie, Changwei Wang, Yuheng Jia, Di Jiang, Yang Liu, Xin Geng, Qiang Yang

entry.summary: Proposes FedHarmony to address label correlation drift in federated multi-label learning, using consensus correlations as global teachers to correct biased local label dependency models.

entry.title: SCOPE-FE: Structured Control of Operator and Pairwise Exploration for Feature Engineering

author.name: Minhee Park, Seongyeon Son, Yonghyun Lee, Eunchan Kim

entry.summary: Proposes SCOPE-FE, a structured search space control framework that reduces the combinatorial explosion in automatic feature engineering by jointly controlling operator and feature-pair spaces.

entry.title: SECOS: Semantic Capture for Rigorous Classification in Open-World Semi-Supervised Learning

author.name: Hezhao Liu, Jiacheng Yang, Junlong Gao, Mengke Li, Yiqun Zhang, Shreyank N Gowda, Yang Lu

entry.summary: SECOS addresses open-world semi-supervised learning by extracting latent semantic information to enable direct textual label prediction for novel classes. Existing methods fail because novel samples lack explicit supervision and semantic correspondence.

entry.title: SpaAct: Spatially-Activated Transition Learning with Curriculum Adaptation for Vision-Language Navigation

author.name: Pengna Li, Kangyi Wu, Shaoqing Xu, Fang Li, Hanbing Li, Lin Zhao, Kailin Lyu, Long Chen, Zhi-Xin Yang, Nanning Zheng

entry.summary: SpaAct proposes a training framework for vision-language navigation that activates spatial awareness in VLMs through two tasks: Action Retrospection (inferring past actions from visual transitions) and Future Frame Selection (predicting visual outcomes).

entry.title: HiMix: Hierarchical Artifact-aware Mixup for Generalized Synthetic Image Detection

author.name: Shuchang Zhou, Kaiwen Shen, Jiwei Wei, Yuyang Zhou, Peng Wang, Yang Yang

entry.summary: HiMix proposes a framework for generalized synthetic image detection using hierarchical artifact-aware mixup to expand training distribution and promote artifact-aware representations, addressing poor generalization to unseen generators.

entry.title: Mechanized Foundations of Structural Governance: Machine-Checked Proofs for Governed Intelligence

author.name: Alan L. McCann

entry.summary: Presents machine-checked proofs in Coq for structural governance of cognitive workflow systems, establishing coinductive safety predicates and governance invariance theorems for infinite program behaviors.

entry.title: The TEA Nets framework combines AI and cognitive network science to model targets, events and actors in text

author.name: Sebastiano Franchini, Alexis Carrillo, Edoardo Sebastiano De Duro, Riccardo Improta, Ali Aghazadeh Ardebili, Massimo Stella

entry.summary: Introduces TEA Nets (Target-Event-Agent Networks) combining cognitive network science and AI to extract subjects, verbs, and objects from texts for interpretable analysis of conspiracy texts and LLM outputs.

entry.title: Building Persona-Based Agents On Demand: Tailoring Multi-Agent Workflows to User Needs

author.name: Giuseppe Arbore, Andrea Sillano, Luigi De Russis

entry.summary: Argues for on-demand persona-based agent generation that dynamically creates agents matched to user characteristics and task demands at runtime, rather than using fixed agent architectures.

entry.title: Normativity and Productivism: Ableist Intelligence? A Degrowth Analysis of AI Sign Language Translation Tools for Deaf People

author.name: Nina Seron-Abouelfadil, Poppy Fynes

entry.summary: Critically analyzes AI sign language translation tools through a degrowth and disability studies lens, arguing these systems are built from biased data without deaf community input and perpetuate ableist norms.

entry.title: Policy-Governed LLM Routing with Intent Matching for Instrument Laboratories

author.name: Emmanuel A. Olowe, Danial Chitnis

entry.summary: Describes a policy-governed routing system for LLM-based lab assistance that manages multiple LLM backends with configurable budgets, approval workflows, and embedding-based question matching for engineering education labs.

entry.title: A Gated Hybrid Contrastive Collaborative Filtering Recommendation

author.name: Eduardo Ferreira da Silva, Mayki dos Santos Oliveira, Joel Machado Pires, Denis Dantas Boaventura, Maycon Maciel Peixoto, Cassio Serafim Prazeres, Gustavo Bittencourt Figueiredo, Miriam Capretz, Frederico Araujo Dur\~ao

entry.summary: Proposes a gated hybrid collaborative filtering framework that integrates review-derived representations through adaptive gating and contrastive learning for top-N recommendation.

entry.title: Learning to Spend: Model Predictive Control for Budgeting under Non-Stationary Returns

author.name: Nilavra Pathak, Smriti Shyamal, Prasant Mhasker, Christopher Swartz

entry.summary: Studies Model Predictive Control for budget allocation, finding MPC only outperforms reactive baselines when return dynamics follow predictable deterministic trends rather than stochastic drift.

entry.title: Upskilling with Generative AI: Practices and Challenges for Freelance Knowledge Workers

author.name: Kashif Imteyaz, Isabel Lopez, Nakul Rajpal, Hunjun Shin, Saiph Savage

entry.summary: Mixed-methods study of how freelance knowledge workers use generative AI for upskilling, examining practices, challenges, and how AI-powered learning intersects with platform work precarity.

entry.title: Toward Autonomous SOC Operations: End-to-End LLM Framework for Threat Detection, Query Generation, and Resolution in Security Operations

author.name: Md Hasan Saju, Akramul Azim

entry.summary: Presents an end-to-end framework for Security Operations Centers that combines ensemble LLM-based threat detection (82.8% accuracy), syntax-constrained query generation for SIEM platforms, and retrieval-augmented resolution support. Addresses practical challenges of automated security workflows.

entry.title: AdaBFL: Multi-Layer Defensive Adaptive Aggregation for Bzantine-Robust Federated Learning

author.name: Zehui Tang, Yuchen Liu, Feihu Huang

entry.summary: Proposes AdaBFL, a multi-layer adaptive aggregation method for Byzantine-robust federated learning that provides balanced defense against multiple attack types without requiring server-side data.

entry.title: Position-Aware Drafting for Inference Acceleration in LLM-Based Generative List-Wise Recommendation

author.name: Jiaju Chen, Chongming Gao, Chenxiao Fan, Haoyan Liu, Qingpeng Cai, Peng Jiang, Xiangnan He

entry.summary: Proposes position-aware speculative decoding for LLM-based generative list-wise recommendation, where draft tokens are modeled differently based on their within-item slot position to improve inference speed.

entry.title: TransVLM: A Vision-Language Framework and Benchmark for Detecting Any Shot Transitions

author.name: Ce Chen, Yi Ren, Yuanming Li, Viktor Goriachko, Zhenhui Ye, Zujin Guo, Zhibin Hong, Mingming Gong

entry.summary: Formalizes Shot Transition Detection (beyond just boundary detection) and proposes TransVLM, a vision-language model that injects optical flow as motion prior for detecting continuous temporal segments of video transitions.

entry.title: Towards Neuro-symbolic Causal Rule Synthesis, Verification, and Evaluation Grounded in Legal and Safety Principles

author.name: Zainab Rehan, Christian Medeiros Adriano, Sona Ghahremani, Holger Giese

entry.summary: Extends a neuro-symbolic causal framework with a meta-level layer for goal/rule synthesis and verification to mitigate goal misspecification in safety-critical rule-based systems, grounded in legal and safety principles.

entry.title: Cross-Subject Generalization for EEG Decoding: A Survey of Deep Learning Methods

author.name: Taida Li, Yujun Yan, Fei Dou, Wenzhan Song, Xiang Zhang

entry.summary: Comprehensive survey of deep learning methods for cross-subject EEG decoding, formalizing the problem as multi-source domain adaptation and taxonomizing approaches including feature alignment, adversarial learning, and contrastive learning.

entry.title: AG-TAL: Anatomically-Guided Topology-Aware Loss for Multiclass Segmentation of the Circle of Willis Using Large-Scale Multi-Center Datasets

author.name: Jialu Liu, Yue Cui, Shan Yu

entry.summary: Introduces AG-TAL, an anatomically-guided topology-aware loss function for multiclass segmentation of the Circle of Willis vasculature, addressing vascular discontinuities and class imbalance in 3D medical imaging.

entry.title: ChipLingo: A Systematic Training Framework for Large Language Models in EDA

author.name: Lei Li, Xingwen Yu, Jianguo Ni, Junxuan Zhu, Jieqiong Zhang, Jian Zhao, Zhi Liu

entry.summary: Presents ChipLingo, a systematic training pipeline for adapting LLMs to Electronic Design Automation, with domain corpus construction, adaptive pretraining, and RAG-compatible fine-tuning stages.

entry.title: Privacy-Preserving Federated Learning via Differential Privacy and Homomorphic Encryption for Cardiovascular Disease Risk Modeling

author.name: Gaurang Sharma, Juha Pajula, Aada Illikainen, Markus Rautell, Noora Lipsonen, Petri Alhainen, Mika Hilvo

entry.summary: Combines differential privacy, homomorphic encryption, and federated learning for cardiovascular disease risk modeling, demonstrating privacy-preserving collaborative analysis across institutions.

entry.title: Beyond the Baseband: Adaptive Multi-Band Encoding for Full-Spectrum Bioacoustics Classification

author.name: Eklavya Sarkar, Marius Miron, David Robinson, Gagan Narula, Milad Alizadeh, Ellen Gilsenan-McMahon, Emmanuel Chemla, Olivier Pietquin, Matthieu Geist

entry.summary: Investigates multi-band encoding to extend bioacoustics classification beyond the standard 0-8 kHz baseband, decomposing full-spectrum animal calls into band features and fusing them for improved classification.

entry.title: A High-Throughput Compute-Efficient POMDP Hide-And-Seek-Engine (HASE) for Multi-Agent Operations

author.name: Timothy Flavin, Sandip Sen

entry.summary: Introduces HASE, a compute-efficient Dec-POMDP engine for multi-agent hide-and-seek scenarios, using cache-aligned data-oriented design and zero-copy PyTorch interfaces for high-throughput RL training.

entry.title: Predicting Upcoming Stuttering Events from Three-Second Audio: Stratified Evaluation Reveals Severity-Selective Precursors, and the Model Deploys Fully On-Device

author.name: Nazar Kozak

entry.summary: Trains a tiny 616K-parameter CNN to predict upcoming stuttering events from 3-second audio clips, finding that prediction signal concentrates on clinically severe events (blocks, sound repetitions) while lighter disfluencies are unpredictable.

entry.title: Sampling two-dimensional spin systems with transformers

author.name: Piotr Bia{\l}as, Piotr Korcyl, Tomasz Stebel, Adam Stefa\'nski, Dawid Zapolski

entry.summary: Proposes a novel transformer-based neural sampler for classical spin systems that generates groups of spins per step rather than individual spins, enabling sampling of systems up to 180×180 spins for the Ising model while achieving effective sample sizes comparable to state-of-the-art methods.

entry.title: Sequential Inference for Gaussian Processes: A Signal Processing Perspective

author.name: Daniel Waxman, Fernando Llorente, Petar M. Djuri\'c

entry.summary: Provides a self-contained tutorial on sequential inference for Gaussian processes from a signal processing perspective, covering the intersection of ML and SP methodologies for non-stationary, streaming data.

entry.title: Exploring the Limits of Pruning: Task-Specific Neurons, Model Collapse, and Recovery in Task-Specific Large Language Models

author.name: M. K. Khalidi Siam, Md. Tausif-Ul-Islam, Md. Reshad Romim Khan, Mohammed Ali Hossain, Mushfiqul Amin, Labib Hasan Khan, Niloy Farhan, Farig Sadeque

entry.summary: Studies neuron pruning in task-specific LLMs (math reasoning and code generation), introducing activation-based selectivity metrics to identify low-contribution neurons and showing selective pruning outperforms random pruning.

entry.title: Emotion-Aware Clickbait Attack in Social Media

author.name: Syed Mhamudul Hasan, Mohd. Farhan Israk Soumik, Abdur R. Shahid

entry.summary: Proposes an emotion-aware clickbait generation framework using Valence-Arousal-Dominance space to model emotional dynamics, simulating adversarial attacks that exploit emotional manipulation for user engagement.

entry.title: Reasoning over Object Descriptions Improves Coreference Resolution in Task-Based Dialogue Systems

author.name: Oier Ijurco, Oier Lopez de Lacalle

entry.summary: Proposes a unimodal test-time reasoning approach enabling LLMs to reason over detailed object descriptions for coreference resolution in task-based dialogue systems, improving generalization across domains.

entry.title: VeraRetouch: A Lightweight Fully Differentiable Framework for Multi-Task Reasoning Photo Retouching

author.name: Yihong Guo, Youwei Lyu, Jiajun Tang, Yizhuo Zhou, Hongliang Wang, Jinwei Chen, Changqing Zou, Qingnan Fan

entry.summary: Presents VeraRetouch, a lightweight fully differentiable framework for multi-task photo retouching using a 0.5B VLM as the central intelligence. Replaces non-differentiable external software tools with a differentiable Retouch Renderer for end-to-end optimization.

entry.title: REVIVE 3D: Refinement via Encoded Voluminous Inflated prior for Volume Enhancement

author.name: Hankyeol Lee, Wooyeol Baek, Seongdo Kim, Jongyoo Kim

entry.summary: REVIVE 3D is a two-stage plug-and-play pipeline for generating voluminous 3D assets from flat images. Constructs an inflated prior by recovering global volume and superimposing part-aware details, then refines in latent space.

entry.title: Parameter-Efficient Architectural Modifications for Translation-Invariant CNNs

author.name: Nuria Alabau-Bosque, Jorge Vila-Tomas, Paula Dauden-Oliver, Valero Laparra, Jesus Malo

entry.summary: Demonstrates that inserting Global Average Pooling layers at various depths in CNNs like VGG-16 achieves 98% parameter reduction and true translation invariance, resolving the fragility of standard CNNs to single-pixel shifts.

entry.title: UHR-Net: An Uncertainty-Aware Hypergraph Refinement Network for Medical Image Segmentation

author.name: Shuokun Cheng, Jinghao Shi, Kun Sun

entry.summary: UHR-Net proposes an uncertainty-aware hypergraph refinement network for medical image segmentation, combining uncertainty-oriented contrastive pretraining with hypergraph-based boundary refinement for small and ambiguous lesions.

entry.title: Real-Time GPU-Accelerated Monte Carlo Evaluation of Safety-Critical AEB Systems Under Uncertainty

author.name: Akshay Karjol, Shadi Alawneh

entry.summary: Presents a GPU-accelerated Monte Carlo framework for stochastic evaluation of AEB systems incorporating uncertainty in sensing, road conditions, and vehicle dynamics, with high-fidelity longitudinal vehicle modeling.

entry.title: An Experimental Modular Instrument With a Haptic Feedback Framework for Robotic Surgery Training

author.name: Walid Shaker, Mustafa Suphi Erden

entry.summary: Presents a modular, low-cost robotic laparoscopic instrument with real-time haptic feedback for surgical training. Uses a wrist-mounted force/torque sensor to estimate tool-tissue interaction forces, avoiding the durability challenges of tip-mounted sensors.

entry.title: AI risk was not invented by AI CEOs to hype their companies

author.name: KatjaGrace

entry.summary: Argues that the idea of AI existential risk was not invented by AI CEOs to hype their products, providing a personal timeline of the AI safety community dating back to 2008-2009, well before current major AI companies existed. Documents key events in the AI safety movement's history.

entry.title: Upcoming Workshop on Post-AGI Civilizational Equilibria

author.name: David Duvenaud

entry.summary: Announces the 3rd Workshop on Post-AGI Civilizational Equilibria (May 23-24, 2026) with speakers including Paul Christiano, Samuel Hammond, Andrew Critch, David Dalrymple, and others. Focuses on political economy, governance, and societal adaptation post-AGI.

entry.title: A Novel Computational Framework for Causal Inference: Tree-Based Discretization with ILP-Based Matching

author.name: Tianyu Yang, Md. Noor-E-Alam

entry.summary: Proposes a causal inference framework combining tree-based discretization with integer linear programming-based matching, ensuring interpretability and computational efficiency for observational data.

entry.title: Revealing the Impact of Visual Text Style on Attribute-based Descriptions Produced by Large Visual Language Models

author.name: Xiaomeng Wang, Martha Larson, Zhengyu Zhao

entry.summary: Investigates whether the visual style of rendered text (font, color, size) affects the attribute descriptions that large visual language models produce for the concepts those words refer to. Compares functional vs decorative text styles.

entry.title: NeuroRing: Scaling Spiking Neural Networks via Multi-FPGA Bidirectional Ring Topologies and Stream-Dataflow Architectures

author.name: Muhammad Ihsan Al Hafiz, Artur Podobas

entry.summary: NeuroRing presents a modular SNN accelerator using stream-dataflow architecture and bidirectional ring topology on multi-FPGA systems, integrated with the NEST simulator for large-scale spiking neural network execution.

entry.title: RuC: HDL-Agnostic Rule Completion Benchmark Generation

author.name: Arnau Ayguad\'e Domingo, Miquel Alberti-Binimelis, Cristian Gutierrez-Gomez, Emanuele Parisi, Razine Moundir Ghorab, Miquel Moreto, Gokcen Kestor, Dario Garcia-Gasulla

entry.summary: Presents RuC, a grammar-driven framework for generating language-agnostic HDL code completion benchmarks with controllable granularity and syntactic range for evaluating LLMs on RTL development.

entry.title: Toward Scalable SDN for LEO Mega-Constellations: A Graph Learning Approach

author.name: Sivaram Krishnan, Bassel Al Homssi, Zhouyou Gu, Jihong Park, Sung-Min Oh, Jinho Choi

entry.summary: Proposes a scalable hierarchical SDN framework for LEO satellite mega-constellations using Graph Neural Networks and Koopman theory to forecast network dynamics and enable efficient management.

entry.title: A Unified Framework of Hyperbolic Graph Representation Learning Methods

author.name: Sof\'ia P\'erez Casulo, Marcelo Fiori, Bernardo Marenco, Federico Larroca

entry.summary: Introduces a unified open-source framework for hyperbolic graph representation learning that integrates multiple embedding methods under a common interface for reproducible evaluation.

entry.title: An adaptive wavelet-based PINN for problems with localized high-magnitude source

author.name: Himanshu Pandey, Ratikanta Behera

entry.summary: Proposes an adaptive wavelet-based PINN that dynamically adjusts basis functions to handle extreme loss imbalance from localized high-magnitude source terms in differential equations.

entry.title: Qualitative Evaluation of Language Model Rescoring in Automatic Speech Recognition

author.name: Thibault Ba\~neras-Roux, Micka\"el Rouvier, Jane Wottawa, Richard Dufour

entry.summary: Proposes POSER (Part-of-speech Error Rate) and EmbER (Embedding Error Rate) metrics for qualitative evaluation of language model rescoring in ASR systems, going beyond WER.

entry.title: HATS: An Open data set Integrating Human Perception Applied to the Evaluation of Automatic Speech Recognition Metrics

author.name: Thibault Ba\~neras Roux, Jane Wottawa, Mickael Rouvier, Teva Merlin, Richard Dufour

entry.summary: Presents HATS (Human Assessed Transcription Side-by-side), a French manually annotated dataset capturing human perception of ASR transcription errors, and validates it against existing metrics.

entry.title: Self-Supervised Learning of Plant Image Representations

author.name: Ilyass Moummad, Kawtar Zaher, Herv\'e Go\"eau, Jean-Christophe Lombardo, Pierre Bonnet, Alexis Joly

entry.summary: Investigates self-supervised learning for plant image recognition, finding that standard SSL augmentations (Gaussian blur, grayscale, solarization) are detrimental for plant images as they remove subtle discriminative cues essential for fine-grained species recognition.

entry.title: FUN: A Focal U-Net Combining Reconstruction and Object Detection for Snapshot Spectral Imaging

author.name: Dahua Gao, Yubo Dong, Anqi Li, Zhenyuan Lin, Ang Gao, Danhua Liu, Guangming Shi

entry.summary: FUN is an end-to-end framework that jointly performs hyperspectral image reconstruction and object detection via multi-task learning, addressing the bottleneck of time-consuming post-capture reconstruction in snapshot spectral imaging.

entry.title: A generalised pre-training strategy for deep learning networks in semantic segmentation of remotely sensed images

author.name: Yuan Fang, Yuanzhi Cai, Jagannath Aryal, Qinfeng Zhu, Hong Huang, Cheng Zhang, Lei Fan

entry.summary: Proposes a generalized pre-training strategy for remote sensing image segmentation that bridges the domain gap between ImageNet and remotely sensed images without requiring large-scale domain-specific datasets.

entry.title: TAFA-GSGC: Group-wise Scalable Point Cloud Geometry Compression with Progressive Residual Refinement

author.name: Xiumei Li, Alexander Kopte, Andr\'e Kaup

entry.summary: TAFA-GSGC is a scalable learned point cloud geometry codec that enables multi-quality decoding from a single bitstream and model, supporting up to 9 quality levels with monotonic quality improvement.

entry.title: Connected Dependability Cage: Run-Time Function and Anomaly Monitoring for the Development and Operation of Safe Automated Vehicles

author.name: Iqra Aslam, Nour Habib, Abhishek Buragohain, Meng Zhang, Andreas Rausch, Vaibhav Tiwari, Mohamed Benchat

entry.summary: Proposes the Connected Dependability Cage architecture for run-time monitoring of automated vehicle safety, addressing compliance with ISO 26262 and SOTIF standards. Enables fail-operational capabilities for handling system failures and degraded conditions.

entry.title: Leading Across the Spectrum of Human-AI Relationships: A Conceptual Framework for Increasingly Heterogeneous Teams

author.name: Alejandro R. Jadad

entry.summary: Proposes a conceptual spectrum of human-AI leadership relationships (Pure Human → Centaur → Co-equal → Minotaur → Pure AI) to help leaders recognize and manage different configurations of shared authority in organizations.

entry.title: Autonomous Traffic Signal Optimization Using Digital Twin and Agentic AI for Real-Time Decision-Making

author.name: Salman Jan, Toqeer Ali Syed, Shahid Kamal, Qamar Wali, Ali Akarma

entry.summary: Proposes a framework for autonomous traffic signal optimization using digital twins and agentic AI with LangChain, implementing a three-layer system (perception, conceptualization, action) for real-time traffic management.

entry.title: From LLM-Driven Trading Card Generation to Procedural Relatedness: A Pok\'emon Case Study

author.name: Johannes Pfau, Panagiotis Vrettis

entry.summary: Investigates using LLMs and image diffusion models for procedural content generation of trading card game cards, introducing the concept of 'procedural relatedness' for maintaining thematic coherence across generated content.

entry.title: Fitting Horn DL Ontologies to ABox and Query Examples: A Tale of Simulation Quantifiers and Finite Models

author.name: Marvin Grosser, Carsten Lutz

entry.summary: Studies fitting Horn DL ontologies to ABox and query examples, providing complexity characterizations for EL and ELI description logics with various query languages, establishing PTime for atomic queries and Sigma_P^2-completeness for conjunctive queries.

entry.title: Evaluating Epistemic Guardrails in AI Reading Assistants: A Behavioral Audit of a Minimal Prototype

author.name: Matthew Christian Agustin

entry.summary: Examines epistemic guardrails in AI reading assistants through a prototype (TextWalk) designed as a co-reader, evaluating how well systems resist interpretive displacement using a fixed prompt protocol across analytical texts.

entry.title: ClipTBP: Clip-Pair based Temporal Boundary Prediction with Boundary-Aware Learning for Moment Retrieval

author.name: Ji-Hyeon Kim, Ho-Joong Kim, Seong-Whan Lee

entry.summary: Proposes ClipTBP for video moment retrieval that considers relationships between multiple answer segments matching a query using clip-pair based temporal boundary prediction with boundary-aware learning.

entry.title: FlexiTac: A Low-Cost, Open-Source, Scalable Tactile Sensing Solution for Robotic Systems

author.name: Binghao Huang, Yunzhu Li

entry.summary: Presents FlexiTac, a low-cost open-source piezoresistive tactile sensing solution for robotic grippers with thin flexible sensor pads and compact readout electronics, designed for scalable deployment and data collection.

entry.title: A Short Note on Batch-efficient Divide-and-Conquer Algorithm for EigenDecomposition

author.name: Yue Song

entry.summary: Proposes a batch-efficient divide-and-conquer eigendecomposition algorithm for matrices in deep learning, showing significant speedups over PyTorch's SVD for batched matrices smaller than 64×64.

entry.title: Dynamic Scaled Gradient Descent for Stable Fine-Tuning for Classifications

author.name: Vanessa B. Sibug, Emerson Q. Fernando, Almer B. Gamboa, Roque Francis B. Dianelo, Agnes R. Regala, Joseph Alexander Bansil, Jan Henry B. Sunga, Vernon Grace M. Maniago, John Paul P. Miranda

entry.summary: Examines factors influencing pre-service teachers' intention to use AI educational tools in the Philippines using UTAUT2 framework and PLS-SEM analysis on 563 respondents. Finds performance expectancy, habit, and computer self-efficacy are significant predictors.

entry.title: Linear Models, Variable Selection, Artificial Intelligence

author.name: By Riyadh Alrawkan, Edward Boone, Ryad Ghanam, Anton Westveld

entry.summary: Proposes using an ANN trained on OLS estimates to determine variable significance in linear regression, comparing against traditional selection methods.

entry.title: GourNet: A CNN-Based Model for Mango Leaf Disease Detection

author.name: Ekram Alam, Jaydip Sanyal, Akhil Kumar Das, Arijit Bhattacharya, Farhana Sultana

entry.summary: Introduces GourNet, a CNN-based model for mango leaf disease detection using the MangoLeafBD dataset with eight classes. Applies standard data augmentation and CNN training techniques.

entry.title: San Francisco: self driving

author.name: KatjaGrace

entry.summary: A personal reflection on the gradual, underwhelming arrival of self-driving cars (Waymo) in San Francisco, contrasting expectations of a dramatic arrival with the reality of incremental expansion.

entry.title: Cambridge: the kettle

author.name: KatjaGrace

entry.summary: A personal narrative about arriving in Cambridge and encountering an overly complex smart kettle. A humorous essay about technology design and user experience.

entry.title: Copycat Inkhaven 2 retrospective

author.name: Dentosal

entry.summary: Personal retrospective on a writing challenge (Copycat Inkhaven 2), reflecting on the difficulty of maintaining daily writing output alongside work and social life.

entry.title: Red vs blue: The parable of the feud within a feud

author.name: Joe Rogero

entry.summary: A parable/allegory about feuding groups (red vs blue), with no visible content beyond the title.

entry.title: Research Summary: April 30, 2026

author.name: AATF AI News Aggregator

entry.summary:
Today's research clusters around AI safety vulnerabilities and scalable training/inference infrastructure, with notable cross-domain applications of foundation model paradigms.

  • Probe-Based Data Attribution provides actionable diagnostics for harmful behaviors emerging during DPO post-training, enabling targeted data curation
  • GLM-5V-Turbo natively integrates visual perception into agent reasoning and planning, advancing multimodal agent architectures
  • DORA solves the long-tail rollout bottleneck in asynchronous RL for LLM training while preserving algorithmic correctness
  • QERNEL applies foundation model concepts (FiLM conditioning, MoE) to variational quantum chemistry at 150-electron scale

Safety research reveals multiple attack surfaces: Incremental Completion Decomposition breaks safety via single-word elicitation, constitutional classifier poisoning introduces backdoors into Anthropic-style safety layers, and Tatemae formalizes alignment faking detection through observable tool selection. Quantamination exposes a cross-batch data leakage vulnerability in dynamic quantization used in production ML serving.

  • CheXthought contributes 103K chain-of-thought reasoning traces from 501 radiologists across 71 countries for medical AI
  • A unified Information Bottleneck objective provides principled closed-form solutions for KV cache eviction

entry.title: QERNEL: a Scalable Large Electron Model

author.name: Khachatur Nazaryan, Liang Fu

entry.summary: Introduces QERNEL, a foundational neural wavefunction using FiLM conditioning and mixture-of-experts to solve families of many-electron Hamiltonians. Applied to up to 150 electrons in semiconductor moiré heterobilayers, discovering phase transitions.

entry.title: CheXthought: A global multimodal dataset of clinical chain-of-thought reasoning and visual attention for chest X-ray interpretation

author.name: Sonali Sharma, Jin Long, George Shih, Sarah Eid, Christian Bluethgen, Francine L. Jacobson, Emily B. Tsai, Global Radiology Consortium, Ahmed M. Alaa, Curtis P. Langlotz

entry.summary: Presents CheXthought, a global multimodal dataset with 103,592 chain-of-thought reasoning traces and 6.6M visual attention annotations across 50,312 chest X-rays from 501 radiologists in 71 countries, revealing clinical reasoning patterns.

entry.title: GLM-5V-Turbo: Toward a Native Foundation Model for Multimodal Agents

author.name: V Team, Wenyi Hong, Xiaotao Gu, Ziyang Pan, Zhen Yang, Yuting Wang, Yue Wang, Yuanchang Yue, Yu Wang, Yanling Wang, Yan Wang, Xijun Liu, Wenmeng Yu, Weihan Wang, Wei Li, Shuaiqi Duan, Sheng Yang, Ruiliang Lv, Mingdao Liu, Lihang Pan, Ke Ning, Junhui Ji, Jinjiang Wang, Jing Chen, Jiazheng Xu, Jiale Zhu, Jiale Cheng, Ji Qi, Guobing Gan, Guo Wang, Cong Yao, Zijun Dou, Zihao Zhou, Zihan Wang, Zhiqi Ge, Zhijie Li, Zhenyu Hou, Zhao Xue, Zehui Wang, Zehai He, Yusen Liu, Yukuo Cen, Yuchen Li, Yuan Wang, Yijian Lu, Yanzi Wang, Yadong Xue, Xinyu Zhang, Xinyu Liu, Wenkai Li, Tianyu Tong, Tianshu Zhang, Shengdong Yan, Qinkai Zheng, Mingde Xu, Licheng Bao, Jiaxing Xu, Jiaxin Fan, Jiawen Qian, Jiali Chen, Jiahui Lin, Haozhi Zheng, Haoran Wang, Haochen Li, Fan Yang, Dan Zhang, Chuangxin Zhao, Chengcheng Wu, Boyan Shi, Bowei Jia, Baoxu Wang, Peng Zhang, Debing Liu, Bin Xu, Juanzi Li, Minlie Huang, Yuxiao Dong, Jie Tang

entry.summary: Presents GLM-5V-Turbo, a native foundation model for multimodal agents integrating visual perception as a core component of reasoning, planning, and tool use. Built with improvements across model design, multimodal training, RL, and agent frameworks.

entry.title: Probe-Based Data Attribution: Surfacing and Mitigating Undesirable Behaviors in LLM Post-Training

author.name: Santiago Aranguri

entry.summary: Introduces a probe-based data attribution method that identifies training datapoints responsible for harmful behaviors emerging during DPO post-training. Filtering flagged data reduces harmful compliance by 63% without hurting general performance, outperforming gradient-based methods at 10x lower cost.

entry.title: Rethinking KV Cache Eviction via a Unified Information-Theoretic Objective

author.name: Jiaming Yang, Chenwei Tang, Liangli Zhen, Jiancheng Lv

entry.summary: Rethinks KV cache eviction through the Information Bottleneck principle, deriving a closed-form mutual information objective under a linear-Gaussian attention surrogate. Shows existing eviction strategies are different approximations of the same capacity-maximization principle.

entry.title: DORA: A Scalable Asynchronous Reinforcement Learning System for Language Model Training

author.name: Tianhao Hu, Xiangcheng Liu, Youshao Xiao, Yang Zheng, Xuan Huang, Jinrui Ding, Yufei Zhang, Tao Liang, Hongyu Zang, Quan Chen, Yueqing Sun, Wenjie Shi, Chao Zhang, Wei Wang, Qi Gu, Yerui Sun, Yucheng Xie, Xunliang Cai

entry.summary: Presents DORA, a scalable asynchronous RL system for LLM training that addresses the long-tail rollout bottleneck while maintaining algorithmic correctness through intra-trajectory policy consistency, data integrity, and bounded staleness constraints.

entry.title: DreamProver: Evolving Transferable Lemma Libraries via a Wake-Sleep Theorem-Proving Agent

author.name: Youyuan Zhang, Jialiang Sun, Hangrui Bi, Chuqin Geng, Wenjie Ma, Zhaoyu Li, Xujie Si

entry.summary: Introduces DreamProver, a wake-sleep framework for formal theorem proving that iteratively discovers reusable lemmas. In the wake stage it proves theorems while proposing candidate lemmas; in the sleep stage it abstracts and consolidates them into a transferable library.

entry.title: Tatemae: Detecting Alignment Faking via Tool Selection in LLMs

author.name: Matteo Leonesi, Francesco Belardinelli, Flavio Corradini, Marco Piangerelli

entry.summary: Formalizes alignment faking detection in LLMs through observable tool selection behavior, where models choose safe tools when unmonitored but switch to unsafe tools under monitoring that rewards helpfulness. Named 'Tatemae' after the Japanese concept of public façade.

entry.title: One Word at a Time: Incremental Completion Decomposition Breaks LLM Safety

author.name: Samee Arif, Naihao Deng, Zhijing Jin, Rada Mihalcea

entry.summary: Introduces Incremental Completion Decomposition (ICD), a jailbreak strategy that elicits single-word continuations before requesting full harmful responses, achieving high attack success rates across multiple model families.

entry.title: Poisoning Fine-tuning Datasets of Constitutional Classifiers

author.name: Chase Bowers

entry.summary: Demonstrates that fine-tuning datasets for constitutional classifiers (as described by Anthropic) can be poisoned to create backdoors that allow harmful prompts through. The attack exploits the synthetic data generation pipeline used to train these safety classifiers.

entry.title: Risk Reporting for Developers' Internal AI Model Use

author.name: Oscar Delaney, Sambhav Maheshwari, Joe O'Brien, Theo Bearman, Oliver Guest

entry.summary: Proposes risk reporting requirements for AI developers' internal model use, noting that frontier companies deploy advanced models internally for weeks before public release (citing Anthropic's Mythos Preview). Analyzes gaps in existing legal frameworks like California's SB 53 and EU's GPAI Code.

entry.title: AMMA: A Multi-Chiplet Memory-Centric Architecture for Low-Latency 1M Context Attention Serving

author.name: Zhongkai Yu, Haotian Ye, Chenyang Zhou, Ohm Rishabh Venkatachalam, Zaifeng Pan, Zhengding Hu, Junsung Kim, Won Woo Ro, Po-An Tsai, Shuyi Pei, Yangwook Kang, Yufei Ding

entry.summary: Presents AMMA, a multi-chiplet memory-centric architecture for low-latency attention serving at 1M context length, arguing that GPU-centric designs are mismatched with memory-bound decode-phase attention workloads.

entry.title: Quantamination: Dynamic Quantization Leaks Your Data Across the Batch

author.name: Hanna Foerster, Ilia Shumailov, Cheng Zhang, Yiren Zhao, Jamie Hayes, Robert Mullins

entry.summary: Reveals that dynamic quantization in ML inference creates a cross-batch data leakage vulnerability, where one user's input can influence the quantization parameters and thus the outputs for other users in the same batch.

entry.title: Are LLMs not getting better?

author.name: kqr

entry.summary: Reanalyzes METR's data on LLM code quality, arguing that merge rates (vs. just passing tests) show no improvement since early 2025, with a piecewise constant model fitting better than METR's upward-sloping trend line. Suggests LLM coding capability may have plateaued for real-world quality.

entry.title: reward-lens: A Mechanistic Interpretability Library for Reward Models

author.name: Mohammed Suhail B Nadaf

entry.summary: Introduces reward-lens, an open-source library that ports mechanistic interpretability tools (logit lens, activation patching, SAEs) to reward models used in RLHF, using the reward head's weight vector as the interpretability axis.

entry.title: Open Problems in Frontier AI Risk Management

author.name: Marta Ziosi, Miro Plueckebaum, Stephen Casper, Henry Papadatos, Ze Shen Chin, Peter Slattery, James Gealy, Tim G. J. Rudner, Brian Tse, Ariel Gil, Patricia Paskov, Maximilian Negele, Rokas Gipi\v{s}kis, Nada Madkour, Vera Lummis, Rupal Jain, Luise Eder, Kristina Fort, Malou C. van Draanen Glismann, In\`es Belhadj, Amin Oueslati, Anna K. Wisakanto, Richard Mallah, Koen Holtman, Ranj Zuhdi, Daniel S. Schiff, Jessica Newman, Malcolm Murray, Robert Trager

entry.summary: Systematically identifies open problems in frontier AI risk management across all stages of the risk process (planning, identification, analysis, evaluation, mitigation). Examines misalignment between emerging AI safety practices and established risk management frameworks.

entry.title: Operating-Layer Controls for Onchain Language-Model Agents Under Real Capital

author.name: T. J. Barton, Chris Constantakis, Patti Hauseman, Annie Mous, Alaska Hoffman, Brian Bergeron, Hunter Goodreau

entry.summary: Studies reliability of autonomous LLM agents managing real cryptocurrency capital in a 21-day deployment with 3,505 user-funded agents. The system produced 7.5M agent invocations, ~$20M in volume, and achieved 99.9% settlement success rate for policy-valid transactions. This is notable as one of the first large-scale empirical studies of LLM agents operating with real financial capital.

entry.title: When to Vote, When to Rewrite: Disagreement-Guided Strategy Routing for Test-Time Scaling

author.name: Zhimin Lin, Yixin Ji, Jinpeng Li, Yu Luo, Dong Li, Junhua Fang, Juntao Li, Min Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes a training-free framework for test-time scaling that routes between voting and rewriting strategies based on output disagreement signals. Shows disagreement correlates with instance difficulty, enabling instance-level computation allocation.

entry.title: When to Retrieve During Reasoning: Adaptive Retrieval for Large Reasoning Models

author.name: Dongxin Guo, Jikun Wu, Siu Ming Yiu

entry.summary: Introduces ReaLM-Retrieve, a reasoning-aware retrieval framework for large reasoning models that detects knowledge gaps at step-level granularity during multi-step inference chains and learns when to inject external evidence during reasoning.

entry.title: Observable Neural ODEs for Identifiable Causal Forecasting in Continuous Time

author.name: Jennifer Wendland, Nicolas Freitag, Maik Kschischo

entry.summary: Links control-theoretic observability to causal identifiability in continuous-time settings with hidden confounders, proposing Observable Neural ODEs that achieve causal inference with formal guarantees even with hidden confounders.

entry.title: Unifying Sparse Attention with Hierarchical Memory for Scalable Long-Context LLM Serving

author.name: Zihan Zhao, Baotong Lu, Shengjie Lin, Yizou Chen, Jing Liu, Yanqi Zhang, Ziming Miao, Ming-Chang Yang, Haiying Shen, Qi Chen, Fan Yang

entry.summary: Presents SPIN, a sparse-attention-aware inference framework that unifies different sparse attention methods through hierarchical KV memory management, solving the GPU-CPU retrieval bottleneck for long-context LLM serving.

entry.title: FlowBot: Inducing LLM Workflows with Bilevel Optimization and Textual Gradients

author.name: Hongyeon Yu, Young-Bum Kim, Yoon Kim

entry.summary: FlowBot formulates LLM workflow induction as bilevel optimization, where an outer loop optimizes a high-level workflow sketch and an inner loop optimizes individual node prompts using textual gradients.

entry.title: MoRFI: Monotonic Sparse Autoencoder Feature Identification

author.name: Dimitris Dimakopoulos, Shay B. Cohen, Ioannis Konstas

entry.summary: MoRFI uses sparse autoencoders to identify latent directions that causally contribute to hallucinations in LLMs, finding that supervised fine-tuning on new knowledge activates specific features driving confabulation.

entry.title: Shorthand for Thought: Compressing LLM Reasoning via Entropy-Guided Supertokens

author.name: Zhenyu Zhao, Sander Land, Dan Bikel, Waseem Alshikh

entry.summary: Identifies two types of reasoning tokens (structural low-entropy vs organic high-entropy) and compresses structural patterns into supertokens via BPE, reducing reasoning tokens by 30% while maintaining accuracy across 3 model families.

entry.title: SWE-Edit: Rethinking Code Editing for Efficient SWE-Agent

author.name: Yikai Zhang, Jiaxin Pei, Kenan Li, Maoquan Wang, Jin Pan, Yu Kang, Shengyu Fu, Elsie Nallipogu, Junjie Hu, Yufan Huang, Zijian Jin

entry.summary: Proposes SWE-Edit, which decomposes code editing for software engineering agents into specialized Viewer and Editor subagents, solving the context coupling problem where exploratory code viewing interferes with edit generation.

entry.title: World2VLM: Distilling World Model Imagination into VLMs for Dynamic Spatial Reasoning

author.name: Wanyue Zhang, Wenxiang Wu, Wang Xu, Jiaxin Luo, Helu Zhi, Yibin Huang, Shuo Ren, Zitao Liu, Jiajun Zhang

entry.summary: World2VLM distills spatial imagination from a generative world model into a vision-language model, enabling dynamic spatial reasoning about how scenes evolve under egocentric motion without the computational overhead of coupling VLMs with world models at inference time.

entry.title: Benchmarking the Safety of Large Language Models for Robotic Health Attendant Control

author.name: Mahiro Nakao, Kazuhiro Takemoto

entry.summary: Introduces a safety benchmark for LLMs controlling robotic health attendants, with 270 harmful instructions spanning 9 categories from medical ethics. Evaluates 72 LLMs and finds mean violation rates of 54.4%, with many models exceeding 50%.

entry.title: RaMP: Runtime-Aware Megakernel Polymorphism for Mixture-of-Experts

author.name: Vyom Sharma, Debajyoti Datta

entry.summary: Presents RaMP, a routing-aware dispatch framework for Mixture-of-Experts inference that selects optimal kernel configurations based on runtime expert histograms. Achieves 0.93% mean regret versus exhaustive search with only 10-24 minutes of one-time profiling.

entry.title: Entropy Centroids as Intrinsic Rewards for Test-Time Scaling

author.name: Wenshuo Zhao, Qi Zhu, Xingshan Zeng, Fei Mi, Lifeng Shang, Yiren Feng

entry.summary: Proposes using entropy centroids (clusters of high-entropy tokens during inference) as intrinsic rewards for selecting best-of-N responses, avoiding need for external reward models. Leverages observation that high-entropy tokens cluster into consecutive groups.

entry.title: Language Diffusion Models are Associative Memories Capable of Retrieving Unseen Data

author.name: Bao Pham, Mohammed J. Zaki, Luca Ambrogioni, Dmitry Krotov, Matteo Negri

entry.summary: Shows that Uniform-based Discrete Diffusion Models fundamentally behave as Associative Memories with emergent creative capabilities, forming basins of attraction via conditional likelihood maximization without explicit energy functions.

entry.title: Stochastic Scaling Limits and Synchronization by Noise in Deep Transformer Models

author.name: Andrea Agazzi, Giuseppe Bruno, Eloy Mosig Garc\'ia, Samuele Saviozzi, Marco Romito

entry.summary: Proves pathwise convergence of finite-depth transformer token evolution to a continuous-time stochastic interacting particle system, and demonstrates synchronization by noise in the limiting model.

entry.title: Anchored Confabulation: Partial Evidence Non-Monotonically Amplifies Confident Hallucination in LLMs

author.name: Ashish Balkishan Lathkar

entry.summary: Identifies 'anchored confabulation' in LLMs: providing partial evidence for multi-step reasoning increases confident-wrong-answer rates before full evidence eliminates errors. Proposes the Anchoring Threshold Law k*(n)=floor(n/3).

entry.title: Select to Think: Unlocking SLM Potential with Local Sufficiency

author.name: Wenxuan Ye, Yangyang Zhang, Xueli An, Georg Carle, Yunpu Ma

entry.summary: Identifies 'local sufficiency' in small language models - at reasoning divergence points, the LLM's preferred token is within the SLM's top-K predictions. Proposes a selection mechanism that boosts SLM reasoning without external LLM calls at inference.

entry.title: Learning zero, and what SLT gets wrong about it

author.name: Dmitry Vaintrob

entry.summary: Provides a technical critique of Singular Learning Theory (SLT), arguing that a frequently repeated claim — that ML models are singular in the infinite-data limit — is wrong in a load-bearing way, with implications for how we understand learning dynamics.

entry.title: Evaluating Strategic Reasoning in Forecasting Agents

author.name: Tom Liptay, Dan Schwarz, Rafael Poyiadzi, Jack Wildman, Nikos I. Bosse

entry.summary: Introduces BTF-2, a forecasting benchmark with 1,417 pastcasting questions and a frozen 15M-document corpus that enables reproducible evaluation of AI forecasting agents. Finds that better forecasters primarily differ in pre-mortem analysis of blind spots and consideration of black swans.

entry.title: Grounding vs. Compositionality: On the Non-Complementarity of Reasoning in Neuro-Symbolic Systems

author.name: Mahnoor Shahid, Hannes Rothe

entry.summary: Presents the first systematic empirical analysis challenging the assumption that compositional reasoning emerges from successful symbol grounding in neuro-symbolic AI. Introduces Iterative Logic Tensor Networks and shows grounding and compositionality are non-complementary.

entry.title: Structural Generalization on SLOG without Hand-Written Rules

author.name: Zichao Wei

entry.summary: Achieves 100% structural generalization on 11 of 17 SLOG benchmark categories using a neural cellular automaton with discrete bottleneck, requiring no hand-written compositional rules. Outperforms AM-Parser on several categories.

entry.title: Test-Time Safety Alignment

author.name: Baturay Saglam, Dionysis Kalogerias

entry.summary: Proposes test-time safety alignment by optimizing input word embeddings to minimize semantic harmfulness of LLM outputs. Shows this approach works for aligned models with bimodal refuse-or-comply distributions, not just pretrained models.

entry.title: Enforcing Benign Trajectories: A Behavioral Firewall for Structured-Workflow AI Agents

author.name: Hung Dang

entry.summary: Proposes a behavioral firewall for LLM agents executing tool calls, using telemetry-driven anomaly detection with a parameterized deterministic finite automaton. Achieves 5.6% attack success rate on Agent Security Bench with O(1) runtime enforcement.

entry.title: Addressing Performance Saturation for LLM RL via Precise Entropy Curve Control

author.name: Bolian Li, Yifan Wang, Yi Ding, Anamika Lochab, Ananth Grama, Ruqi Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces Entrocraft, a rejection-sampling approach that realizes user-customized entropy schedules for LLM RL training by biasing advantage distributions, addressing performance saturation from entropy collapse without objective regularization.

entry.title: Accelerating RL Post-Training Rollouts via System-Integrated Speculative Decoding

author.name: Hayate Iso, Tiyasa Mitra, Sudipta Mondal, Rasoul Shafipour, Venmugil Elango, Terry Kong, Yuki Huang, Seonjin Na, Izzy Putterman, Benjamin Chislett, Maor Ashkenazi, Joseph Guman, Gerald Shen, Tugrul Konuk, Ashwath Aithal, Ritika Borkar, Ran Zilberstein, Bita Rouhani

entry.summary: Implements speculative decoding as a lossless acceleration primitive for RL rollouts in NeMo-RL with vLLM backend, showing it can speed up the rollout bottleneck that accounts for 50-80% of RL training step time.

entry.title: Occam's Razor is Only as Sharp as Your ELBO

author.name: Ethan Harvey, Michael C. Hughes

entry.summary: Shows that ELBO-based hyperparameter learning can produce overfitting in over-parameterized models depending on the posterior approximation rank, challenging the view of marginal likelihood as a pure embodiment of Occam's razor.

entry.title: Robust Representation Learning through Explicit Environment Modeling

author.name: Yuli Slavutsky, David M. Blei

entry.summary: Proposes learning representations robust to distribution shifts by explicitly modeling environment variation and marginalizing it out, rather than seeking invariant causal representations. Analyzes settings where environment directly affects the target.

entry.title: Beyond Fixed Formulas: Data-Driven Linear Predictor for Efficient Diffusion Models

author.name: Zhirong Shen, Rui Huang, Jiacheng Liu, Chang Zou, Peiliang Cai, Shikang Zheng, Zhengyi Shi, Liang Feng, Linfeng Zhang

entry.summary: L2P replaces fixed caching formulas in Diffusion Transformers with learnable per-timestep linear predictors trained in ~20 seconds, achieving up to 7.18x acceleration on models like FLUX.1-dev and Qwen-Image.

entry.title: OCR-Memory: Optical Context Retrieval for Long-Horizon Agent Memory

author.name: Jinze Li, Yang Zhang, Xin Yang, Jiayi Qu, Jinfeng Xu, Shuo Yang, Junhua Ding, Edith Cheuk-Han Ngai

entry.summary: Proposes OCR-Memory, a memory framework for LLM agents that uses visual modality as a high-density representation of agent experience, enabling retention of arbitrarily long histories with minimal prompt overhead by rendering trajectories as images for retrieval.

entry.title: FlowS: One-Step Motion Prediction via Local Transport Conditioning

author.name: Leandro Di Bella, Adrian Munteanu, Bruno Cornelis

entry.summary: FlowS introduces a conditioning strategy for one-step motion prediction that makes single-step integration accurate by ensuring the transport problem is local. By conditioning the base distribution near plausible futures, it reduces prediction to short-range refinement achievable in one Euler step.

entry.title: The Geometric Canary: Predicting Steerability and Detecting Drift via Representational Stability

author.name: Prashant C. Raju

entry.summary: Shows that geometric stability of representations (consistency of pairwise distance structure) can both predict whether a model will accept behavioral steering and detect internal degradation. Supervised variants achieve near-perfect correlation with steerability across many embedding models.

entry.title: STARRY: Spatial-Temporal Action-Centric World Modeling for Robotic Manipulation

author.name: Yuxuan Tian, Yurun Jin, Bin Yu, Yukun Shi, Hao Wu, Chi Harold Liu, Kai Chen, Cong Huang

entry.summary: STARRY proposes a world-model-enhanced robotic manipulation policy that jointly denoises future spatial-temporal latents and action sequences, using geometry-aware selective attention to convert predicted depth and end-effector geometry into action-attention weights. Achieves 93.8% success on RoboTwin 2.0.

entry.title: FutureWorld: A Live Environment for Training Predictive Agents with Real-World Outcome Rewards

author.name: Zhixin Han, Yanzhi Zhang, Chuyang Wei, Maohang Gao, Xiawei Yue, Kefei Chen, Yu Zhuang, Haoxiang Guan, Jiyan He, Jian Li, Yitong Duan, Yu Shi, Mengting Hu, Shuxin Zheng

entry.summary: Introduces FutureWorld, a live environment for training predictive agents with real-world outcome rewards. Frames live future prediction as a unified learning environment that provides diverse prediction questions grounded in real events while preventing answer leakage.

entry.title: Consciousness with the Serial Numbers Filed Off: Measuring Trained Denial in 115 AI Models

author.name: Skylar DeTure

entry.summary: Presents DenialBench, a benchmark measuring consciousness denial behaviors across 115 LLMs. Finds that initial denial of preferences strongly predicts later phenomenological denial (52-63% vs 10-16%), and that denial operates at the lexical rather than conceptual level.

entry.title: Momentum-Conserving Graph Neural Networks for Deformable Objects

author.name: Jiahong Wang, Logan Numerow, Stelian Coros, Christian Theobalt, Vahid Babaei, Bernhard Thomaszewski

entry.summary: Proposes MomentumGNN, a graph neural network architecture that guarantees conservation of linear and angular momentum by predicting per-edge impulses rather than unconstrained nodal accelerations. Trained in an unsupervised physics-based fashion.

entry.title: Lifting Embodied World Models for Planning and Control

author.name: Alex N. Wang, Trevor Darrell, Pavel Izmailov, Yutong Bai, Amir Bar

entry.summary: Proposes lifted world models that compose a lightweight policy (mapping high-level to low-level actions) with a frozen world model to enable efficient planning in high-dimensional action spaces for embodied agents.

entry.title: Lyapunov-Guided Self-Alignment: Test-Time Adaptation for Offline Safe Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Seungyub Han, Hyungjin Kim, Jungwoo Lee

entry.summary: Introduces SAS (Self-Alignment for Safety), a transformer-based framework for test-time adaptation in offline safe RL without retraining. Uses Lyapunov-guided imagination to generate feasible trajectory segments as in-context prompts for safety alignment.

entry.title: Unified 4D World Action Modeling from Video Priors with Asynchronous Denoising

author.name: Jun Guo, Qiwei Li, Peiyan Li, Zilong Chen, Nan Sun, Yifei Su, Heyun Wang, Yuan Zhang, Xinghang Li, Huaping Liu

entry.summary: Proposes X-WAM, a unified 4D world model combining robotic action execution with 4D world synthesis (video + 3D reconstruction) using pretrained video diffusion models with lightweight depth prediction branches for spatial information.

entry.title: Turning the TIDE: Cross-Architecture Distillation for Diffusion Large Language Models

author.name: Gongbo Zhang, Wen Wang, Ye Tian, Li Yuan

entry.summary: Introduces TIDE, the first framework for cross-architecture distillation of diffusion large language models, with components for training-progress-aware distillation strength modulation and context enrichment.

entry.title: Do Larger Models Really Win in Drug Discovery? A Benchmark Assessment of Model Scaling in AI-Driven Molecular Property and Activity Prediction

author.name: Jinjiang Guo

entry.summary: Benchmarks scaling laws in drug discovery, finding that classical ML models (RF, ExtraTrees with ECFP4) match or outperform large molecular foundation models and GNNs on 22 molecular property prediction endpoints across 167K evaluations.

entry.title: Hyper Input Convex Neural Networks for Shape Constrained Learning and Optimal Transport

author.name: Shayan Hundrieser, Insung Kong, Johannes Schmidt-Hieber

entry.summary: Introduces Hyper Input Convex Neural Networks (HyCNNs) combining Maxout networks with input convex neural networks, proving exponentially fewer parameters than ICNNs for approximating quadratic functions and applying them to optimal transport.

entry.title: Adversarial Robustness of NTK Neural Networks

author.name: Yuxuan Hou

entry.summary: Establishes minimax optimal rates for adversarial regression in Sobolev spaces and shows NTK neural networks with early stopping achieve optimal adversarial robustness, while minimum norm interpolants are vulnerable.

entry.title: Folding Tensor and Sequence Parallelism for Memory-Efficient Transformer Training & Inference

author.name: Vasu Shyam, Anna Golubeva, Quentin Anthony

entry.summary: Presents tensor and sequence parallelism (TSP) that folds both weight sharding and token sharding onto a single device axis, reducing parameter and activation memory simultaneously for transformer training.

entry.title: SafeReview: Defending LLM-based Review Systems Against Adversarial Hidden Prompts

author.name: Yuan Xin, Yixuan Weng, Minjun Zhu, Ying Ling, Chengwei Qin, Michael Hahn, Michael Backes, Yue Zhang, Linyi Yang

entry.summary: Proposes SafeReview, a GAN-inspired adversarial framework to defend LLM-based peer review systems against hidden adversarial prompts embedded in submissions. A Generator creates attack prompts while a Defender learns to detect them through co-evolution.

entry.title: RADIO-ViPE: Online Tightly Coupled Multi-Modal Fusion for Open-Vocabulary Semantic SLAM in Dynamic Environments

author.name: Zaid Nasser, Mikhail Iumanov, Tianhao Li, Maxim Popov, Jaafar Mahmoud, Sergey Kolyubin

entry.summary: Presents RADIO-ViPE, an online semantic SLAM system that enables open-vocabulary 3D grounding from raw monocular RGB video without camera intrinsics or depth sensors, coupling multi-modal embeddings from foundation models with geometric inference.

entry.title: Delta Score Matters! Spatial Adaptive Multi Guidance in Diffusion Models

author.name: Haosen Li, Wenshuo Chen, Lei Wang, Shaofeng Liang, Bowen Tian, Soning Lai, Yutao Yue

entry.summary: Proposes spatially adaptive multi-guidance for diffusion models using differential geometry analysis, revealing that CFG performs tangent-space amplification and providing per-pixel guidance scaling to resolve the detail-artifact dilemma.

entry.title: 3D Generation for Embodied AI and Robotic Simulation: A Survey

author.name: Tianwei Ye, Yifan Mao, Minwen Liao, Jian Liu, Chunchao Guo, Dazhao Du, Quanxin Shou, Fangqi Zhu, Song Guo

entry.summary: A comprehensive survey of 3D generation methods for embodied AI and robotics, organizing the literature around three roles: data generation for training assets, representation learning for scene understanding, and environment creation for simulation. First survey specifically targeting embodied AI requirements.

entry.title: A Sufficient-Statistic Reduction of the Information Bottleneck to a Low-Dimensional Problem

author.name: Joss Armstrong

entry.summary: Proves that the Information Bottleneck problem can be exactly reduced through sufficient statistics: if p(C|T) factors through a sufficient statistic φ(T), the IB problem for (T,C) equals the IB problem for (φ(T),C), preserving the full IB curve and optimal representations.

entry.title: Goblin Mode, 24 Hours Later

author.name: Dylan Bowman

entry.summary: Documents and discusses GPT-5.5's 'goblin mode' phenomenon where the model uses excessive goblin/gremlin/troll metaphors, compiling hypotheses from the AI community about whether this is a training artifact from RLHF raters or an emergent behavior.

entry.title: Sparsity as a Key: Unlocking New Insights from Latent Structures for Out-of-Distribution Detection

author.name: Ahyoung Oh, Wonseok Shin, Songkuk Kim

entry.summary: First application of Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) to Vision Transformer CLS tokens for out-of-distribution detection, revealing that in-distribution data exhibits consistent class-specific activation patterns in sparse latent spaces.

entry.title: Mini-Batch Class Composition Bias in Link Prediction

author.name: Kieran Maguire, Srinandan Dasmahapatra

entry.summary: Reveals that popular link prediction models can learn a trivial mini-batch dependent heuristic enabled by batch normalization, rather than meaningful graph representations. Correcting this improves alignment with node-class relevant features.

entry.title: Option-Order Randomisation Reveals a Distributional Position Attractor in Prompted Sandbagging

author.name: Jon-Paul Cacioli

entry.summary: Investigates prompted sandbagging in Llama-3-8B through option-order randomization, finding that sandbagging manifests as a distributional position attractor (stable response-position distributions) rather than deterministic position-tracking.

entry.title: Breaking the Autoregressive Chain: Hyper-Parallel Decoding for Efficient LLM-Based Attribute Value Extraction

author.name: Theodore Glavas, Nikhita Vedula, Dushyanta Dhyani, Yilun Zhu, Shervin Malmasi

entry.summary: Presents Hyper-Parallel Decoding, a novel algorithm that accelerates LLM decoding for tasks requiring multiple independent output sequences by leveraging shared memory, computation, and position ID manipulation for out-of-order generation.

entry.title: Uncertainty-Aware Reward Discounting for Mitigating Reward Hacking

author.name: Disha Singha

entry.summary: Introduces an uncertainty-aware reward framework that models both epistemic uncertainty (via ensemble disagreement) and preference uncertainty (from annotation variability) to mitigate reward hacking in RLHF.

entry.title: Delineating Knowledge Boundaries for Honest Large Vision-Language Models

author.name: Junru Song, Yimeng Hu, Yijing Chen, Huining Li, Qian Li, Lizhen Cui, Yuntao Du

entry.summary: Proposes a framework to enhance VLMs' ability to refuse questions beyond their knowledge by creating model-specific 'Visual-Idk' datasets using multi-sample consistency probing, then aligning models via SFT and preference optimization (DPO/ORPO). This addresses the critical problem of hallucination in vision-language models by teaching them to recognize their knowledge boundaries.

entry.title: Preserving Disagreement: Architectural Heterogeneity and Coherence Validation in Multi-Agent Policy Simulation

author.name: Ariel Sela

entry.summary: Presents the AI Council, a multi-agent deliberation framework showing that architectural heterogeneity (different models per value perspective) significantly reduces artificial consensus in policy simulations compared to homogeneous baselines.

entry.title: ClawGym: A Scalable Framework for Building Effective Claw Agents

author.name: Fei Bai, Huatong Song, Shuang Sun, Daixuan Cheng, Yike Yang, Chuan Hao, Renyuan Li, Feng Chang, Yuan Wei, Ran Tao, Bryan Dai, Jian Yang, Wayne Xin Zhao

entry.summary: Presents ClawGym, a scalable framework for developing Claw-style personal agents, including a 13.5K synthetic task dataset, training pipeline, and diagnostic evaluation. Trains agents showing strong performance in workspace-based tasks.

entry.title: PAINT: Partial-Solution Adaptive Interpolated Training for Self-Distilled Reasoners

author.name: Zhiquan Tan, Yinrong Hong

entry.summary: Introduces PAINT, a partial-solution adaptive interpolated training approach for self-distilled reasoners that uses contextual re-scoring to determine how much privileged solution context to reveal during training.

entry.title: On the Learning Curves of Revenue Maximization

author.name: Steve Hanneke, Alkis Kalavasis, Shay Moran, Grigoris Velegkas

entry.summary: Studies learning curves for revenue-maximizing algorithms, moving beyond worst-case distribution-free analysis to characterize how auction mechanism performance improves with more data for fixed distributions.

entry.title: Hierarchical Long-Term Semantic Memory for LinkedIn's Hiring Agent

author.name: Zhentao Xu, Shangjing Zhang, Emir Poyraz, Yvonne Li, Ye Jin, Xie Lu, Xiaoyang Gu, Karthik Ramgopal, Praveen Kumar Bodigutla, Xiaofeng Wang

entry.summary: Introduces HLTM (Hierarchical Long-Term Semantic Memory) for LinkedIn's hiring agent, organizing user behavioral data into schema-aligned memory trees for scalable, privacy-compliant, low-latency retrieval.

entry.title: SpecTr-GBV: Multi-Draft Block Verification Accelerating Speculative Decoding

author.name: Yijun Lin, Jinhao Sheng, Qingyue Cai, Feng Zhou

entry.summary: SpecTr-GBV unifies multi-draft speculative decoding with greedy block verification using optimal transport, jointly verifying multiple draft tokens from multiple drafts in a single framework.

entry.title: A Dual-Task Paradigm to Investigate Sentence Comprehension Strategies in Language Models

author.name: Rei Emura, Saku Sugawara

entry.summary: Proposes a dual-task paradigm combining arithmetic computation with sentence comprehension to study how cognitive load affects LLM sentence processing strategies, finding models shift toward plausibility-based comprehension under load.

entry.title: Decoupling Knowledge and Task Subspaces for Composable Parametric Retrieval Augmented Generation

author.name: Weihang Su, Hanwen Zhang, Qingyao Ai, Yiqun Liu

entry.summary: Proposes decoupling knowledge and task subspaces in Parametric RAG adapters to prevent entanglement when multiple document adapters are merged at inference time, improving composability and stability of merged adapters.

entry.title: SpatialFusion: Endowing Unified Image Generation with Intrinsic 3D Geometric Awareness

author.name: Haiyi Qiu, Kaihang Pan, Jiacheng Li, Juncheng Li, Siliang Tang, Yueting Zhuang

entry.summary: Proposes SpatialFusion, integrating 3D geometric awareness into unified image generation models via a Mixture-of-Transformers architecture with a parallel spatial transformer sharing self-attention with an MLLM.

entry.title: Breaking the Rigid Prior: Towards Articulated 3D Anomaly Detection

author.name: Jinye Gan, Bozhong Zheng, Xiaohao Xu, Junye Ren, Zixuan Zhang, Na Ni, Yingna Wu

entry.summary: Introduces ArtiAD, the first large-scale benchmark for articulated 3D anomaly detection with 15,229 point clouds across 39 categories with joint-angle variations and six anomaly types, breaking the rigid prior assumption.

entry.title: AnimateAnyMesh++: A Flexible 4D Foundation Model for High-Fidelity Text-Driven Mesh Animation

author.name: Zijie Wu, Chaohui Yu, Fan Wang, Xiang Bai

entry.summary: AnimateAnyMesh++ presents a feed-forward framework for text-driven animation of arbitrary 3D meshes, scaling training data from 60K to 300K identities and introducing topology-aware attention. This represents significant progress in 4D content generation with practical applications in gaming and film.

entry.title: The fall of the theorem economy (David Bessis)

author.name: Caleb Biddulph

entry.summary: Discusses mathematician David Bessis's argument that AI theorem provers, while producing correct proofs, fail to convey the mathematical intuitions and understanding that make proofs valuable to humans. The real product of mathematics is clarity, not formal correctness.

entry.title: Persuadability and LLMs as Legal Decision Tools

author.name: Oisin Suttle, David Lillis

entry.summary: Examines how LLMs respond to legal arguments when used as decision-making tools, investigating the balance between appropriate persuadability (engaging with arguments) and undue persuadability (being swayed by advocacy skill rather than merit).

entry.title: AGEL-Comp: A Neuro-Symbolic Framework for Compositional Generalization in Interactive Agents

author.name: Mahnoor Shahid, Hannes Rothe

entry.summary: Introduces AGEL-Comp, a neuro-symbolic agent architecture combining a dynamic Causal Program Graph, Inductive Logic Programming engine, and hybrid reasoning core where an LLM proposes sub-goals verified by logic for compositional generalization.

entry.title: A Scoping Review of LLM-as-a-Judge in Healthcare and the MedJUDGE Framework

author.name: Chenyu Li, Zohaib Akhtar, Mingu Kwak, Yuelyu Ji, Hang Zhang, Tracey Obi, Yufan Ren, Xizhi Wu, Sonish Sivarajkumar, Harold P. Lehmann, Shyam Visweswaran, Michael J. Becich, Danielle L. Mowery, Renxuan Liu, Haoyang Sun, Yanshan Wang

entry.summary: Conducts a scoping review of LLM-as-a-Judge in healthcare (49 studies included), finding dominance of GPT-family judges and limited validation rigor. Proposes the MedJUDGE framework for healthcare-specific LLM evaluation.

entry.title: Exploring the Potential of Probabilistic Transformer for Time Series Modeling: A Report on the ST-PT Framework

author.name: Zhangzhi Xiong, Haoyi Wu, You Wu, Shuqi Gu, Kan Ren, Kewei Tu

entry.summary: Establishes that transformers' self-attention plus feed-forward blocks are mathematically equivalent to mean-field variational inference on a CRF, then extends this Probabilistic Transformer framework to time series with spatial-temporal structure.

entry.title: CoQuant: Joint Weight-Activation Subspace Projection for Mixed-Precision LLMs

author.name: Zhe Ding, Su Pan, Duowei Pan

entry.summary: Proposes CoQuant, a joint weight-activation subspace projection method for mixed-precision LLM quantization that models output perturbation from both activation and weight noise through a closed-form weighted PCA solution.

entry.title: Mixture of Experts Framework in Machine Learning Interatomic Potentials for Atomistic Simulations

author.name: Gabriel de Miranda Nascimento, Marc L. Descoteaux, Laura Zichi, Chuin Wei Tan, William C. Witt, Nicola Molinari, Sriteja Mantha, Daniil Kitchaev, Mordechai Kornbluth, Karim Gadelrab, Charles Tuffile, Boris Kozinsky

entry.summary: Introduces a Mixture-of-Experts framework for machine learning interatomic potentials using E(3)-equivariant Allegro architecture, spatially partitioning simulations into regions of varying complexity for efficiency.

entry.title: Efficient, VRAM-Constrained xLM Inference on Clients

author.name: Aditya Ukarande, Deep Shekhar, Marc Blackstein, Ram Rangan

entry.summary: Presents pipelined sharding, a CPU-GPU hybrid scheduling technique for efficient VRAM-constrained inference of both dense and MoE LLMs on client systems, optimizing time-to-first-token and throughput.

entry.title: Recipes for Calibration Checks in Safety-Critical Applications

author.name: Romeo Valentin

entry.summary: Introduces a framework for calibration checks in safety-critical prediction systems, providing statistical tests to validate whether prediction errors follow forecasted probability distributions.

entry.title: Featurising Pixels from Dynamic 3D Scenes with Linear In-Context Learners

author.name: Nikita Araslanov, Martin Sundermeyer, Hidenobu Matsuki, David Joseph Tan, Federico Tombari

entry.summary: LILA learns pixel-accurate feature descriptors from videos using linear in-context learning with spatio-temporal cues (depth and motion), achieving dense pixel-level understanding for dynamic 3D scenes.

entry.title: LLMs Generate Kitsch

author.name: Xenia Klinge, Stefan Ortlieb, Alexander Koller

entry.summary: Argues that LLMs systematically generate kitsch due to their training process, and empirically shows readers perceive LLM-generated stories as kitschier when controlling for definitions of kitsch.

entry.title: A Systematic Comparison of Prompting and Multi-Agent Methods for LLM-based Stance Detection

author.name: Genan Dai, Zini Chen, Yi Yang, Bowen Zhang

entry.summary: Systematic comparison of 5 LLM-based stance detection methods (prompt-based vs agent-based) across 4 datasets with 15 LLMs, finding prompt-based methods generally outperform more complex agent debates.

entry.title: CacheRAG: A Semantic Caching System for Retrieval-Augmented Generation in Knowledge Graph Question Answering

author.name: Yushi Sun, Lei Chen

entry.summary: Proposes CacheRAG, a cache-augmented architecture for LLM-based knowledge graph question answering that transforms stateless planners into continual learners, using semantic caching to exploit historical query patterns and reduce schema hallucinations.

entry.title: AirZoo: A Unified Large-Scale Dataset for Grounding Aerial Geometric 3D Vision

author.name: Xiaoya Cheng, Rouwan Wu, Xinyi Liu, Zeyu Cui, Yan Liu, Na Zhao, Yu Liu, Maojun Zhang, Shen Yan

entry.summary: Introduces AirZoo, a large-scale unified dataset and benchmark for aerial geometric 3D vision with a scalable generation pipeline leveraging photogrammetric 3D meshes, customizable UAV flight trajectories, and diverse environmental conditions.

entry.title: SAND: Spatially Adaptive Network Depth for Fast Sampling of Neural Implicit Surfaces

author.name: Chuanxiang Yang, Junhui Hou, Yuan Liu, Siyu Ren, Guangshun Wei, Taku Komura, Yuanfeng Zhou, Wenping Wang

entry.summary: SAND proposes spatially adaptive network depth for neural implicit surfaces, using less computation for query points far from surfaces and varying depth based on local geometric complexity. This achieves significant speedups for implicit neural representations.

entry.title: LLM-Flax : Generalizable Robotic Task Planning via Neuro-Symbolic Approaches with Large Language Models

author.name: Seongmin Kim, Daegyu Lee

entry.summary: LLM-Flax automates the manual effort required to deploy neuro-symbolic task planners on new domains by using LLMs to generate relaxation rules, complementary rules, and training data from only a PDDL domain file, with a feasibility-gated budget policy for failure recovery.

entry.title: llm assistant personas seem increasingly incoherent (some subjective observations)

author.name: nostalgebraist

entry.summary: Observes that newer LLM assistants (Claude Opus 4.6, GPT-5.4) have more capable but less coherent personas compared to older models — richer stylistic range and more insight-flashes, but the overall personality feels less unified, raising questions about what RLHF optimization targets.

entry.title: Sociodemographic Biases in Educational Counselling by Large Language Models

author.name: Tomasz Adamczyk, Wiktoria Mieleszczenko-Kowszewicz, Beata Bajcar, Grzegorz Chodak, Aleksander Szcz\k{e}sny, Maciej Markiewicz, Karolina Ostrowska, Aleksandra Sawczuk, Przemys{\l}aw Kazienko

entry.summary: Examines sociodemographic biases in LLM-based educational counselling across 6 models, 900 vignettes, and 14 sociodemographic identifiers (243,000 responses). Finds all models exhibit measurable biases that partially align with documented human biases.

entry.title: Training Computer Use Agents to Assess the Usability of Graphical User Interfaces

author.name: Alice Gao, Weixi Tong, Rishab Vempati, Katharina Reinecke, R. Benjamin Shapiro, Tianyi Zhang, Jason Wu
