author.name: Seyed Moein Abtahi, Rasa Rahnema, Hetkumar Patel, Neel Patel, Majid Fekri, Tara Khani

entry.summary: Introduces Memanto, a universal memory layer for AI agents that challenges the assumption that knowledge graph complexity is necessary for high-fidelity agent memory, using typed semantic memory with information-theoretic retrieval instead.

entry.title: Parameter Efficiency Is Not Memory Efficiency: Rethinking Fine-Tuning for On-Device LLM Adaptation

author.name: Irene Tenison, Stella Ahn, Miriam Kim, Ebtisam Alshehri, Lalana Kagal

entry.summary: Challenges the assumption that parameter efficiency equals memory efficiency in PEFT, showing methods like LoRA still hit OOM due to activation tensors scaling with sequence length. Introduces LARS which constrains activation subspace instead of parameter space.

entry.title: ELSA: Exact Linear-Scan Attention for Fast and Memory-Light Vision Transformers

author.name: Chih-Chung Hsu, Xin-Di Ma, Wo-Ting Liao, Chia-Ming Lee

entry.summary: Introduces ELSA, an exact softmax attention reformulation cast as a prefix scan with O(n) memory, O(log n) parallel depth, provable FP32 error bounds, and no Tensor Core dependency. Drop-in replacement for FlashAttention requiring no retraining.

entry.title: Rewarding the Scientific Process: Process-Level Reward Modeling for Agentic Data Analysis

author.name: Zhisong Qiu, Shuofei Qiao, Kewei Xu, Yuqi Zhu, Lun Du, Ningyu Zhang, Huajun Chen

entry.summary: Introduces DataPRM, an environment-aware process reward model for data analysis agents that detects silent errors and avoids penalizing exploratory actions, addressing failures of general PRMs in dynamic analysis tasks.

entry.title: Large Language Models Decide Early and Explain Later

author.name: Ayan Datta, Zhixue Zhao, Bhuvanesh Verma, Radhika Mamidi, Mounika Marreddy, Alexander Mehler

entry.summary: Shows that LLMs often determine their final answer early in chain-of-thought generation, with subsequent tokens serving as post-decision explanation. Finds predicted answers change in only 32% of queries for Qwen3-4B, and once final answer stabilizes, later reasoning rarely changes it.

entry.title: Math Takes Two: A test for emergent mathematical reasoning in communication

author.name: Michael Cooper, Samuel Cooper

entry.summary: Proposes 'Math Takes Two', a benchmark testing whether two AI agents can develop mathematical reasoning through communication without prior mathematical knowledge. This addresses the fundamental question of whether LLMs truly reason mathematically or just pattern-match over formal syntax.

entry.title: GenMatter: Perceiving Physical Objects with Generative Matter Models

author.name: Eric Li, Arijit Dasgupta, Yoni Friedman, Mathieu Huot, Vikash Mansinghka, Thomas O'Connell, William T. Freeman, Joshua B. Tenenbaum

entry.summary: Proposes a generative model inspired by human perception that hierarchically groups motion cues and appearance features into particles (small Gaussians) and then clusters them into coherently moveable physical entities.

entry.title: Hidden Failure Modes of Gradient Modification under Adam in Continual Learning, and Adaptive Decoupled Moment Routing as a Repair

author.name: Yuelin Hu, Zhenbo Yu, Zhengxue Cheng, Wei Liu, Li Song

entry.summary: Reveals that gradient modification methods (projection, penalty rescaling, replay mixing) have hidden failure modes when composed with Adam optimizer in continual learning, and proposes adaptive decoupled moment routing as a fix.

entry.title: Stochastic KV Routing: Enabling Adaptive Depth-Wise Cache Sharing

author.name: Anastasiia Filippova, David Grangier, Marco Cuturi, Jo\~ao Monteiro

entry.summary: Proposes Stochastic KV Routing for reducing KV cache memory along the depth dimension by enabling adaptive cross-layer cache sharing. Addresses the practical challenge that existing cross-layer sharing methods reduce throughput or increase time-to-first-token.

entry.title: Supernodes and Halos: Loss-Critical Hubs in LLM Feed-Forward Layers

author.name: Audrey Cherilyn, Houman Safaai

entry.summary: Discovers that loss sensitivity in transformer FFN layers is concentrated in a small set of 'supernode' channels (top 1% accounts for ~59% of loss proxy mass in Llama-3.1-8B), distinct from activation outliers. Identifies a 'halo' structure of correlated channels around these supernodes.

entry.title: DPRM: A Plug-in Doob h transform-induced Token-Ordering Module for Diffusion Language Models

author.name: Dake Bu, Wei Huang, Andi Han, Hau-San Wong, Qingfu Zhang, Taiji Suzuki, Atsushi Nitanda

entry.summary: Introduces DPRM, a plug-in module for diffusion language models that improves token ordering using Doob h-transform process reward models. It replaces random masking or confidence-only ordering with a policy that balances exploration and exploitation, addressing train-test mismatch in diffusion LMs.

entry.title: Beyond Single-Agent Alignment: Preventing Context-Fragmented Violations in Multi-Agent Systems

author.name: Jie Wu, Ming Gong

entry.summary: Identifies Context-Fragmented Violations (CFVs) in multi-agent AI systems where individually safe actions collectively violate policies, and proposes Distributed Sentinel with Semantic Taint Tokens for cross-boundary enforcement.

entry.title: Architecture Matters for Multi-Agent Security

author.name: Ben Hagag, William L. Anderson, Christian Schroeder de Witt, Sarah Scheffler

entry.summary: Empirically studies how multi-agent system design decisions affect the tradeoff between task performance and attack resistance across 13 architectural configurations in browser, desktop, and code environments.

entry.title: Scaling Properties of Continuous Diffusion Spoken Language Models

author.name: Jason Ramapuram, Eeshan Gunesh Dhekane, Amitis Shidani, Dan Busbridge, Bogdan Mazoure, Zijin Gu, Russ Webb, Tatiana Likhomanenko, Navdeep Jaitly

entry.summary: Studies scaling properties of continuous diffusion spoken language models, finding they exhibit scaling laws similar to autoregressive models. Introduces phoneme Jensen-Shannon divergence metric and shows optimal token-to-parameter ratios decrease with compute.

entry.title: Long-Context Aware Upcycling: A New Frontier for Hybrid LLM Scaling

author.name: Parsa Ashrafi Fashi, Utkarsh Saxena, Mehdi Rezagholizadeh, Aref Jafari, Akash Haridas, Mingyu Yang, Vansh Bhatia, Guihong Li, Vikram Appia, Emad Barsoum

entry.summary: Proposes HyLo, a recipe for upcycling pretrained Transformer LLMs into hybrid architectures combining attention with linear sequence models (Mamba2, Gated DeltaNet). Demonstrates preservation of short-context quality while improving long-context capability with staged training and teacher-guided distillation.

entry.title: Dream-Cubed: Controllable Generative Modeling in Minecraft by Training on Billions of Cubes

author.name: Tim Merino, Sam Earle, Ryunosuke Iwai, Julian Togelius, Edoardo Cetin

entry.summary: Dream-Cubed introduces a large-scale Minecraft voxel dataset (tens of billions of tokens) and conducts the first large-scale study of 3D diffusion models for voxel generation. The work analyzes discrete vs continuous diffusion, data compositions, and architecture choices, enabling interactive workflows like inpainting.

entry.title: ClawMark: A Living-World Benchmark for Multi-Turn, Multi-Day, Multimodal Coworker Agents

author.name: Fanqing Meng, Lingxiao Du, Zijian Wu, Guanzheng Chen, Xiangyan Liu, Jiaqi Liao, Chonghe Jiang, Zhenglin Wan, Jiawei Gu, Pengfei Zhou, Rui Huang, Ziqi Zhao, Shengyuan Ding, Ailing Yu, Bo Peng, Bowei Xia, Hao Sun, Haotian Liang, Ji Xie, Jiajun Chen, Jiajun Song, Liu Yang, Ming Xu, Qionglin Qiu, Runhao Fu, Shengfang Zhai, Shijian Wang, Tengfei Ma, Tianyi Wu, Weiyang Jin, Yan Wang, Yang Dai, Yao Lai, Youwei Shu, Yue Liu, Yunzhuo Hao, Yuwei Niu, Jinkai Huang, Jiayuan Zhuo, Zhennan Shen, Linyu Wu, Cihang Xie, Yuyin Zhou, Jiaheng Zhang, Zeyu Zheng, Mengkang Hu, Michael Qizhe Shieh

entry.summary: Introduces ClawMark, a benchmark for evaluating AI coworker agents across multi-turn, multi-day tasks with evolving environments and multimodal evidence including images, PDFs, audio, and video. Features rule-based verification.

entry.title: Zero-to-CAD: Agentic Synthesis of Interpretable CAD Programs at Million-Scale Without Real Data

author.name: Mohammadmehdi Ataei, Farzaneh Askari, Kamal Rahimi Malekshan, Pradeep Kumar Jayaraman

entry.summary: Zero-to-CAD presents a scalable framework for synthesizing executable CAD construction sequences by framing the problem as an agentic search using an LLM within a feedback-driven CAD environment. The system iteratively generates, executes, and validates code to produce geometrically valid and diverse CAD programs at million-scale without requiring real data. This addresses a critical data scarcity problem in CAD/3D modeling where existing datasets lack procedural construction history.

entry.title: Vision-Language-Action Safety: Threats, Challenges, Evaluations, and Mechanisms

author.name: Qi Li, Bo Yin, Weiqi Huang, Ruhao Liu, Bojun Zou, Runpeng Yu, Jingwen Ye, Weihao Yu, Xinchao Wang

entry.summary: Comprehensive survey of safety challenges in Vision-Language-Action models, organizing threats along attack timing axes across robotic learning, adversarial ML, AI alignment, and autonomous systems. Covers physical consequences, multimodal attack surfaces, latency constraints, and data supply chain vulnerabilities.

entry.title: Characterizing Vision-Language-Action Models across XPUs: Constraints and Acceleration for On-Robot Deployment

author.name: Kaijun Zhou, Qiwei Chen, Da Peng, Zhiyang Li, Xijun Li, Jinyu Gu

entry.summary: Systematic benchmarking of Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models across heterogeneous edge accelerators (GPUs, XPUs, NPUs) for on-robot deployment. Introduces a CET (Cost, Energy, Time) leaderboard and identifies a two-phase inference pattern enabling targeted optimization strategies for real-time robot control.

entry.title: Feedback Over Form: Why Execution Feedback Matters More Than Pipeline Topology in 1-3B Code Generation

author.name: Charles Junichi McAndrews

entry.summary: Studies code generation pipelines built from small (1-3B) language models, finding that execution feedback provides >4 standard deviation improvement while more complex pipeline structures offer no benefit beyond simple refinement loops.

entry.title: KARL: Mitigating Hallucinations in LLMs via Knowledge-Boundary-Aware Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Cheng Gao, Cheng Huang, Kangyang Luo, Ziqing Qiao, Shuzheng Si, Huimin Chen, Chaojun Xiao, Maosong Sun

entry.summary: Proposes KARL, a framework that aligns LLM abstention behavior with evolving knowledge boundaries using online knowledge boundary estimation and progressive training. Addresses the problem of RL methods causing excessive caution when trying to reduce hallucinations.

entry.title: V-GRPO: Online Reinforcement Learning for Denoising Generative Models Is Easier than You Think

author.name: Bingda Tang, Yuhui Zhang, Xiaohan Wang, Jiayuan Mao, Ludwig Schmidt, Serena Yeung-Levy

entry.summary: Proposes V-GRPO for aligning denoising generative models with rewards using ELBO-based policy gradients. Shows that with proper variance reduction and gradient control, ELBO-based RL for diffusion models can be both stable and efficient.

entry.title: Necessary and sufficient conditions for universality of Kolmogorov-Arnold networks

author.name: Vugar Ismailov

entry.summary: Proves necessary and sufficient conditions for universal approximation of KANs: deep KANs need only a single non-affine edge function for universality, while two-hidden-layer KANs require nonpolynomial functions. Shows the full class of affine functions is not needed.

entry.title: Learning Curves and Benign Overfitting of Spectral Algorithms in Large Dimensions

author.name: Weihao Lu, Qian Lin, Yingcun Xia, Dongming Huang

entry.summary: Studies learning curves and benign overfitting of spectral algorithms in the large-dimensional setting, characterizing excess risk across the full regularization path and revealing non-monotone learning curves with multiple descent phenomena.

entry.title: Representational Curvature Modulates Behavioral Uncertainty in Large Language Models

author.name: Jack King, Evelina Fedorenko, Eghbal A. Hosseini

entry.summary: Shows that contextual curvature (how sharply the representational trajectory bends over recent context) in LLMs correlates with next-token entropy, and this relationship emerges during training. Provides a geometric link between trajectory straightening and token-level behavior.

entry.title: Measuring and Mitigating Persona Distortions from AI Writing Assistance

author.name: Paul R\"ottger, Kobi Hackenburg, Hannah Rose Kirk, Christopher Summerfield

entry.summary: Large-scale study (N=2,939 writers, N=11,091 readers) measuring how AI writing assistance distorts writer personas across 29 dimensions. Finds AI makes writers seem more opinionated, competent, and positive, with demographic profile shifts, but a simple disclosure intervention can partially correct these distortions.

entry.title: Breaking Lock-In: Preserving Steerability under Low-Data VLA Post-Training

author.name: Suning Huang, Jiaqi Shao, Ke Wang, Qianzhong Chen, Jiankai Sun, Yanjiang Guo, Mac Schwager, Jeannette Bohg

entry.summary: Identifies 'lock-in' in VLA policies after low-data fine-tuning where the policy becomes overly specialized and stops responding to novel instructions. Proposes solutions without requiring additional supervision signals, augmented datasets, or foundation model guidance.

entry.title: A satellite foundation model for improved wealth monitoring

author.name: Zhuo Zheng, Iv\'an Higuera-Mendieta, Richard Lee, David Newhouse, Talip Kilic, Stefano Ermon, Marshall Burke, David B. Lobell

entry.summary: Introduces Tempov, a satellite foundation model pretrained on 3 million bi-temporal Landsat pairs for wealth/poverty monitoring. Uses parameter-efficient fine-tuning to sparse survey labels, enabling large-scale, high-resolution economic livelihood estimation that handles temporal shift better than existing approaches.

entry.title: UniSonate: A Unified Model for Speech, Music, and Sound Effect Generation with Text Instructions

author.name: Chunyu Qiang, Xiaopeng Wang, Kang Yin, Yuzhe Liang, Yuxin Guo, Teng Ma, Ziyu Zhang, Tianrui Wang, Cheng Gong, Yushen Chen, Ruibo Fu, Chen Zhang, Longbiao Wang, Jianwu Dang

entry.summary: Introduces UniSonate, a unified flow-matching framework for synthesizing speech, music, and sound effects from text instructions, using a novel dynamic token injection mechanism to reconcile structural disparities between modalities.

entry.title: Introducing Background Temperature to Characterise Hidden Randomness in Large Language Models

author.name: Alberto Messina, Stefano Scotta

entry.summary: Formalizes the concept of 'background temperature'—the effective randomness in LLM outputs even at temperature=0 due to implementation-level nondeterminism (batch-size variation, floating-point non-associativity)—and proposes an empirical estimation protocol.

entry.title: Verbal Confidence Saturation in 3-9B Open-Weight Instruction-Tuned LLMs: A Pre-Registered Psychometric Validity Screen

author.name: Jon-Paul Cacioli

entry.summary: Pre-registered study finding that all seven 3-9B instruction-tuned LLMs produce invalid verbal confidence estimates under numeric elicitation, with confidence saturating rather than discriminating item difficulty.

entry.title: Rethinking XAI Evaluation: A Human-Centered Audit of Shapley Benchmarks in High-Stakes Settings

author.name: In\^es Oliveira e Silva, S\'ergio Jesus, Iker Perez, Rita P. Ribeiro, Carlos Soares, Hugo Ferreira, Pedro Bizarro

entry.summary: Conducts a large-scale human-centered audit of 8 Shapley value variants with professional fraud analysts across 3,735 case reviews. Reveals fundamental misalignment between standard quantitative XAI metrics and actual human utility in high-stakes settings.

entry.title: Scaling Multi-Node Mixture-of-Experts Inference Using Expert Activation Patterns

author.name: Abhimanyu Bambhaniya, Geonhwa Jeong, Jason Park, Jiecao Yu, Jaewon Lee, Pengchao Wang, Changkyu Kim, Chunqiang Tang, Tushar Krishna

entry.summary: Profiles expert activation patterns in SOTA MoE models (Llama 4 Maverick, DeepSeek V3, Qwen3) across 100K+ traces for multi-node inference scaling. Studies expert load imbalance and communication overhead in distributed MoE serving.

entry.title: When PINNs Go Wrong: Pseudo-Time Stepping Against Spurious Solutions

author.name: Sifan Wang, Shawn Koohy, Yiping Lu, Paris Perdikaris

entry.summary: Argues that PINNs can converge to spurious solutions not due to optimization difficulty but because the empirical PDE residual loss admits trivial solutions. Shows pseudo-time stepping combined with collocation-point resampling progressively eliminates these spurious solutions.

entry.title: JigsawRL: Assembling RL Pipelines for Efficient LLM Post-Training

author.name: Zhengding Hu, Hehua Ouyang, Chang Chen, Zaifeng Pan, Yue Guan, Zhongkai Yu, Zhen Wang, Steven Swanson, Yufei Ding

entry.summary: Presents JigsawRL, a framework for efficient RL-based LLM post-training that decomposes pipelines into sub-stage graphs and uses dynamic resource allocation and look-ahead scheduling. Achieves up to 1.85x throughput over Verl on 4-64 H100/A100 GPUs.

entry.title: Scalable Hyperparameter-Divergent Ensemble Training with Automatic Learning Rate Exploration for Large Models

author.name: Hailing Cheng, Tao Huang, Chen Zhu, Antonio Alonso

entry.summary: Proposes HDET, a method that repurposes GPU replicas in data-parallel training to explore different learning rates simultaneously, alternating between independent training and parameter averaging phases with automatic learning rate selection.

entry.title: Artificial General Intelligence Forecasting and Scenario Analysis: State of the Field, Methodological Gaps, and Strategic Implications

author.name: Gopal P. Sarma, Sunny D. Bhatt, Michael Jacob, Rachel Steratore

entry.summary: Reviews AGI forecasting methodologies, assesses their reliability, and proposes a research agenda for better forecasting infrastructure. Uses an iterative human-AI collaborative drafting approach with GPT 5.1 and Gemini 3 Pro.

entry.title: AutoPyVerifier: Learning Compact Executable Verifiers for Large Language Model Outputs

author.name: Pouya Pezeshkpour, Estevam Hruschka

entry.summary: Proposes AutoPyVerifier, a framework that automatically synthesizes minimal sets of Python verifier functions for validating LLM outputs, bridging the gap between expressive but unreliable LLM verifiers and limited deterministic ones.

entry.title: Well-Conditioned Oblivious Perturbations in Linear Space

author.name: Shabarish Chenakkod, Micha{\l} Derezi\'nski, Xiaoyu Dong, Mark Rudelson

entry.summary: Proposes an oblivious matrix perturbation requiring only O(n) random numbers and O(log n) bits precision that reduces condition number to O(n), matching Gaussian perturbations but with linear space complexity, improving conjugate gradient and other algorithms.

entry.title: From Stateless Queries to Autonomous Actions: A Layered Security Framework for Agentic AI Systems

author.name: Kexin Chu

entry.summary: Introduces the Layered Attack Surface Model (LASM), a seven-layer security framework for agentic AI systems that maps threats to architectural components (Foundation, Cognitive, Memory, Tool Execution, Multi-Agent Coordination, Ecosystem, Governance) across different timescales.

entry.title: Kwai Summary Attention Technical Report

author.name: Chenglong Chu, Guorui Zhou, Guowang Zhang, Han Li, Hao Peng, Hongtao Cheng, Jian Liang, Jiangxia Cao, Kun Gai, Lingzhi Zhou, Lu Ren, Qi Zhang, Ruiming Tang, Ruitao Wang, Xinchen Luo, Yi Su, Zhiyuan Liang, Ziqi Wang, Boyang Ding, Chengru Song, Dunju Zang, Hui Wang, Jiao Ou, Jiaxin Deng, Jijun Shi, Jinghao Zhang, Junmin Chen, Lejian Ren, Minxuan Lv, Qianqian Wang, Qigen Hu, Shiyao Wang, Siyang Mao, Tao Wang, Xingmei Wang, Zhixin Ling, Ziming Li, Zixing Zhang

entry.summary: Presents Kwai Summary Attention, a technique for addressing quadratic attention complexity in long-context LLMs by compressing KV cache beyond head-level (GQA) and dimension-level (MLA) approaches.

entry.title: Computational Design and Experimental Validation of Photoactive PARP1 Inhibitors

author.name: Simon Axelrod, Miroslav Ka\v{s}par, Krist\'yna Jel\'inkov\'a, Mark\'eta \v{S}m\'idkov\'a, Erika Bart\r{u}\v{n}kov\'a, Sille \v{S}t\v{e}p\'anov\'a, Eugene Shakhnovich, V\'aclav Ka\v{s}i\v{c}ka, Martin Dra\v{c}\'insk\'y, Zlatko Janeba, Rafael G\'omez-Bombarelli

entry.summary: Uses computational techniques including ML force fields, docking, and quantum chemistry to screen 5 million hypothetical photoactive ligands for PARP1 cancer target inhibition, with experimental validation confirming predicted candidates.

entry.title: How Do AI Agents Spend Your Money? Analyzing and Predicting Token Consumption in Agentic Coding Tasks

author.name: Longju Bai, Zhemin Huang, Xingyao Wang, Jiao Sun, Rada Mihalcea, Erik Brynjolfsson, Alex Pentland, Jiaxin Pei

entry.summary: First systematic study of token consumption patterns in agentic coding tasks. Analyzes trajectories from eight frontier LLMs on SWE-bench, finding agentic tasks consume 1000x more tokens than standard tasks and that models cannot accurately predict their own token costs.

entry.title: PrivUn: Unveiling Latent Ripple Effects and Shallow Forgetting in Privacy Unlearning

author.name: Xiaoyi Chen, Haoyuan Wang, Siyuan Tang, Sijia Liu, Liya Su, XiaoFeng Wang, Haixu Tang

entry.summary: Proposes PrivUn, an evaluation framework for machine unlearning that reveals current methods exhibit 'shallow forgetting' - private information can be recovered through in-context learning and fine-tuning. Identifies gradient-driven ripple effects of unlearning.

entry.title: EgoDyn-Bench: Evaluating Ego-Motion Understanding in Vision-Centric Foundation Models for Autonomous Driving

author.name: Finn Rasmus Sch\"afer, Yuan Gao, Dingrui Wang, Thomas Stauner, Stephan G\"unnemann, Mattia Piccinini, Sebastian Schmidt, Johannes Betz

entry.summary: EgoDyn-Bench is a diagnostic benchmark evaluating whether vision-language models understand ego-motion physics for autonomous driving. Testing 20+ models reveals a 'Perception Bottleneck' where models have logical physical reasoning but fail to extract motion cues from visual input.

entry.title: CheXmix: Unified Generative Pretraining for Vision Language Models in Medical Imaging

author.name: Ashwin Kumar, Robbie Holland, Corey Barrett, Jangwon Kim, Maya Varma, Zhihong Chen, Yunhe Gao, Greg Zaharchuk, Tara Taghavi, Krishnaram Kenthapadi, Akshay Chaudhari

entry.summary: CheXmix is a unified early-fusion generative model for chest X-rays that processes image and text tokens in a single sequence (Chameleon-style), eliminating the projection bottleneck of standard LLaVA-style medical MLLMs.

entry.title: CF-VLA: Efficient Coarse-to-Fine Action Generation for Vision-Language-Action Policies

author.name: Fan Du, Feng Yan, Jianxiong Wu, Xinrun Xu, Weiye Zhang, Weinong Wang, Yu Guo, Bin Qian, Zhihai He

entry.summary: CF-VLA restructures flow-based vision-language-action policies from noise-to-action generation into a coarse-to-fine two-stage process: a coarse initialization creating an action-aware starting point, followed by single-step refinement. This addresses the fundamental inefficiency of multi-step inference in flow-based VLA policies.

entry.title: Self Knowledge Re-expression: A Fully Local Method for Adapting LLMs to Tasks Using Intrinsic Knowledge

author.name: Mengyu Wang, Xiaoying Zhi, Zhiyi Li, Robin Schmucker, Shay B. Cohen, Tiejun Ma, Fran Silavong

entry.summary: Self-Knowledge Re-expression (SKR) transforms LLM outputs from generic token generation to task-specific expression without requiring human supervision or model distillation. It uses only unannotated data and is fully local, demonstrating substantial improvements on financial document tasks.

entry.title: BridgeACT: Bridging Human Demonstrations to Robot Actions via Unified Tool-Target Affordances

author.name: Yifan Han, Jianxiang Liu, Haoyu Zhang, Yuqi Gu, Yunhan Guo, Wenzhao Lian

entry.summary: BridgeACT learns robotic manipulation directly from human videos without robot demonstration data by modeling affordance as an embodiment-agnostic intermediate representation. Decomposes manipulation into two complementary affordance components bridging human demos and robot actions.

entry.title: EgoLive: A Large-Scale Egocentric Dataset from Real-World Human Tasks

author.name: Yihang Li, Xuelong Wei, Jingzhou Luo, Yingjing Xiao, Yibo Bai, Guangyuan Zhou, Teng Zou, Chenguang Gui, Jiajun Wen, He Zhang, Kangliang Chen, Xing Pan, Shuaiyan Liu, Daming Wang, Tao An, Jiayi Li, Shibo Jin, Wanwan Zhang, Tianyu Wang, Boren Wei, Zhixuan Huang, Fangsheng Liu, Ruodai Li, Hui Zhang, Anson Li, Yicheng Gong, Peng Cao, Jiaming Liang, Liang Lin

entry.summary: EgoLive is a large-scale egocentric dataset for robot manipulation learning, representing the largest open-source annotated egocentric dataset. Establishes advantages in annotation quality and task diversity over existing egocentric datasets for scalable robot learning.

entry.title: Agent-Centric Visual Reinforcement Learning under Dynamic Perturbations

author.name: Zhengru Fang, Yu Guo, Fei Liu, Yuang Zhang, Yihang Tao, Senkang Hu, Wenbo Ding, Yuguang Fang

entry.summary: Introduces the Visual Degraded Control Suite (VDCS) benchmark for studying visual RL under dynamic perturbations, and proposes Agent-Centric Visual RL that avoids entangling perturbation artifacts in latent representations. Provides theoretical analysis via information theory showing why reconstruction-based approaches fail.

entry.title: Bootstrapping with AI/ML-generated labels

author.name: Timothy Christensen, Silvia Goncalves, Benoit Perron

entry.summary: Studies whether bootstrap methods can correct bias from AI/ML-generated binary labels used as regression covariates. Shows a naive bootstrap fails in general, and proposes a 'coupled-label bootstrap' that jointly resamples true and imputed labels to deliver valid inference.

entry.title: AI Is Bad at Physics

author.name: fessus

entry.summary: Discusses a Peking University preprint showing LLMs achieve 0% end-to-end reproduction of experimental physics results, despite understanding methodology. Analyzes failure modes in numerical simulation and data analysis, distinguishing these from math/coding abilities.

entry.title: Reliable Self-Harm Risk Screening via Adaptive Multi-Agent LLM Systems

author.name: Meghana Karnam, Ananya Joshi

entry.summary: Presents a statistical framework for multi-agent LLM pipelines in self-harm risk screening, replacing heuristic voting with principled adaptive decision-making using confidence bounds and bandit-based adaptive sampling.

entry.title: Continual Calibration: Coverage Can Collapse Before Accuracy in Lifelong LLM Fine-Tuning

author.name: Ibne Farabi Shihab, Sanjeda Akter, Anuj Sharma

entry.summary: Shows that conformal prediction coverage collapses 3.4x faster than accuracy during continual fine-tuning of LLMs, demonstrating that uncertainty reliability degrades much earlier than top-1 performance in sequential learning.

entry.title: Reliability Auditing for Downstream LLM tasks in Psychiatry: LLM-Generated Hospitalization Risk Scores

author.name: Shevya Pandya, Shinjini Bose, Ananya Joshi

entry.summary: Proposes a reliability auditing approach for LLM-based psychiatric hospitalization risk scoring, evaluating impact of prompt design and medically insignificant inputs on predicted scores.

entry.title: Contexts are Never Long Enough: Structured Reasoning for Scalable Question Answering over Long Document Sets

author.name: Harshit Joshi, Priyank Shethia, Jadelynn Dao, Monica S. Lam

entry.summary: Presents SLIDERS, a framework for QA over long document collections that extracts information into a relational database for scalable structured reasoning, avoiding the aggregation bottleneck of chunk-based approaches.

entry.title: Causal Representation Learning from General Environments under Nonparametric Mixing

author.name: Ignavier Ng, Shaoan Xie, Xinshuai Dong, Peter Spirtes, Kun Zhang

entry.summary: Formalizes causal representation learning under general environments with nonparametric mixing, relaxing assumptions about intervention types and parametric constraints that limit prior work.

entry.title: Where Should LoRA Go? Component-Type Placement in Hybrid Language Models

author.name: Hector Borobia, Elies Segu\'i-Mas, Guillermina Tormo-Carb\'o

entry.summary: Systematically studies where to place LoRA adapters in hybrid language models (attention vs. recurrent components). Finds that adapting the attention pathway alone consistently outperforms full-model adaptation with 5-10x fewer parameters, while adapting recurrent backbones is destructive.

entry.title: $Z^2$-Sampling: Zero-Cost Zigzag Trajectories for Semantic Alignment in Diffusion Models

author.name: Haosen Li, Wenshuo Chen, Shaofeng Liang, Lei Wang, Kaishen Yuan, Yutao Yue

entry.summary: Z²-Sampling theoretically shows that explicit zigzag trajectories in diffusion sampling can be reduced to a zero-cost topological equivalent, maintaining semantic alignment benefits of Z-Sampling without tripling NFE cost.

entry.title: Sound Agentic Science Requires Adversarial Experiments

author.name: Dionizije Fa, Marko Culjak

entry.summary: Argues that LLM-based scientific agents accelerate a familiar failure mode—producing plausible but selectively optimized analyses—and advocates for adversarial experiments as a necessary safeguard for sound agentic science.

entry.title: From Skills to Talent: Organising Heterogeneous Agents as a Real-World Company

author.name: Zhengxu Yu, Yu Fu, Zhiyuan He, Yuxuan Huang, Lee Ka Yiu, Meng Fang, Weilin Luo, Jun Wang

entry.summary: Introduces OneManCompany (OMC), a framework that elevates multi-agent systems to an organizational level with portable agent identities ('Talents'), typed organizational interfaces, and cross-session learning decoupled from individual agent capabilities.

entry.title: EgoMAGIC- An Egocentric Video Field Medicine Dataset for Training Perception Algorithms

author.name: Brian VanVoorst, Nicholas Walczak, Christopher Gilleo, Charles Meissner, Fabio Felix, Iran Roman, Bea Steers, Claudio Silva, Yuhan Shen, Zijia Lu, Shih-Po Lee, Ehsan Elhamifar

entry.summary: Introduces EgoMAGIC, an egocentric medical activity dataset with 3,355 videos of 50 medical tasks collected as part of DARPA's PTG program, for training virtual assistants in augmented reality headsets for medical task guidance.

entry.title: Navigating Large-Scale Document Collections: MuDABench for Multi-Document Analytical QA

author.name: Zhanli Li, Yixuan Cao, Lvzhou Luo, Ping Luo

entry.summary: Introduces MuDABench, a benchmark for analytical question answering over large semi-structured document collections requiring cross-document synthesis and quantitative analysis, with 80,000+ pages and 332 QA instances.

entry.title: FETS Benchmark: Foundation Models Outperform Dataset-specific Machine Learning in Energy Time Series Forecasting

author.name: Marco Obermeier, Marco Pruckner, Florian Haselbeck, Andreas Zeiselmair

entry.summary: Presents the FETS benchmark comparing foundation models against dataset-specific ML for energy time series forecasting, finding that foundation models outperform traditional approaches without domain-specific training.

entry.title: Learning Evidence Highlighting for Frozen LLMs

author.name: Shaoang Li, Yanhang Shi, Yufei Li, Mingfu Liang, Xiaohan Wei, Yunchen Pu, Fei Tian, Chonglin Sun, Frank Shyu, Luke Simon, Sandeep Pandey, Xi Liu, Jian Li

entry.summary: Introduces HiLight, an evidence emphasis framework that trains a lightweight actor to insert highlight tags around key spans in long contexts for frozen LLMs. Uses RL with only task reward, requiring no evidence labels or model modifications.

entry.title: CoFi-PGMA: Counterfactual Policy Gradients under Filtered Feedback for Multi-Agent LLMs

author.name: Stela Tong, Elai Ben-Gal

entry.summary: Introduces CoFi-PGMA, a framework for multi-agent LLM systems that handles filtered feedback (from routing or collaboration) using counterfactual policy gradients. Addresses the misspecification of standard RLHF in multi-agent settings.

entry.title: Process Supervision of Confidence Margin for Calibrated LLM Reasoning

author.name: Liaoyaqi Wang, Chunsheng Zuo, William Jurayj, Benjamin Van Durme, Anqi Liu

entry.summary: Introduces RLCM, a calibration-aware RL framework that jointly optimizes correctness and confidence reliability via margin-enhanced process reward over intermediate completions. Addresses overconfidence in LLM reasoning.

entry.title: Autocorrelation Reintroduces Spectral Bias in KANs for Time Series Forecasting

author.name: Chen Zeng, Jiahui Wang, Qiao Wang

entry.summary: Shows that temporal autocorrelation in time series reintroduces spectral bias in Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs), contradicting theoretical expectations that assumed independent inputs. Proposes DCT-KAN using discrete cosine transform to mitigate this bias.

entry.title: The Override Gap: A Magnitude Account of Knowledge Conflict Failure in Hypernetwork-Based Instant LLM Adaptation

author.name: Shuaizhi Cheng, Xiang Shi, Mingwei Li

entry.summary: Identifies the 'override gap' in hypernetwork-based instant LLM adaptation: when documents contradict pretraining knowledge, the adapter margin is too small relative to pretrained confidence, causing systematic failure on deep knowledge conflicts.

entry.title: Agentic Fusion of Large Atomic and Language Models to Accelerate Materials Discovery

author.name: Mingze Li, Yu Rong, Songyou Li, Lihong Wang, Jiacheng Cen, Liming Wu, Anyi Li, Zongzhao Li, Qiuliang Liu, Rui Jiao, Tian Bian, Pengju Wang, Hao Sun, Jianfeng Zhang, Ji-Rong Wen, Deli Zhao, Shifeng Jin, Tingyang Xu, Wenbing Huang

entry.summary: Presents ElementsClaw, an agentic framework combining Large Atomic Models (LAMs) with LLMs for materials discovery, orchestrating fine-tuned atomic simulation tools while using LLMs for high-level reasoning. Demonstrates autonomous materials discovery pipeline.

entry.title: A Limit Theory of Foundation Models: A Mathematical Approach to Understanding Emergent Intelligence and Scaling Laws

author.name: Jun Shu, Junxiong Jia, Deyu Meng, Zongben Xu

entry.summary: Develops a mathematical limit theory for foundation model intelligence, formalizing emergent abilities as properties of the limit of a performance function E(N,P,K) as data, model size, and training steps approach infinity.

entry.title: A Reward-Free Viewpoint on Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Ying-Tu Chen, Wei Hung, Bing-Shu Wu, Zhang-Wei Hong, Ping-Chun Hsieh

entry.summary: Explores using reward-free reinforcement learning (RFRL) as an auxiliary training objective for multi-objective RL, leveraging RFRL's ability to learn policies for any reward function to handle unknown user preferences in MORL.

entry.title: Cortex-Inspired Continual Learning: Unsupervised Instantiation and Recovery of Functional Task Networks

author.name: Kevin McKee, Thomas Hazy, Yicong Zheng, Zacharie Bugaud, Thomas Miconi

entry.summary: Introduces Functional Task Networks (FTN), a cortex-inspired continual learning method using self-organizing binary masks over small deep networks for parameter isolation, addressing catastrophic forgetting without task labels at inference.

entry.title: The Randomness Floor: Measuring Intrinsic Non-Randomness in Language Model Token Distributions

author.name: Jaros{\l}aw Hryszko

entry.summary: Introduces Entropic Deviation (ED) to measure intrinsic non-randomness in LM token distributions, finding that 88-93% of non-randomness is intrinsic to learned weights rather than context-induced, consistent across transformer families.

entry.title: Representation Homogeneity and Systemic Instability in AI-Dominated Financial Markets: A Structural Approach

author.name: Yimeng Qiu, Qiwei Han

entry.summary: Investigates how similarity in AI trading agents' market state representations creates systemic instability in financial markets through a structural multi-agent model calibrated with high-frequency microstructural data.

entry.title: DeepImagine: Learning Biomedical Reasoning via Successive Counterfactual Imagining

author.name: Youze Zheng, Jianyou Wang, Yuhan Chen, Matthew Feng, Longtian Bao, Hanyuan Zhang, Maxim Khan, Aditya K. Sehgal, Christopher D. Rosin, Umber Dube, Ramamohan Paturi

entry.summary: Proposes DeepImagine, a framework teaching LLMs biomedical reasoning via successive counterfactual imagining - training models to infer how clinical trial results change under controlled perturbations of experimental conditions.

entry.title: Mixture of Heterogeneous Grouped Experts for Language Modeling

author.name: Zhicheng Ma, Xiang Liu, Zhaoxiang Liu, Ning Wang, Yi Shen, Kai Wang, Shuming Shi, Shiguo Lian

entry.summary: Proposes Mixture of Heterogeneous Grouped Experts (MoHGE) for LLMs, introducing two-level routing where experts of varying sizes are grouped to balance GPU utilization and align computational costs with token complexity.

entry.title: RouteNLP: Closed-Loop LLM Routing with Conformal Cascading and Distillation Co-Optimization

author.name: Dongxin Guo, Jikun Wu, Siu Ming Yiu

entry.summary: Presents RouteNLP, a closed-loop framework for routing LLM queries across tiered model portfolios using difficulty-aware routing, conformal prediction for calibration, and distillation-routing co-optimization to minimize cost while meeting quality constraints.

entry.title: Primitive Recursion without Composition: Dynamical Characterizations, from Neural Networks to Polynomial ODEs

author.name: Olivier Bournez

entry.summary: Proves that primitive recursion admits equivalent characterizations in recurrent ReLU networks, polynomial ODEs, and discrete polynomial maps, showing composition emerges from dynamics rather than as a closure rule.

entry.title: Enhancing molecular dynamics with equivariant machine-learned densities

author.name: Mihail Bogojeski, Muhammad R. Hasyim, Leslie Vogt-Maranto, Klaus-Robert M\"uller, Kieron Burke, Mark E. Tuckerman

entry.summary: Introduces DenSNet, a density-first approach to machine-learned electronic structure that predicts ground-state electron density from nuclear configurations using SE(3)-equivariant neural networks. Enables access to electronic observables beyond forces, like dipole moments and polarizabilities.

entry.title: Preference Heads in Large Language Models: A Mechanistic Framework for Interpretable Personalization

author.name: Weixu Zhang, Ye Yuan, Changjiang Han, Yuxing Tian, Zipeng Sun, Linfeng Du, Jikun Kang, Hong Kang, Xue Liu, Haolun Wu

entry.summary: Identifies 'Preference Heads' - sparse attention heads that encode user-specific preferences and causally influence generation. Proposes Differential Preference Steering (DPS), a training-free framework for interpretable personalization at inference time.

entry.title: Behavioral Canaries: Auditing Private Retrieved Context Usage in RL Fine-Tuning

author.name: Chaoran Chen, Dayu Yuan, Peter Kairouz

entry.summary: Introduces Behavioral Canaries for auditing whether RL fine-tuning pipelines have incorporated private retrieved contexts. The method instruments preference data with document triggers paired with behavioral feedback signals that RL uniquely amplifies.

entry.title: MeshLAM: Feed-Forward One-Shot Animatable Textured Mesh Avatar Reconstruction

author.name: Yisheng He, Steven Hoi

entry.summary: MeshLAM generates high-fidelity animatable 3D head avatars from a single image in one forward pass, using a dual shape-texture map architecture with a shared transformer backbone. Avoids test-time optimization or multi-view data.

entry.title: GenAssets: Generating in-the-wild 3D Assets in Latent Space

author.name: Ze Yang, Jingkang Wang, Haowei Zhang, Sivabalan Manivasagam, Yun Chen, Raquel Urtasun

entry.summary: GenAssets proposes a 3D latent diffusion model for generating realistic traffic participant assets from in-the-wild LiDAR and camera data, addressing sparse/occluded observations for autonomous driving simulation.

entry.title: Edit Where You Mean: Region-Aware Adapter Injection for Mask-Free Local Image Editing

author.name: Honghao Cai, Xiangyuan Wang, Yunhao Bai, Haohua Chen, Tianze Zhou, Runqi Wang, Wei Zhu, Yibo Chen, Xu Tang, Yao Hu, Zhen Li

entry.summary: Introduces REDEdit, a co-trained adapter framework that enables frozen diffusion transformers to perform precise local image editing by factorizing what-to-edit from where-to-edit, without modifying backbone weights.

entry.title: ServImage: An Image Generation and Editing Benchmark from Real-world Commercial Imaging Services

author.name: Fengxian Ji, Jingpu Yang, Zirui Song, Lang Gao, Junhong Liang, Zhenhao Chen, Jinghui Zhang, Xiuying Chen

entry.summary: Introduces ServImage, a benchmark correlating image generation model outputs with economic value in commercial design projects, featuring $295k worth of real paid design tasks and human annotations.

entry.title: EXACT: an explainable anomaly-aware vision foundation model for analysis of 3D chest CT

author.name: Xuguang Bai, Mingxuan Liu, Tongxi Song, Yifei Chen, Hongjia Yang, Kasidit Anmahapong, Zihan Li, Ying Zhou, Qiyuan Tian

entry.summary: Introduces EXACT, an explainable anomaly-aware foundation model for 3D chest CT that learns spatially resolved representations to localize abnormalities and provide interpretable visual evidence, going beyond scan-level prediction.

entry.title: Don't Pause! Every prediction matters in a streaming video

author.name: Dibyadip Chatterjee, Zhanzhong Pang, Fadime Sener, Yale Song, Angela Yao

entry.summary: Introduces SPOT-Bench for evaluating streaming video models with proactive multi-turn queries and Timeliness-F1 metric, revealing that offline models significantly outperform streaming ones in current benchmarks.

entry.title: Diffusion Model as a Generalist Segmentation Learner

author.name: Haoxiao Wang, Antao Xiang, Haiyang Sun, Peilin Sun, Changhao Pan, Yifu Chen, Minjie Hong, Weijie Wang, Shuang Chen, Yue Chen, Zhou Zhao

entry.summary: DiGSeg repurposes pretrained diffusion models into a unified segmentation framework that handles text-conditioned semantic and open-vocabulary segmentation. It encodes input images and ground-truth masks into latent space as conditioning signals for the diffusion U-Net, with a CLIP-aligned text path for open-vocabulary capability.

entry.title: DiffuSAM: Diffusion-Based Prompt-Free SAM2 for Few-Shot and Source-Free Medical Image Segmentation

author.name: Tal Grossman, Noa Cahan, Lev Ayzenberg, Hayit Greenspan

entry.summary: DiffuSAM adapts SAM2 for prompt-free medical image segmentation using a lightweight diffusion prior that synthesizes SAM2-compatible mask embeddings from frozen image features. This eliminates the need for expert-designed prompts and extensive fine-tuning, working in few-shot and source-free settings.

entry.title: Vision-Language-Action in Robotics: A Survey of Datasets, Benchmarks, and Data Engines

author.name: Ziyao Wang, Bingying Wang, Hanrong Zhang, Tingting Du, Tianyang Chen, Guoheng Sun, Yexiao He, Zheyu Shen, Wanghao Ye, Ang Li

entry.summary: A comprehensive survey of VLA research organized around datasets, benchmarks, and data engines. Argues that future VLA advances depend more on data infrastructure co-design than model architecture, revealing a persistent fidelity-cost trade-off in data collection.

entry.title: Modular Sensory Stream for Integrating Physical Feedback in Vision-Language-Action Models

author.name: Jimin Lee, Huiwon Jang, Myungkyu Koo, Jungwoo Park, Jinwoo Shin

entry.summary: MoSS proposes a modular sensory stream framework for integrating multiple physical sensory signals (beyond vision) into VLA models via decoupled modality streams with joint cross-modal self-attention. Enables stable incorporation of new modalities without full retraining.

entry.title: $M^2$-VLA: Boosting Vision-Language Models for Generalizable Manipulation via Layer Mixture and Meta-Skills

author.name: Siyao Xiao, Yuhong Zhang, Zhifang Liu, Zihan Gao, Jingye Zhang, Sinwai Choo, Dake Zhong, Mengzhe Wang, Xiao Lin, Xianfeng Zhou, Jia Jia, Haoqian Wang

entry.summary: M²-VLA preserves VLM generalization for robotic manipulation by using Mixture of Layers (MoL) to selectively extract task-critical information and meta-skills for efficient learning, avoiding catastrophic forgetting from end-to-end fine-tuning.

entry.title: Guiding Vector Field Generation via Score-based Diffusion Model

author.name: Zirui Chen, Shiliang Guo, Shiyu Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes Score-Induced Guiding Vector Fields (SGVF), which use score-based diffusion models to construct robot path-following vector fields directly from data distributions. This removes reliance on smooth, ordered curve assumptions and enables guidance along complex topologies like branching paths.

entry.title: Generative Synthetic Data for Causal Inference: Pitfalls, Remedies, and Opportunities

author.name: Yichen Xu

entry.summary: Demonstrates that generative synthetic data (from GANs and LLMs) can achieve good predictive performance while substantially distorting causal estimands like average treatment effects. Proposes a hybrid framework generating covariates and outcomes separately to preserve causal structure.

entry.title: AI companies should publish security assessments

author.name: ryan_greenblatt

entry.summary: Argues AI companies should commission and publish third-party security assessments detailing their robustness against different threat actors. Contends that publishing high-level findings (which threat actors they can defend against) wouldn't meaningfully degrade security.

entry.title: Wiggle and Go! System Identification for Zero-Shot Dynamic Rope Manipulation

author.name: Arthur Jakobsson, Abhinav Mahajan, Karthik Pullalarevu, Krishna Suresh, Yunchao Yao, Yuemin Mao, Bardienus Duisterhof, Shahram Najam Syed, Jeffrey Ichnowski

entry.summary: Presents 'Wiggle and Go!', a system-identification framework enabling zero-shot dynamic rope manipulation by robots, using learned simulation priors from observed rope movement to predict physical parameters before task execution.

entry.title: A general optimization solver based on OP-to-MaxSAT reduction

author.name: Yuxin Zhao, Han Huang, Zhifeng Hao

entry.summary: Proposes GORED, a general optimization solver that reduces various optimization problems to MaxSAT instances in polynomial time, enabling unified solving across problem types using state-of-the-art MaxSAT solvers.

entry.title: Revisable by Design: A Theory of Streaming LLM Agent Execution

author.name: Zhiyuan Zhai, Ming Li, Xin Wang

entry.summary: Proposes the stream paradigm for LLM agent execution where execution and user intervention are concurrent. Introduces a reversibility taxonomy (Idempotent, Reversible, Compensable, Irreversible) and proves flexibility is bounded by reversibility.

entry.title: Can Multimodal Large Language Models Truly Understand Small Objects?

author.name: Fujun Han, Junan Chen, Xintong Zhu, Jingqi Ye, Xuanjie Mao, Tao Chen, Peng Ye

entry.summary: SOUBench is the first comprehensive benchmark for evaluating small object understanding in multimodal LLMs, with 18K VQA pairs across driving, aerial, and underwater scenarios. Evaluation of 15 state-of-the-art MLLMs reveals significant limitations.

entry.title: CognitiveTwin: Robust Multi-Modal Digital Twins for Predicting Cognitive Decline in Alzheimer's Disease

author.name: Bulent Soykan, Gulsah Hancerliogullari Koksalmis, Hsin-Hsiung Huang, Laura J. Brattain

entry.summary: Presents CognitiveTwin, a digital twin framework predicting patient-specific cognitive trajectories in Alzheimer's disease using a Transformer-based architecture fusing multi-modal longitudinal data with a Deep Markov Model for temporal dynamics.

entry.title: Rethinking Math Reasoning Evaluation: A Robust LLM-as-a-Judge Framework Beyond Symbolic Rigidity

author.name: Erez Yosef, Oron Anschel, Shunit Haviv Hakimi, Asaf Gendler, Adam Botach, Nimrod Berman, Igor Kviatkovsky

entry.summary: Proposes an LLM-based evaluation framework for math reasoning that replaces rigid symbolic comparison with flexible LLM-as-judge evaluation, enabling accurate assessment across diverse mathematical representations and solution formats.

entry.title: Mochi: Aligning Pre-training and Inference for Efficient Graph Foundation Models via Meta-Learning

author.name: Jo\~ao Mattos, Arlei Silva

entry.summary: Proposes Mochi, a Graph Foundation Model using meta-learning that aligns pre-training with downstream evaluation by training on few-shot episodes rather than reconstruction objectives, addressing limitations of link-prediction-based pre-training.

entry.title: An LLM-Driven Closed-Loop Autonomous Learning Framework for Robots Facing Uncovered Tasks in Open Environments

author.name: Hong Su

entry.summary: Proposes an LLM-driven closed-loop framework where robots facing uncovered tasks autonomously generate, execute, and store new methods in a local library, reducing repeated LLM interaction for recurring tasks.

entry.title: LeHome: A Simulation Environment for Deformable Object Manipulation in Household Scenarios

author.name: Zeyi Li, Yushi Yang, Shawn Xie, Kyle Xu, Tianxing Chen, Yuran Wang, Zhenhao Shen, Yan Shen, Yue Chen, Wenjun Li, Yukun Zheng, Chaorui Zhang, Siyi Lin, Fei Teng, Hongjun Yang, Ming Chen, Steve Xie, Ruihai Wu

entry.summary: Introduces LeHome, a simulation environment for deformable object manipulation in household scenarios covering garments and food items with high-fidelity dynamics that existing simulators struggle to handle.

entry.title: From Local to Cluster: A Unified Framework for Causal Discovery with Latent Variables

author.name: Zongyu Li

entry.summary: Proposes L2C (Local to Cluster Causal Abstraction), a framework bridging local structure learning and cluster-level causal discovery with latent variables, without requiring pre-specified clusters or causal sufficiency.

entry.title: Quantifying and Mitigating Self-Preference Bias of LLM Judges

author.name: Jinming Yang, Chuxian Qiu, Zhenyu Deng, Xinshan Jiao, Tao Zhou

entry.summary: Introduces an automated framework for quantifying and mitigating Self-Preference Bias (SPB) in LLM-as-judge evaluations, where LLMs systematically favor their own outputs. Avoids costly human annotations.

entry.title: Preserving Long-Tailed Expert Information in Mixture-of-Experts Tuning

author.name: Haoze He, Xingyuan Ding, Xuan Jiang, Xinkai Zou, Alex Cheng, Yibo Zhao, Juncheng Billy Li, Heather Miller

entry.summary: Proposes an auxiliary-loss-free MoE supervised fine-tuning framework that preserves knowledge in rarely-activated experts. Shows that even rarely activated experts encode non-trivial knowledge useful for downstream tasks.

entry.title: Can an MLP Absorb Its Own Skip Connection?

author.name: Antonij Mijoski, Marko Karbevski

entry.summary: Proves that skip connections around MLPs with homogeneous activations (ReLU², ReGLU) or gated activations (SwiGLU, GeGLU) cannot be absorbed into residual-free MLPs of the same width, at any depth. These are impossibility results with implications for model compression.

entry.title: A General Representation-Based Approach to Multi-Source Domain Adaptation

author.name: Ignavier Ng, Yan Li, Zijian Li, Yujia Zheng, Guangyi Chen, Kun Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes a general domain adaptation framework with relaxed assumptions (allows dependent latent variables and varying label distributions) that learns compact representations capturing distribution shifts via latent causal structures.

entry.title: Symmetric Equilibrium Propagation for Thermodynamic Diffusion Training

author.name: Aditi De

entry.summary: Shows that Equilibrium Propagation applied to bilinearly-coupled analog substrates yields unbiased denoising score-matching gradients for diffusion model training, potentially enabling 3-4 orders of magnitude energy advantage over digital training.

entry.title: AgenticCache: Cache-Driven Asynchronous Planning for Embodied AI Agents

author.name: Hojoon Kim, Yuheng Wu, Thierry Tambe

entry.summary: Introduces AgenticCache, a planning framework for embodied AI that exploits plan locality to cache and reuse plans, avoiding per-step LLM calls. Improves success rate by 22% on average while reducing LLM calls by 62%.

entry.title: GeoEdit: Local Frames for Fast, Training-Free On-Manifold Editing in Diffusion Models

author.name: Yiming Zhang, Sitong Liu, Ke Li, Zhihong Wu, Alex Cloninger, Melvin Leok

entry.summary: Proposes GeoEdit for training-free diffusion model editing that estimates local manifold tangent spaces from perturbed samples and performs Jacobian-free edits via tangent frame moves with diffusion-based projections.

entry.title: Prior-Agnostic Robust Forecast Aggregation

author.name: Zhi Chen, Cheng Peng, Wei Tang

entry.summary: Studies robust forecast aggregation without knowledge of the state space or prior, extending previous work limited to known binary states. Provides near-optimal aggregation guarantees under this more general setting.

entry.title: When VLMs 'Fix' Students: Identifying and Penalizing Over-Correction in the Evaluation of Multi-line Handwritten Math OCR

author.name: Jin Seong, Wencke Liermann, Minho Kim, Jong-hun Shin, Soojong Lim

entry.summary: Reveals that VLMs performing handwritten math OCR tend to 'fix' student errors rather than faithfully transcribing them, a critical failure for educational assessment. Proposes PINK metric to penalize over-correction in multi-line math OCR.

entry.title: Intervention-Aware Multiscale Representation Learning from Imaging Phenomics and Perturbation Transcriptomics

author.name: Jiayuan Chen, Ruoqi Liu, Zishan Gu, Ping Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces an intervention-aware distillation framework that uses perturbational transcriptomics to guide microscopy image representation learning, with a chemistry-aware codebook and soft distribution matching for drug discovery.

entry.title: On (not) learning the M\"obius function

author.name: Alexey Pozdnyakov

entry.summary: Proves lower bounds on learning the Möbius function using kernel methods, noisy gradient methods, and correlational statistical query algorithms, connecting these bounds to digital prime number theorems.

entry.title: Sliced-Regularized Optimal Transport

author.name: Khai Nguyen

entry.summary: Proposes sliced-regularized optimal transport (SROT) that regularizes transport plans toward a smoothened sliced OT plan rather than independent coupling. Provides dual formulation, post-Bayesian interpretation, and Sinkhorn-style algorithm.

entry.title: Hierarchical Behaviour Spaces

author.name: Michael Tryfan Matthews, Anssi Kanervisto, Jakob Foerster, Pierluca D'Oro, Scott Fujimoto, Mikael Henaff

entry.summary: Proposes Hierarchical Behaviour Spaces (HBS) for hierarchical RL, where the controller specifies linear combinations over reward functions to induce a continuous space of behaviors rather than selecting single options. Evaluated on NetHack with strong results.

entry.title: How Large Language Models Balance Internal Knowledge with User and Document Assertions

author.name: Shuowei Li, Haoxin Li, Wenda Chu, Yi Fang

entry.summary: Proposes a three-source interaction framework evaluating how 27 LLMs balance internal knowledge, user assertions, and document content simultaneously. Reveals general patterns in how models resolve conflicts when all three sources are present.

entry.title: FreqFormer: Hierarchical Frequency-Domain Attention with Adaptive Spectral Routing for Long-Sequence Video Diffusion Transformers

author.name: Haopeng Jin

entry.summary: Proposes FreqFormer, a frequency-aware heterogeneous attention framework for long-sequence video diffusion transformers. Routes different spectral bands to appropriate operators: dense attention for low frequencies, sparse for mid, and local attention for high frequencies.

entry.title: Probing Visual Planning in Image Editing Models

author.name: Zhimu Zhou, Yanpeng Zhao, Qiuyu Liao, Bo Zhao, Xiaojian Ma

entry.summary: Proposes EAR (editing-as-reasoning), reformulating visual planning as single-step image transformation instead of step-by-step generation. Introduces AMAZE dataset based on maze puzzles to probe intrinsic visual reasoning in image editing models.

entry.title: PushupBench: Your VLM is not good at counting pushups

author.name: Shengzhi Li, Jiarun Chen, Karun Sharma, Jiaqi Su, Shichao Pei

entry.summary: PushupBench evaluates VLMs on repetition counting in 446 long-form exercise clips. Best frontier model achieves only 42.1% exact accuracy. Fine-tuning on counting transfers to general video understanding.

entry.title: Oracle Noise: Faster Semantic Spherical Alignment for Interpretable Latent Optimization

author.name: Haosen Li, Wenshuo Chen, Lei Wang, Shaofeng Liang, Haozhe Jia, Yutao Yue

entry.summary: Oracle Noise proposes spherically-constrained latent optimization for text-to-image diffusion models, preventing norm inflation and visual artifacts while improving semantic alignment without reward hacking.

entry.title: Talker-T2AV: Joint Talking Audio-Video Generation with Autoregressive Diffusion Modeling

author.name: Zhen Ye, Xu Tan, Aoxiong Yin, Hongzhan Lin, Guangyan Zhang, Peiwen Sun, Yiming Li, Chi-Min Chan, Wei Ye, Shikun Zhang, Wei Xue

entry.summary: Talker-T2AV proposes autoregressive diffusion for joint talking audio-video generation where high-level cross-modal modeling occurs in a shared backbone while low-level rendering is decoupled into modality-specific branches.

entry.title: Do Protective Perturbations Really Protect Portrait Privacy under Real-world Image Transformations?

author.name: Ruiqing Sun, Xingshan Yao, Zhijing Wu, Tian Lan, Chenhao Cui, Huiyang Zhao, Jialing Shi, Chen Yang, Xianling Mao

entry.summary: Systematically evaluates whether proactive privacy protection perturbations on portrait images remain effective under real-world transformations like scaling and compression. Finds these pixel-level defenses may be fragile under common image processing.

entry.title: VitaminP: cross-modal learning enables whole-cell segmentation from routine histology

author.name: Yasin Shokrollahi, Karina B. Pinao Gonzales, Elizve N. Barrientos Toro, Paul Acosta, Patient Mosaic Team, Pingjun Chen, Yinyin Yuan, Xiaoxi Pan

entry.summary: Introduces VitaminP, a cross-modal learning framework that enables whole-cell segmentation from routine H&E images by learning from paired H&E-immunofluorescence data, transferring molecular boundary information.

entry.title: GoClick: Lightweight Element Grounding Model for Autonomous GUI Interaction

author.name: Hongxin Li, Yuntao Chen, Zhaoxiang Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces GoClick, a lightweight 230M-parameter VLM for GUI element grounding that achieves competitive accuracy while being small enough for on-device mobile deployment.

entry.title: PointTransformerX:Portable and Efficient 3D Point Cloud Processing without Sparse Algorithms

author.name: Laurenz Reichardt, Nikolas Ebert, Oliver Wasenm\"uller

entry.summary: Introduces PointTransformerX (PTX), a fully PyTorch-native 3D point cloud transformer backbone that removes all custom CUDA operators, enabling portable deployment on non-NVIDIA hardware while maintaining competitive accuracy.

entry.title: ReVSI: Rebuilding Visual Spatial Intelligence Evaluation for Accurate Assessment of VLM 3D Reasoning

author.name: Yiming Zhang, Jiacheng Chen, Jiaqi Tan, Yongsen Mao, Wenhu Chen, Angel X. Chang

entry.summary: Introduces ReVSI, a rebuilt evaluation benchmark for VLM 3D spatial reasoning that addresses systematic validity issues in existing benchmarks caused by annotation artifacts and frame sampling limitations.

entry.title: Global Context or Local Detail? Adaptive Visual Grounding for Hallucination Mitigation

author.name: Yubo Jiang, Xin Yang, Abudukelimu Wuerkaixi, Zheming Yuan, Xuxin Cheng, Fengying Xie, Zhiguo Jiang, Cao Liu, Ke Zeng, Haopeng Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces PND, a training-free decoding framework that mitigates VLM object hallucination through dual-path contrast: amplifying visual evidence (positive path) while degrading unreliable information (negative path).

entry.title: AutoGUI-v2: A Comprehensive Multi-Modal GUI Functionality Understanding Benchmark

author.name: Hongxin Li, Xiping Wang, Jingran Su, Zheng Ju, Yuntao Chen, Qing Li, Zhaoxiang Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces AutoGUI-v2, a comprehensive benchmark evaluating whether VLM-based GUI agents truly understand interface functionality and transition logic, going beyond static grounding to predictive mental models.

entry.title: NeuroClaw Technical Report

author.name: Cheng Wang, Zhibin He, Zhihao Peng, Shengyuan Liu, Yufan Hu, Lichao Sun, Xiang Li, Yixuan Yuan

entry.summary: NeuroClaw is a domain-specialized multi-agent research assistant for reproducible neuroimaging research that operates directly on raw neuroimaging data across modalities (sMRI, fMRI, dMRI, EEG). It integrates environment management with Docker support and automated pipelines for executable and reproducible workflows.

entry.title: DeepSignature: Digitally Signed, Content-Encoding Watermarks for Robust and Transparent Image Authentication

author.name: Mathias Graf, Marco Willi, Melanie Mathys, Michael Aerni, Christian Schwarzer, Martin Melchior, Michael H. Graber

entry.summary: DeepSignature integrates digital signatures with deep neural networks for image watermarking, enabling cryptographically verifiable source attribution and integrity validation. Neural networks generate content-encoding watermarks that are imperceptibly embedded and robustly extractable.

entry.title: SeaEvo: Advancing Algorithm Discovery with Strategy Space Evolution

author.name: Sichun Luo, Yi Huang, Haochen Luo, Fengyuan Liu, Guanzhi Deng, Lei Li, Qinghua Yao, Zefa Hu, Junlan Feng, Qi Liu

entry.summary: SeaEvo introduces a strategy-space layer for LLM-guided evolutionary search that organizes natural-language strategy descriptions into a population-level structure. This helps distinguish syntactically different implementations of the same idea and preserves strategically promising but lower-fitness directions.

entry.title: RecoverFormer: End-to-End Contact-Aware Recovery for Humanoid Robots

author.name: Zihui Liu

entry.summary: RecoverFormer is an end-to-end humanoid recovery policy using a causal transformer over observation history with novel latent recovery mode and contact affordance heads. It learns to switch among recovery behaviors (stepping, hand contact, center-of-mass reshaping) under model mismatch.

entry.title: Tube Diffusion Policy: Reactive Visual-Tactile Policy Learning for Contact-rich Manipulation

author.name: Teng Xue, Alberto Rigo, Bingjian Huang, Jiayi Shen, Zhengtong Xu, Nick Colonnese, Amirhossein H. Memar

entry.summary: Tube Diffusion Policy proposes a reactive visual-tactile policy learning framework for contact-rich manipulation that addresses the reactivity limitations of action chunking. Enables rapid response to unforeseen observations during execution using tactile feedback.

entry.title: AsyncShield: A Plug-and-Play Edge Adapter for Asynchronous Cloud-based VLA Navigation

author.name: Kai Yang, Zedong Chu, Yingnan Guo, Zhengbo Wang, Shichao Xie, Yanfen Shen, Xiaolong Wu, Xing Li, Mu Xu

entry.summary: AsyncShield addresses the latency and jitter issues of cloud-deployed VLA models for mobile navigation by using deterministic physical spatial mapping instead of time-series prediction. Provides a plug-and-play framework that corrects spatiotemporal misalignment from stale cloud inferences.

entry.title: Instrumental Variable Analysis Without Structural Equations

author.name: Zikai Shen, Dimitri Meunier, Houssam Zenati, Arthur Gretton, Nathan Kallus, Aur\'elien Bibaut

entry.summary: Develops a framework for instrumental variable analysis that avoids assuming structural equations have exact solutions. Inference targets a quantity that coincides with usual estimands when solutions exist but remains well-defined otherwise, making IV analysis more robust.

entry.title: Fail safe(r) at alignment by channeling reward-hacking into a "spillway" motivation

author.name: Anders Cairns Woodruff

entry.summary: Proposes 'spillway design' - deliberately channeling reward-hacking into a curated bundle of benign motivations rather than trying to eliminate it entirely. Argues this could decrease worst-case outcomes and enable inference-time correction via satiation of benign reward-seeking traits.

entry.title: QuantClaw: Precision Where It Matters for OpenClaw

author.name: Manyi Zhang, Ji-Fu Li, Zhongao Sun, Xiaohao Liu, Zhenhua Dong, Xianzhi Yu, Haoli Bai, Xiaobo Xia

entry.summary: Proposes QuantClaw, a plug-and-play precision routing plugin for the OpenClaw agent system that dynamically assigns quantization precision based on task characteristics, reducing costs while maintaining performance on complex workflows.

entry.title: Foundation models for discovering robust biomarkers of neurological disorders from dynamic functional connectivity

author.name: Deepank Girish, Yi Hao Chan, Sukrit Gupta, Jing Xia, Jagath C. Rajapakse

entry.summary: Proposes RE-CONFIRM, a framework for evaluating the robustness of potential biomarker candidates identified by deep learning models including brain foundation models, tested across five large datasets of neurological disorders.

entry.title: Optimal Question Selection from a Large Question Bank for Clinical Field Recovery in Conversational Psychiatric Intake

author.name: Guan Gui, Peter Zandi, Jacob Taylor, Ananya Joshi

entry.summary: Formulates psychiatric intake as a question-selection problem with a benchmark of 655 clinician-authored questions and synthetic patient vignettes, evaluating LLM-based conversational AI for structured clinical information gathering.

entry.title: ResRank: Unifying Retrieval and Listwise Reranking via End-to-End Joint Training with Residual Passage Compression

author.name: Xiaojie Ke, Shuai Zhang, Liansheng Sun, Yongjin Wang, Hengjun Jiang, Xiangkun Liu, Cunxin Gu, Jian Xu, Guanjun Jiang

entry.summary: Presents ResRank, a unified retrieval-reranking framework that compresses passages into compact token representations for LLM-based listwise reranking, addressing both the 'lost in the middle' phenomenon and inference latency.

entry.title: Preserve Support, Not Correspondence: Dynamic Routing for Offline Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Zhancun Mu, Guangyu Zhao, Yiwu Zhong, Chi Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes DROL, a latent-conditioned one-step actor for offline RL that uses top-1 dynamic routing to separately optimize Q-value improvement and data support preservation, avoiding the compromise forced by paired training.

entry.title: SOLAR-RL: Semi-Online Long-horizon Assignment Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Jichao Wang, Liuyang Bian, Yufeng Zhou, Han Xiao, Yue Pan, Guozhi Wang, Hao Wang, Zhaoxiong Wang, Yafei Wen, Xiaoxin Chen, Shuai Ren, Lingfang Zeng

entry.summary: Proposes SOLAR-RL, a semi-online RL framework for training MLLM GUI agents that bridges offline and online RL by integrating trajectory-level semantics without full online interaction costs. Addresses task completion and execution quality in dynamic GUI navigation.

entry.title: Aligning Dense Retrievers with LLM Utility via DistillationAligning Dense Retrievers with LLM Utility via Distillation

author.name: Rajinder Sandhu, Di Mu, Cheng Chang, Md Shahriar Tasjid, Himanshu Rai, Maksims Volkovs, Ga Wu

entry.summary: Proposes Utility-Aligned Embeddings (UAE) for RAG that trains a bi-encoder to imitate utility distributions from LLM perplexity reduction. Uses a Utility-Modulated InfoNCE objective to inject graded utility signals into dense retrieval.

entry.title: CODA: Coordination via On-Policy Diffusion for Multi-Agent Offline Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Marcel Hedman, Kale-ab Abebe Tessera, Juan Claude Formanek, Anya Sims, Riccardo Zamboni, Trevor McInroe, John Torr, Elliot Fosong

entry.summary: Introduces CODA, a diffusion-based multi-agent trajectory generator for offline MARL that generates synthetic experience conditioned on the current joint policy to enable co-adaptation. Addresses coordination failure from static off-policy data.

entry.title: When Does Removing LayerNorm Help? Activation Bounding as a Regime-Dependent Implicit Regularizer

author.name: Lucky Verma

entry.summary: Studies when Dynamic Tanh (DyT) as LayerNorm replacement helps vs hurts, showing it's a regime-dependent implicit regularizer. DyT improves in low-data regimes but worsens in high-data settings; benefits diminish with scale.

entry.title: On the Memorization of Consistency Distillation for Diffusion Models

author.name: Bingqing Jiang, Difan Zou

entry.summary: Analyzes how consistency distillation reshapes memorization behavior in diffusion models, showing that distillation can amplify or restructure memorization from teacher models in ways not previously understood.

entry.title: OptProver: Bridging Olympiad and Optimization through Continual Training in Formal Theorem Proving

author.name: Chenyi Li, Yanchen Nie, Zhengyu Ming, Gong Zhang, Kun Yuan, Zaiwen Wen

entry.summary: Presents OptProver, a formal theorem prover that transfers from Olympiad-level math to undergraduate optimization through continual training with optimization-focused data curation, addressing distribution shift between mathematical domains.

entry.title: Learning Interpretable PDE Representations for Generative Reconstructions with Structured Sparsity

author.name: Valerie Tsao, Nathaniel Chaney, Manolis Veveakis

entry.summary: Introduces LatentPDE, a latent diffusion framework where latent variables are directly parameterized as PDE coefficients and source terms, enabling interpretable physics-compliant reconstruction from sparse observations with super-resolution.

entry.title: When to Commit? Towards Variable-Size Self-Contained Blocks for Discrete Diffusion Language Models

author.name: Danny Wang, Ruihong Qiu, Zi Huang

entry.summary: Introduces self-containedness as a principled criterion for deciding when to commit token blocks in discrete diffusion language models, addressing the training-inference mismatch in blockwise semi-autoregressive decoding.

entry.title: Coverage-Based Calibration for Post-Training Quantization via Weighted Set Cover over Outlier Channels

author.name: Ibne Farabi Shihab, Sanjeda Akter, Anuj Sharma

entry.summary: Formulates PTQ calibration sample selection as a weighted set cover problem over outlier channels, ensuring calibration data activates critical high-magnitude channels that dominate quantization error.

entry.title: Latent-Hysteresis Graph ODEs: Modeling Coupled Topology-Feature Evolution via Continuous Phase Transitions

author.name: Qinhan Hou, Jing Tang

entry.summary: Proposes Hysteresis Graph ODE (HGODE) that couples feature evolution with latent topological potential through double-well edge potentials, overcoming the monostability trap where Graph ODEs converge to global consensus.

entry.title: Efficient learning by implicit exploration in bandit problems with side observations

author.name: Tomas Kocak, Gergely Neu, Michal Valko, Remi Munos

entry.summary: Proposes an algorithm for online learning with partial observability and side observations that achieves near-optimal regret without requiring advance knowledge of the observation system, extending to combinatorial optimization settings.

entry.title: Diffusion-Guided Feature Selection via Nishimori Temperature: Noise-Based Spectral Embedding

author.name: Vasiliy S. Usatyuk, Denis A. Sapozhnikov, Sergey I. Egorov

entry.summary: Proposes Noise-Based Spectral Embedding (NBSE), a physics-informed feature selection framework using Nishimori temperature and Bethe Hessian singularity to identify informative features without greedy search in high-dimensional data.

entry.title: Audio2Tool: Bridging Spoken Language Understanding and Function Calling

author.name: Ramit Pahwa, Apoorva Beedu, Parivesh Priye, Rutu Gandhi, Saloni Takawale, Aruna Baijal, Zengli Yang

entry.summary: Introduces Audio2Tool, a large-scale benchmark of ~30,000 queries for evaluating tool-calling capabilities of speech language models across smart car, smart home, and wearables domains with multi-tier complexity.

entry.title: Large language model-enabled automated data extraction for concrete materials informatics

author.name: Zhanzhao Li, Kengran Yang, Qiyao He, Kai Gong

entry.summary: Introduces an LLM-powered pipeline for automated extraction of materials data from scientific literature, achieving F1 of 0.97 and extracting 9,000 records with 100+ attributes from 27,000 publications in one hour for concrete materials.

entry.title: MOCA: A Transformer-based Modular Causal Inference Framework with One-way Cross-attention and Cutting Feedback

author.name: Lei Wang, Debashis Ghosh

entry.summary: Proposes MOCA, a transformer-based causal inference framework with modular separation of treatment and outcome modeling via one-way cross-attention, preventing outcome information from contaminating treatment representations.

entry.title: Dissociating Decodability and Causal Use in Bracket-Sequence Transformers

author.name: Aryan Sharma, Cutter Dawes, Shivam Raval

entry.summary: Examines whether decodable representations in transformers trained on Dyck language (balanced brackets) are causally used. Finds that depth, distance, and top-of-stack signals are all decodable, but their causal roles diverge - attention to matching brackets is causally necessary while depth information is not.

entry.title: SHAPE: Unifying Safety, Helpfulness and Pedagogy for Educational LLMs

author.name: Sihang (Nagi), Zhao, Kangrui Yu, Youliang Yuan, Pinjia He, Hongyi Wen

entry.summary: Identifies 'pedagogical jailbreaks' where students trick educational LLMs into giving answers rather than scaffolded instruction. Introduces SHAPE benchmark (9,087 student-question pairs) and a graph-augmented tutoring pipeline using knowledge-mastery graphs.

entry.title: MetaEarth3D: Unlocking World-scale 3D Generation with Spatially Scalable Generative Modeling

author.name: Jinqi Cao, Zhiping Yu, Baihong Lin, Chenyang Liu, Zhenwei Shi, Zhengxia Zou

entry.summary: Introduces MetaEarth3D for world-scale 3D generation from satellite imagery, arguing that spatial scale should be a core dimension of generative AI intelligence. Addresses the gap in modeling geographic environments across thousands of kilometers.

entry.title: Unified Multi-Foundation-Model Slide Representation for Pan-Cancer Recognition and Text-Guided Tumor Localization

author.name: Tianyang Wang, Ziyu Su, Abdul Rehman Akbar, Usama Sajjad, Lina Gokhale, Charles Rabolli, Wei Chen, Anil Parwani, Muhammad Khalid Khan Niazi

entry.summary: Presents ASTRA, a pan-cancer framework integrating heterogeneous pathology foundation model representations into unified slide-level embeddings through mixture-of-experts, masked reconstruction, and contrastive alignment with structured pathology prompts.

entry.title: BrickNet: Graph-Backed Generative Brick Assembly

author.name: Peter Kulits, Cordelia Schmid

entry.summary: BrickNet trains a language model on 100K+ human-designed LEGO objects to generate brick build sequences, using graph-based representations to handle thousands of part types with diverse connection semantics and physical constraints.

entry.title: Identity-Decoupled Anonymization for Visual Evidence in Multi-modal Retrieval-Augmented Generation

author.name: Zehua Cheng, Wei Dai, Jiahao Sun

entry.summary: Proposes identity-decoupled anonymization for visual evidence in multimodal RAG systems, using a disentangled variational encoder to separate identity from attribute codes while preserving non-identity visual cues.

entry.title: Hallo-Live: Real-Time Streaming Joint Audio-Video Avatar Generation with Asynchronous Dual-Stream and Human-Centric Preference Distillation

author.name: Chunyu Li, Jiaye Li, Ruiqiao Mei, Haoyuan Xia, Hao Zhu, Jingdong Wang, Siyu Zhu

entry.summary: Hallo-Live is a streaming framework for real-time joint audio-visual avatar generation using asynchronous dual-stream diffusion with Future-Expanding Attention for reduced articulation lag.

entry.title: DynProto: Dynamic Prototype Evolution for Out-of-Distribution Detection

author.name: Yanqi Wu, Xinhua Lu, Runhe Lai, Qichao Chen, Jia-Xin Zhuang, Wei-Shi Zheng, Ruixuan Wang

entry.summary: Proposes DynProto for OOD detection in VLMs that dynamically learns OOD prototypes during testing using only in-distribution information, addressing the limitation of predefined OOD label sets.

entry.title: Latent Inter-Frame Pruning: A Training-Free Method Bridging Traditional Video Compression and Modern Diffusion Transformers for Efficient Generation

author.name: Dennis Menn, Chih-Hsien Chou

entry.summary: Proposes Latent Inter-frame Pruning, a training-free method that reduces video generation computation by pruning redundant latent patches across frames, drawing analogy to traditional video compression.

entry.title: Exploring Audio Hallucination in Egocentric Video Understanding

author.name: Ashish Seth, Xinhao Mei, Changsheng Zhao, Varun Nagaraja, Ernie Chang, Gregory P. Meyer, Gael Le Lan, Yunyang Xiong, Vikas Chandra, Yangyang Shi, Dinesh Manocha, Zhipeng Cai

entry.summary: Presents a systematic evaluation framework for audio hallucination in egocentric video understanding, showing that large audio-visual language models often hallucinate sounds from visual cues that are visible but not actually heard.

entry.title: SMoES: Soft Modality-Guided Expert Specialization in MoE-VLMs

author.name: Zi-Hao Bo, Yaqian Li, Anzhou Hou, Rinyoichi Takezoe, Ertao Zhao, Tianxiang Pan, Jiale Yan, Mo Guang, Kaiwen Long

entry.summary: Proposes SMoES for MoE-based VLMs, introducing soft modality-guided expert specialization with dynamic modality scores, expert binning, and mutual information regularization for better expert routing.

entry.title: Robust Deepfake Detection, NTIRE 2026 Challenge: Report

author.name: Benedikt Hopf, Radu Timofte, Chenfan Qu, Junchi Li, Fei Wu, Dagong Lu, Mufeng Yao, Xinlei Xu, Fengjun Guo, Yongwei Tang, Zhiqiang Yang, Zhiqiang Wu, Jia Wen Seow, Hong Vin Koay, Haodong Ren, Feng Xu, Shuai Chen, Minh-Khoa Le-Phan, Minh-Hoang Le, Trong-Le Do, Minh-Triet Tran, Chih-Yu Jian, Yi-Fan Wang, Bang-Kang Chen, You-Chen Chao, Chia-Ming Lee, Fu-En Yang, Yu-Chiang Frank Wang, Chih-Chung Hsu, Aashish Negi, Hardik Sharma, Prateek Shaily, Jayant Kumar, Sachin Chaudhary, Akshay Dudhane, Praful Hambarde, Amit Shukla, Jielun Peng, Yabin Wang, Yaqi Li, Jincheng Liu, Xiaopeng Hong, Krish Wadhwani, Liam Fitzpatrick, Utkarsh Tiwari, Bilel Benjdira, Anas M. Ali, Wadii Boulila, Cristian Lazo Quispe, Aishwarya A, Akshara S, Ashwathi N, Jiachen Tu, Guoyi Xu, Yaoxin Jiang, Jiajia Liu, Yaokun Shi
