entry.summary: Proposes a physics-informed neural network for power system state estimation that's robust against false data injection attacks without adversarial training. Embeds power-flow constraints into the learning objective.

entry.title: Conformal PM2.5 Mapping Under Spatial Covariate Shift: Satellite-Reanalysis Fusion for Africa's Green Industrial Transition

author.name: Yaw Osei Adjei (Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology, Kumasi, Ghana), Davis Opoku (Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology, Kumasi, Ghana), Ephraim Abotsi (Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology, Kumasi, Ghana), Kwadwo Owusu Amanqua (Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology, Kumasi, Ghana), Oliver Kornyo (Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology, Kumasi, Ghana), Elisha Soglo-Ahianyo (Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology, Kumasi, Ghana), Cephas Anertey Abbey (Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology, Kumasi, Ghana)

entry.summary: Develops a satellite-reanalysis PM2.5 fusion system for Africa using conformal prediction and spatial cross-validation. Honestly reports low R² under proper spatial CV, contrasting with inflated random-split benchmarks.

entry.title: On-Device Vision Training, Deployment, and Inference on a Thumb-Sized Microcontroller

author.name: Jeremy Ellis

entry.summary: Presents a complete on-device ML pipeline (training + inference) running on a $15-40 microcontroller in ~1750 lines of C++. Achieves 3-class image classification with CNN trained in 9 minutes on-device.

entry.title: Complex SGD and Directional Bias in Reproducing Kernel Hilbert Spaces

author.name: Natanael Alpay, Emeric Battaglia

entry.summary: Proposes complex-valued SGD with convergence guarantees without analyticity constraints, extending to reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces. Studies directional bias induced by complex SGD.

entry.title: Contrastive Learning for Multimodal Human Activity Recognition with Limited Labeled Data

author.name: Long Jing, Zhixiong Yang, Yajun Zhang, Xinlong Feng

entry.summary: Proposes CLMM, a contrastive learning framework for multimodal human activity recognition with limited labels, using CNN-DiffTransformer encoder for cross-modal learning in a two-stage training strategy.

entry.title: Layer Embedding Deep Fusion Graph Neural Network

author.name: Taihua Xu, Genhao Tian, Jicong Fan, Xibei Yang, Qinghua Zhang, Yun Cui

entry.summary: Proposes Layer Embedding Deep Fusion GNN addressing over-smoothing and limited heterophily handling by embedding layer information. Targets message passing limitations on heterophilic graphs.

entry.title: Robust and Clinically Reliable EEG Biomarkers: A Cross Population Framework for Generalizable Parkinson's Disease Detection

author.name: Nicholas R. Rasmussen, Longwei Wang, Rodrigue Rizk, Md Rezwanul Akter Pallab, Samuel Stuwart, Martina Mancini, Arun Singh, KC Santosh

entry.summary: Proposes a population-aware evaluation framework for EEG biomarkers in Parkinson's disease detection, systematically testing cross-population generalization across clinical cohorts using n-gram expansion of train-test configurations.

entry.title: End-to-End Learning for Partially-Observed Time Series with PyPOTS

author.name: Wenjie Du, Yiyuan Yang, Tianxiang Zhan, Qingsong Wen

entry.summary: Tutorial paper introducing PyPOTS, an open-source Python ecosystem for end-to-end learning on partially-observed time series, covering imputation, forecasting, classification, clustering, and anomaly detection.

entry.title: Fed-DLoRA: Efficient Wireless Federated Learning with Dynamic Low-Rank Adaptation

author.name: Huaicheng Li, Junhui Zhao, Haoyu Quan, Xiaoming Wang

entry.summary: Proposes Fed-DLoRA combining federated learning with dynamic LoRA for IoV applications, reducing parameters and communication costs while adapting rank dynamically during training.

entry.title: IMPA-Net: Meteorology-Aware Multi-Scale Attention and Dynamic Loss for Extreme Convective Radar Nowcasting

author.name: Haofei Cui, Guangxin He, Juanzhen Sun, Jingjia Luo, Haonan Chen, Xiaoran Zhuang, Mingxuan Chen, Xian Xiao

entry.summary: Introduces IMPA-Net for 0-2 hour convective radar nowcasting with meteorologically-informed multi-scale attention and dynamic loss to address the smoothing problem in deep learning weather prediction.

entry.title: An Automatic Ground Collision Avoidance System with Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Seyyid Osman Sevgili, Atahan Cilan, Mahir Demir, \"Ozg\"un Can Y\"ur\"utken, \"Umit Can Bekar

entry.summary: Develops an AI-based Automatic Ground Collision Avoidance System for jet trainers using reinforcement learning, with line-of-sight terrain queries in a limited observation space.

entry.title: 2D Pre-Training for 3D Pose Estimation

author.name: Liyao Jiang, Ruichen Chen, Keith G. Mills

entry.summary: Studies the effect of 2D pre-training on 3D human pose estimation, expanding compatibility with additional datasets and analyzing how model size and pre-training data affect downstream 3D HPE performance.

entry.title: STAND: Semantic Anchoring Constraint with Dual-Granularity Disambiguation for Remote Sensing Image Change Captioning

author.name: Yanpei Gong, Beichen Zhang, Hao Wang, Zhaobo Qi, Xinyan Liu, Yuanrong Xu, Ruiyang Gao, Weigang Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces STAND for remote sensing image change captioning, using semantic anchoring constraints and dual-granularity disambiguation to resolve ambiguities in viewpoint, scale, and prior knowledge when describing differences between satellite images.

entry.title: Modeling Induced Pleasure through Cognitive Appraisal Prediction via Multimodal Fusion

author.name: Nastaran Dab, Raziyeh Zall, Mohammadreza Kangavari

entry.summary: Introduces a computational model to infer video-induced pleasure via cognitive appraisal variables, addressing noisy labels, semantic gaps between positive emotions and pleasure, and limited interpretability through theory-driven multimodal fusion.

entry.title: EPM-RL: Reinforcement Learning for On-Premise Product Mapping in E-Commerce

author.name: Minhyeong Yu, Wonduk Seo

entry.summary: Proposes EPM-RL, a reinforcement learning approach for product mapping in e-commerce that avoids expensive LLM APIs while handling noisy seller-modified product titles for on-premise deployment.

entry.title: Modeling Behavioral Intensity and Transitions for Generative Recommendation

author.name: Wenxuan Yang, Xiaoyang Xu, Hanyu Zhang, Zhexuan Xu, Wanqiang Xiong, Zhaoqun Chen

entry.summary: Proposes BITRec, a generative multi-behavior recommendation framework that models behavioral intensity and transitions rather than treating behaviors as uniform tokens. Introduces structural mechanisms to capture how users shift between different interaction types.

entry.title: GSC-QEMit: A Telemetry-Driven Hierarchical Forecast-and-Bandit Framework for Adaptive Quantum Error Mitigation

author.name: Steven Szachara, Sheeraja Rajakrishnan, Dylan Jay Van Allen, Jason Pollack, Travis Desell, Daniel Krutz

entry.summary: Introduces GSC-QEMit, a framework for adaptive quantum error mitigation that combines self-organizing maps for context clustering, Gaussian process forecasting for fidelity prediction, and contextual bandits for selecting mitigation strategies under time-varying noise.

entry.title: TTS-PRISM: A Perceptual Reasoning and Interpretable Speech Model for Fine-Grained Diagnosis

author.name: Xi Wang, Jie Wang, Xingchen Song, Baijun Song, Jingran Xie, Jiahe Shao, Zijian Lin, Di Wu, Meng Meng, Jian Luan, Zhiyong Wu

entry.summary: Proposes TTS-PRISM, a multi-dimensional diagnostic framework for Mandarin text-to-speech quality assessment with 12 dimensions spanning stability to expressiveness. Uses adversarial perturbations and instruction tuning for fine-grained evaluation.

entry.title: Aggregate vs. Personalized Judges in Business Idea Evaluation: Evidence from Expert Disagreement

author.name: Wataru Hirota, Tomoki Taniguchi, Tomoko Ohkuma, Kosuke Takahashi, Takahiro Omi, Kosuke Arima, Takuto Asakura, Chung-Chi Chen, Tatsuya Ishigaki

entry.summary: Studies whether automatic business idea evaluation should approximate aggregate consensus or model individual evaluators. Introduces PBIG-DATA dataset with ~3,000 expert scores across 300 patent-grounded product ideas on six business dimensions.

entry.title: WeatherSeg: Weather-Robust Image Segmentation using Teacher-Student Dual Learning and Classifier-Updating Attention

author.name: Zhang Zhang, Yifeng Zeng, Jinquan Pan, Yinghui Pan

entry.summary: Proposes WeatherSeg, a semi-supervised segmentation framework for autonomous driving in adverse weather, combining dual teacher-student weight sharing with classifier weight updating attention mechanism.

entry.title: ATTN-FIQA: Interpretable Attention-based Face Image Quality Assessment with Vision Transformers

author.name: Guray Ozgur, Tahar Chettaoui, Eduarda Caldeira, Jan Niklas Kolf, Marco Huber, Andrea Atzori, Naser Damer, Fadi Boutros

entry.summary: Proposes ATTN-FIQA, a training-free face image quality assessment method using pre-softmax attention scores from Vision Transformer-based face recognition models as quality indicators.

entry.title: On the Complementarity of Quantum and Classical Features: Adaptive Hybrid Quantum-Classical Feature Fusion for Breast Cancer Classification

author.name: Yasmin Rodrigues Sobrinho, Jo\~ao Renato Ribeiro Manesco, Jo\~ao Paulo Papa

entry.summary: Proposes a hybrid quantum-classical architecture for breast cancer diagnosis that fuses features from classical CNNs and quantum circuits, exploring trainable and deterministic quantum paradigms with three progressive fusion strategies.

entry.title: LatentBurst: A Fast and Efficient Multi Frame Super-Resolution for Hexadeca-Bayer Pattern CIS images

author.name: Sangwook Baek, Vin Van Duong, Karam Park, Pilkyu Park

entry.summary: LatentBurst proposes a multi-frame super-resolution network for hexadeca-Bayer pattern sensor images, handling demosaicing, denoising, fusion, and super-resolution for mobile device deployment.

entry.title: H-SemiS: Hierarchical Fusion of Semi and Self-Supervised Learning for Knee Osteoarthritis Severity Grading

author.name: Chandravardhan Singh Raghaw, Anushka Parwal, Shahid Shafi Dar, Prajakta Darade, Nagendra Kumar

entry.summary: H-SemiS proposes hierarchical semi-supervised learning with self-supervision for knee osteoarthritis grading, decomposing multi-class grading into sequential binary sub-tasks within a teacher-student framework.

entry.title: SolarFCD: A Large-Scale Dataset and Benchmark for Solar Fault Classification in Photovoltaic Systems

author.name: Misbah Ijaz, Saif Ur Rehman Khan, Abd Ur Rehman, Arooj Zaib, Sebastian Vollmer, Andreas Dengel, Muhammad Nabeel Asim

entry.summary: SolarFCD introduces a large-scale multi-modal dataset of solar panel defects (RGB/Drone + Thermal IR) with 4,435 images across four defect classes, consolidating three existing datasets.

entry.title: Learning to Decipher from Pixels -- A Case Study of Copiale

author.name: Lei Kang, Giuseppe De Gregorio, Raphaela Heil, Alicia Forn\'es, Be\'ata Megyesi

entry.summary: Proposes an end-to-end approach to directly map handwritten cipher images to plaintext, bypassing the traditional transcription step. Uses the Copiale cipher as a case study with a novel text-line-level dataset.

entry.title: Mapping License Plate Recoverability Under Extreme Viewing Angles for Oppor-tunistic Urban Sensing

author.name: Igor Adamenko, Orpaz Ben Aharon, Yehudit Aperstein, Alexander Apartsin

entry.summary: Introduces recoverability maps, a method for quantifying the boundary between recoverable and unrecoverable license plate information under extreme viewing angles, combining synthetic simulation with AI-based restoration.

entry.title: 6thGrid-Net: Unified Remote Sensing Image Dehazing Based on Color Restoration and Edge-Preserving

author.name: Runci Bai, Kui Jiang, Xiang Chen, Chen Wu, Dianjie Lu, Guijuan Zhang, Zhuoran Zheng

entry.summary: Proposes 6th Grid-Net, an efficient unified remote sensing image dehazing framework designed for edge devices, combining color restoration and edge-preserving capabilities.

entry.title: Computer Vision-Based Early Detection of Container Loss at Sea

author.name: Vishakha Lall, Capt. Stanley S Pinto, Capt. Chu Xing Peng, Wu Kaiwen

entry.summary: Presents a computer vision system for early detection of destabilized shipping containers at sea using existing onboard cameras, addressing the IMO's new mandatory reporting requirements.

entry.title: Graph-augmented Segmentation of Complex Shapes in Laser Powder bed Fusion for Enhanced In Situ Inspection

author.name: Stefano Raimondo (Department of Mechanical Engineering, Politecnico di Milano, Milan, Italy), Matteo Bugatti (Department of Mechanical Engineering, Politecnico di Milano, Milan, Italy), Marco Grasso (Department of Mechanical Engineering, Politecnico di Milano, Milan, Italy)

entry.summary: Proposes a graph-augmented segmentation approach for laser powder bed fusion manufacturing inspection that handles industrial illumination variability and layer-to-layer intensity changes.

entry.title: An Affordable,Wearable Stereo-Eye-Tracking Platform

author.name: Alexander Zimmer, Yasmeen Abdrabou, Enkelejda Kasneci

entry.summary: Presents an affordable, open-source wearable stereo eye-tracking platform supporting multiple tracking paradigms within a single hardware configuration for research purposes.

entry.title: Point Cloud Registration for Fusion between SPECT MPI and CTA Images

author.name: Ni Yao, Xiangyu Liu, Shaojie Tang, Danyang Sun, Chuang Han, Yanting Li, Jiaofen Nan, Chengyang Li, Fubao Zhu, Chen Zhao, Zhihui Xu, Weihua Zhou

entry.summary: Proposes a registration and fusion framework for SPECT MPI and CTA cardiac imaging using U-Net segmentation and point cloud registration to align functional and structural cardiac information. Addresses cross-modality misregistration challenges in clinical cardiac evaluation.

entry.title: RACANet: Reliability-Aware Crowd Anchor Network for RGB-T Crowd Counting

author.name: Jinghao Shi, Mengqi Lei, Kunliang He, Yun Li, Wei Bao, Siqi Li

entry.summary: RACANet proposes a two-stage fusion framework for RGB-Thermal crowd counting that explicitly models local spatial discrepancies and modality reliability at the positional level. The approach introduces a lightweight cross-modal fusion with reliability-aware anchor mechanisms.

entry.title: Aycromo: An Open-Source Platform for Automatic Chromosome Detection in Metaphase Images Based on Deep Learning

author.name: Jorge L. A. Lima, Filipe R. Cordeiro

entry.summary: Aycromo is an open-source desktop platform for AI-assisted chromosome detection and karyotyping, built on Electron and ONNX Runtime. It provides a clinical-ready interface for cytogeneticists to use deep learning models for chromosome analysis with manual correction capabilities.

entry.title: CT-Guided Spatially-varying Regularization for Voxel-Wise Deformable Whole-Body PET Registration

author.name: Xiangcen Wu, Ruohua Chen, Sichun Li, Qianye Yang, Sheng Liu, Jianjun Liu, Zhaoheng Xie

entry.summary: Proposes CT-guided spatially-varying regularization for whole-body PET registration, using CT structural information to apply different regularization strengths for rigid structures versus soft tissues in deformable registration.

entry.title: An Efficient Beam Search Algorithm for Active Perception in Mobile Robotics

author.name: Kaixian Qu, Han Wang, Victor Klemm, Cesar Cadena, Marco Hutter

entry.summary: Proposes node-wise beam search algorithms for active perception in mobile robotics as scalable alternatives to TSP-based approaches. Addresses local optima and parameter sensitivity issues in standard beam search for informative path planning.

entry.title: Projected Attainable Speed Space: A Driving Efficiency Metric Connecting Instantaneous Evaluation to Travel Time

author.name: Xiaohua Zhao, Zhaowei Huang, Chen Chen, Haiyi Yang

entry.summary: Proposes the Projected Attainable Speed Space (PASS) model for assessing autonomous vehicle driving efficiency, connecting instantaneous metrics to travel-time outcomes by integrating kinematic and spatial traffic information.

entry.title: Hybrid A*-Based Reverse Path-Planning of a Vehicle with Trailer System

author.name: Xincheng Cao, Haochong Chen, Bilin Aksun-Guvenc, Levent Guvenc, Brian Link, Peter J Richmond, Dokyung Yim, Shihong Fan, John Harber

entry.summary: Presents a modified Hybrid A* algorithm for reverse path planning of vehicle-trailer systems that incorporates collision avoidance with surrounding obstacles. Addresses a practical gap where existing trailer reverse-motion planners lack integrated obstacle avoidance.

entry.title: Computational Design and Co-Robotic Fabrication for Material Reuse in Architecture

author.name: Arash Adel (Princeton University), Daniel Ruan (Princeton University), Ruxin Xie (Princeton University)

entry.summary: Proposes an integrated framework coupling computational design with human-robot collaborative fabrication to enable reuse of reclaimed materials (especially timber) in architectural construction. Addresses circular economy goals by handling heterogeneous salvaged material inventories.

entry.title: Alignment Through Rational AI: a testable approach

author.name: John Matrix

entry.summary: Argues that the orthogonality thesis may not fully apply when goals describe discoverable properties, proposing that sufficiently rational AI could converge on certain values through logical reasoning and empirical investigation. Suggests a testable framework for alignment through rational inquiry.

entry.title: On the Properties of Feature Attribution for Supervised Contrastive Learning

author.name: Leonardo Arrighi, Julia Eva Belloni, Aur\'elie Gallet, Ivan Gentile, Matteo Lippi, Marco Zullich

entry.summary: Analyzes feature attribution properties for supervised contrastive learning (SCL), comparing explainability between SCL and cross-entropy trained models. Examines how the lack of an explicit classification layer in SCL affects standard explanation methods.

entry.title: BiTA: Bidirectional Gated Recurrent Unit-Transformer Aggregator in a Temporal Graph Network Framework for Alert Prediction in Computer Networks

author.name: Zahra Makki Nayeri, Mohsen Rezvani

entry.summary: Proposes BiTA, a bidirectional GRU-Transformer aggregator for temporal graph networks applied to alert prediction in computer networks. Combines bidirectional and multi-scale temporal aggregation for cybersecurity applications.

entry.title: A Differentiable Framework for Global Circulation Model Precipitation Bias Correction

author.name: Kamlesh Sawadekar, Seth McGinnis, Peijun Li, Chaopeng Shen

entry.summary: Proposes a differentiable bias correction framework (δCLIMBA) for Global Circulation Model precipitation outputs, addressing non-Gaussian distributions and nonlinear extremes with interpretable components.

entry.title: Task-guided Spatiotemporal Network with Diffusion Augmentation for EEG-based Dementia Diagnosis and MMSE Prediction

author.name: Xiaoyu Zheng, Xu Tian, Bin Jiao, Kunbo Cui, Hanhe Lin, Lu Shen, Jin Liu

entry.summary: Proposes a task-guided spatiotemporal network with diffusion augmentation for EEG-based dementia diagnosis and MMSE prediction, using multi-band feature fusion and task-specific guidance to reduce inter-task interference.

entry.title: Cross-Course Generalizability of SRL-Aligned Predictive Models Using Digital Learning Traces

author.name: Jakob Schwerter, Loreen Sabel, Judith Bose, Matthew L. Bernacki, Di Xu, Marko Schmellenkamp, Thomas Zeume, Philipp Doebler

entry.summary: Analyzes cross-course generalizability of SRL-aligned prediction models for STEM student performance using digital learning traces from three computer science courses at two universities.

entry.title: WebSerial Vision Training for Microcontrollers: A Browser-Based Companion to On-Device CNN Training

author.name: Jeremy Ellis

entry.summary: Presents a browser-based zero-install system for TinyML vision model training and deployment on a $15-40 ESP32 microcontroller, enabling end-to-end CNN training from firmware flashing to live inference visualization.

entry.title: Magnetic Indoor Localization through CNN Regression and Rotation Invariance

author.name: Helge Ros\'e, Konstantin Klipp, Tom Koubek, Bernd Sch\"aufele, Ilja Radusch

entry.summary: Proposes a CNN-based magnetic indoor localization system using rotation-invariant features (field norm and gravity projection) from magnetometer data, achieving precise positioning with a lightweight architecture.

entry.title: Neural Grammatical Error Correction for Romanian

author.name: Teodor-Mihai Cotet, Stefan Ruseti, Mihai Dascalu

entry.summary: Introduces the first grammatical error correction corpus for Romanian with 10k sentence pairs, adapts ERRANT for Romanian, and evaluates neural models with pretraining strategies for low-resource GEC.

entry.title: SeqShield: A Behavioral Analysis Approach to Uncover Rootkits

author.name: Paras Ghodeshwar, Sandeep K Shukla, Anand Handa, Nitesh Kumar

entry.summary: Proposes SeqShield, a behavior-based rootkit detection approach for Windows using API call sequences for dynamic analysis, including evaluation with metamorphic code variants to test robustness.

entry.title: Mammographic Lesion Segmentation with Lightweight Models: A Comparative Study

author.name: Helder Oliveira

entry.summary: Compares lightweight models (MobileNetV2, EfficientNet Lite, ENet, Fast-SCNN) against U-Net for mammographic lesion segmentation, finding MobileNetV2 with squeeze-attention achieves competitive performance with fewer parameters.

entry.title: Personalized Worked Example Generation from Student Code Submissions using Pattern-based Knowledge Components

author.name: Griffin Pitts, Muntasir Hoq, Peter Brusilovsky, Narges Norouzi, Arto Hellas, Juho Leinonen, Bita Akram

entry.summary: Presents an approach for generating personalized worked examples from student code submissions using pattern-based knowledge components, creating a pipeline that extracts recurring structural patterns from student code to guide content generation.

entry.title: Dynamically Acquiring Text Content to Enable the Classification of Lesser-known Entities for Real-world Tasks

author.name: Fahmida Alam, Ellen Riloff

entry.summary: Enables domain experts to create entity classifiers using only entity names and labels by dynamically acquiring descriptive text from web and LLM sources. Targets lesser-known entities poorly covered by existing NLP resources.

entry.title: From Skeletons to Pixels: Few-Shot Precise Event Spotting via Representation and Prediction Distillation

author.name: Zhong Han Ervin Yeoh, Jiang Kan

entry.summary: Studies distillation strategies for few-shot precise event spotting in sports, combining adaptive weight distillation and annealed multimodal distillation from skeleton to visual modalities.

entry.title: EX-FIQA: Leveraging Intermediate Early eXit Representations from Vision Transformers for Face Image Quality Assessment

author.name: Guray Ozgur, Tahar Chettaoui, Eduarda Caldeira, Jan Niklas Kolf, Andrea Atzori, Fadi Boutros, Naser Damer

entry.summary: Investigates how intermediate ViT representations contribute to face quality assessment through early exit mechanisms. Demonstrates different transformer depths capture complementary quality-relevant information.

entry.title: MAE-Based Self-Supervised Pretraining for Data-Efficient Medical Image Segmentation Using nnFormer

author.name: R. M. Krishna Sureddi, T. Satyanarayana Murthy, Nomula Varsha Reddy, Adi Kanishka, Nalla Manvika Reddy

entry.summary: Applies MAE-based self-supervised pretraining to nnFormer for volumetric medical image segmentation, addressing the need for large labeled datasets. Leverages unlabeled medical imaging data to improve training stability and reduce overfitting.

entry.title: From Pixels to Explanations: Interpretable Diabetic Retinopathy Grading with CNN-Transformer Ensembles, Visual Explainability and Vision-Language Models

author.name: Pir Bakhsh Khokhar, Carmine Gravino, Fabio Palomba, Sule Yildirim Yayilgan, Sarang Shaikh

entry.summary: Combines CNN-Transformer ensembles with visual explainability methods and vision-language models for interpretable diabetic retinopathy grading on the APTOS 2019 benchmark.

entry.title: A Heterogeneous Two-Stream Framework for Video Action Recognition with Comparative Fusion Analysis

author.name: Md. Afzalur Rahaman, Tahmid Rahman

entry.summary: DualStreamHybrid assigns different backbones to RGB (ViT-Tiny) and optical flow (MobileNetV2) streams for action recognition, arguing heterogeneous architectures better match each modality's properties.

entry.title: Emotion-Conditioned Short-Horizon Human Pose Forecasting with a Lightweight Predictive World Model

author.name: Jingni Huang, Peter Bloodsworth

entry.summary: Investigates whether facial expression-derived emotion embeddings can improve short-term human pose prediction, proposing a lightweight autoregressive predictive world model for 15-step rolling prediction.

entry.title: MIRAGE: A Micro-Interaction Relational Architecture for Grounded Exploration in Multi-Figure Artworks

author.name: Jui-Cheng Chiu, Yu-Chao Wang, Shengyang Luo, Tongyan Wang, Qi Yang, Nabin Khanal, Yingjie Victor Chen

entry.summary: Presents MIRAGE, a framework for understanding micro-interactions in multi-figure artworks by constructing structured representations of identities, poses, and gaze to scaffold exploration of artistic narratives.

entry.title: 2nd of the 5th PVUW MeViS-Audio Track: ASR-SaSaSa2VA

author.name: Zhiyu Wang, Xudong Kang, Shutao Li

entry.summary: Presents ASR-SaSaSa2VA, a resource-efficient framework for audio-guided video segmentation that converts audio to text via ASR then leverages text-based segmentation models, avoiding expensive audio-visual training.

entry.title: JSSFF: A Joint Structural-Semantic Fusion Framework for Remote Sensing Image Captioning

author.name: Swadhin Das, Vivek Yadav

entry.summary: Proposes JSSFF for remote sensing image captioning, combining structural feature extraction (dealing with occlusion and unclear edges) with semantic features for improved caption generation.

entry.title: Airspeed Forward-Invariance for Unpowered Fixed-Wing Aircraft

author.name: Huseyin Emre Tekaslan, Ella M. Atkins

entry.summary: Develops airspeed protection for unpowered fixed-wing aircraft using viability theory and Nagumo's tangency condition. Derives closed-form wind-dependent characterization of admissible guidance commands that guarantee airspeed remains within safe bounds.

entry.title: Real-Time Non-Contact Force Compensation for Wrist-Mounted Force/Torque Sensors in Haptic-Enabled Robotic Surgery Training

author.name: Walid Shaker, Mustafa Suphi Erden

entry.summary: Extends the RoboScope low-cost robotic surgery training setup with wrist-mounted force/torque sensing for haptic feedback. Develops real-time compensation for non-contact forces (gravity, bias, offsets) inherent in wrist-mounted sensor placement.

entry.title: Designing Robots to Support Parent-Child Connections: Opportunities Through Robot-Mediated Communication

author.name: Michael F Xu, Bengisu Cagiltay, Yaxin Hu, Anjun Zhu, Bilge Mutlu

entry.summary: Investigates how robots can facilitate parent-child communication rather than replace human interaction. Explores design dimensions including robot behavior strategy (passive/reactive/proactive) and communication modes (synchronous/asynchronous) through in-home studies with families.

entry.title: Trajectory Planning for an Articulated Commercial Vehicle using Model Predictive Contouring Control

author.name: A. J. Aertssen, R. G. M. Huisman, I. J. M. Besselink, J. Elfring, M. J. G. van de Molengraft

entry.summary: Extends Model Predictive Contouring Control to articulated commercial vehicles (tractor-semitrailers) with scenario-dependent anchor point weighting for different maneuvers like docking and parking.

entry.title: Real-time windrow detection from onboard tractor sensors for automated following

author.name: Lorenz Gunreben, Nico Heider, Sebastian Z\"urner, Martin Schieck, Bogdan Franczyk

entry.summary: Presents a multi-modal dataset and real-time windrow detection method for autonomous forage harvesting, combining stereo vision and LiDAR on an NVIDIA Jetson. Shows stereo sensors can approach LiDAR performance in the critical guidance range, suggesting low-cost alternatives for agricultural robotics.

entry.title: Avionic Main Fuel Pump Simulation and Fault-Diagnosis Benchmark

author.name: Felix Leonhard Janzen, Lukas Moddemann, Alexander Diedrich, Oliver Niggemann

entry.summary: Introduces a physics-informed co-simulation benchmark for aircraft main-fuel-pump fault diagnosis, with health and fault annotations. Tests unsupervised RNN-VAE and SOM-VAE baselines.

entry.title: Collocation-based Robust Physics Informed Neural Networks for time-dependent simulations of pollution propagation under thermal inversion conditions on Spitsbergen

author.name: Leszek Siwik, Maciej Sikora, Natalia Leszczy\'nska, Tomasz Maciej Ciesielski, Eirik Valseth, Manuela Bastidas Olivares, Marcin {\L}o\'s, Tomasz S{\l}u\.zalec, Jacek Leszczy\'nski, Maciej Paszy\'nski

entry.summary: Proposes a collocation-based Physics-Informed Neural Network for time-dependent pollution propagation simulation from moving sources, with mathematical guarantees on approximation error. Applied to pollution on Spitsbergen.

entry.title: K-Score: Kalman Filter as a Principled Alternative to Reward Normalization in Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Zixuan Xia, Quanxi Li

entry.summary: Proposes using a 1D Kalman filter for online reward estimation in policy gradient RL as an alternative to reward normalization. Demonstrates faster convergence on simple environments.

entry.title: Machine learning models for estimating counterfactuals in a single-arm inflammatory bowel disease study

author.name: Dan Liu, Fida K. Dankar, Jennifer C. deBruyn, Amanda Ricciuto, Anne M. Griffiths, Thomas D. Walters, Khaled EI Emam

entry.summary: Develops ML models to construct virtual control arms for single-arm inflammatory bowel disease trials, predicting counterfactual outcomes for ADA-treated pediatric Crohn's disease patients. This is an applied clinical ML paper with practical value for accelerating clinical trials.

entry.title: Cardiac Stability Theory: An Axiomatically Grounded Framework for Continuous Cardiac Health Monitoring via Smartphone Photoplethysmography

author.name: Timothy Oladunni, Farouk Ganiyu Adewumi

entry.summary: Presents Cardiac Stability Theory defining cardiovascular health as a stability margin using Lyapunov exponents and recurrence analysis, extended from ECG to smartphone PPG via domain transfer with a tiny model.

entry.title: Model-Free Inference of Investor Preferences: A Relative Entropy IRL Approach

author.name: Chen Xu

entry.summary: Uses Relative Entropy Inverse RL to recover investor reward functions from observed investment actions, with K-nearest neighbor policy estimation to handle data sparsity.

entry.title: Epicure: Multidimensional Flavor Structure in Food Ingredient Embeddings

author.name: Jakub Radzikowski, Josef Chen

entry.summary: Shows that FlavorGraph's ingredient embeddings encode at least fifteen classifiable dimensions of culinary knowledge (taste, texture, geography, etc.), using LLM-augmented curation to consolidate ingredients.

entry.title: Non-Destructive Prediction of Fruit Ripeness and Firmness Using Hyperspectral Imaging and Lightweight Machine Learning Models

author.name: Phongsakon Mark Konrad, Casper Kunstmann-Olsen, Jacek Fiutowski, Serkan Ayvaz

entry.summary: Evaluates 20 classical ML algorithms on hyperspectral imaging data for fruit ripeness and firmness prediction across five species, showing that lightweight models with proper preprocessing can match or outperform deep learning approaches.

entry.title: Context-Integrated Adversarial Learning for Predictive Modelling of Stock Price Dynamics

author.name: Alexis Lazanas, Spyros Christodoulou, Spyridon Karpouzis

entry.summary: Introduces a context-sensitive adversarial learning model for stock price prediction that combines LSTM for temporal patterns with adversarial training to handle distribution shifts in financial markets.

entry.title: A Specialized Importance-Aware Quantum Convolutional Neural Network with Ring-Topology (IA-QCNN) for MGMT Promoter Methylation Prediction in Glioblastoma

author.name: Emine Akpinar, Murat Oduncuoglu

entry.summary: Proposes a quantum CNN with ring topology and importance-aware design for predicting MGMT promoter methylation in glioblastoma from MRI, leveraging quantum superposition and entanglement for feature learning.

entry.title: AnemiaVision: Non-Invasive Anemia Detection via Smartphone Imagery Using EfficientNet-B3 with TrivialAugmentWide, Mixup Augmentation, and Persistent Patient History Management

author.name: Rahul Patel

entry.summary: Presents AnemiaVision, a web-based system for non-invasive anemia screening from smartphone photos of conjunctiva and fingernail beds using fine-tuned EfficientNet-B3 with augmentation techniques.

entry.title: An Empirical Evaluation of Locally Deployed LLMs for Bug Detection in Python Code

author.name: Jelena Ili\'c Vuli\'cevi\'c

entry.summary: Evaluates locally deployed LLMs (LLaMA 3.2 and Mistral) for Python bug detection using the BugsInPy benchmark, finding 43-45% accuracy with zero-shot prompting compared to higher accuracy from cloud-based models.

entry.title: Beyond coauthorship: semantic structure and phantom collaborators in transportation research, 1967--2025

author.name: Seongjin Choi

entry.summary: Presents a semantic-structural atlas of transportation research from 120K papers across 34 journals (1967-2025), using SPECTER2 embeddings and Leiden community detection to reveal that topic communities differ substantially from coauthorship clusters.

entry.title: Incentivizing Neuro-symbolic Language-based Reasoning in VLMs via Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Karthic Palaniappan

entry.summary: Explores neuro-symbolic language-based reasoning in VLMs via reinforcement learning, drawing inspiration from the movie Arrival's alien language concept. Achieves improvements on reasoning benchmarks using Qwen3-VL-2B with abstract symbolic language.

entry.title: An End-to-End Ukrainian RAG for Local Deployment. Optimized Hybrid Search and Lightweight Generation

author.name: Mykola Trokhymovych, Yana Oliinyk, Nazarii Nyzhnyk

entry.summary: Presents an efficient RAG system for Ukrainian document QA that achieved 2nd place in UNLP 2026, featuring custom two-stage retrieval, Ukrainian-specific fine-tuning on synthetic data, and model compression for local deployment.

entry.title: ParkingScenes: A Structured Dataset for End-to-End Autonomous Parking in Simulation Scenes

author.name: Haonan Chen, Kaiwen Xiao, Bin Tian, Jun Fu

entry.summary: Presents ParkingScenes, a multimodal dataset for end-to-end autonomous parking built on CARLA simulator with structured trajectories from Hybrid A* planner and MPC.

entry.title: OAMVOS:2nd Report for 5th PVUW MOSE Track

author.name: Deshui Miao, Xingsen Huang, Yameng Gu, Xiaogang yu, Xin Li, Ming-Hsuan Yang

entry.summary: Extends SAM3 tracker with occlusion- and reappearance-aware mechanisms including reliability tracking, branch recovery, and selective memory management. Targets long occlusion and small object tracking scenarios.

entry.title: LunarDepthNet: Generation of Digital Elevation Models using Deep Learning and Monocular Satellite Images

author.name: Aaranay Aadi, Jai Gopal Singla, Amitabh, Nitant Dube, Praveen Kumar Shukla, Vijaypal Singh Dhaka

entry.summary: LunarDepthNet proposes a UNet-based architecture with EfficientNet encoder to generate digital elevation models from monocular lunar surface images using Chandrayaan-2 data. Addresses scarcity of detailed lunar elevation data.

entry.title: Resource-Constrained UAV-Based Weed Detection for Site-Specific Management on Edge Devices

author.name: Linyuan Wang, Haibo Yao, Te-Ming Tseng, Kelvin Betitame, Xin Sun, Hanbo Huang, Dong Chen

entry.summary: Proposes a deployment-oriented framework for real-time UAV-based weed detection on edge platforms, systematically comparing detection model architectures under resource constraints.

entry.title: A Synergistic CNN-Transformer Network with Pooling Attention Fusion for Hyperspectral Image Classification

author.name: Peng Chen, Wenxuan He, Feng Qian, Guangyao Shi, Jingwen Yan

entry.summary: Proposes a CNN-Transformer network with pooling attention fusion for hyperspectral image classification, combining local and non-local feature extraction with information preservation across layers.

entry.title: Touchless Intraoperative Image Access System Based on Vision-Based Hand Tracking

author.name: Yin Lin, Domenico Aquino, Alberto Redaelli, Massimiliano Del Bene, Riccardo Barbieri, Simona Ferrante

entry.summary: Presents a vision-based touchless system for intraoperative medical image navigation using hand gestures captured by a single RGB camera with MediaPipe Hands.

entry.title: Infrastructure-Guided Connectivity-Enhanced Road Crack Detection and Estimation

author.name: Haosong Xiao, Yamini Ramesh, Rishabh Shukla, Swarat Sarkar, Chaozhe R. He

entry.summary: Presents a communication-enhanced road crack detection pipeline using infrastructure-to-vehicle communication to transmit regions of interest, with dynamic cropping and deep learning-based detection. Demonstrated on an experimental vehicle platform.

entry.title: Phase-Separated Complex Hilbert PCA on Markerless 3D Pose Estimation Data: A Global Phase Network and Its Extension to a Continuous Field on the Body Surface

author.name: Hiromitsu Goto, Tao Tao, Zheng-Lin Chia

entry.summary: Applies Complex Hilbert PCA to markerless 3D pose estimation data for sports motion analysis, extracting whole-body phase patterns from a single complex eigenvector. Extends to a continuous field on the body surface.

entry.title: Supporting Family-School Partnerships with Robot-Facilitated Home-Based Activities

author.name: Michael F Xu, Qiyao Yang, Heather Kirkorian, Bilge Mutlu

entry.summary: Explores robots supporting family-school partnerships through home-based activities. A week-long in-home study with 10 families evaluates how a social robot designed through co-design sessions can facilitate family communication about school topics.

entry.title: Interpretable Physics-Informed Load Forecasting for U.S. Grid Resilience: SHAP-Guided Ensemble Validation in Hybrid Deep Learning Under Extreme Weather

author.name: Md Abubakkar, Sajib Debnath, Md. Uzzal Mia

entry.summary: Proposes a physics-informed CNN-Transformer ensemble for electricity load forecasting with SHAP interpretability, incorporating temperature-demand relationships from ERCOT. Targets extreme weather resilience for U.S. grid operations.

entry.title: Meta-Ensemble Learning with Diverse Data Splits for Improved Respiratory Sound Classification

author.name: June-Woo Kim, Miika Toikkanen, Heejoon Koo, Yoon Tae Kim, Doyoung Kwon, Kyunghoon Kim

entry.summary: Proposes meta-ensemble learning for respiratory sound classification that trains base models on diverse data splits and combines them through a trained meta-model to reduce prediction correlation.

entry.title: From Equations to Algorithms and Data: Transforming Microwave Engineering and Education with Machine Learning

author.name: Mehmet Parlak, Islam Guven

entry.summary: Proposes integrating ML and data-driven electromagnetic synthesis into microwave/RFIC engineering education, arguing that traditional analytical methods are insufficient for millimeter-wave and terahertz regimes.

entry.title: A Dynamic Learning Observatory Reveals the Rapid Salinization of Satkhira, Bangladesh

author.name: Showmitra Kumar Sarkar, Sai Ravela

entry.summary: Develops ML-based framework for mapping soil salinity in coastal Bangladesh using XGBoost with satellite-derived spectral indices and field observations, with spatial cross-validation and uncertainty quantification.

entry.title: HalalBench: A Multilingual OCR Benchmark for Food Packaging Ingredient Extraction

author.name: Hasan Arief

entry.summary: Introduces HalalBench, the first multilingual OCR benchmark for food packaging with 1,043 images and 36,438 annotations in 14 languages. Evaluates four OCR engines, finding all fail on Japanese and overall F1 scores are low.

entry.title: AgentRVOS for MeViS-Text Track of 5th PVUW Challenge: 3rd Method

author.name: Deshui Miao, Chao Yang, Chao Tian, Guoqing Zhu, Kai Yang, Zhifan Mo, Xin Li

entry.summary: Describes an agent-based pipeline for referring video object segmentation using Sa2VA as core model with explicit agent roles for refinement, achieving competitive results on MeViS-Text Track.

entry.title: CNN-ViT Fusion with Adaptive Attention Gate for Brain Tumor MRI Classification: A Hybrid Deep Learning Model

author.name: Syed Ibad Hasnain, Muhammad Faris, Hafiza Syeda Yusra Tirmizi, Rabail Khowaja, Hafsa Israr

entry.summary: Hybrid CNN-ViT architecture combining SqueezeNet-style CNN with MobileViT-style transformer through an Adaptive Attention Gate for brain tumor MRI classification.

entry.title: A Topology fixated Shape Gradient Framework for Non Simple Boundary Extraction for CIE Lab color images with Repulsive Energy

author.name: Shafeequdheen Palengara, Jyotiranjan Nayak, Vijayakrishna Rowthu

entry.summary: Proposes a level-set-free image segmentation approach using modified Mumford-Shah shape gradient with repulsive functions to handle disjoint regions and self-intersection during boundary evolution.

entry.title: VDLF-Net: Variational Feature Fusion for Adaptive and Few-Shot Visual Learning

author.name: Jiawei Yan

entry.summary: VDLF-Net attaches a compact VAE to a multi-scale CNN backbone for few-shot and standard classification, using latent vectors and softmax gates to support feature maps.

entry.title: ResAF-Net: An Anchor-Free Attention-Based Network for Tree Detection and Agricultural Mapping in Palestine

author.name: Rabee Al-Qasem

entry.summary: ResAF-Net combines ResNet-50, ASPP, multi-head attention, and anchor-free FCOS detection for satellite-based tree detection in Palestine for agricultural monitoring in resource-constrained settings.

entry.title: A Lightweight Toggleable Adhesion Prototype for Multirotor UAV Landing on Tilting Platforms

author.name: Teighin Nordholt, Melissa Greeff

entry.summary: Presents a lightweight toggleable adhesion mechanism for multirotor UAV landing on tilting platforms, using a motor-driven corkscrew engaging hook-and-loop material. Evaluated on a Crazyflie platform with a tilting surface simulating wave conditions.

entry.title: OpenPodcar2: a robust, ROS2 vehicle for self-driving research

author.name: Rakshit Soni, Chris Waltham, Md Umar Ibrahim, Mark Crampton, Charles Fox

entry.summary: OpenPodcar2 is an open-source autonomous vehicle platform based on a mobility scooter with ROS2 integration and Gazebo simulation. Provides a low-cost platform for self-driving research and potential deployment.

entry.title: Otherness as a Quality in Designing Expressive Robotic Touch

author.name: Ran Zhou, Laurens Boer, Daniel Leithinger, Madeline Balaam

entry.summary: Proposes embracing the 'otherness' of robotic touch as a design quality rather than a limitation, drawing on HRI theory and design research precedents. Argues against the dominant paradigm of replicating realistic human touch in haptic technologies.

entry.title: Predicting Wind Loads on Container Ships in Harbor Environments through Multi-Fidelity Modeling

author.name: Matilde Fiore, Andrea Bresciani, Miguel Alfonso Mendez, Jeroen van Beeck

entry.summary: Proposes a multi-fidelity surrogate modeling framework for predicting wind loads on container ships, combining empirical correlations with CFD at multiple fidelity levels using recursive co-kriging.

entry.title: Impact of Age Specialized Models for Hypoglycemia Classification

author.name: Beyza Cinar, Maria Maleshkova

entry.summary: Studies age-specialized models for hypoglycemia classification in Type 1 diabetes using continuous glucose monitoring data, investigating whether age-stratified models outperform general ones.

entry.title: WISE-FM:Operation-Aware, Engineering-Informed Foundation Model for Multi-Task Well Design

author.name: Carine de Menezes Rebello, Anderson Rapello dos Santos, Idelfonso B. R. Nogueira

entry.summary: Presents WISE, a design-aware foundation model for multi-task well operations (virtual flow metering, bottomhole estimation) using FiLM conditioning and cross-modal attention on well design parameters.

entry.title: Uncovering Latent Patterns in Social Media Usage and Mental Health: A Clustering-Based Approach Using Unsupervised Machine Learning

author.name: Md All Shahria, Sanjeda Dewan Mithila, Touhid Alam, Mohammad Sakib Mahmood, Mahfuza Khatun

entry.summary: Applies unsupervised clustering to segment social media users by behavioral and psychological patterns, aiming to identify mental health risk profiles. Uses standard ML clustering algorithms.

entry.title: Attention-Augmented YOLOv8 with Ghost Convolution for Real-Time Vehicle Detection in Intelligent Transportation Systems

author.name: Syed Sajid Ullah, Muhammad Zunair Zamir, Ahsan Ishfaq, Salman Khan

entry.summary: Enhances YOLOv8n with Ghost Module, CBAM, and DCNv2 for vehicle detection, achieving 95.4% mAP@0.5 on KITTI (8.97% improvement over baseline). Targets intelligent transportation systems.

entry.title: Comparative Study of Weighted and Coupled Second- and Fourth-Order PDEs for Image Despeckling in Grayscale, Color, SAR, and Ultrasound

author.name: Manish Kumar, Rajendra K. Ray

entry.summary: Compares two PDE-based frameworks for image despeckling: weighted second/fourth-order PDE combination and coupled PDE formulation, applied to grayscale, color, SAR, and ultrasound images.

entry.title: Machine Learning and Deep Learning Models for Short Term Electricity Price Forecasting in Australia's National Electricity Market

author.name: Wei Lu, Jay Wang, Dingli Duan, Ding Mao, Caiyi Song, John Huang

entry.summary: Benchmarks six ML/DL algorithms for short-term electricity price forecasting in Australia's National Electricity Market, addressing high volatility from renewable penetration.

entry.title: Machine-Learning-Based Classification of Radio Frequency Building Loss

author.name: Jiayi Tan, Neelabhro Roy, James Gross, Rohit Chandra, Tsao-Tsen Chen

entry.summary: Presents an ML framework for classifying radio frequency building loss using crowdsourced UE data and public building information, comparing supervised and semi-supervised approaches.

entry.title: SolarTformer: A Transformer Based Deep Learning Approach for Short Term Solar Power Forecasting

author.name: Ankan Basu, Jyotiraditya Roy, Aditya Datta, Prayas Sanyal, Sumanta Banerjee

entry.summary: Applies transformer-based model (SolarTformer) with self-attention for short-term solar power forecasting from meteorological data, incorporating station-specific metadata for cross-station generalization.

entry.title: An Aircraft Upset Recovery System with Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Mahir Demir, Atahan Cilan, Seyyid Osman Sevgili, \"Ozg\"un Can Y\"ur\"utken, \"Umit Can Bekar

entry.summary: Develops a pilot-activated recovery system for jet trainers using Soft Actor-Critic RL with domain expert-crafted rewards including negative-g penalties.

entry.title: IoT-Enhanced CNN-Based Labelled Crack Detection for Additive Manufacturing Image Annotation in Industry 4.0

author.name: Mohsen Asghari Ilani, Yaser Mike Banad

entry.summary: Presents an IoT-enhanced CNN framework for automated crack detection in additive manufacturing surfaces, achieving 99.54% accuracy on ~15K images. Integrates edge computing for real-time in-situ defect detection.

entry.title: Curious cases of financial engineering in biotech

author.name: Abhishaike Mahajan

entry.summary: Explores creative financial engineering structures in biotech that help manage the extremely high-risk, high-cost nature of drug development. Examines how structural tricks like royalty financing, contingent value rights, and other mechanisms make the drug development 'lottery' more playable.

entry.title: Perfecting Aircraft Maneuvers with Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Atahan Cilan, Mahir Demir, \"Ozg\"un Can Y\"ur\"utken, Seyyid Osman Sevgili, \"Umit Can Bekar

entry.summary: Applies RL for aircraft aerobatic maneuver simulation as a pilot training tool for advanced jet trainers.

entry.title: From graphemic dependence to lexical structure: a Markovian perspective on Dante's Commedia

author.name: Angelo Maria Sabatini

entry.summary: Analyzes the graphemic structure of Dante's Divina Commedia using vowel-consonant encoding and Markov chain modeling. Finds a slight but consistent increase in graphemic memory from Inferno to Paradiso.

entry.title: Vision-Based Lane Following and Traffic Sign Recognition for Resource-Constrained Autonomous Vehicles

author.name: Md Tanjemul Islam, Md Rafiul Kabir

entry.summary: Presents a lightweight vision-based framework for lane detection, tracking, and traffic sign recognition on embedded autonomous vehicles using threshold-based methods and perspective transformation.

entry.title: On Common Misconceptions in Classical Vehicle Dynamics

author.name: Massimo Guiggiani

entry.summary: A pedagogical paper revisiting common misconceptions in classical vehicle dynamics, clarifying domains of validity and highlighting sources of misunderstanding under rigorous mechanical frameworks.

entry.title: Language models know what matters and the foundations of ethics better than you

author.name: Michele Campolo

entry.summary: Presents examples of various LLMs responding to prompts about ethics and what matters, arguing that models tend to converge on suffering, wellbeing, and consciousness as foundational ethical concepts. Claims this suggests something meaningful about ethical foundations.

entry.title: Empirical Ablation and Ensemble Optimization of a Convolutional Neural Network for CIFAR-10 Classification

author.name: Naser Khatti Dizabadi

entry.summary: Presents an ablation study of CNN optimization for CIFAR-10, evaluating 17 progressive modifications to identify which architectural and training changes improve generalization.

entry.title: From nothing to important actions: agents that act morally

author.name: Michele Campolo

entry.summary: Philosophical exploration of consciousness, moral agency, and the foundations of ethics, using thought experiments about visual experience and a hypothetical 'consciousness device.' Not primarily about AI.

entry.title: In defense of parents

author.name: Yair Halberstadt

entry.summary: A parenting philosophy post responding to Aella's arguments about children's autonomy, arguing that parents face genuine coordination problems and practical constraints that make full respect for children's independence difficult.

entry.title: The Case For Universalism

author.name: Rishabh.ambavanekar@gmail.com

entry.summary: Proposes 'Universalism' as a philosophical framework arguing that humanity's proper purpose is to acquire all cosmic knowledge before committing to specific ideologies. Critiques nihilism, existentialism, and other philosophies.

entry.title: Stop being a pussy

author.name: Natalie Cargill

entry.summary: Writing advice post inspired by Scott Alexander, arguing against hedging and equivocation in writing. Essentially advocates for directness and confidence in prose.

entry.title: Massapequa ACX Meetup

author.name: Gabriel Weil

entry.summary: Announcement for an ACX meetup in Massapequa, NY on May 9th.
